article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết không còn theo mùa, chuyên gia cảnh báo nguy cơ mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever is no longer seasonal; experts warn of a new risk.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is year-round in Vietnam, with over 170,000 suspected cases and 21 deaths since January 2026. Transmission occurs monthly nationwide, linked to climate change and longer rainy seasons. In Hanoi, Thanh Nhàn Hospital treats 20 dengue patients; cases are down from earlier years but higher than last year, and severity may rise in people with underlying conditions. A 47-year-old man from Bạch Mai, Hanoi, was hospitalized for a third dengue episode, with headache and fever (38–39°C); labs showed mild anemia and severe hyponatremia (120), prompting evaluation for a malignancy. Professor Nguyen Van Kinh says dengue is now endemic in Vietnam; vector control remains challenging as Aedes mosquitoes persist via transovarial transmission. Health monitoring uses Breteau index; early management focuses on fever control and hydration, while days 4–7 require vigilance for complications such as thrombocytopenia, liver enzyme elevation, plasma leakage, and myocarditis risk. Children and the elderly need care.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱はもはや季節性ではない、専門家が新たなリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでデング熱が季節性から通年発生へ変化しており、年初来17万件超・死亡21人と規模が大きく、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常な疫学的変化が認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 疾患名にSFTS Virusが含まれるが、記事内容はデング熱のみに言及しておりSFTSに関する記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Two Plasmodium falciparum Gene Variants Modestly Associate With Severe
article.articleSummary: Plasmodium falciparum cbp1 and cbp2, genes encoding CX3CL1-binding proteins, show non-coding polymorphisms modestly linked to malaria severity in Thailand. In a cohort of 473 clinical isolates from patients with mild malaria, cerebral malaria, or severe malaria without cerebral complications, cbp1 379 C/T (intron near the splicing site) associated with cerebral malaria (odds ratio 1.99, 95% CI 1.03–3.85). cbp2 2306 A/T (3′ UTR) associated with severe malaria without cerebral complications (OR 6.67, 95% CI 1.28–34.73). Parasite density did not differ across cbp1/cbp2 genotypes. Genomic analysis found high conservation: cbp1 had nine SNPs (three coding synonymous), cbp2 had three non-coding SNPs and nine microsatellites, with no coding variants in cbp2. Illumina sequencing of 30 isolates guided broader genotyping by PCR-RFLP and Sanger on 473 samples. Authors call for functional studies to understand how these non-coding variants influence host–parasite interactions and disease severity.

triage.headline_ja: 2つのPlasmodium falciparum遺伝子変異が重症マラリアと緩やかに関連
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はタイにおける既存マラリア患者コホートを用いた遺伝子多型と重症度の関連を調べた基礎研究であり、公衆衛生上の新規脅威やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 研究対象はタイの既存臨床検体コホート(473例)を用いた遺伝学的解析であり、新規の発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、発生地域フィールドに関わらずverified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: 수억 달러 지원에도 에볼라 확산 못 막아...방역 현장은 인력·장비 부족 - 시사저널
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Even with hundreds of millions of dollars in aid, the spread of Ebola couldn't be contained... The disease-control frontline is short of personnel and equipment - Sisa Journal
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Democratic Republic of Congo's second-largest Ebola outbreak, transmission remains uncontained despite hundreds of millions in aid. In Ituri, Haut-Uele and North Kivu provinces, frontline responders report severe shortages of personnel, medical supplies, and equipment, with some staff unpaid and ambulances running on fuel shortages. Healthcare workers treat suspected cases without adequate materials. MSF warns that despite large funding, many frontline teams lack gear and salaries, hampering containment. Surveillance gaps persist: despite resource allocations, several areas are neglected, and about two-thirds of Ebola deaths in the past month occurred outside treatment centers, delaying detection and isolation. Only 9% of MSF-treated patients were previously identified as contacts. Basic disinfection gear and PPE are scarce in Beni (North Kivu) and Haut-Uele, where 75% of facility infections occurred. Private clinics, pharmacies, and traditional healers remain largely outside response plans. Cases exceed 11,000; deaths exceed 5,000. Vaccines and therapies trials show progress, but urgent needs include transparent resource management and stronger on-the-ground staff support by the DRC government and UN.

triage.headline_ja: 数億ドルの支援にもかかわらずエボラの拡大を抑えられず…防疫現場は人員・装備不足 - シサジャーナル
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目規模のエボラ流行が6か月継続し、死亡5000例超・症例11000例超と深刻。人員・物資不足で制御不能な状態が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: Ituri、Haut-Uele、North Kivu州にまたがる大規模流行。MSF・UN等の国際機関が関与しており、資源不足と監視体制の不備が指摘されている。感染経路の多くが未接触者からのもので、地域社会への浸透度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Tosse persistente merece atenção: conheça os sinais da tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Persistent cough warrants attention: learn the signs of tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Persistent cough lasting three weeks or more is the key warning sign of tuberculosis (TB), an airborne lung disease caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis (the Koch bacillus) that can also cause afternoon fever, night sweats, and weight loss. In Brazil, TB is curable with treatment lasting at least six months and provided free by the Unified Health System (SUS); patients should complete therapy and not discontinue it. Diagnosis requires clinical evaluation plus laboratory tests and chest X-ray; tests include rapid molecular testing, sputum smear microscopy (bacilloscopy), and culture. Active pulmonary or laryngeal TB can release bacteria into the air when coughing, sneezing or talking, enabling transmission to close contacts; sharing cups or utensils is not a major transmission route. Prevention includes BCG vaccination in childhood, well-ventilated spaces, and cough etiquette. Health teams may screen contacts for latent infection and provide preventive treatment when indicated.

triage.headline_ja: 持続する咳には注意が必要：結核の兆候を知る
triage.triage_reason: 一般向けの結核啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態を報じるものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の症状・予防・治療に関する一般的な健康啓発情報であり、ブラジルにおける具体的な発生イベントや症例数の増加を報告していない。

article.articleHeadline: 三种毒株同时流行 别把得过一次流感当"护身符" -泉州网|泉州晚报社 泉州新闻门户网站
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three influenza strains circulating simultaneously; don't treat having had influenza once as a 'protective talisman'.
article.articleSummary: China’s influenza surveillance shows three strains co-circulating nationwide: A(H3N2), A(H1N1), and B/Victoria. Positive detections have risen in both southern and northern provinces; this season began early with multi-strain circulation, breaking the previous single-dominant pattern. In Quanzhou, Fujian, influenza activity is at a mid-season level and has not reached a peak. Children, especially infants and preschoolers, are most affected. A(H3N2) and B/Victoria are distinct strains, and infection with one does not confer protection against others. Typical symptoms include sudden high fever (up to 40°C), cough and fatigue; fever lasts 3–5 days and overall illness may take 1–2 weeks, with gastrointestinal symptoms more common in children with B. Antiviral treatment is most effective within 48 hours of onset; oseltamivir and baloxavir remain generally effective. Antibiotics do not treat influenza. Early vaccination (6 months and older) is recommended, along with routine preventive measures (hand hygiene, ventilation, masking, and avoiding crowded settings).

triage.headline_ja: 3種類のインフルエンザ株が同時流行中、一度罹患した経験を『お守り』にしないで
triage.triage_reason: 既知の季節性インフルエンザ(A/H3N2, A/H1N1, B/Victoria)の複数株同時流行に関する定期サーベイランス報告であり、新興感染症としての異常性は限定的だが、早期シーズン開始という異例な流行パターンのため今後の推移を注視する。
triage.notes: 既知の季節性インフルエンザ株による国内サーベイランス報告。重症例・死亡例の急増や新規変異株の報告はなく、中国衛生当局による一般市民向け予防啓発記事の性格が強い。抗ウイルス薬・ワクチンによる対応が可能であり、国際支援の必要性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 中国疫情拉警报 中青年重症率高出近5倍
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's outbreak raises alarm as the severe illness rate among young and middle-aged adults is nearly five times higher.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in China is driven by a virulent emergent variant PJ.2.1 with widespread southern spread. Researchers report the severe-illness rate among young and middle-aged adults is nearly five times higher than in earlier waves, and post‑infection sequelae are common, with recurrent hospitalizations and escalating cardiovascular and pulmonary damage. In Shenzhen, wastewater surveillance detected PJ.2.1 in late October; international agencies had flagged the variant, but authorities reportedly suppressed reporting. Guangdong, Sichuan, and Chongqing show sustained transmission; Beijing and Shanghai wastewater data have risen, while Xinjiang, the Northeast, Yunnan, and Guizhou report ongoing activity amid cold, foggy weather. Long‑term sequelae among Shenzhen patients rose from about 30% to 50%. A 35-year-old patient in Yunnan illustrates enduring impairment, requiring oxygen and repeated hospitalizations following prior severe pneumonia.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で感染拡大、警報発令――若年・中年層の重症化率が約5倍に上昇
triage.triage_reason: 新規変異株PJ.2.1による重症化率の急上昇（若年・中年層で約5倍）、複数省での持続的な感染拡大、当局による報告抑制の疑いがあり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は中国語の非公式メディア（阿波羅網）による報道であり、公式統計や査読済みデータに基づく確認が取れていない点に留意。国際機関が当該変異株（PJ.2.1）を既に把握していたとの記述があり、WHO等の公式情報との照合が必要。当局による報告抑制の指摘は社会的・政治的関心を高める要因だが、事実確認が不可欠。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de covid-19 caem na Baixada Santista, apesar de alta no Estado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases fall in Baixada Santista, despite a rise in the state.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases fall in Baixada Santista despite a state-wide rise in SRAG (COVID-19–related). Fiocruz data for the first seven days of November show six municipalities not following the statewide upsurge. Santos registered only 3 of this year’s 85 confirmed cases from September–November, with a peak of 23 in June and 14 in January and May. São Vicente has 19 cases this year (largest in January, 7); Mongaguá, 16; Guarujá, 56 (down from 190 in 2025); Itanhaém, 30; Cubatão, 84 through October (peak 29 in May). Praia Grande, Bertioga and Peruíbe did not report. Santos notes a 64.8% drop in cases January–October vs last year and hospitalizations down 78.3% (8 vs 37); one COVID-19 death this year (two in 2025). Vaccination remains available in the region, prioritized for young children and older adults, with age-based dosing schedules.

triage.headline_ja: バイダダ・サンティスタ地域でCOVID-19症例が減少、州全体では増加傾向
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的な症例増減に関する定例的な統計報告であり、異常性・重症度・国際的拡大リスクはなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認されない。
triage.notes: 既知の病原体（COVID-19）に関する地域統計レポートであり、症例数は減少傾向、死亡者数も低い。ブラジルの特定地域（サンパウロ州沿岸部）に限定された定例報告でパンデミック新展開ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 这些不起眼的习惯正在悄悄助长"超级细菌"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: These inconspicuous habits are quietly fueling "superbugs".
article.articleSummary: AMR and 'superbugs' threaten health worldwide. In China, two national action plans guide response. The 2016–2020 plan tightened regulation of antimicrobial use across healthcare, farming, and manufacturing, and boosted public education. The 2022–2025 plan expands to all microorganisms, with nine measurable indicators, including 80% public AMR awareness, 60% correct antimicrobial use, school health coverage, ≥75% hospital prescribing appropriateness, and 100% prescription-only antimicrobial sales at retail. Progress includes lower antibiotic prescription rates and higher rational use, with resistance decreasing as China moves from an antibiotic powerhouse to a rational-use nation. Challenges remain: public misperceptions that antibiotics treat viral infections, ongoing irrational use at community level, and new resistance mechanisms with some superbugs resistant to most drugs. Four recommended actions for individuals: avoid self-medication or stopping antibiotics; don’t treat viruses with antibiotics; wash hands, maintain hygiene, vaccinate; and educate others.

triage.headline_ja: これらの些細な習慣が静かに「スーパーバグ」を助長している
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、中国におけるAMR対策の啓発記事であり、緊急性のある公衆衛生イベントは報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は薬剤耐性菌(AMR)対策に関する一般的な啓発・政策解説記事であり、具体的な発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告はない。中国政府のAMR対策計画の進捗と課題を紹介する内容。

article.articleHeadline: Otra vez el dengue: más de 100.000 casos y una respuesta que sigue en deuda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Again: More Than 100,000 Cases and a Response Still in Debt.
article.articleSummary: Colombia reports 102,415 dengue cases and 76 deaths confirmed (31 under investigation) as of November 10, per INS. For 2025, the country tallies 120,535 cases, with 2024’s 313,952 representing a record year. The outbreak persists as Aedes aegypti extends to higher elevations and transmission seasons lengthen, while authorities remain heavily dependent on fumigation and urged to implement a comprehensive, integrated control strategy. Regional data show hotspot variation when using incidence per 100,000: Amazonas 1,878 (193% increase), Magdalena 1,176 (238%), Meta 1,682 (56%), Bolívar 954; Barranquilla 3,311 cases (250/100k, +24%), Santa Marta up 204%; Antioquia 75/100k (fewer cases despite high counts), Tolima 302, Chocó 270, Cali 52, Risaralda 26. All four dengue serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4) circulate concurrently, heightening outbreak potential across Colombia.

triage.headline_ja: 再びデング熱：10万件を超える症例と、依然として不十分な対応
triage.triage_reason: コロンビアで10万件超のデング熱症例と76人の死亡が確認され、4血清型が同時流行し、媒介蚊の生息域拡大や季節延長など流行が悪化しており、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 本イベントはコロンビアで発生しており、Bluedotの発生地域にBrazilが含まれるが記事本文はコロンビアの状況のみを扱っているため除外した。コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Quem deve tomar uma nova dose da vacina diante do aumento de casos de covid
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Who should receive another dose of the vaccine in light of the rise in COVID-19 cases
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports rising severe COVID-19 cases across five states and the Federal District as of 2026-11-17. Infectologist Rosana Richtmann urges priority-group individuals to check their last vaccine dose and seek public health services if they have not received a booster in the past six months. Priority groups include people over 60, cancer patients or those on immunosuppressive therapies, pregnant women, and children starting vaccination at six months of age. The key criterion is time since last dose, not dose count. While cases rise, experts say this is not a 2020-level crisis; the virus continues to circulate and may yield more transmissible variants. Fiocruz notes increases in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome requiring hospitalization among vulnerable individuals. Testing and masking are advised for those around the elderly or immunocompromised to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19感染者増加を受け、誰がワクチンの追加接種を受けるべきか
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でCOVID-19重症例が複数州で増加しているが、COVID-19自体は既知の疾患であり国際的な異常性・拡大リスクは低い。脆弱層への注意喚起レベルであり続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 既知のCOVID-19流行の季節的増加と考えられ、既存の公衆衛生対応（ワクチン接種呼びかけ）で管理可能とみられる。新規変異株の出現有無など続報を注視。

article.articleHeadline: 인도서 또 조류독감 발병...닭 등 가금류 집단폐사 잇달아
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another avian influenza outbreak in India... mass die-offs of poultry, including chickens, in quick succession.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (H5N1) outbreak confirmed in Tamil Nadu, India, after mass poultry deaths. The National Institute verified infections in poultry from farms in the Kudalur–Kurjinchipadi region, about 210 km south of Chennai, with initial deaths reported on Oct 30. In response, authorities culled birds on infected farms and imposed a 90-day ban on bringing in or rearing new poultry in the area. Tamiflu (oseltamivir) prophylaxis was distributed to farm workers and handlers. The Chennai Zoo at Vandalur had been closed weeks earlier after infections among animals. The current dead stock comprises young birds aged 25–35 days, while market birds are typically 65–70 days old. Officials say there is no need for public panic. Avian influenza is highly contagious; human infections are rare. India experiences recurring outbreaks along migratory routes, including a 2021 human case in an 11-year-old boy.

triage.headline_ja: インドで再び鳥インフルエンザ発生…鶏など家禽の大量死が相次ぐ
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州でH5N1による家禽大量死が確認され、90日間の家禽導入禁止措置や殺処分、予防投薬など当局の積極対応が取られており、社会的関心も見られるためフルRRAでの確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 現時点でヒト感染例の報告はなく、当局も公衆のパニックは不要としている。インドでは渡り鳥ルート沿いで鳥インフルエンザが周期的に発生しており、2021年には11歳男児のヒト感染例もあるため、今後の感染拡大状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Machine Learning and Positive Numerical Solvers Forecast Ghana Pandemic
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 forecasts five-day case trajectories in Ghana with ~10% average error using a hybrid framework that couples unconditionally positive numerical solvers with machine-learning optimization. Researchers Izgin-Melnikov, Meister, and Azure published in Journal of Mathematics in Industry. They unify five regional COVID-19 models into an eleven-compartment ODE system: Susceptible, Vaccinated, Exposed, Latent/asymptomatic, Hospitalized, Infected, Recovered, Quarantined, Deceased (general), Deceased (COVID-19 specific), and environmental viral load. The model uses production-destruction-rest decomposition to preserve non-negativity and conservation of transfers between living compartments, avoiding negative counts. Modified Patankar-RK schemes are embedded inside a Bayesian optimization loop to extract time-varying transmission parameters from observed infections and fatalities. Contextualizing early pandemic, they reference SARS-CoV-2 dynamics; environmental persistence on surfaces up to 96 hours. The work targets robust short-term forecasts to guide health interventions in resource-constrained settings like Ghana, Senegal, Pakistan, and the United States.

triage.headline_ja: 機械学習と正値数値解法によるガーナのパンデミック予測
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は数理モデル・機械学習による予測手法に関する学術研究報告であり、実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の異常事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は学術論文（Journal of Mathematics in Industry掲載）の紹介であり、COVID-19の新規発生や流行状況の報告ではないため、実発生国としての対象国は該当なしと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: കാര്യവട്ടം ക്യാംപസിൽ ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി പടരുന്നു; രോഗം കണ്ടെത്തിയത് 13 പേർക്ക്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever spreading on Karyavattom campus; 13 people diagnosed.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is spreading on Thiruvananthapuram’s Karyavattom campus, with 13 confirmed cases in the past week—10 students and 3 staff. Transmission is centered in the campus hostels/dormitories, and several students who had returned home on leave are also ill. Students claim unsanitary conditions are driving the outbreak, but university authorities had not acted on these complaints. In response to the outbreak, the college and hostels have been closed and classes moved entirely online. A meeting was held yesterday between the university Syndicate and health department authorities to decide on further steps. No other diseases or locations are emphasized beyond this dengue cluster on the campus. The report highlights ongoing outbreak management decisions in a university setting within Kerala, India.

triage.headline_ja: カーリヤーヴァットムキャンパスでデング熱が拡大、13人感染確認
triage.triage_reason: 単一キャンパス内の小規模クラスター（13例）で地域限定的だが、デング熱は風土病でありヒト-ヒト感染のリスクも低いため、IHR基準には該当しない。衛生状態の問題が指摘されており経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: キャンパス内の衛生状態不良がデング熱蔓延の一因とされ、大学・保健当局が対応会議を実施。学校閉鎖・オンライン授業移行済み。重症例・死亡例の報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: اخبارك نت | اتساع تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو.. هجمات مسلحة تفقد السلطات السيطرة على ألف مخالط
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Akhbarak Net | The Ebola outbreak widens in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Armed attacks leave authorities unable to control a thousand contacts.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo widens as insecurity and armed attacks in North Kivu disrupt surveillance and contact tracing. Over 11,000 cases and more than 5,400 deaths reported since the outbreak began, with 400–500 new infections weekly. An attack on Kantine-Aloya in North Kivu killed 66 civilians, including 3 health workers, and three health facilities were looted or burned. The World Health Organization warns that ongoing violence and displacement impede access for medical teams and hinder case investigation, noting more than 80 attacks on health services since the outbreak. Loss of contact with over 1,000 contacts of confirmed cases threatens early detection and containment, especially in conflict-affected and displaced areas. Children account for more than a quarter of confirmed infections and about one-third of deaths, with under-five fatality around 70%. WHO cautions that progress in some areas does not equal nationwide control, and continued violence could erode gains.

triage.headline_ja: アクバラク・ネット｜コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ流行が拡大…武装攻撃により当局が1000人の濃厚接触者の追跡を喪失
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における大規模エボラアウトブレイク（症例1万1000人超、死亡5400人超）が武装勢力の攻撃により拡大・制御不能化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 北キブ州での武装攻撃により保健医療従事者を含む民間人66人が死亡、保健施設3カ所が破壊され、1000人超の濃厚接触者との接触が途絶。5歳未満の致死率は約70%と極めて高く、WHOは一部地域での進展が全国的な制御を意味しないと警告している。国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限の直接的言及はないが、過去の事例からリスクは高いと推定される。

article.articleHeadline: Candidate vaccine by SII, Oxford varsity to join Ebola trial: WHO
article.articleSummary: On 17 November 2026, WHO announced that two vaccine candidates—ChAdOx1 (Oxford University/Serum Institute of India) and Moderna's mRNA-1469—will join the Tumaini Ebola trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to target Bundibugyo virus driving the outbreak. This marks the first evaluation of vaccines specifically designed for Bundibugyo during an outbreak. Trials proceed after national approvals; INRB leads with support from the University of Antwerp, MSF, WHO, Epicentre, Institute of Tropical Medicine Antwerp, and Africa CDC, under CEPI funding. Tumaini uses a ring-vaccination design testing multiple candidates; four rings are in place for contacts of confirmed cases. Ervebo was the first vaccine in Tumaini to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo. Separately, the PARTNERS trial is assessing MBP134 and remdesivir, with maftivimab to be added and Obeldesivir for post-exposure prophylaxis. Vaccine results expected early 2027; treatment results in coming months.

triage.headline_ja: インド血清研究所とオックスフォード大学のワクチン候補、エボラ治験に参加へ：WHO
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のDRCエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクに対する新規ワクチン候補の治験参加であり、重症度の高い感染症の流行対応として国際機関・複数国が関与しているためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: ベルギー・インド・英国はワクチン開発機関（オックスフォード大学、インド血清研究所等）の所在地であり、エボラ発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。実際の発生・治験実施国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu fully contained, says Minister Kamali
article.articleSummary: Bird flu in Tamil Nadu is reported as fully contained, with no current cases in the state as of 17 November 2026. In Cuddalore district, preventive measures were implemented after symptoms were detected, and authorities say the spread has been completely contained. Minister for Animal Husbandry S Kamali, after inspecting the Kolanthagoundanur veterinary hospital, stated that there are no ongoing outbreaks in Tamil Nadu. The report also notes government schemes unrelated to the outbreak, including a goat-distribution program and efforts to renovate a veterinary dispensary in Karur district, along with stockpiles of medicines in Karur's veterinary hospitals. Kamali also announced compensation provisions for farmers whose livestock die from natural calamities or stray dog attacks and described a state plan to sterilise 10 lakh stray dogs (3 lakh already covered) with a district-wise drive planned. There are 2,000 vacancies in the Animal Husbandry Department to be filled soon.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザは完全に封じ込められたとカマリ大臣が発言
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザは既に完全に封じ込められ、現時点で発生事例はないと当局が発表しており、ヒトへの感染や国際的拡大の懸念も示されていない。
triage.notes: 動物（家禽）における鳥インフルエンザ事例であり、既に封じ込め完了と報告されている。ヒト感染の言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: തിരുവനന്തപുരം കാര്യവട്ടം ക്യാമ്പസ് ഹോസ്റ്റലില്‍ ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി പടരുന്നു; കോളജ് അടച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever spreading at the Kariyavattom campus hostel in Thiruvananthapuram; college closed.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is spreading at Kerala University’s Kariyavattom campus hostel in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. In the past week, 13 individuals have tested positive, including 10 students and 3 staff, with many others exhibiting dengue-like symptoms. With transmission described as uncontrolled, the college and hostel have been closed. A joint decision by the university syndicate and health department, made yesterday, ordered a full shift to online classes and comprehensive hostel fumigation to curb spread. The outbreak is ongoing, and several students who had returned home for holidays have developed fever. No fatalities are reported in the article. The response focuses on laboratory-confirmed dengue cases and containment: online classes, campus-wide fogging, and closure of facilities to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ティルヴァナンタプラムのカリヤヴァットムキャンパス寮でデング熱が拡大、大学閉鎖

triage.notes: ケララ州の大学キャンパスにおける限定的なデング熱アウトブレイク。地域の風土病であり、インド全体や国際的な拡大の情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: PMC to vaccinate 3.16 lakh children against polio on November 22
article.articleSummary: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) will conduct a sub-national pulse polio campaign in Pune on November 22 to vaccinate 316,275 children under five years old. A total of 1,367 vaccination booths will operate from 8 am to 5 pm across the city, with health teams visiting homes to ensure no child is left out. Parents are urged to bring all eligible children for two drops of polio vaccine, even if routine immunisations have been completed. Dr. Nina Borade, PMC health chief, notes polio is a contagious viral disease that can cause permanent paralysis in young children. With the virus still present in some countries, officials emphasize ongoing vaccination to safeguard India’s polio-free status.

triage.notes: 記事は予防的なポリオワクチン接種キャンペーン（定期活動）についてのものであり、実際の感染症発生事例ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。インドはポリオフリー status を維持するための通常の公衆衛生活動であり、シグナルとして扱う必要はない。

article.articleHeadline: Sumenep perkuat perlindungan kesehatan anak melalui vaksinasi DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sumenep strengthens children's health protection through dengue vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Dengue vaccination for children was launched in Sumenep, East Java, on November 12, 2026, by Regent Achmad Fauzi Wongsojudo at SD Negeri Kebundadap, Saronggi. The program targets reducing dengue transmission by immunizing children, amid data showing most hospitalized dengue patients in Sumenep are youths. As of October 2026, Sumenep reported 483 dengue cases and 3 deaths. In addition to vaccination, the local health office (Dinkes-P2KB) intensified the 3M campaign—drain regularly bathtubs, cover containers, and bury discarded items that collect rainwater—to curb Aedes aegypti breeding. Medical staff across 27 districts and both mainland and island areas have been mobilized to fumigate around homes. The vaccination aims to reinforce early-life health protections and prevent dengue spread through integrated public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: スメネップ、デング熱ワクチン接種で子どもの健康保護を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・スメネップでの季節性デング熱流行に対する通常のワクチン接種・防疫プログラムの開始報道であり、異常性や社会的関心の高まりは認められないが、蚊媒介感染症の継続的曝露リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアの風土病であり、本記事は地方自治体による通常のワクチン接種・防疫キャンペーンの開始を報じるもの。483例・3死亡は地域の季節性流行の範囲内とみられ、国際的な注目や緊急対応を要する兆候は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: آنفلوآنزا در مبتلایان به دیابت می‌تواند نگران‌کننده باشد !
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza in people with diabetes can be concerning!
article.articleSummary: Influenza in people with diabetes can be concerning. The Fartak News article notes that influenza-like illness in diabetics requires vigilant self-care and tight blood glucose management. Diabetes often involves unstable glucose, which can cause inflammation, impair immunity, and slow recovery if not controlled. During influenza, glucose levels may fluctuate due to reduced appetite, fatigue, and dehydration, so diabetics should monitor blood sugar every four hours and maintain appropriate nutrition. Hydration is crucial, preferably with beverages that do not raise glucose. Warning signs needing closer medical attention include frequent urination, dry mouth, dizziness, abdominal pain, nausea, weight loss, reduced consciousness, and fever with elevated blood glucose. Some over-the-counter medicines, such as decongestants and cough syrups, may affect glucose levels; consult a physician before use. The Times of India is cited regarding potential glucose-raising effects of OTC meds. No specific case counts or local outbreak details are provided.

article.articleSummary: Dengue fever spreading at Kerala University’s Karyavattom campus in Thiruvananthapuram, with the college and hostel closed to contain the outbreak. As of 17 November 2026, 13 people have tested positive in a week—10 students and 3 staff initially. The Syndicate and Health Department decided to shift all classes online and to fog the hostel as part of containment. Several others remain symptomatic, and some students who had returned home for holidays have developed fever. The aggressive campus response emphasizes vector control and classroom disruption to halt transmission; further details on infection source or imported/exported cases were not provided in the update.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo claims 5,568 lives as cases surpass 11,000
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has surpassed 11,000 cases with 5,568 deaths as of the latest report published 2026-11-17. In the last 24 hours, 60 new infections and 36 deaths were recorded, underscoring ongoing transmission six-plus months after the outbreak's initial declaration in April 2026. Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention Director-General Jean Kaseya warned the outbreak remains out of control, citing challenges including attacks on healthcare workers, delayed salary payments to medical staff, and critical resource shortages. There is no vaccine or treatment licensed specifically for Bundibugyo Ebola yet. The report emphasizes persistent spread and response obstacles. In related notes, Kenya reported discharge of its last Ebola patient and awaits an outbreak-free status.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、死者5,568人・感染者11,000人超に
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が11,000例・死者5,568人を超え、Africa CDCが「制御不能」と警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアでの患者退院報告は越境感染の懸念材料だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・治療薬が未承認である点も流行制御困難性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: 三种毒株同时活跃 流感季这些防护要点请收好
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three strains circulating simultaneously: Key protective measures for the flu season.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-17, influenza activity in China is rising with three strains co-circulating: A(H3N2) predominates, A(H1N1) rising in neighboring countries, and influenza B also present, potentially weakening cross-protection and prolonging the season. High-risk groups include adults ≥65, children ≤5, pregnant/perinatal women, immunocompromised individuals, those with chronic diseases, and obesity. Common symptoms for influenza A and B include fever, sore throat, cough, myalgia, and fatigue; children with A(H1N1) may have more GI symptoms. Vaccination remains the best prevention and should not be delayed; trivalent inactivated vaccines can be co-administered with other inactivated vaccines at different sites, while live nasal vaccines require a 28-day interval from other live vaccines. Rabies vaccination takes priority when needed. Antivirals (oseltamivir and baloxavir) are effective within 48 hours; do not self-medicate or stop early. Post-fever rest is advised, with avoidance of strenuous exercise for 1–3 weeks and vigilance for lingering cough or myocarditis symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 三種類のウイルス株が同時流行：インフルエンザシーズンの予防対策まとめ
triage.triage_reason: 中国における季節性インフルエンザ（A/H3N2、A/H1N1、B型）の同時流行に関する定例的な予防啓発記事であり、重症化や異常な拡大の報告はなく、新興感染症シグナルとしての特徴に乏しい。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの複数株同時流行は例年見られる現象であり、本記事は一般向けの予防啓発情報が主体。重症例急増や異常なクラスター発生の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: 韓, 13년 연속 홍역 퇴치국 인증..."대응 능력 우수"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Korea certified as a measles-elimination country for 13 consecutive years... "Excellent response capability."
article.articleSummary: South Korea was certified by the WHO as a measles-elimination country for 13 consecutive years, a status reaffirmed by the WHO Western Pacific Regional Office after a Jakarta verification committee meeting (Sept 7–11), recognizing no domestic transmission since the elimination program began in 2014. In the first half of 2025–2026, Korea reported 86 measles cases imported from abroad: 61 infections contracted abroad and 25 cases transmitted domestically from imported cases. The WHO commended Korea’s sustained high vaccination coverage, rapid isolation of cases, and effective contact tracing and laboratory surveillance, which underpin the elimination status. Given global measles outbreaks across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Southeast Asia, and the Western Pacific, Korea designates 107 countries as measles quarantine-control regions; travelers from these areas should report symptoms on arrival via Q-code/health-status forms. KDCA pledges continued vaccination and import surveillance to sustain elimination.

triage.headline_ja: 韓国、13年連続麻疹排除国に認証…「対応能力優秀」
triage.triage_reason: 韓国が麻疹排除国として認証されたという肯定的な公衆衛生成果の報道であり、新規の異常事態や公衆衛生リスクの発生を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国の麻疹排除認証に関する内容で、対象国リストに韓国は含まれない。輸入症例数（86例）は言及されているが新規アウトブレイクではなく既存の管理体制の成果報告。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de mpox aumentam 91% no Distrito Federal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox cases rise 91% in the Federal District.
article.articleSummary: Mpox cases in the Federal District, Brazil, rose 91% to 44 as of November 12, with no deaths reported, reflecting a national upward trend. Officials caution that current data do not confirm sustained community transmission or a localized outbreak. The SES-DF emphasizes intensified epidemiologic surveillance, case linkage, and contact tracing. Vaccination: 100 mpox doses arrived on November 9 from the Ministry of Health. In the initial phase, vaccination targets immunocompromised individuals—people living with HIV/AIDS aged 18+ with CD4 counts below 100 cells/mm³—and about 150 DF residents meet this criterion. The two-dose schedule has a 28-day interval. Additional vaccination may be offered to those with medium- or high-risk exposure after surveillance assessment. Mpox is caused by Monkeypox virus (MPXV); symptoms include rash and skin lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, and fatigue; transmission via close contact, including prolonged close contact, and intimate or sexual contact.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦直轄区でMpox症例が91%増加
triage.triage_reason: 国内の上昇傾向の一部であり死亡例もないが、免疫不全者への対応やワクチン接種開始など公衆衛生上の継続的な注視が必要なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 当局は持続的な地域内感染（コミュニティ伝播）は確認されていないとしており、免疫不全者（HIV陽性でCD4<100）を対象とした限定的なワクチン接種が開始された段階。国際的な拡大や渡航制限の兆候は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: ES Hoje 17/11: Tuberculose desafia diagnóstico e tratamento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ES Today November 17: Tuberculosis challenges diagnosis and treatment.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis challenges diagnosis and treatment in the state, with 1,916 cases and 113 deaths reported in 2025, as late diagnosis raises concerns among specialists. The World Health Organization’s WHO Global TB Report 2026 places the 2025 global TB burden at about 10.6 million new cases and 1.13 million deaths, and notes roughly 2.2 million people remained undiagnosed or unregistered in health systems. The figures underscore the persistent TB burden and gaps in detection and reporting, highlighting the need for timely diagnosis and improved access to treatment. Data from the state align with the global pattern of under-detection and transmission risk, signaling ongoing public health challenges for TB control.

triage.headline_ja: ES Hoje 11月17日号：結核が診断と治療に課題を突きつける
triage.triage_reason: 結核はブラジル・エスピリトサント州における既知の風土病に関する定例統計報道であり、異常性や新規性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: WHO Global TB Report 2026の世界統計引用を含むが、記事主題はブラジル・エスピリトサント州の既存の結核診断・治療課題に関する定例報道であり、新規アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ampliar a vacinação contra a mpox diante da alta de casos no Rio - Diário Causa Operária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Expand mpox vaccination amid the surge in cases in Rio de Janeiro
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (mpox) in the state of Rio de Janeiro reached 396 confirmed cases in 2026, with the first death of the year reported in late October. The deceased was aged 40–49 and had an underlying condition compromising immunity; death occurred after admission to the Evandro Chagas Institute (Fiocruz). About 14% of mpox patients in Rio required hospitalization this year. Rio de Janeiro city resumed vaccination on November 6, prioritizing HIV/AIDS patients aged 18+ with CD4 counts below 200 cells/mm³; additional groups will be included as more doses arrive. The Municipal Health Department had urged expansion on November 11; at that time the city reported 257 capital cases, with 396 statewide now. City received 2,000 doses and had administered 738 by November 9. Emphasis is on rapid vaccination of high-risk groups, clear vaccination-site information, securing more doses, and ensuring SUS access for testing and referrals, especially for residents far from centers; mpox symptoms include fever, pain, lymphadenopathy, and skin/mucosal lesions.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロでの症例急増を受け、mpoxワクチン接種を拡大
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロ州でmpox症例が396例に達し、今年初の死亡例と14%の入院率が報告されており、ワクチン供給不足への対応が急務となっているため、公衆衛生上の影響が深刻でWPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 本事例はブラジル・リオデジャネイロ州における国内流行の継続的拡大であり、HIV感染者など免疫不全者における重症化・死亡例の発生とワクチン供給不足が主な懸念点。国際的拡大や渡航制限への言及はなく、既知の疾患（mpox）の国内アウトブレイクとしての性質が強い。

article.articleHeadline: RN contabiliza oito casos de mpox e 19 notificações de casos suspeitos - Tribuna do Norte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RN reports eight mpox cases and 19 notifications of suspected cases - Tribuna do Norte.
article.articleSummary: Eight mpox cases in Rio Grande do Norte in 2026, with six confirmed and two probable, plus 19 suspected notifications, per the Health Ministry's epidemiological panel updated on 14 November. Five patients reside in Natal; 75% male, 25% female; average age 38. No hospitalizations and no deaths reported. RN ranks fourth in the Northeast with eight cases this year, behind Ceará (62), Pernambuco (13) and Maranhão (9). Of the eight patients, five have no coinfection; one reports another sexually transmitted infection; data unavailable for two. Transmission is mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, but contaminated objects can spread the virus; higher frequency during sexual activity. Condoms do not fully prevent transmission due to lesions outside protected areas. Symptoms include skin lesions that progress from macules to painful vesicles; diagnosis via history, examination, and PCR on lesion material. Vaccination is available at CRIE in Natal with a physician prescription.

triage.headline_ja: RN州、mpox8例と疑い例19件の報告を記録 - Tribuna do Norte
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル北東部の一州における既知のmpox症例の定例疫学報告であり、死亡・入院例はなく、ワクチン等の対応体制も整っているため新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: mpoxは性的接触を介した伝播が継続している点でWPRO基準の『流行しやすさ』『長期曝露』に該当するが、重症度・異常性・社会的関心は低く、保健当局による定例モニタリング情報の域を出ない。

article.articleHeadline: കാര്യവട്ടം ക്യാമ്പസിൽ ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി വ്യാപനം; ഒരാഴ്ചയ്ക്കിടെ 13 പേർക്ക് രോഗം, കോളജും ഹോസ്റ്റലും അടച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue outbreak at Karyavattom campus; 13 people contracted dengue within a week, college and hostels closed.
article.articleSummary: 13 dengue fever cases have been confirmed in the past week at the University of Kerala’s Karyavattom campus, with transmission concentrated in hostels where students reside. In response, the campus and hostels have been closed and all classes shifted online; hostel fumigation is planned to halt spread. Of the confirmed infections, 10 are students and 3 are staff, with several others exhibiting symptoms and awaiting laboratory results. Some students who had returned home for holidays have developed fever, indicating ongoing transmission. Health authorities are intensifying preventive measures, maintaining contact lists and monitoring patients’ health status as the outbreak continues on campus.

triage.headline_ja: カーリヤヴァッタム・キャンパスでデング熱が拡大；1週間で13人感染、大学とホステルを閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケララ州の大学キャンパス内での限定的なデング熱クラスターであり、既に閉鎖・消毒等の対応措置が取られている。デングはインドで流行性があり異常性は低く、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 大学キャンパス内の局地的なデング熱クラスター。死亡例や重症例の報告はなく、既に閉鎖・消毒等の対応措置が講じられている。インドでは季節性・流行性があり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Wabup Bangka ingatkan masyarakat ikut cegah penyebaran DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangka Vice Regent reminds residents to help prevent the spread of dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (DBD) outbreak in Sungailiat, Bangka Regency, Bangka Belitung Islands Province, Indonesia, with 247 confirmed cases and one death as of 2026-11-17. In response to the rainy season, Deputy Regent Syahbudin urged residents to actively prevent DBD by boosting neighborhood environmental hygiene, including mutual gotong royong cleanups to remove debris from drainage channels. Emphasis was placed on eliminating standing water at homes to prevent Aedes aegypti breeding. Dinas Kesehatan Bangka reports cases across primary health centers, underscoring a community-wide transmission risk during heavy rains. Residents experiencing health issues should immediately visit the nearest puskesmas for care. Authorities also highlighted flood risk in areas such as Lingkungan Air Hanyut and Lingkungan Parit Pekir, linking sanitation and vector control to flood preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: バンカ副知事、デング熱(DBD)の感染拡大防止への協力を住民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・バンカ島の一地域における季節性デング熱の発生であり、国際的拡大リスクや異常性は低いが、死亡例を伴い雨季の継続的な感染リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアで毎年雨季に発生する風土病的疾患であり、本件は地方自治体レベルでの衛生啓発活動が中心。247例・死亡1例は局地的規模で、国際的な懸念材料とは言えないが、感染拡大の継続可能性からWATCH評価とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kết quả xác minh tin đồn 'lây nhiễm HIV trong nhóm người chơi pickleball'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Verification results of rumors about HIV transmission among pickleball players.
article.articleSummary: Rumors of HIV transmission among pickleball players in Ea Ning commune, Dak Lak, Vietnam, were deemed unverified as of 17 November. The Ea Ning People’s Committee said misinformation circulating on social media from 12–13 November alleged a local resident with HIV had infected others, prompting public alarm and reputational harm. Health authorities reviewed HIV management (HIV INFO 4.0) and treatment (HMED) records and found the named individual not listed in care or treatment databases. HIV/AIDS in Ea Ning remains stable, with no unusual increase in new cases or outbreak risk linked to the rumor. Authorities stated the rumor is baseless and pledged to monitor and sanction those who post misinformation to protect individuals and public security. Earlier reports mentioning Cu Kuin district (old name) also lacked verification; meetings with health and police were held.

triage.headline_ja: 「ピックルボール愛好者間でのHIV感染」の噂に関する検証結果
triage.triage_reason: HIV感染の噂は当局により根拠がないと確認されており、実際の感染拡大や公衆衛生上の異常事態は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 本件はHIV感染拡大に関する誤情報・デマの検証報道であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクではない。地域保健当局がデータベースを確認し、噂が根拠のないものと公式に否定している。

article.articleHeadline: Ike Nimah Tatimu, Penjaga Asa Pasien TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ike Nimah Tatimu, Guardian of Hope for TB Patients
article.articleSummary: Jakarta, Indonesia—61-year-old Ike Nimah Tatimu from Manado has been supporting tuberculosis (TB) patients in Jakarta since 2013 to prevent treatment interruptions. Despite a kidney removal and a lingering urinary catheter, she motorcycles through North Jakarta to reach patients who miss doses, arranging medication pickups and collecting sputum samples, and helps locate those who disappear from clinics. She also works with drug-resistant TB cases and emphasizes education to dispel myths, sometimes mobilizing neighborhood associations for community talks. Her motivation dates to a neighbor’s TB death and the belief that eggs were used as a remedy, a myth she aims to correct. A former Jumantik and health cadre since 2000, Ike has involved two children and a grandchild in TB education. She continues outreach as long as her health permits.

triage.headline_ja: イケ・ニマ・タティム、結核患者の希望の守護者
triage.triage_reason: 個人の人道的活動を紹介する人間ドラマ記事であり、新規の公衆衛生上の異常事態や感染拡大の兆候を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はジャカルタで結核患者を支援する地域保健活動家の人物紹介であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: കാര്യവട്ടം ക്യാമ്പസിൽ ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി വ്യാപനം; കോളേജും ഹോസ്റ്റലും അടച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever spreads on the Karyavattom campus; college and hostel closed.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak at the University of Kerala’s Kariavattom Campus and hostel in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, with campus and hostel closed for three days. As of 17 November 2026, 13 people have tested positive for dengue; symptoms are reported in many others. The Syndicate, after discussions with health department officials, ordered total online classes and comprehensive hostel fumigation. Of the confirmed cases, 10 are female students and 3 are staff members, with several additional individuals awaiting test results. Transmission is concentrated in the student hostel, and some students who had returned home for holidays have developed fever. The response emphasizes campus-wide sanitation, online instruction, and continued investigations into the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: カリヤヴァットム・キャンパスでデング熱が拡大、大学と寮を閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 単一大学キャンパス内でのデング熱クラスター発生であり、デング熱自体はインドで流行性の疾患であるため異常性は低いが、学生への感染拡大や寮内での集団発生という点で経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ケララ州トリバンドラムの大学キャンパス内での局地的なデング熱アウトブレイク（13例確認、重症例の報告なし）。デング熱は同地域で流行性の疾患であり、ベクター媒介感染症対策（消毒等）で管理可能とみられる。重症度・国際的拡大のリスクは低いが、寮内での継続的な感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع وفيات "إيبولا" في الكونغو والإصابات تتجاوز 11 ألفاً
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising Ebola deaths in Congo, infections exceed 11,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains out of control, with 5,568 deaths and 11,376 confirmed infections since the outbreak began in April 2026. The National Institute of Public Health reported 60 new infections and 36 deaths over the last 24 hours. Africa CDC Director-General John Kasia said the outbreak remains uncontrolled despite more than six months since its declaration, citing challenges including attacks on health workers, delayed salary payments, and persistent resource shortages. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which, as of now, no vaccine or treatment has been licensed. The case totals and daily changes underscore ongoing transmission and the urgent need for strengthened health-system support, protection for frontline staff, and accelerated access to countermeasures in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者が増加、感染者数は11,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模に拡大し続けており（感染者11,376人、死者5,568人）、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyo株による流行で、医療従事者への攻撃や資源不足により制御不能な状態が続いている。Africa CDCも懸念を表明しており、既知の大規模アウトブレイクの継続報道として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: Vụ đồn người chơi Pickleball gây lây nhiễm HIV ở Đắk Lắk: Kết quả xác minh ra sao?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rumors that Pickleball players caused HIV transmission in Đắk Lắk: What did the investigation reveal?
article.articleSummary: Rumors that a person infected with HIV spread the virus to others after playing Pickleball in Ea Ning, Dak Lak Province, were investigated and found unsubstantiated. On 12–13 November, social media posts alleged a resident of Ea Ning infected multiple people; the Dak Lak CDC partnered with Cu Kuin District Health Center and the Ea Ning Commune to verify. Reviewing HIV patient management (HIV INFO 4.0) and treatment (HMED) records, the Ea Ning Commune Health Station found the named individual was not listed for HIV care. Surveillance showed HIV/AIDS in Ea Ning under control, with no unusual rise in new cases and no outbreak linked to the rumor. Police invited two individuals who shared or commented on the posts; further verification and possible legal action are being considered. The health center provides voluntary, confidential HIV testing and counseling and urges relying on accurate information rather than rumors.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省でピックルボール競技者によるHIV感染の噂、調査結果は？
triage.triage_reason: 噂は調査の結果、根拠なしと確認され、実際のHIV感染拡大やアウトブレイクは確認されていない。公衆衛生上の実質的リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はSNS上の誤情報・噂に関する報道であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクではない。地元当局が調査し否定済み。ベトナムが舞台だが実際の感染拡大事象ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Dok bukti smrtonosna epidemija ebole, od kolere već umrlo 1.800 ljudi u DR Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the deadly Ebola epidemic rages, 1,800 people have already died of cholera in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Cholera in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) hits over 60,000 cases and about 1,800 deaths this year, the World Health Organization calling it the worst outbreak in decades. Eastern provinces North Kivu and South Kivu are the epicenters amid long-running armed conflict, with groups like M23 controlling areas and hindering coordinated response. In Kinshasa, new cholera cases emerge along the Congo River basin, including three recent cases in Kingabva; fears mount that the capital’s dense population could fuel wider spread. The case fatality rate is around 3%. MSF stresses that lack of safe drinking water and sanitation drives transmission, urging access to clean water, improved sanitation, and hand hygiene, plus water chlorination and oral vaccination campaigns as supplementary protection. Logistical obstacles—high transport costs (around $15,000 per truck) and security/terrain issues—compound delays. Authorities are urged to shift from reactive to preventive public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が猛威を振るう中、コンゴ民主共和国でコレラにより既に1,800人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: WHOが「数十年で最悪」と称するコレラ流行がDRCで拡大中（6万人超の症例、1800人死亡）。紛争による対応阻害と首都キンシャサへの拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はセルビア語メディアによる報道で見出しにエボラへの言及があるが、本文内容はコレラ流行に関するもの。北/南キブ州での武力紛争（M23支配地域）が対応を妨げており、キンシャサ（首都）への拡大兆候も確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Pimpri Chinchwad Dengue Cases: थंडी सुरू, तरी डासांचा डंख कायम! पिंपरी-चिंचवडमध्ये डेंग्यूचे ३३ रुग्ण पॉझिटिव्ह
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pimpri-Chinchwad Dengue Cases: Cold weather has begun, yet the mosquitoes' bite remains! In Pimpri-Chinchwad, 33 dengue patients tested positive.
article.articleSummary: November 2026, Pimpri-Chinchwad, India: 33 dengue cases confirmed among 894 suspected dengue tests conducted by the municipal medical department. Malaria screening of fever patients yielded 16,742 tests in November with 1 positive case. No chikungunya or Zika cases were detected that month. Despite the onset of cold weather, temperatures remain conducive to mosquito breeding, with water stagnation inside homes, on balconies, in pots, coolers, and scrap identified as primary dengue habitats. The city is conducting door-to-door checks to eliminate standing water and curb transmission. Laboratory confirmation underpins the dengue and malaria counts; there is no report of imported/exported cases in this update. Public health measures continue despite ongoing cooler conditions.

triage.headline_ja: ピンプリ・チンチワッドのデング熱症例:寒さが始まっても蚊の脅威は健在!ピンプリ・チンチワッドでデング熱陽性患者33人
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域における季節性デング熱・マラリアの通常の発生報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、既存の公衆衛生対応(戸別点検等)で管理可能なレベルである。
triage.notes: デング熱33例、マラリア1例という小規模かつ季節性の通常発生。市当局による標準的な蚊対策(戸別点検、水たまり除去)が実施されており、特別な懸念事項は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Eastern Visayas Dengue Cases Surge by 110% with 12 Fatalities, DOH Urges Preventive Measures
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Eastern Visayas, Philippines, surged to 6,710 infections and 12 deaths as of 7 November, a 110% increase from 3,194 cases at the same point in 2025. Leyte province recorded the highest burden (2,142 cases, 32% of regional total), followed by Northern Samar (1,403), Samar (861), and Tacloban City (790), the region’s only highly urbanized city. Males accounted for 53% of cases. The DOH urged intensified prevention via regular cleanup to eliminate mosquito breeding sites and emphasized the 4S strategy—search for and destroy breeding sites, self-protection against bites, seek early medical consultation, and targeted fogging where necessary. Dr. Joey Julius Ty-Farma called for stronger DILG coordination to sustain measures across local governments and communities, with emphasis on areas with high infection rates and continued removal of stagnant water.

triage.headline_ja: 東ビサヤ地方でデング熱症例が110%急増、12人死亡—保健省が予防対策を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 前年同期比110%増という顕著な症例増加と12名の死者が報告されており、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・異常な増加）に2つ該当するため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで毎年流行する風土病だが、今回は前年同期比110%増・12人死亡と顕著な悪化がみられ、DOHおよびDILGが地域横断的な対策強化を呼びかけている。ベクター媒介疾患のため国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の必要性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Virus hợp bào hô hấp (RSV) ở người lớn tuổi: Từ triệu chứng tưởng nhẹ đến nguy cơ nhập viện
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in older adults: From seemingly mild symptoms to the risk of hospitalization
article.articleSummary: RSV infection in older adults can rapidly worsen. A 65-year-old woman in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, with degenerative spine disease began with cough, fever, sore throat and sputum; within 3 days she developed dyspnea, wheeze, and hypoxemia requiring supplemental oxygen, noninvasive ventilation, and nebulization for about 10 days. At the University of Medicine and Pharmacy Hospital, Ho Chi Minh City, about 2–3 years of data show 2,600 patients tested with 84 RSV positives, most over 60, and those 75+ at higher risk of severe disease, including cases needing intubation. Diabetes mellitus is noted as a factor reducing immune defense when hyperglycemic. Diagnosis may require respiratory sampling to distinguish RSV from flu or COVID-19. There is no routinely used RSV-specific treatment; mild cases are managed symptomatically, while severe cases need oxygen and supportive care. Prevention through hand hygiene, reduced close contact, and early medical review is emphasized for high-risk individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 高齢者におけるRSV感染:軽症に見える症状から入院リスクまで
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例報告及び一施設の統計に基づく啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性も認められない。
triage.notes: RSVの季節性・高齢者リスクに関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクやクラスター発生を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah TBC, Lapas Narkotika Jakarta periksa warga binaan dan keluarga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To prevent TB, Jakarta Narcotics Prison screens inmates and their families.
article.articleSummary: Jakarta's Narcotics Prison (Lapas Narkotika Jakarta) conducts free health screenings for inmates and their families to prevent and interrupt Tuberculosis (TB) transmission. The initiative, led by Yudi Suseno, Director of Health Care and Rehabilitation at the Directorate General of Corrections, and implemented with support from Kemenimipas, emphasizes early TB detection alongside general health checks. Screening extends to inmates’ relatives to break transmission chains and safeguard about 2,000 detainees. If TB is detected, follow-up actions will be taken. The effort underscores a preventive approach within detention facilities, aiming to keep inmates and their households healthy, with prisoners like Pras, 36, expressing relief at improved health after the evaluations.

triage.headline_ja: 結核予防のため、ジャカルタ麻薬刑務所が収容者とその家族を検査
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核予防スクリーニング活動の報道であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は示されていない。既存の予防的取り組みの紹介に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 刑務所内での結核予防のための日常的な健康診断活動に関する記事。アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dong Nai delegation learns from Hanoi rabies pilot
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention and control in Hanoi uses a One Health approach to cut transmission at the source while safeguarding livelihoods. In 14 Hanoi wards, the pilot has led 28 dog- and cat-meat businesses to stop trading and 25 households to join livelihood transitions; Giang Vo Ward is the first with no activity. Approved by the Hanoi People’s Committee and led by the Department of Agriculture and Environment, the model is implemented by the Sub-Department of Livestock Production, Fisheries and Veterinary Medicine with support from the Soi Dog Foundation and SBCC Vietnam. It rests on three pillars: human health (pre-exposure education, wound treatment, post-exposure vaccination), animal health (rabies vaccination, managed transport and slaughter, welfare), and community/environment (hygiene, food safety). The Dong Nai delegation visited on November 13 to learn, praising the One Health approach and ongoing transitions to new livelihoods to advance the 2030 target of zero human rabies deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ドンナイ省代表団、ハノイの狂犬病対策モデルから学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病対策の成功事例・視察報告であり、新規発生やアウトブレイクの情報ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 本記事はハノイにおける狂犬病予防管理モデル（One Healthアプローチ）の成功事例をドンナイ省が視察した内容であり、アウトブレイクや新規症例報告ではない。政策的関心はあるが公衆衛生上の緊急シグナルには該当しない。
