article.articleHeadline: Viện Pasteur TP.HCM với những dấu ấn từ phát hiện HIV đến Covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City Pasteur Institute: Milestones from the discovery of HIV to COVID-19
article.articleSummary: On 17 November 2026, the Ho Chi Minh City Pasteur Institute marks 135 years (1891–2026) with a conference on 'Research for Public Health: Adaptation and Innovation.' The institute’s milestones include Vietnam’s first HIV infection detected in 1990 and the last polio case confirmed in 1996. In 2003, it became Vietnam’s first to fully decipher the genome of avian influenza A/H5N1, providing genome maps and testing for suspected cases from 126 southern units. From 2001 to 2010, it identified Enterovirus 71 causing encephalitis in children. In 2016 it reported Zika, in 2020 confirmed the first COVID-19 case in Vietnam, and in 2022 a monkeypox case. The institute contributed to BCG vaccine research for pediatric TB, led seven national projects and more than 20 vaccine clinical trials, and hosts large-scale vaccine studies. Deputy Minister Lê Đức Luận urged stronger independent research, biotech, AI, digitalization, and expanded domestic and international collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市パスツール研究所：HIV発見からCOVID-19までの歩み
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はパスツール研究所の135周年記念及び過去の業績を振り返る歴史的・回顧的な内容であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の緊急事態や新規感染症イベントを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去の感染症対応実績（HIV、ポリオ、H5N1、EV71、ジカ、COVID-19、Mpox等）を振り返る周年記念の歴史的レビュー記事であり、現時点での新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Đồng Nai studies rabies prevention and livelihood transition models in Hà Nội
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention in Vietnam advances via Hanoi’s One Health pilot model, targeting source-of-infection risk while supporting livelihoods of dog and cat meat traders. The project, titled “Pilot Model for Rabies Prevention and Control and Sustainable Economic Development, Phased-Transitioning Away from the Dog and Cat Meat Trade in 14 Wards of Hà Nội,” was approved by the Hanoi People’s Committee on 24 July 2025 and led by the Department of Agriculture and Environment, with Soi Dog Foundation and SBCC Vietnam providing technical support. After just over a year across 14 wards, 28 businesses have ceased dog/cat meat trading and 25 more have registered to transition; Giảng Võ Ward has fully ended sales. The model links human health, animal health, and living environment, offering vocational training, startup support, and market linkage to shift livelihoods, reduce rabies risk at the source, and contribute to Vietnam’s goal of zero human rabies deaths by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: ドンナイ省、ハノイでの狂犬病予防と生計転換モデルを視察・研究
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病対策・生計転換プロジェクトの進捗報告であり、新規症例や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事は狂犬病予防プログラムの進捗・政策レビューであり、新規発生や流行拡大に関する情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: An Giang siết chặt kiểm soát dịch tả lợn châu Phi trước Tết Nguyên đán Đinh Mùi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Giang Province tightens control measures against African swine fever ahead of the Đinh Mùi Lunar New Year.
article.articleSummary: An Giang Province tightens controls on pig farming, transport, slaughter, and pork consumption ahead of the Đinh Mùi Lunar New Year 2027 due to persistent African swine fever (ASF). Since the first outbreak on 25 August 2026, ASF has affected 47 households across 36 hamlets in 21 communes, with 1,057 pigs culled weighing over 58,600 kg. Three communes (Thạnh Đông, Thạnh Lộc, Gò Quao) have 21 days without new cases; however, surveillance at six slaughterhouses detected ASF-positive samples in 2 of 20 tested. The Hùng Hà slaughterhouse in Bình An processes about 200 pigs daily and now requires healthy pigs from disease-free farms, traceable origins, routine health checks, and stringent vehicle/facility disinfection. Some households plan to restock with 20–30 kg piglets for Tet. Authorities urge coordinated prevention, rapid culling/disposal of infected stock, farmer support, and strict enforcement against illegal pig movements.

triage.headline_ja: アンザン省、丁未（テト）旧正月を前にアフリカ豚コレラの管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）は家畜（豚）のみに感染するウイルス性疾患であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクはない。ベトナムでは既知・継続的な家畜疾病であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクも低い。
triage.notes: 本事例はヒトに感染しない動物疾病（ASF）であり、公衆衛生上のシグナルではなく農業・畜産管理の範疇。影響カテゴリも'animals'のみで、ヒト健康への直接的影響は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Pediatra mówi, na co chorują Polacy. Rodzime infekcje i egzotyczne zakażenia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A pediatrician explains what Poles are suffering from. Endemic infections and exotic infections.
article.articleSummary: A child returning from Thailand developed high fever, rash, and abdominal pain and was diagnosed with dengue, a non-severe case. Autumn infections in Poland are rising but not yet at a winter peak; common ailments include respiratory tract infections, scarlet fever, and croup, with RSV posing particular danger to infants and the elderly. Travelers also bring tropical infections—dengue, chikungunya, and traveler's diarrhea—from Egypt, Thailand, and other destinations; clinicians stress not to ignore fever after exotic trips and to record travel history for accurate diagnosis. Dengue can worsen with a second serotype, raising the risk of severe dengue and dengue hemorrhagic fever. An Egyptian case with gastrointestinal symptoms highlights tropical pathogens in differential diagnoses. RSV activity in 2026 Jan 1–Oct 31 reached 76,067 cases in Poland; severe outcomes include bronchiolitis, pneumonia, and possible ICU care. Preventive vaccines for certain adults and pregnant women, plus monoclonal antibodies for infants, are noted.

triage.headline_ja: 小児科医が語るポーランド人の罹患状況。国内感染症と海外由来のエキゾチックな感染症
triage.triage_reason: ポーランドにおける秋季感染症全般とRSV流行、および海外渡航者の輸入デング熱単発例を紹介する一般的な健康情報記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: タイから帰国した小児の輸入デング熱症例（非重症）が言及されているが、単発の渡航関連症例であり、タイ国内でのアウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はない。主題はポーランド国内の季節性感染症（RSV等）の概況記事。エジプトは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: കാര്യവട്ടം കാമ്പസിൽ ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി വ്യാപനം; കോളജും ഹോസ്റ്റലും അടച്ചു, ക്ലാസ് ഓൺലൈനിൽ | Dengue fever spreads- Karyavattom campus closed
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever spreads on Karyavattom campus; college and hostel closed, classes online.
article.articleSummary: At Kerala University’s Kariavattom campus in Thiruvananthapuram, dengue fever is spreading, prompting the closure of the college and hostel and a switch to online classes. Over the past week, 13 people tested positive—10 students and 3 staff members—and several other hostel residents have fever or related symptoms. Some students who had returned home for holidays are also reported to be feverish. A joint meeting of the University Syndicate and the Health Department decided to shut the campus and hostel to curb transmission. Online classes will continue, while the hostel surroundings and campus will be fogged and disinfected. The outbreak underscores dengue activity among campus residents and the need for intensified infection-control measures in the university system.

triage.headline_ja: カリヤヴァッタムキャンパスでデング熱が拡大、大学と寮を閉鎖しオンライン授業に切り替え
triage.triage_reason: 単一キャンパス内での局地的なデング熱クラスター（13名陽性）であり、地域流行病であるため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、地域の流行監視として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はケララ州で季節性・地域流行的に発生しており、本イベントは単一大学キャンパス内の限定的クラスター。重症例や死亡の報告はなく、地域保健当局により対応済み。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรคแจงผู้ป่วยหัดออสเตรเลีย ยังไม่มีหลักฐานติดเชื้อจากไทย เตือนผู้โดยสารร่วมเที่ยวบินเฝ้าระวัง 21 วัน
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Disease Control explains: No evidence the Australian measles patient contracted the infection in Thailand; warns passengers on the same flight to monitor for 21 days.
article.articleSummary: Australian measles case: no evidence of infection acquired in Thailand; 21-day monitoring urged for passengers on the same flights. The patient began fever, cough, and sore throat on 2026-11-02, traveled through Thailand on 2026-11-07 and developed a measles rash on 2026-11-08; laboratory confirmation obtained. Timeline suggests infection preceded Thailand transit, with Bangladesh reporting a large outbreak (>50,000 cases and at least 350 deaths) that informs risk assessment. The patient flew Thai Airways TG340 from Dhaka to Bangkok (seat 46D) and TG475 Bangkok to Sydney (seat 36D) on 2026-11-07; infectious period at that time. Measles spreads via airborne droplets and can linger up to 2 hours in enclosed spaces. Passengers and crew on those flights, especially seats 46D and 36D, should self-monitor until 2026-11-28; seek care if fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes, or rash, and disclose travel history. Vaccination remains critical; authorities are coordinating contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病管理局、オーストラリアの麻疹患者について説明：タイでの感染の証拠はない、同便搭乗者に21日間の経過観察を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 単一の輸入麻疹症例（確定はオーストラリア）であり、タイ当局はタイ国内での感染拡大の証拠はないとしている。バングラデシュで大規模流行（5万人超）が背景にあるが対象国リスト外であり、タイでは接触者追跡・経過観察の段階にとどまるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事例はタイでの感染確認ではなく、タイ経由便を利用した輸入症例（確定はオーストラリア）。感染源は渡航歴からバングラデシュの可能性が高いが、バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。タイ当局は搭乗者への21日間の健康観察を要請しており、今後の国内二次感染の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรคยันผู้ป่วยหัดออสเตรเลียยังไม่มีหลักฐานติดเชื้อจากไทย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Department of Disease Control confirms there is no evidence yet that the Australian measles patient contracted the infection in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Measles in an Australian traveler; no evidence of infection acquired in Thailand, but the patient was in an infectious period while transiting through Thailand. The Department of Disease Control indicates the patient developed fever, cough, runny nose, and rash, with rash onset on 8 November 2569 after initial symptoms on 2 November 2569, with laboratory confirmation of measles. The patient flew Thai Airways TG340 from Dhaka to Suvarnabhumi (seat 46D) and then TG475 from Bangkok to Sydney (seat 36D) on 7 November 2569, while contagious. Given the widespread Bangladesh measles outbreak (over 50,000 cases and at least 350 deaths), investigators preliminarily suspect infection may have been acquired in Bangladesh or earlier travel, still under investigation. Passengers on the same flights were alerted to monitor for symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: タイ疾病管理局、オーストラリアの麻疹患者がタイで感染した証拠はまだないと確認
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュで5万人超・死亡350人以上という大規模麻疹アウトブレイクが背景にあり、国際便を介した越境感染の可能性が指摘されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本事例の実際の感染源として疑われているのはバングラデシュでの大規模麻疹アウトブレイク（対象国リスト外）であり、タイは患者の経由地（乗継便搭乗）に過ぎず、タイ国内での感染拡大の証拠は現時点でない。タイ疾病管理局は同便搭乗者への健康観察を呼びかけており、公衆衛生対応としての関連性からタイを verified_locations に含めたが、発生源国としての扱いではない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Sumenep Perkuat Perlindungan Anak Lewat Vaksinasi DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sumenep Regency Government Strengthens Child Protection Through Dengue Vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in Sumenep Regency, East Java, Indonesia: As of October 2026, 483 dengue cases and 3 deaths have been recorded, prompting intensified child-focused protection measures. The Sumenep Health and Population Control and Family Planning Office (Dinkes-P2KB) reports that vaccination targets children, launched on 12 November 2026 by Regent Achmad Fauzi Wongsojudo at SD Negeri Kebundadap, Saronggi. The initiative follows data showing most hospitalized dengue patients are children. The strategy combines vaccination with an integrated response across 27 districts, including 3M hygiene actions (regularly draining bathtubs and water containers, tightly covering water storage, burying used items that can collect rainwater), fogging by health workers at health centers in both mainland and island areas, and parental health education to emphasize early protection. Aedes aegypti is the vector. Officials hope this combined approach will reduce disease burden in Sumenep.

triage.headline_ja: スメネップ県政府、デング熱ワクチン接種を通じて子どもの保護を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・東ジャワ州スメネップ県における季節性・地域流行性のデング熱に対する通常の予防接種キャンペーン・啓発活動の報道であり、新規性・異常性や国際的拡大リスクを示す要素は見られない。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアの風土病であり、本記事は地方自治体による予防接種・衛生対策（3M運動、フォギング等）のルーティン報告。483症例・3死亡は2026年10月時点のデータで、急激な異常増加を示す記述はない。国際的関心や支援要請の兆候もなく、フルRRAの必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 한국, 13년 연속 '홍역 퇴치국' 인정...해외 유입 감염은 여전 - 시사저널
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Korea recognized for 13 consecutive years as a measles-elimination country... Infections imported from abroad remain a concern - Sisa Journal.
article.articleSummary: South Korea has maintained measles elimination for 13 consecutive years since 2014, confirmed by the WHO Western Pacific Region after a Jakarta evaluation (Sept 7–11). Despite this, 86 measles cases in Korea from 2025 through mid-2026 were linked to imported infections: 61 imported, 25 secondary transmissions from imported cases, with no endemic transmission. WHO notes global measles activity across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Southeast Asia, and the Western Pacific, underscoring travel vigilance. Korea designates 107 countries as measles-quarantine management areas; travelers returning from these areas should report via Q-CODE or health statement and check Travel Health Alerts. Within 3 weeks of entry, fever or rash warrants isolation and medical review; vaccination remains crucial: two MMR doses at 12–15 months and 4–6 years, with accelerated MMR for infants 6–11 months before travel. KDCA's Im Seung-kan urged sustained high vaccination coverage and vigilant surveillance to keep elimination status.

triage.headline_ja: 韓国、13年連続「麻疹排除国」認定…海外からの流入感染は依然懸念 - シサジャーナル
triage.triage_reason: 韓国は13年連続で麻疹排除国に認定されており、輸入症例のみで地域内伝播は確認されていない。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常事態ではなく、通常の渡航注意喚起の内容である。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国の麻疹排除国認定とKDCAによる渡航者向け注意喚起が主題。インドネシア（ジャカルタ）はWHO西太平洋地域評価会議の開催地として言及されているのみで、インドネシア国内の感染事例ではないため対象国リストには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: alcançar pessoas isoladas é crucial após 6 meses de surto na RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Reaching hard-to-reach people is crucial after six months of the outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, there are over 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths. Children under five account for a large share of infections and deaths, with about 70% fatality in this group. Transmission remains active across eight provinces, despite slowing in initial epicenters; weekly cases persist and contact tracing remains below target. Cases have been detected in Kenya and Nigeria, indicating cross-border risk; frontline pay delays and security threats hinder operations, including attacks on health facilities and the Cantine-Aloya incursion that killed health workers. UN agencies and nearly 100 partners report progress: containment in initial foci and declines in Bunia; diagnostic capacity expanded from a few labs to dozens; beds and treatment centers increased; thousands of recoveries with survivors in follow-up. Prevention trained tens of thousands of community health workers, secured safe burials, and distributed meals. Vaccines and treatments are under evaluation. An urgent ceasefire and protection of health workers, plus rapid funding and integrated actions beyond the virus, are needed by 2027.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国での流行から6か月、孤立地域への到達が急務
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は11,000例・5,400死亡に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境例も報告されており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が明白なためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアでの症例検出が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。資金不足、治安悪化（医療従事者への攻撃）、接触者追跡の遅れなど対応上の課題が深刻で、継続的な監視と支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pune Polio Drive On November 22, 3.16 Lakh Children To Be Covered
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination drive in Pune, India. As of 2026-11-17, the Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) will hold a citywide polio immunisation campaign on November 22, aiming to reach more than 3.16 lakh children under five. The drive will operate at 1,367 vaccination booths across Pune from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm, delivering two scheduled drops of oral polio vaccine. Parents are urged to bring children to the nearest booth, even if they have already received routine vaccines, since the additional doses are intended to ensure complete coverage. The initiative is part of ongoing sub-national immunisation rounds to sustain protection against polio and prevent a resurgence. The report focuses on vaccination logistics; no polio cases or outbreaks are described.

triage.headline_ja: プネーでポリオワクチン接種キャンペーン、11月22日実施、316万人の子供が対象
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防接種活動に関する報道であり、症例や発生の報告はなく、異常性・緊急性も認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は定期的な補完的予防接種活動（Sub-National Immunisation Day）の実施案内であり、ポリオ症例やアウトブレイクの報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: കാര്യവട്ടം ക്യാമ്പസ് ഹോസ്റ്റലിൽ ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി പടരുന്നു; രോഗവ്യാപനം രൂക്ഷമായതോടെ കോളജ് അടച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever spreading at Karyavattom campus hostel; college closed as the outbreak intensified.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak at Kerala University’s Kariavattom campus hostel in Thiruvananthapuram with 13 confirmed cases in one week—10 students and 3 staff. The college and hostel are closed and all classes shifted online. Health experts say stagnant rainwater on campus is fueling mosquito breeding, driving transmission. The health department has intensified fogging and source-reduction efforts around the campus. Additional fever cases are reported among hostel residents, and some students who went home for holidays are also symptomatic; local authorities have been asked to assess whether returning students are affected. Ongoing vector control and surveillance are being implemented to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: カリヤヴァットムキャンパス寮でデング熱が拡大、感染激化に伴い大学閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 単一キャンパス内での局地的なデング熱アウトブレイク（13例）であり、インドではデングは流行性疾患として既知であるため異常性は低いが、対策状況（フォギング等）の継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はケララ州を含むインドの多くの地域で季節性流行が見られる既知の風土病であり、本事例は単一大学キャンパス内の局地的クラスターに限定される。帰省した学生の発症有無の確認が今後の拡大評価に重要。

article.articleHeadline: 科学网-清华大学团队首次高分辨率解析痘病毒复制"要害
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ScienceNet—Tsinghua University team first to achieve high-resolution elucidation of the key determinants of poxvirus replication.
article.articleSummary: Researchers at Tsinghua University, led by Li Sai, used cryo-electron tomography and sub-tomogram averaging to determine the in situ, near-atomic structure of the poxvirus portal complex and its central channel. Resolved on intact poxvirus particles to 6.7 Å and 4.4 Å, the portal is a ~12 nm-diameter, multi-layered assembly with sixfold symmetry built from E8, E6, and L3 subunits, and a central pore formed by four hexameric rings. A distinctive gating region comprises four lysine residues creating a 2 nm-long, inner channel with ~16.5 Å diameter, a positively charged conduit that can accommodate single-stranded RNA and small substrates. Mutating any of the four lysines prevents production of stable progeny virus, confirming an essential role in replication. The findings, published November 16 in Nature, suggest new antiviral targets against poxviruses, including monkeypox, and highlight the importance of in situ physiological-state structure.

triage.headline_ja: 科学網—清華大学の研究チームが痘病毒の複製における「要所」を高解像度で初めて解析
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究（痘病毒の構造解析）に関する学術的成果の報告であり、実際の感染症発生・公衆衛生事象ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は清華大学の研究成果（Nature誌掲載）に関する学術ニュースであり、実際の疾病発生事例ではない。発生地域としてChinaが付与されているが、感染症イベントの発生地ではなく研究機関の所在地であるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Avian Influenza Risk Drivers Diverge Between Wild and Domestic Birds
article.articleSummary: Across the Pan-Tibetan Plateau’s six western Chinese provinces—Xizang, Qinghai, Gansu, Sichuan, Yunnan, Xinjiang Uygur—risk of highly pathogenic avian influenza diverges by host: wild birds driven by landscape features; domestic poultry driven by human socioeconomic activity. An outbreak registry (2004–2024) included 137 confirmed events: 26 wild-bird, 111 domestic poultry. Researchers built three ecological niche models (Wild, Domestic, Mixed) using 34 predictors at 2 km × 2 km, after eliminating multicollinearity. The Wild model excludes socioeconomic factors; the Domestic model incorporates the Wild risk layer to probe wild-to-domestic spillover. Wild infections average 1.24/year with peaks in 2006 (6) and 2020 (4); seasonality around day 100–150 (May). Domestic outbreaks average 5.29/year, peaking 2004–2005 (13.5) and 2014–2017 (≈15); post-2020, zero poultry cases in 2021–2024, with all detections in wild birds. Validation: AUC >0.90, TSS >0.80.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザのリスク要因は野鳥と家禽で異なる
triage.triage_reason: 2004年〜2024年の過去データに基づく生態学的リスクモデルの学術研究であり、新規の発生事例やヒト感染の報告ではないため、トリアージ対象としての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国西部6省における過去20年間（2004-2024）の高病原性鳥インフルエンザのリスク要因を分析した学術研究の紹介であり、現在進行中の新規アウトブレイクやヒト感染事例の報告ではない。2021年以降は家禽での発生がゼロと報告されており、現時点での公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: वाराणसी जिले में डेंगू मरीजों की संख्या पहुंची 137 के पार, मच्‍छरों की फौज ने नाक में दम क‍िया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Varanasi district, the number of dengue patients has crossed 137, as an army of mosquitoes has made life difficult.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, dengue cases in Varanasi district have surpassed 137, with eight cases each of chikungunya and malaria. Based on five-year data, 70 densely populated neighborhoods across 17 urban wards have been declared sensitive, with intensified surveillance and sanitation drives. The current weather window, between 10°C and 35°C, favors rapid breeding of Aedes mosquitoes. District malaria officer Sharat Chandra Pandey said blood samples from contacts are being collected to monitor transmission. Anti-larvicide spraying in drains and fogging operations are underway to curb vector populations, with officials intensifying sanitation drives. This situation underscores the need for sustained vector control and public awareness campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: ワラナシ県でデング熱患者数が137人を超える、蚊の大群が猛威を振るう
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域における季節性デング熱・チクングニア・マラリアの流行であり、地方当局が対策を実施中だが、国際的拡大や重大な異常性は認められないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地方紙報道による季節性のベクター媒介感染症（デング熱主体）の流行。地元当局による媒介動物対策・監視が進行中で、国レベルの危機事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: হাতে ছড়িয়েছে সংক্রমণ,খসছে চামড়া, নদীর আবর্জনা সাফাই করতে গিয়ে হাসপাতালে ভর্তি বিট্টু তবাহি!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infection has spread to the hand, the skin is peeling, Bittu Tabahi admitted to hospital while cleaning up river garbage!
article.articleSummary: In Madhya Pradesh, India, college student-turned-environmental activist Surendra Singh Chaudhary, also known as Bittu Tabahi, was hospitalized after contracting a suspected infection while cleaning the Ajanar River garbage. A video circulating on November 16 shows him in hospital, claiming repeated exposure to polluted water caused skin peeling and a spreading infection, with his hand affected. He had been cleaning the river using rubber gloves, boots, and a simple stick. The report notes no laboratory confirmation or medical details were provided, and Anandabazar did not verify the clip’s authenticity. The incident has sparked online discussion, with many urging river cleanup and greater civic responsibility to prevent pollution of the Ajanar River.

triage.headline_ja: 手に感染が広がり、皮膚が剥がれる―川のゴミ清掃中にビットゥ・タバヒが入院！
triage.triage_reason: 単一個人の未確認症例であり、検査による病原体確認や医療的詳細もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や流行の可能性を示す根拠がないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 単一の環境活動家の個人的な症例であり、検査確認やメディアによる映像の真正性検証もされていない。川の汚染による皮膚症状の可能性が示唆されているが、感染症としての確証はなく、公衆衛生イベントとしての要件を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: 麻疹破5400例 亞洲移民或未打疫苗 | 世界新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles tops 5,400 cases; Asian immigrants may be unvaccinated | World Journal
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in the United States reach 5,412 this year, the highest in about 35 years (since 1991). About 41% of reports are adults aged 20 and over. Some Asian immigrants may be unvaccinated or lack verifiable records, leaving them vulnerable. India started measles vaccination in 1985; vaccination timing and doses vary by country, complicating immunity assessments for immigrant adults. CDC guidance notes that adults born in 1957 or earlier are presumed immune; others without immunity can receive a single MMR dose or have measles IgG tested. Those vaccinated with the inactivated measles vaccine used from 1963–1967, or with unknown vaccine types, should be evaluated for MMR catch-up. High-risk groups such as travelers and healthcare workers should have two documented vaccine doses if no other immunity evidence; pregnancy or severe immunodeficiency are contraindications. The U.S. has maintained measles elimination since 2000; PAHO is reviewing genomic data to determine if outbreaks share a transmission chain, with results not yet released as of November 13.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹感染が5,400例を突破、アジア系移民は未接種の可能性｜世界新聞網
triage.triage_reason: 米国における麻疹症例数が約35年ぶりの高水準に達し、排除状態の維持に懸念が生じている。PAHOが伝播チェーンの共有可能性を調査中であり、国際的拡大リスクも示唆される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国内の麻疹流行であり、インドは移民のワクチン接種歴の文脈で言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため、該当国なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: കേരള യൂണിവേഴ്സിറ്റി കാര്യവട്ടം ക്യാമ്പസിൽ ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി; 13 പേർക്ക് സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു; കോളേജും ഹോസ്റ്റലും മൂന്ന് ദിവസത്തേക്ക് അടച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue at the University of Kerala Karyavattom Campus; 13 people confirmed; College and hostels closed for three days.
article.articleSummary: 13 dengue cases confirmed at the University of Kerala's Karyavattom Campus and hostels within a week, prompting a three-day closure. Of the 13, 10 are female students and 3 are staff; many more cases awaiting lab results. Some students who had returned home during holidays have developed fever. Transmission is highest in the Ladies' Hostel. The decision, made at a Syndicate meeting with health department officials, shuts down on-campus activities and moves classes online for the three days. To curb spread, the health department has ordered full sanitation and fogging around the campus and hostel premises. Officials emphasized ongoing monitoring and awaited further test results.}

triage.headline_ja: ケララ大学カリヤヴァットムキャンパスでデング熱発生、13人感染確認、大学・寮を3日間閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 単一大学キャンパス内での局地的なデング熱クラスター（13例）であり、インドでは季節的に流行する風土病のため異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低いが、今後の拡大状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はインド・ケララ州で季節的に流行する風土病であり、大学寮内でのクラスター発生は地域の保健当局により消毒・燻蒸等の対応が既になされている。重症例や死亡の報告はなく、現時点でフルRRAの必要性は低いが、追加症例の推移を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: A fungus best known for killing plum branches caused a painful abscess in a kidney transplant recipient -- the second human infection ever reported
article.articleSummary: Chondrostereum purpureum, a fungus best known for causing silver leaf in plums, caused the second ever human infection and the first in a kidney transplant recipient, in Bangkok, Thailand. A 65-year-old female state submitted with a growing, painful right-shoulder abscess (4 × 10 cm) and 10 mL pale green pus; no trauma reported. Lab findings showed branching hyphae and grayish velvety colonies; DNA sequencing of ITS and D1/D2 regions identified C. purpureum. The patient underwent incision, drainage, and six months of posaconazole; at one year, no recurrence. The first human case was in 2023 in Kolkata, India, involving a plant mycologist with an abscess near the windpipe treated with drainage and voriconazole, with no recurrence at two years. The fungus is a soil/wood-associated basidiomycete; in trees it enters via wounds and releases airborne spores. The Thai patient’s exposure is unknown, and immunosuppressed hosts are at risk. No established optimal antifungal exists.

triage.headline_ja: スモモの枝を枯らすことで知られる真菌が腎移植患者に痛みを伴う膿瘍を引き起こす――これまでに報告されたヒト感染例としては2例目
triage.triage_reason: きわめて稀な植物病原性真菌によるヒト感染の症例報告（世界で2例目）であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や流行の可能性はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性や社会的関心も認められない。
triage.notes: 本事例は植物病原性真菌Chondrostereum purpureumによる孤発性のヒト感染症例報告（タイ・バンコクの腎移植患者、2026年公表）であり、2023年にインド・コルカタで報告された世界初のヒト感染例に続く2例目。いずれも免疫不全・特殊曝露によるものでヒト-ヒト感染性はなく、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上のリスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Poeira cruzou o Atlântico desde o Saara e levou bactérias do deserto até a floresta amazônica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dust crossed the Atlantic Ocean from the Sahara and carried desert bacteria to the Amazon rainforest.
article.articleSummary: Saharan dust crossed the Atlantic and delivered African microbes to the Amazon atmosphere. A February 2020 study at Brazil’s ATTO Observatory collected samples over three weeks; five days showed a dust mass from North Africa. Dust travels westward from Sahara/Sahel via trade winds, reaching the Amazon during the rainy season under favorable circulation. Genetic analyses revealed temporary shifts in atmospheric bacterial communities linked to arid soils, desert crusts, and marine environments; fungal communities remained largely stable. Endotoxins in air rose about threefold during the episode. Two sampling heights (42 m, 323 m) and filters, sequencing, chemical analyses, and trajectory models supported Saharan origin, corroborated by calcium minerals. The study by Weber et al. appeared in Communications Earth & Environment (Oct 2026). NASA CALIPSO animations depict the route; NASA estimates 27.7 million tons reach the Amazon annually. Implications: atmospheric connectivity of ecosystems; viability and health impacts require further study.

triage.headline_ja: サハラ砂漠から大西洋を越えた砂塵がアマゾン熱帯雨林に砂漠の細菌を運んだ
triage.triage_reason: 感染症アウトブレイクではなく、大気中の微生物叢に関する学術研究報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2020年の観測データに基づく学術研究（Communications Earth & Environment誌掲載）の紹介であり、ヒトの感染症事例や疾病アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。'Unknown Illness'という疾患分類はBluedotの誤分類と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 登革熱境外移入228例 3成來自越南
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 228 imported dengue fever cases, 30% from Vietnam
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s Centers for Disease Control (Taiwan CDC) reports 246 dengue fever confirmed cases through November 13, 2026, with 228 imported and 18 locally transmitted. Imported infections are predominantly from Vietnam, followed by the Philippines and Indonesia; local cases are concentrated in Kaohsiung City (13). In early November, an imported cluster from Vietnam involved two adults (ages 40s–60s) in the same tour group who became ill after late October travel to Phu Quoc Island and were diagnosed on return. Health authorities conducted vector-control at residences and activity sites and are tracing other group members through December 6. Dengue fever is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and presents with fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia/arthralgia, and rash; infection with a different serotype can be severe. Prevention emphasizes long sleeves, MOH-approved repellents, screens or air conditioning, and water-management: drain, remove, clean, and scrub standing water.

triage.headline_ja: 登革熱（デング熱）の海外からの輸入症例228件、3割がベトナムから
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における輸入デング熱症例の定例的な報告であり、ベトナム・フィリピン・インドネシアは東南アジアで毎年流行する既知の風土病地域であるため、異常性・社会的関心ともに低い。
triage.notes: 台湾(Taiwan)は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。輸入症例の感染源地（ベトナム、フィリピン、インドネシア）をverified_locationsとした。デング熱は当該地域で季節性・流行性に発生する既知の疾患であり、新規性や重症例の急増等の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Leptospirosis Saat Musim Hujan, Kenali Gejala dan Cara Mencegahnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware of Leptospirosis During the Rainy Season: Recognize the Symptoms and How to Prevent It.
article.articleSummary: Bandung, Indonesia faces heightened leptospirosis risk during the rainy season as heavy rainfall causes flooding and widespread standing water. Leptospira bacteria, carried in the urine or blood of rodents, can infect humans when exposed through open wounds, scraped skin, or mucous membranes, or via contaminated water or food. Symptoms resemble influenza and include high fever, severe headache, calf and lower back muscle pain, red eyes, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea; mild cases may resolve in about a week, but untreated infections can progress to Weil’s disease with serious organ involvement. Diagnosis relies on clinical history and laboratory tests, including blood tests, urine tests, and assessment of kidney and liver function. Prevention emphasizes environmental hygiene during the rainy season, prompt wound care, avoiding face touching, personal cleanliness, and rodent-control measures at home to reduce exposure to contaminated water.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季のレプトスピラ症に注意、症状と予防法を知ろう
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の一般的な注意喚起・啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数・アウトブレイク報告がなく、異常性や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は雨季に伴うレプトスピラ症のリスク啓発と予防法を解説する一般的な健康情報記事であり、具体的な感染者数やアウトブレイクの報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Interconnected Water Risks Amplify Infectious Disease in Informal Urban
article.articleSummary: In informal urban settlements across the Global South, especially India, water insecurity combines scarcity, microbial contamination, flooding, inadequate sanitation, and fragmented governance to drive elevated rates of both water-borne diseases (diarrhoea, cholera, typhoid, dysentery) and vector-borne illnesses (dengue, malaria, chikungunya, leptospirosis). A narrative review argues these burdens stem from systemic exclusion from formal urban planning, not poverty or density alone, and criticizes single-target interventions. Effective mitigation requires a justice-oriented, integrated approach: reliable water supply, comprehensive sanitation chain management, flood adaptation, and stronger local accountability. Safety claims based on 'improved' source are misleading due to recontamination risk during collection, transport, and storage in dense, low-income settings. Flooding and drainage failures, often on floodplains, worsen both pathways by mobilizing waste, damaging water points, creating stagnant water, and fostering Aedes aegypti-borne outbreaks, with pit latrines near drinking-water sources.

triage.headline_ja: 相互に関連する水リスクがインフォーマルな都市居住区における感染症を増幅させる
triage.triage_reason: これは特定のアウトブレイクに関する速報ではなく、インフォーマル都市部における水リスクと感染症(水系・媒介生物由来)の構造的要因を論じた学術的ナラティブレビューであり、急性の公衆衛生イベントではない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドを含むグローバルサウス全般のインフォーマル居住区における構造的な水リスクと感染症の関連性を扱う総説記事であり、特定の国・地域での具体的なアウトブレイク発生を報告するものではない。具体的な症例数・流行地域の特定情報がないため、対象国としての特定は見送った。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies' nearly 100% fatality rate underscores need for prevention at source in Vietnam
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains nearly 100% fatal after symptoms, highlighting the need to prevent transmission at the source through dog and cat vaccination and safer high‑risk practices. Hanoi is piloting a One Health model to phase out dog and cat meat trading in 14 wards, aiming to reach zero human deaths from rabies by 2030. The Pilot Model for Rabies Prevention and Control and Sustainable Economic Development, approved July 2025, is led by Hanoi’s Department of Agriculture and Environment and implemented by the Sub-department of Livestock Production, in coordination with Soi Dog Foundation and SBCC Vietnam. Outcomes include 28 facilities ceasing operations and 25 registering to transition. Vietnam recorded 54 human rabies deaths Jan–Sep 2026 and about 400,000 post‑exposure prophylaxis recipients. In H1 2026, nearly 20 rabies deaths occurred in the southern region. A Dong Nai delegation (Nov 13–16, 2025) learned Hanoi’s approach, emphasizing three-step livelihoods: training, startup support, and market linkage.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病の致死率はほぼ100%、ベトナムでは発生源での予防が急務
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける狂犬病は既知の風土病であり、本記事は政府の予防・対策プログラム（One Healthモデル）を紹介する政策的内容。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、ヒト-ヒト感染もない動物由来感染症であるため、フルRRAの必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムにおいて恒常的な風土病であり、本記事はハノイ市のOne Healthパイロットモデル（犬猫肉取引の段階的廃止、ワクチン接種推進）に関する政策紹介記事。2026年1-9月で54人の死亡者が報告されているが、新規性・緊急性のあるアウトブレイクではなく、通常のサーベイランス記事として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: Africa: Unitaid Announces U.S.$25 Million Funding Opportunity to Expand Access to Integrated TB and Hepatitis C Care in High-Transmission Settings
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, Unitaid announces a US$25 million call for proposals to expand integrated, people-centered TB and hepatitis C care in high-transmission and vulnerable settings. Deadline for full proposals is 1 March 2027, 12:00 CET. Proposals should show how integrated TB and hepatitis C services can reduce health-system fragmentation and overcome stigma in prisons and other closed settings, migrants, refugees and internally displaced people, people who inject drugs, mining communities, and other crowded environments. The program emphasizes linking screening, diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up within existing platforms, avoiding parallel channels, and generating evidence on implementation, cost-effectiveness, and budget impact with a clear government adoption pathway. Projects should be led by LMIC organizations, ideally in target countries (e.g., Nigeria, South Africa, Kenya, Ethiopia, Bangladesh, Pakistan, India, Brazil), though others are welcome. Affected communities must play meaningful roles. Webinar 9 December, 15:00 CET.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：Unitaidが高感染率地域における結核・C型肝炎統合ケア拡大のため2500万米ドルの資金提供機会を発表
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は特定の感染症アウトブレイクに関する報告ではなく、Unitaidによる資金提供（助成金公募）の発表であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はTBとC型肝炎の統合ケア拡大に向けた資金提供プログラム（公募）の案内であり、具体的な疾病発生・流行事例を報告するものではない。挙げられている国々（Nigeria, South Africa, Kenya, Ethiopia, Bangladesh, Pakistan, India, Brazilなど）は想定される対象国の例示であり、実際の感染症発生地域ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 民主刚果伊波拉疫情半年　无国界医生：救援资源未转化为有效应对
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six months into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Doctors Without Borders says aid resources have not translated into an effective response.
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the country has recorded over 11,000 confirmed cases and more than 5,500 deaths, the second-largest Ebola epidemic on record. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) says funds and donor support have not translated into an effective, coordinated response. MSF runs eight Ebola treatment centers and has deployed three rapid-response teams, but gaps persist: two-thirds of deaths occur in the community, not in treatment facilities; monitoring systems are under-resourced; in Ituri, only about 9% of diagnosed patients were registered as close contacts before seeking care. In North Kivu’s Beni zone, three-quarters of transmissions occur in healthcare facilities due to limited disinfection, water, PPE, and triage. About €64.6 million has been spent, largely from private donors, with around 1,500 patients treated in MSF facilities. The relief groups urge stronger supervision, accountability, and resource allocation to the most affected areas, including private clinics and traditional healers, to rebuild trust and halt spread.

triage.headline_ja: 民主刚果のエボラ出血熱流行から半年、国境なき医師団「支援資源が効果的な対応に転化されていない」
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例11,000人超、死者5,500人超という史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行が継続中であり、医療施設内感染や監視体制の不備など対応の不備が指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行とされ、死者の2/3がコミュニティ内で発生、医療施設内感染が北キブ州ベニ地区で75%を占めるなど対応の脆弱性が顕著。資金は主に民間ドナーに依存しており、国際的な調整・監督強化が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: 美國麻疹旅遊疫情升至二級警示 疾管署研判對台威脅未增
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. measles travel-related outbreak upgraded to Level 2 alert; Taiwan CDC says the threat to Taiwan has not increased.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC upgrades U.S. measles travel advisory to Level 2 on 2026-11-17, citing a rapidly worsening outbreak in the United States but stating Taiwan’s risk remains low. As of 2026-11-12, the U.S. reported 5,412 confirmed measles cases across 47 states and 6 deaths; about 11% were hospitalized and 96% of cases had no vaccination or unknown status. The outbreak centers on Pennsylvania, South Carolina, and Utah, with 2,622 cases in the past three months and 14 consecutive weeks of >100 weekly cases, signaling sustained community transmission. Taiwan notes strong herd immunity: about 97% MMR coverage in children; high-risk health-care workers ~90% vaccinated and airline crew >80%. Domestic: 11 measles cases this year (3 locally, 8 imported from Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, Japan, the U.S., India, Kyrgyzstan). Advice includes ensuring two-dose MMR for children; adults born after 1966 traveling to measles regions may get one paid MMR dose 2–4 weeks before travel; pregnant women and infants should avoid outbreak zones; immunity takes at least two weeks post-vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の麻疹流行による渡航警報がレベル2に引き上げ、台湾CDCは台湾への脅威は増していないと判断
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は米国内での麻疹アウトブレイクと台湾の渡航警報引き上げであり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand等）での実際の発生事例として扱われているのは輸入症例の起源国としての言及のみで、現地発生の主題ではないため対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 本イベントは米国での麻疹アウトブレイクが主題であり、台湾CDCの渡航警報対応に関する記事。対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に含まれるベトナム・タイ・インドネシア・インドなどは台湾への輸入症例の起源国として言及されているのみで、当該国内での発生が主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。米国・台湾自体も対象国リストに含まれないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Rutan Unaaha bentuk 48 kader kesehatan warga binaan cegah penularan TBC dan HIV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unaaha Detention Center forms 48 inmate health cadres to prevent TB and HIV transmission.
article.articleSummary: Unaaha Detention Center (Rutan Kelas IIB Unaaha) in Konawe, Southeast Sulawesi, Indonesia, formed 48 inmate health cadres to curb transmission of tuberculosis (TB) and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) within the facility. Of 463 detainees, the center established a ratio of 10 cadres per 100 inmates, selecting 48 active participants for training. The cadre program follows directives from the Directorate General of Corrections to optimize prevention and control of communicable diseases in custodial facilities. During training, participants received comprehensive education on TB and HIV—hazards, early detection, and management—and completed pre-test and post-test assessments. Officials expect the cadres to serve as extensions of health staff, monitoring housing blocks, promoting personal hygiene, and reinforcing healthy living (PHBS) to create a healthier, safer, and more productive prison environment.

triage.headline_ja: ウナアハ拘置所、結核・HIV感染予防のため収容者48名を保健推進員として養成
triage.triage_reason: 既存の予防プログラム活動を伝える内容であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 拘置所内でのTB・HIV予防啓発・教育活動の通常業務報告であり、新規感染拡大や異常事象の報告ではない。
