article.articleHeadline: 與死神搶時間！剛果伊波拉累計近萬例 牛津新疫苗啟動英烏人體試驗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Racing Against Death! Ebola in the Congo Nears 10,000 Cases as Oxford's New Vaccine Kicks Off UK-Ukraine Human Trials
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo is nearing 9,704 reported cases with 4,687 deaths (case fatality ~49%), driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Oxford University’s new vaccine, using a zero live-virus manufacturing approach and leveraging COVID-19 vaccine experience, has started multinational human trials in the United Kingdom and Uganda (Uganda’s Phase I–B trial underway). The vaccine aims to induce strong antibody and T-cell responses to a viral fragment, providing protection if exposed. Researchers are also evaluating potential cross-protection from Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) against the current strain, though findings are not yet confirmed. In parallel with vaccine development, animal studies and early human trials are conducted concurrently to accelerate timelines. Serum Institute of India has pre-stocked 620,000 doses and is expanding production to meet frontline needs, as global supply chains race to curb infections and severe disease in the DRC outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 死神との競争！コンゴのエボラ出血熱が累計約1万例に、オックスフォードの新ワクチンが英国・ウガンダで人体試験開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱が約9,704例・致死率約49%と深刻であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、重症度）に該当し、国際的なワクチン開発・供給対応も進行中であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行の深刻化を主題とし、ウガンダ・英国・インドはワクチン治験・製造拠点としての言及であり感染発生国ではないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: রামেক হাসপাতালে ডেঙ্গুতে আরও একজনের প্রাণহানি
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another death due to dengue at Ramek Hospital.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, dengue deaths at Rajshahi Medical College Hospital (Ramk) rose with another fatality. Ratna Khatun, 40, of Kadirganj, Rajshahi city, was admitted 10 November and died 16 November at 12:52 pm due to dengue hemorrhagic fever and dengue encephalitis. Ramk has recorded 24 dengue deaths this year, with Chapainawabganj residents accounting for 10 (the highest), followed by Rajshahi with 7; Natore and Kushtia 2 each; Pabna, Jhenaidah, and Sirajganj 1 each. Combined Chapainawabganj and Rajshahi deaths total 17 (≈71% of the total). Officials cite Aedes larvae around homes in Chapainawabganj raising concerns. Earlier on 10 November, Bulu Begum, 40, of Dargapara, Rajshahi, died of dengue hemorrhagic fever at Ramk. From Jan 1–Nov 17, Rajshahi district and Ramk logged 3,656 dengue cases; Ramk alone 3,209 with 3,024 discharged. In the last 24 hours: 29 new admissions; 36 discharges; 161 dengue inpatients. Godagari 5, Puthia 4, Mohanpur 1 admitted.

triage.headline_ja: ラメク病院でデング熱による死亡者がまた1人
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュ・ラジシャヒ地域でデング熱による死亡者が継続的に発生し症例数も多いが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等のリスクは認められず既存の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられるため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はバングラデシュ・ラジシャヒ地域における既存のデング熱流行に関する続報であり、発生地域リストにIndiaが含まれるが記事本文はBangladeshのみを扱っているため、対象国リストに該当するverified_locationsはなし（Bangladeshは対象国リストに含まれない）。

article.articleHeadline: Há sete anos poderá ter surgido o primeiro caso de Covid-19. Cientistas apontam a data que mudou o mundo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven years ago, the first case of COVID-19 may have emerged. Scientists point to the date that changed the world.
article.articleSummary: Seven years after the putative start of the pandemic, scientists identify 17 November 2019 as the most probable date for the first COVID-19 case in China, with an uncertainty window extending to 4 October 2019. In a PLOS Pathogens study (published 2021), David Roberts, Jeremy Rossman and Ivan Jarić used an extinction-modeling approach—reversing a conservation method to infer the start of human SARS-CoV-2 transmission from the earliest known infections across 203 countries and territories. The analysis suggests the virus may have circulated in Wuhan before the December 2019 recognition of pneumonia of unknown cause linked to the Huanan Market. Internationally, first cases could have appeared earlier than official dates: Japan (Jan 3, 2020); Thailand (Jan 7); Spain (Jan 12); South Korea (Jan 14); United States (Jan 16). Findings are probabilistic estimates, not confirmed individual cases, reflecting difficulties in pinpointing the true origin amid limited early testing and asymptomatic infection.

triage.headline_ja: 7年前、COVID-19の最初の症例が発生していた可能性がある。科学者たちは世界を変えた日付を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 2019年のCOVID-19起源に関する過去の科学的研究・推定日付に関する回顧的記事であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の脅威や新規事象ではないため。
triage.notes: 2021年発表の学術研究（PLOS Pathogens）に基づく歴史的・回顧的な分析記事。COVID-19起源の推定日付に関する内容であり、新規の感染症発生イベントではないため対象国への該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Barrick furloughing some Congo mine personnel over Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: Barrick Gold Corp said it is furloughing non-essential personnel at its Kibali gold mine in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo and reinforcing health screenings after two Ebola cases were confirmed near the operation. The measures, announced on 2026-11-17, aim to reduce exposure risk for workers and prevent further spread in the area around the Kibali site. Furloughs apply to staff not required for core mine operations while health screenings are being intensified at the site. The report did not provide details on the Ebola strain, patient status, or how the infections were contracted. The moves reflect precautionary steps by Barrick in response to confirmed Ebola cases near the Kibali site.

triage.headline_ja: バリック社、エボラ懸念によりコンゴの鉱山要員の一部を一時帰休
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のキバリ鉱山付近でエボラ出血熱の確定症例が2件報告され、企業が予防的措置を講じている。エボラは常に公衆衛生上重大なイベントであり、IHR通知対象疾患であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は企業（バリック社）の経済的対応に焦点を当てており、エボラ株、患者の状態、感染経路など疫学的詳細は不明。公式保健当局（DRC政府、WHO）からの発表内容を確認し、フルリスク評価で詳細情報を収集する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dugaan Keracunan Makanan Viral, Codeblu Komentari Dapur Restoran Sushi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Food Poisoning Goes Viral, Codeblu Comments on the Kitchen of a Sushi Restaurant
article.articleSummary: Suspected food poisoning in Indonesia drew public attention after a sushi restaurant customer reported illness following a shared meal. The incident went viral as social media users discussed the patient's symptoms and restaurant practices. Indonesian creator Codeblu commented on video footage allegedly from the kitchen of Sushiwokwok, highlighting hygiene concerns: dirty receipts, raw salmon stored improperly, and meat turning dark—raising questions about storage duration and cross-contamination. The video reportedly shows salmon that appears reused or not properly separated from rice, suggesting possible reuse of previously served sushi. In addition, meat (beef) was observed stored in proximity to rice, implying inappropriate separation of proteins. Codeblu questioned SOP adherence and urged scrutiny of food-safety measures. The discussion mentions possible involvement of the Badan Perlindungan Konsumen (Consumer Protection Agency) and underscores calls for safety standards and investigations, though no lab-confirmed diagnoses or case counts are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 疑わしい食中毒がバイラル化、CodebluがSushi店の厨房について言及
triage.triage_reason: 単一の食中毒疑い事例であり、検査確定診断や症例数も不明。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、SNS上の話題性にとどまる。
triage.notes: 一レストランでの食中毒疑いがSNSでバイラル化した事例。衛生管理上の懸念は指摘されているが、感染症アウトブレイクとしての証拠（検査確定、複数症例、公的機関の介入等）は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ninh Bình tập trung cao độ kiểm soát, khống chế bệnh dịch tả lợn châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ninh Bình intensifies efforts to control and contain African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks in Vietnam reached 1,542 across 921 communes in 31 of 34 provinces in 2026, with 205,602 pigs dead or culled. Ninh Bình Province is among the eight hardest-hit, reporting over 10,000 pigs destroyed. Since early November 2026, 12 more communes in Ninh Bình have ASF, about half of them relapsing. Districts Đồng Thái, Tây Hoa Lư, Nho Quan, Thanh Sơn, Phú Sơn, and Yên Khánh show large culling totals and persistent transmission. Nghe An is described as having a complex ASF dynamic as of 05/11/2026. On 16/11/2026, the Ninh Bình People’s Committee issued Directive No. 8151 mandating intensified, coordinated containment: delineated zones, daily/weekly reporting, rapid diagnostic confirmation before culling, strict movement controls, and crackdown on illicit slaughter and trade, with vaccination and biosecurity emphasized. Departments will bolster surveillance and farmer support; local leaders held accountable to prevent wider spread.

triage.headline_ja: ニンビン省、アフリカ豚熱の制圧・抑制に全力で取り組む
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（アフリカ豚熱）であり直接ヒトへの健康影響はないが、ベトナム全土で大規模発生中であり、養豚産業・食料供給・貿易への影響が懸念されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ASFはヒトに感染しない動物疾患であり公衆衛生上の直接リスクは低いが、31/34省に拡大し20万頭超が死亡・殺処分されるなど大規模な食料安全保障・経済的影響がある。政府が強制的な封じ込め指令（第8151号）を発令しており、今後の貿易制限や経済的波及に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: como recorde de casos nos EUA e avanço do vírus nas Américas ameaça eliminação da doença no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Record U.S. Cases and the Virus's Advance Across the Americas Threaten the Elimination of the Disease in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in the Americas threaten Brazil’s elimination status as the United States loses its measles elimination certification after more than a year of active transmission. The U.S. reported a record number of measles cases this year (about 5,700 confirmed through Nov 13, per Johns Hopkins), with at least eight deaths in Pennsylvania, New York, and Wisconsin. OPAS re-evaluated the status in meetings held last week. In Brazil, which eliminated measles in 2016 and was certified measles-free in 2024, 65 cases had been confirmed by early November 2026 across São Paulo, Amazonas, Rio de Janeiro, and Acre. Some municipalities launched mass revaccination and a dose zero campaign for infants 6–11 months, not replacing the routine two-dose schedule. National coverage reached 95.3% (first dose) and 80.7% (second dose) in 2026, up from 2025’s 93.2% and 78.6%. Imported cases and limited local transmission persist, especially in Amazonas and São Paulo; maintaining 95% vaccination remains the key defense, with São Paulo nearing interruption after 12 weeks without new cases.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：米国での記録的な感染者数とアメリカ大陸全域でのウイルス拡大がブラジルの排除達成を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは2024年に麻疹排除認証を受けたが、2026年に65例の確認例が報告され再興の兆候があり、米国の排除認証喪失とアメリカ大陸全体での拡大という国際的拡大リスクが認められるため、IHR基準を2つ満たしフルRRAへ進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国の麻疹排除認証喪失とそれに伴うブラジルでの再興リスクであり、対象国リストにある国はブラジルのみ。米国・スペイン領カナリア諸島は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu scare hits Namakkal egg exports, pushes prices below production cost - english.punjabkesari.com
article.articleSummary: Bird flu outbreak in Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu triggers cancellations from overseas buyers, hitting Namakkal’s egg exports (India’s poultry hub). Importers in the United Arab Emirates, Oman and South Africa pulled orders over biosecurity concerns, while farmers say Namakkal itself remains unaffected. Exports have fallen from about 25 crore eggs per month six months ago to 15 crore, then a further 50% to roughly 7.5 crore this month, with ongoing freight disruptions fueled by the Iran–Israel conflict. The National Egg Coordination Committee cut procurement price to Rs 6 per egg from Rs 6.70, leaving producers with costs around Rs 6.50 per egg and a below-break-even margin. Namakkal hosts about 1,000 layer farms producing six crore eggs daily; biosecurity is being tightened, and demand is seasonally weaker due to Sashti and Sabarimala.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ懸念がナマッカルの卵輸出を直撃、価格が生産コストを下回る
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州クダロールでの鳥インフルエンザ発生による輸出国（UAE・オマーン・南アフリカ）のバイオセキュリティ懸念から貿易制限（注文キャンセル）が生じているが、人への感染報告はなく主に家きん・貿易経済への影響に留まるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 疾患タグは『鳥インフルエンザの人への感染』となっているが、記事本文には人への感染報告はなく、タミル・ナードゥ州の家きん産業における経済的影響（卵輸出減少、価格下落）が主題。UAE、オマーン、南アフリカ、イラン、イスラエルは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu detected in two Alappuzha farms; 26,000 birds to be culled
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (avian influenza) confirmed at two poultry farms in Alappuzha district, Kerala, with culling of about 26,000 domestic birds planned within a one-kilometre radius of affected farms in Ambalappuzha North, Ambalappuzha South and Chennithala panchayats. Infection detected among quails and chickens at Ward 11, Ambalappuzha North and among ducks and chickens at Ward 1, Chennithala. Samples tested positive at NIHSAD in Bhopal. Preliminary estimate indicates 10,044 birds in Ambalappuzha North will be culled as part of the operation. Six rapid response teams from the Animal Husbandry and Health departments will conduct culling on Wednesday; each team comprises a doctor, two livestock inspectors, two attendants and four workers. A 10-km surveillance zone is declared. District authorities held an emergency meeting to coordinate preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザがアラップーザ州の2つの養鶏場で検出、2万6000羽の殺処分へ
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州の養鶏場で鳥インフルエンザが確認され殺処分・監視区域設定などの対応が行われているが、現時点でヒト感染の報告はなく、インドでは比較的頻発する動物衛生事象であるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はケララ州アラップーザ県の家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生と殺処分対応に関するもので、ヒト感染の報告は含まれていない。動物衛生当局による緊急会議と監視区域設定が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Barrick furloughing some Congo mine personnel over Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola cases confirmed near Kibali gold mine in Haut-Uele, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, prompt Barrick to furlough non-essential personnel and reinforce health screenings. Officials reported the cases were fatal; Barrick says contact tracing with health authorities and the World Health Organization found no employees or contractors exposed, and mining operations at Kibali continue normally. Barrick had earlier increased Ebola precautions in May, reflecting ongoing outbreak conditions. Kibali is one of Africa's largest gold mines, jointly owned by Barrick and AngloGold Ashanti (45% each) with 10% by SOKIMO. Congo's Ebola outbreak is the second-largest on record, with more than 11,000 infections and over 5,000 deaths; artisanal mining has been affected, though no industrial mines have reported cases. The company did not specify how many personnel were demobilized.

triage.headline_ja: バリック社、エボラ懸念でコンゴの一部鉱山要員を一時帰休
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（11,000人以上感染、5,000人以上死亡）に関連し、大規模金鉱山近郊で致死例が確認され、国際企業が人員対応を行っている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: DRCのエボラアウトブレイクは史上2番目の規模とされ、産業鉱山での感染確認は本記事が初めての可能性があり、経済・鉱業分野への波及が懸念される。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 美國麻疹疫情失控！ 確診破5400例、創35年新高 旅遊警示今升至第二級
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles outbreak in the United States spiraling out of control! More than 5,400 confirmed cases, a 35-year high; travel advisory now raised to Level 2.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in the United States escalates, with 2026 US confirmed measles cases surpassing 5,400—a 35-year high. CDC data through Nov 12 show 47 states reporting 5,412 cases and 6 deaths, about 11% hospitalized. Community transmission concentrated in Pennsylvania, South Carolina, and Utah. About 96% of cases are unvaccinated or have unknown vaccination status. The Pan American Health Organization is considering revoking the region’s 26-year measles elimination status. In response, Taiwan's CDC raised its international travel advisory for the United States to Level 2 Alert, advising pregnant women and children under 1 to avoid outbreak areas; infants 6–11 months may be vaccinated after medical consultation, with protection two weeks post-vaccination. Domestic risk is not considered increased. Taiwan reports 11 total measles cases this year, including 3 local and 8 imported from Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, Japan, United States, India, and Kyrgyzstan.

triage.headline_ja: 米国麻疹（はしか）流行が制御不能に！確診数5,400例超え、35年ぶりの高水準。渡航警告は第2級に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: 米国の麻疹症例数が35年ぶりの高水準に達し、死亡例・入院例も発生、国際的拡大（台湾等への輸入例・PAHOの排除認定見直し検討）と渡航制限（台湾の警戒レベル引き上げ）が確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 本イベントは米国（ペンシルベニア州・サウスカロライナ州・ユタ州）での麻疹流行が主題であり、対象国リストに米国は含まれない。記事中に言及されるベトナム・タイ・インドネシア・インド・キルギス等は台湾への輸入感染症例の渡航歴国として挙げられているのみで、これらの国自体で麻疹アウトブレイクが発生しているわけではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Barrick confirms Congo mine personnel furlough over DRC Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-17, Barrick confirms two Ebola cases were confirmed near the Kibali gold mine in Haut-Uele, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo. The company furloughed non-essential personnel and intensified health screenings, with contact tracing by health authorities and the World Health Organization finding no exposed employees or contractors; mine operations continue normally. Barrick did not disclose the number demobilised and noted that Ebola precautions had been heightened since last May. Kibali is jointly owned by Barrick and AngloGold Ashanti (45% each) with 10% by SOKIMO, and is one of Africa’s largest gold mines. Congo’s Ebola outbreak—the second-largest on record—has infected more than 11,000 people and killed more than 5,000; there have been no cases at industrial mines, though artisanal operations have been affected.

triage.headline_ja: バリック・ゴールド、DRCのエボラ懸念によりコンゴ鉱山スタッフを一時帰休と確認
triage.triage_reason: DRC北東部で進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（感染1万1000人超、死者5000人超）に関連し、主要金鉱山運営企業が人員一時帰休などの対応を取っており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRCで継続中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（史上2番目の規模、感染者1万1000人超、死者5000人超）に関する産業界（キバリ金鉱山、バリック社）への影響報道。鉱山労働者への直接感染例はないが、既知の深刻なアウトブレイクの一環として既にWHO等が対応中であり、フルリスク評価の継続対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: 科学网-手机数据还原创纪录的埃博拉疫情的早期传播
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ScienceNet - Early transmission of the Ebola outbreak reconstructed from mobile phone data
article.articleSummary: Nature reports epidemiologists used anonymized mobile-phone data and testing records to map the early spread of Bundibugyo Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo weeks before the outbreak was officially announced. The first confirmed case appeared May 15; the country declared an outbreak, and the WHO designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Since May, more than 10,000 infections and 5,198 deaths have been reported, making this the largest Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak to date with no approved vaccine or targeted therapy. Mobility analyses show higher infection risk within 150–200 km of the initial center in Ituri Province, driven by movement to larger towns. Surveillance signals were missed early, partly due to reduced funding for community health workers. Bundibugyo-specific testing began in early June in affected regions; previously diagnostics identified only Zaire ebolavirus, and several healthcare worker clusters occurred.

triage.headline_ja: 科学網－携帯電話データが記録的なエボラ流行の早期拡散を再現
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言し、10,000人超の感染・5,198人の死亡が報告される史上最大規模のブンディブギョ型エボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 本記事はNature誌の報道を引用し、携帯電話データによる感染拡大の事後解析を扱う学術的性格が強いが、背景となる流行自体が極めて深刻（PHEIC宣言済み、死者5,198人、承認されたワクチン・治療薬なし）であり、既にフルリスク評価の対象となっている可能性が高い。続報で公式統計・対応状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 'ก.ควบคุมโรค' ยัน 'ผู้ป่วยหัด' ที่ออสเตรเลีย ไม่ได้ติดเชื้อจากไทย มาจากพื้นที่ 'ระบาดหนัก'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Disease Control confirms that the measles patient in Australia did not contract the infection in Thailand and came from an area with a severe outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s Department of Disease Control confirms the measles case reported in Australia did not originate in Thailand. IHR-based investigation traces the patient’s travel from Dhaka, Bangladesh, to Bangkok’s Suvarnabhumi Airport on Thai Airways TG340 (seat 46D) and then to Sydney on TG475 (seat 36D) on 7 November 2026; symptoms began 2 November 2026, with a rash appearing on 8 November, and lab-confirmed measles infection. The patient was likely infectious during the Bangkok–Sydney segment. Bangladesh is experiencing a severe outbreak with over 50,000 cases and at least 350 deaths, making it the probable infection source, though a source earlier in travel cannot be excluded. Close contacts on the implicated flights, especially near seats 46D and 36D, should monitor for 21 days (through 28 November 2026) and seek medical care if fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes, or rash develop. Vaccination is emphasized; contact 1422 for inquiries.

triage.headline_ja: タイ疾病管理局、オーストラリアの麻疹患者はタイでの感染ではないと確認、重度流行地域からの感染と発表
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染源はバングラデシュ（対象国外）の大規模流行とされ、タイでの感染は否定されているが、タイ国内のフライト接触者への21日間の曝露監視が継続中であり、二次感染の可能性を経過観察する必要がある。
triage.notes: 感染源とされるバングラデシュ（50,000例以上、死亡350人以上の大規模流行）は対象国リストに含まれない。タイは経由地であり、当局は自国内感染を否定しているため、タイでの『発生』とは認定できない。ただし搭乗便の接触者モニタリングはタイ国内でも実施されている可能性があり、続報に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Alta de infecções exige resposta integrada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in infections demands an integrated response
article.articleSummary: Measles in São Paulo marked Brazil’s first case this year, with total infections at 65—a 71% rise from 2025. COVID-19 cases have surged from about 50,000 in March to 120,000. Mpox also climbs, reaching 1,099 cases this year, just above last year’s 1,075 as December nears. The co-occurrence of these infections strains health authorities and the population, underscoring the need to reinforce protective measures and preparedness. Vaccination remains central but complex for three diseases: measles vaccines under the National Immunization Program since 1973, second-dose coverage around 80% versus the WHO 95% target, with a measles-free status certificate regained a little over two years ago. For COVID-19, regular vaccination is advised for many, including the elderly. Mpox vaccination remains limited to a small group, causing confusion with outdated immunization cards. Dengue season looms; projections estimate 860,000–1.6 million dengue cases in coming months, possibly peaking in April 2027, amplified by a super El Niño. The SUS must organize and intensify prevention to prevent overload.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症の増加に統合的対応が求められる
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の排除認定後の初症例や71%増、COVID-19の倍増以上の増加、デング熱の大規模流行予測など、複数疾患が同時進行しており公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められる。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル国内の複数感染症（麻疹・COVID-19・Mpox・デング熱）の同時流行に関する論説記事であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限への言及はない。ブラジル保健当局（SUS）の対応強化の必要性が論じられている。

article.articleHeadline: Após morte por mpox: o que se sabe sobre sintomas, contágio e formas de prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After death from mpox: what is known about symptoms, transmission, and ways to prevent.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) in Brazil reports 1,055 confirmed cases and one death in Rio de Janeiro among a 40–49-year-old patient with immunocompromise; 46 probable and 617 suspected cases are under monitoring. Caused by MPXV, an Orthopoxvirus, the disease is a zoonosis with wild African rodents as natural reservoirs. Transmission occurs via direct contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, saliva, or contaminated items (bedding, towels, utensils). Incubation spans 3–16 days, up to 21; individuals remain infectious until all crusts shed and new skin forms, typically 2–4 weeks. Symptoms include myalgias, headache, chills, weakness, and evolving vesiculopustular lesions that can involve face, mouth, hands, feet, and genital/anal regions. Treatment is supportive; no approved specific antiviral exists. Vaccination is two doses, 28 days apart, for adults 18+, prioritized for high-risk groups such as laboratory workers handling samples, people with HIV with CD4 <100, PrEP users, and those with direct exposure after epidemiological assessment.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox(エムポックス)による死亡後：症状、感染経路、予防法について分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロ州における既知のMpox流行の継続報告であり、死亡例1件と重症化リスクはあるが、新規性・異常性は低く既存流行のアップデートに留まる。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内での既存Mpox流行（確定1,055例、死亡1例、免疫不全患者）に関する一般向け解説記事であり、新規の国際的拡大や渡航制限等の言及はない。継続的な症例動向の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला वायरस के बढ़ते वैश्विक खतरे के बीच झारखंड में भी अलर्ट, केंद्र ने दिए ये 4 निर्देश
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid the growing global threat posed by the Ebola virus, Jharkhand is also on alert; the Centre has issued these four directives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease alert extends to Jharkhand as the Centre issues four directives. With rising global Ebola cases in Kenya and Nigeria, the Indian Ministry of Health and Family Welfare instructs Jharkhand to maintain heightened readiness. A letter from Joint Secretary Harsh Mangla to Chief Secretary Ajay Kumar Singh mandates immediate review of preparedness, ensuring resource availability and robust inter-department coordination. Emphasis is placed on swift case identification, isolation, treatment, and safe specimen handling. Four directives: (1) secure adequate PPE stock at hospitals; (2) keep isolation and treatment facilities ready at designated referral hospitals; (3) enforce strict infection prevention, control, and timely sample collection and lab transport; (4) strengthen reporting and inter-departmental collaboration for rapid action. A Mock Drill 2.0 was conducted on Nov 12 at referral hospitals, with an ICMR observer, to refine preparedness and feed the National Disease Control Center with post-exercise reports.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの世界的脅威拡大を受け、ジャールカンド州にも警戒態勢—中央政府が4つの指示を発出
triage.triage_reason: エボラの実際の発生国はケニア・ナイジェリア（対象国外）であり、インドはあくまで予防的な準備態勢強化の段階で感染発生の確認はないため、フルRRAに進む緊急性は低いが、グローバルな拡大動向として継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインド（ジャールカンド州）における予防的な準備態勢強化を報じるものであり、インド国内でのエボラ発生は確認されていない。実際の発生国とされるケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Un virus qui progresse très rapidement
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A virus that progresses very rapidly.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo strain is driving the Democratic Republic of Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak, spreading markedly faster than earlier episodes. The U.S. CDC says it is the second-largest outbreak ever recorded for this virus. Declared in May 2026, the outbreak's rapid progression highlights enhanced transmission dynamics relative to prior outbreaks. The article excerpt does not provide specific case or death counts. The Bundibugyo strain is a known Ebola variant; public health authorities are monitoring transmission and reinforcing detection and response measures to contain spread within the DRC and prevent cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: 急速に拡大するウイルス
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）による第17次アウトブレイクが発生し、過去2番目の規模かつ従来より急速に拡大していると報告されており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるため。
triage.notes: 米国は発生地域として記載されているが、記事内容はDRC国内の流行拡大に関するものであり、米国CDCは情報源として言及されているのみのため米国は含めない。具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu detected in two Alappuzha farms; 26,000 birds to be culled
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (avian influenza) confirmed at two poultry farms in Kerala’s Alappuzha district, triggering culling of about 26,000 domestic birds within a 1-km radius of the affected farms in Ambalappuzha North (Ward 11), Ambalappuzha South and Chennithala panchayats. Infection detected in quails and chickens at Ambalappuzha North Ward 11, and in ducks and chickens at Chennithala Ward 1. Laboratory confirmation from the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD), Bhopal. Preliminary estimates indicate 10,044 birds in Ambalappuzha North alone will be culled. Six rapid response teams—each with a doctor, two livestock inspectors, two attendants and four workers—will conduct the culling on Wednesday, 18 November 2026; two more teams on standby. A 10-km surveillance zone surrounds the farms; emergency meetings with district officials and local bodies have coordinated the response. Keywords: outbreak, culling, Kerala, poultry, NIHSAD.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザがアラップーザの2養鶏場で検出、2万6000羽を殺処分へ
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州の養鶏場で鳥インフルエンザ（H5系統と推定）が確認され殺処分対応が進行中だが、ヒトへの感染報告はなく、現時点では動物衛生事案にとどまる。人獣共通感染症としての監視継続が必要。
triage.notes: 家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生で、ヒト感染の報告は記事中に見られない。インド・ケララ州アラップーザ地区での局地的な家禽アウトブレイクとして、地方自治体による殺処分・サーベイランス対応が進行中。ヒト感染例の有無について続報を注視する必要がある。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Thứ trưởng Bộ Y tế: Viện Pasteur TP.HCM tạo nền tảng quan trọng trong giám sát, cảnh báo và khống chế dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Minister of Health: Pasteur Institute in Ho Chi Minh City lays an important foundation for surveillance, early warning, and outbreak containment.
article.articleSummary: On November 17, 2026, Deputy Minister Lê Đức Luận praised Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City for 135 years of foundational work in surveillance, early warning, and outbreak containment in Vietnam. At the 2026 scientific conference, themed 'Research for Community Health: Adaptation and Innovation,' the institute highlighted seven national-level studies and more than 20 vaccine trials. Notable achievements include the BCG vaccine for pediatric TB; the first HIV case identified in 1990; and the last polio case confirmed in 1996. From 2001–2010, it decoded the full genome of influenza A/H5N1 (2003), supported diagnostics for southern units, and advanced vaccine research. It also detected Enterovirus 71 causing acute encephalitis in children, and contributed to Zika (2016), COVID-19 (2020), and monkeypox (2022) work. The event urged strengthened surveillance, forecasting, tech transfer, and international collaboration. In Ho Chi Minh City, five meningococcal meningitis cases among students (one death); eight southern provinces report rising numbers.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省次官：ホーチミン市パスツール研究所は監視・警報・流行制御における重要な基盤を築いている
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は研究所の135周年記念式典だが、文末に「ホーチミン市で学生5例の髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎（うち1名死亡）、南部8省で増加傾向」との言及があり、クラスター化・拡大の可能性を示す断片情報のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事本来の主題はパスツール研究所の歴史的功績紹介であり、感染症アウトブレイクに関する一次報道ではない。ただし末尾の髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎クラスター（学生5例・死亡1例、南部8省で増加）の記述は独立した懸念材料であり、詳細情報（発症時期、地理的分布、血清型等）が不明なため、追加情報の収集が望ましい。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Đẩy mạnh nghiên cứu, ứng dụng công nghệ trong giám sát dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Promoting research and the application of technology in disease surveillance
article.articleSummary: On 17 November 2026, the Ho Chi Minh City Pasteur Institute marked 135 years with a scientific congress themed “Research for Public Health: Adaptation and Innovation.” Deputy Minister Le Duc Luân urged intensified research, technology application, and enhanced surveillance, early warning, and translation of findings into practical disease control in Vietnam. The Institute highlighted seven state-level projects and more than 20 vaccine clinical trials, noting milestones such as the BCG vaccine for pediatric tuberculosis, the first HIV infection detected in 1990, and the last polio case confirmed in 1996. In influenza work, 2003 saw the complete genome decoding of A/H5N1 and the institute supported diagnostics for suspected cases from 126 southern units, aiding virus surveillance and vaccine development. The Institute also identified Enterovirus 71 causing pediatric encephalitis, reported Zika in 2016, confirmed the first COVID-19 case in 2020, and the monkeypox case in 2022, coordinating large-scale vaccine trials. Emphasis was placed on strengthening surveillance, forecasting, AI and digital health, and expanding domestic–international collaboration and tech transfer to local health services.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病監視における技術研究・応用の推進
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はパスツール研究所135周年記念の科学会議に関する報道であり、過去の実績紹介と今後の研究方針の表明であって、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去の歴史的実績（HIV・ポリオ・H5N1・EV71・ジカ・COVID-19・Mpoxなど）の振り返りと、今後の監視技術強化方針についての式典報道であり、現行の具体的な感染症発生事例を報告するものではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Malária no Namibe: cinco vectores para avançar para a eliminação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria in Namibe: five vectors to advance toward elimination.
article.articleSummary: Namibe Province, Angola, hosted the Moçâmedes congress (6–7 November) on malaria control toward five-year pre-elimination and interruption of local transmission. In 2025, malaria cases reached 163,062 with 175 deaths, down from 183,536 cases and 268 deaths in 2024; the first half of 2026 saw 100 malaria deaths, vs 121 in H1 2025. In 2023–2024, about 3% of children aged 6–59 months tested positive for malaria, indicating generally favorable indicators but uneven local risk. Bibala, Lucira and Cacimbas had the highest incidence, with Bibala reporting 3,959 cases in Q3 and a substantial reduction thereafter. The plan hinges on five complementary vectors; first: (1) epidemiological surveillance and rapid response, and (2) integrated mosquito control, adapted to Namibe’s desert/semi-desert climate and transmission dynamics.

triage.headline_ja: ナミベ州のマラリア：撲滅に向けた5つのベクター（対策要素）
triage.triage_reason: アンゴラ・ナミベ州における既知の風土病マラリアの対策進捗報告であり、症例・死亡数は前年より減少傾向。異常性・国際的拡大リスクはなく、対象国にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はアンゴラのナミベ州におけるマラリア撲滅会議・統計報告が主題。発生地域にBrazilやParaíbaが付与されているが、記事中にブラジルへの言及はなく誤付与と判断。アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: ഒരാഴ്ചയ്ക്കിടെ 13 പേർക്കു ഡെങ്കി, പടരുമെന്നു ഭീതി; കാര്യവട്ടം ക്യാംപസ് അടച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue hits 13 people in a week; fear of spread; Karyavattom Campus closed.
article.articleSummary: Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala: Dengue fever infected 13 people in a week, forcing the University of Kerala’s Karyavattom Campus and its hostels to close temporarily. The outbreak is most severe among hostel residents, with several students who had returned home on holidays reporting fever. In a joint meeting of the university Syndicate and health department officials, the campus and hostels were closed for three days. Dengue was confirmed in 10 students and 3 staff members. Classes will switch to online. To curb transmission, fogging and full disinfection will be conducted around the campus and hostel premises. Students allege that the disease spreads in an unsanitary environment and say authorities have not acted despite repeated complaints.

triage.headline_ja: 1週間で13人がデング熱感染、拡大への懸念；カリヤヴァッタム・キャンパスを閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 単一大学キャンパス内でのデング熱クラスター（13例）であり、局地的対応（一時閉鎖・消毒）が取られている。地域的拡大や深刻な公衆衛生危機の明確な証拠はないが、衛生環境への懸念と感染継続の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はケララ州で季節的に発生する既知の疾患であり、本件は大学キャンパス内の局地的クラスター。学生は不衛生な環境と対応の遅れを訴えているが、地域当局はフォギングや消毒等の対応を実施済み。国際的拡大やIHR通知相当の事象ではないが、感染継続のリスクがあるため続報を注視。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di Kongo Meluas Krisis Pangan dan Konflik Bersenjata Perburuk Situasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Congo widens as a food crisis and armed conflict worsen the situation.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo widens amid hunger and conflict. As of November 14, 2026, 11,376 laboratory-confirmed infections and 5,568 deaths have been reported (case fatality ~49%), spanning 68 health zones across eight provinces, with about 240 deaths per week recently. The response is hampered by fragile infrastructure: many clinics lack clean water, electricity, sterilization, and safe waste disposal, limiting protective equipment effectiveness. MSF notes roughly two-thirds of Ebola deaths occur in the community, signaling weak surveillance and delayed case detection. The current strain is Bundibugyo; there is no vaccine or proven treatment. Widespread rumors—including distrust of care centers—fuel fear. A looming food crisis threatens nearly 29 million people with acute insecurity, rising toward 30 million, as conflict in Ituri and Kivu drives displacement and disrupts farming. Contact tracing is hampered by armed attacks; private health-sector involvement is urged. Isolation remains difficult amid extreme poverty.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が拡大、食糧危機と武力紛争が状況を悪化させる
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行が継続・拡大しており、致死率約49%、死者数・感染者数が多く、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心・支援が必要なためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ワクチン・有効治療薬がない点、武力紛争・食糧危機による対応困難、地域社会での死亡率の高さ（サーベイランスの弱さ）が強調されており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Венесуэла в бешенстве: целые штаты захватывает страшное вирусное заболевание
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Venezuela in a frenzy: a terrifying viral disease is sweeping through entire states.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak intensifies in 2026, triggering a national quarantine as six deaths from animal bites are confirmed, with vaccination efforts focused in Sucre and southern regions. A 14-year-old boy died in Sífontes, Bolívar, after bat exposure; five more deaths occurred in Sucre from stray-dog attacks, including a man, another man, a woman, and two children. A 2025 Caracas child death is noted. In Week 42 of 2026, Sucre shows high activity: of 219 brain tissue samples from animals, 154 are positive (70.3%). Main vectors: street dogs (128/179); infected cats (19); wild bats carrying forest strain. Nine municipalities are affected in Sucre; Caracas leads with 77 foci, followed by San Francisco (23), Mara (16), Lagunillas (12). Nationally, 42,363 suspicious bites (+25.9% vs 2025); 967 consultations in Week 42. Protocols emphasize wound washing, post-exposure prophylaxis, and a plan to vaccinate 2.5 million animals; Brazil donated 5,000 human vaccines via PAHO.

triage.headline_ja: ベネズエラが狂乱状態：恐ろしいウイルス性疾患が複数の州を席巻
triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラでの狂犬病流行は深刻化しているが、対象監視国（ブラジル等）での直接発生は確認されておらず、国際的拡大リスクも限定的なため、フルRRAには進めず経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はベネズエラ（Sucre州、Zulia州、Caracas等）での狂犬病流行であり、ブラジルはワクチン提供国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため、対象国リストに該当する発生地域はなし。国境地域（ブラジル等）への波及可能性は今後注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: SUS reforça vacinação contra Covid-19, mpox e pneumonia com novas remessas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SUS reinforces vaccination against COVID-19, mpox, and pneumonia with new shipments.
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s Unified Health System (SUS) is expanding shipments of COVID-19, mpox, and pneumococcal vaccine nationwide. Guided by the Ministry of Health and the National Immunization Program, vaccines remain free but are allocated by age, comorbidity, and risk. COVID-19 vaccines stay in the National Vaccination Schedule, prioritizing children 6 months to under 5 years, pregnant people, and those 60+, with additional lots to ten states, including São Paulo (>500,000), Rio de Janeiro (350,000), and Minas Gerais (290,000). Mpox vaccination targets high-risk groups (people living with HIV, PrEP users, lab workers, and contacts of confirmed cases) at Immunization Reference Centers, not in Basic Health Units. Pneumo 20 vaccine now covers elderly 85+, with a single dose for first-time recipients or boosters spaced per prior vaccination. Access via local health channels; logistics are phased and vary by municipality.

triage.headline_ja: SUS、新規出荷によりCOVID-19・mpox・肺炎ワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常のワクチン接種プログラムの拡充に関する行政発表であり、異常な感染症発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの通常予防接種プログラム（SUS）に関する行政広報であり、新規感染症発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため対象国verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Viện Pasteur TP HCM cảnh báo nguy cơ bùng phát dịch do tỷ lệ tiêm chủng giảm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City Pasteur Institute warns of the risk of a disease outbreak due to declining vaccination rates
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in southern Vietnam, led by Ho Chi Minh City, with 2024-2025 waves larger than 2014 and 2019. Early in the period, more than 85% of cases were children under 10; the dip in second-dose measles vaccination in the South (below 80%) created an immunity gap. A catch-up campaign for 1-10-year-olds and expansion to 6-9 months was launched. Pertussis is rising, mainly affecting infants under 3 months, with over half of transmissions originating from adults in households. Diphtheria deaths have occurred among unvaccinated individuals; neonatal tetanus persists among migrant workers. Polio has reappeared in neighboring Laos. Root causes include uneven vaccine coverage and incomplete post-pandemic recovery, with high-risk groups in dormitories and industrial areas being overlooked. About 60% previously refused vaccination, though 85% would vaccinate after counseling. WHO and local authorities urge rapid containment within 24-48 hours, better data linkage, and a proactive, primary-care-driven prevention strategy.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市パスツール研究所、ワクチン接種率低下による感染症流行リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の大規模流行（過去最大規模）、百日咳の増加、ジフテリアによる死亡、新生児破傷風の残存、近隣ラオスでのポリオ再出現など複数のワクチン予防可能疾患が同時進行しており、IHR基準2項目以上・WPRO基準複数該当のためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナム（主にホーチミン市を含む南部）における麻疹・百日咳・ジフテリア・新生児破傷風の同時流行を主題としている。ポリオはラオスでの再出現が言及されているが、ラオスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOおよび地元当局が24-48時間以内の迅速な封じ込めを要請しており、国際支援の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Lào Cai nâng cao năng lực phòng, chống dịch bệnh động vật tại 8 xã biên giới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lao Cai strengthens capacity for the prevention and control of animal diseases in eight border communes.
article.articleSummary: In early November 2026, Lao Cai Province’s Department organized eight animal-disease prevention trainings for 238 participants across eight border communes: Pha Long, Si Ma Cai, A Mu Sung, Y Ty, Trịnh Tường, Bát Xát, Bản Lầu, and Mường Khương. The aim is to raise knowledge and skills of local officials and village representatives to detect and curb livestock diseases at the community level and enable rapid response. Training covered livestock and veterinary regulations, recognition of infectious diseases in cattle and poultry, and zoonoses; plus guidance on livestock management, vaccination, sanitation, disinfection, biosecurity, and safe husbandry. Emphasis on surveillance, anomaly reporting, and coordinated outbreak response; with a focus on TOT (training of trainers) to empower participants to continue disseminating knowledge. The program is part of ICT4Health collaboration with the Vietnam National Institute of Animal Husbandry and partners, targeting mobility and dispersed farming in border areas.

triage.headline_ja: ラオカイ省、国境沿い8コミューンにおける動物疾病予防・対策能力を強化

article.articleHeadline: Namakkal egg exports fall as bird flu scare hits demand
article.articleSummary: As of Nov 17, 2026, Namakkal's egg exports have fallen sharply after a bird flu outbreak in Cuddalore prompted overseas buyers to cancel orders. Tamil Nadu's poultry hub, with more than 1,000 layer farms and about six crore eggs produced daily, saw shipments shrink from around 25 crore eggs per month to 15 crore, and then drop a further 50% to roughly 7.5 crore as demand eroded and freight costs rose due to the Iran-Israel conflict. The National Egg Coordination Committee cut the procurement price to Rs 6 per egg from Rs 6.70 (reductions of 20 paise on Nov 11, then 25 paise on 13 and 15). Production costs are about Rs 6.50 per egg, leaving little margin. Importers in UAE, Oman, and South Africa canceled orders. Namakkal's farmers report the outbreak affected only Cuddalore broilers; Namakkal's egg-laying birds remain healthy. Biosecurity measures intensified: disinfection, restricted visitors, sprayed feed vehicles.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザの懸念によりナマッカルの卵輸出が減少
triage.triage_reason: Tamil Nadu州Cuddaloreでブロイラーの鳥インフルエンザ発生が報告されているが、人への感染や重症例の言及はなく、記事の主題は経済的影響（輸出減少）である。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽（ブロイラー・採卵鶏）における鳥インフルエンザの経済的影響（輸出減少、価格下落）が主題であり、人への感染事例の報告はない。Namakkalの採卵鶏は健康であると報告されている。Iran, Israel, Oman, UAE, South Africaは輸出先・物流コストの文脈でのみ言及されており、発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Scoping Review Identifies Broad Animal Hosts Driving Severe Fever With
article.articleSummary: SFTS (severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome) is a tick-borne zoonosis in Asia. Identified in China in 2009, it has reached Japan and the Republic of Korea, with records in Southeast Asia. In humans it causes acute fever with thrombocytopenia and GI symptoms; case-fatality is 5–30%, higher with age and comorbidity. A scoping review of 353 studies (2011–2025) maps a vertebrate host network across at least 15 species, including domestic livestock with seroprevalence of 45.7% in sheep/goats and 36.7% in cattle; pigs and chickens show lower but detectable seroprevalence. Active viremia in livestock is transient, but PCR confirms replication. Haemaphysalis longicornis is the principal vector; other ticks harbor viral material. Lab data show transstadial and transovarial transmission; sentinel goats acquire infection after heavy tick exposure. Wildlife (wild boar, hedgehogs, shrews, small rodents) maintain cycles, with S-segment homology between goat isolates and feeding ticks.

triage.headline_ja: スコーピングレビューにより、重症熱性血小板減少症候群（SFTS）を媒介する広範な動物宿主が特定される
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は既知疾患であるSFTSの動物宿主に関する学術的スコーピングレビューであり、新規の発生事例やアウトブレイクを報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は2011〜2025年の353件の研究を対象とした学術レビューであり、SFTSの既知の疫学的・生態学的知見（宿主動物、ベクター、伝播経路）を整理したもの。新規の症例増加や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す記述はない。中国はSFTSの起源国として言及されているため対象国に含めたが、日本・韓国は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue spurt in Thiruvananthapuram: KU's Karyavattom campus, Cliff House compound emerge as hotspots
article.articleSummary: Dengue spike in Thiruvananthapuram centers on Kerala University’s Karyavattom campus, which has reported over 50 cases since November 9 and where transmission is believed to have started weeks earlier. In the city over the last 10 days, about 200 probable and 97 confirmed dengue cases have been recorded. Statewide in November, Kerala logged 739 confirmed and 2,056 probable cases, with three probable deaths. To curb transmission, the Karyavattom campus and hostel blocks will be shut for three days for intensified vector control, including fogging, indoor space spraying, and a source-reduction campaign. The Kerala Public Health Act may be invoked against the KU Registrar for allowing campus breeding grounds. Officials point to solid-waste mismanagement, rainwater stagnation in plastic containers, indoor plants, broken manholes, and blocked drains; Cliff House and nearby bungalows are also hot spots.

triage.headline_ja: ティルヴァナンタプラムでデング熱急増：ケララ大学カリヤヴァッタム・キャンパスとクリフハウス一帯がホットスポットに
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州における季節性デング熱の局地的な増加であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、死亡例や感染拡大が続いているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで季節的に発生する風土病であり、今回の報告も州内での局地的な対応（防疫強化、キャンパス閉鎖等）が既に行われている。国際的な拡大や渡航制限の懸念は低いが、死亡例の発生と感染拡大傾向から今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Concern Worldwide commits funding to help end Ebola transmission in the Democratic Republic of Congo as outbreak reaches six months - fundsforNGOs News
article.articleSummary: Concern Worldwide commits essential support to end Ebola transmission in the Democratic Republic of Congo as the outbreak reaches six months in eastern DRC. The update highlights ongoing transmission and public health response efforts, with a focus on sustaining frontline capacity, infection prevention and treatment, and rapid case detection to interrupt transmission. Eastern DRC has faced repeated Ebola outbreaks, and response operations emphasize keeping essential services functioning and promoting safe care-seeking and reporting of suspected cases as the crisis persists. The source does not specify funding amounts, partners, or precise locations beyond eastern DRC, but reiterates that continued funding is crucial to maintain health- and community-based responses aimed at ending transmission. The six-month milestone underscores the need for long-term planning, operational continuity, and adaptable programming for prolonged epidemics, benefiting affected people and communities.

triage.headline_ja: Concern WorldwideがDRCのエボラ対応を支援、発生から6ヶ月が経過
triage.triage_reason: 東部DRCでエボラの伝播が6ヶ月間継続しており、重症度が高く国際支援（NGO資金拠出）が必要とされている進行中の公衆衛生危機であるため。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規発生の報告ではなく、既存のエボラアウトブレイク（東部DRC、発生から6ヶ月）に対するNGOの資金支援継続を報じるもの。具体的な感染者数・死亡者数・正確な発生地域・資金額などの詳細情報は記事に記載されておらず不明。既存アウトブレイクの継続状況として経過観察・フルRRA実施の要否を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Aceh Utara laksanakan skrining cegah penyebaran TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Aceh Health Office conducts screening to prevent the spread of TB.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, the North Aceh Health Office in Aceh Province, Indonesia, is intensifying tuberculosis (TB) control across 27 sub-districts, targeting 1,300 residents suspected of TB. The initiative, expected to conclude by the end of November, follows instructions from the Ministry of Health to interrupt the TB transmission chain. The program emphasizes active screening and case identification to enable timely treatment and reduce spread within North Aceh. The report provides no counts of confirmed TB cases or deaths. This district-level intervention demonstrates adherence to national guidance to curb TB transmission within Aceh, with a focus on screening, early detection, and linkage to care.

triage.headline_ja: 北アチェ保健局、結核(TB)の感染拡大防止のためスクリーニングを実施
