article.articleHeadline: 'Vi khuẩn ăn thịt người' tấn công phổi, người đàn ông 54 tuổi phải thở máy
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Flesh-eating bacteria' attack the lungs, a 54-year-old man had to be put on a ventilator.
article.articleSummary: Burkholderia pseudomallei, the agent of melioidosis (Whitmore, often called the flesh-eating bacteria), caused severe pneumonia in a 54-year-old man (Nam N.H.D.) from Tay Ninh, Vietnam. He presented with dyspnea and multi-organ failure, rapidly requiring ICU care with endotracheal intubation and mechanical ventilation for septic-like shock. After about three days of intensive support, his respiratory status improved enough to transfer to the Pulmonology Department. During monitoring, he developed upper gastrointestinal bleeding; urgent esophagogastroduodenoscopy revealed a Forrest IIa gastric ulcer with mild duodenal erosions, and endoscopic hemostasis was achieved while continuing infection control and respiratory management. Nearly three weeks of treatment led to stabilization and discharge. Clinician Oanh notes melioidosis is a severe infection with high mortality if not detected early and advises prompt medical evaluation for respiratory symptoms. COPD/asthma patients should adhere to prescribed therapies. As of 17 November 2026, the patient was discharged.

triage.headline_ja: 「人食いバクテリア」が肺を攻撃、54歳男性が人工呼吸器を装着
triage.triage_reason: 単発のメリオイドーシス症例報告であり、ベトナムでは風土病として知られている。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、患者は治療後に退院しており、公衆衛生上の異常event性や拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシスは土壌・水を介した環境感染症であり、東南アジアでは風土病的に発生する。個人の重症例ではあるが、ヒト-ヒト感染がなく、単発症例であるためアウトブレイクシグナルとしての該当性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : une épidémie de diarrhée inquiète dans la zone de santé de Pinga (Walikale), au moins 28 décès signalés parmi les déplacés de guerre à Lukala
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: a diarrheal outbreak raises concerns in the Pinga Health Zone (Walikale), with at least 28 deaths reported among war-displaced in Lukala
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, in Lukala, Walikale territory, Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, a diarrheal outbreak among war-displaced residents has caused at least 28 deaths in the Lukala health area. The displaced, from Hembe, Kirungu and Birihi in Bashali Mukoto, Masisi, live in shelters with unsafe water, poor sanitation, and limited access to care. Contaminated water and inadequate latrines are driving transmission, raising risk for children and other vulnerable groups. Local authorities report an urgent need for medical treatment, medications, potable water, and improved sanitation at refugee sites. The interim Pinga health zone chief, Dr Théophile Muka, says advocacy with humanitarian partners (notably MSF Belgium and the Red Cross) is under way to secure support to address the outbreak and prevent further fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：ワリカレ地域ピンガ保健ゾーンで下痢症流行が懸念、ルカラの避難民の間で少なくとも28人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 紛争避難民キャンプでの下痢症流行により28人が死亡し、汚染水・不衛生な環境下で感染拡大のリスクが継続しており、国際人道支援（MSF、赤十字）が必要とされているため。
triage.notes: 原因病原体は特定されていないが、汚染水と不衛生な衛生環境が感染拡大要因とされる。避難民キャンプという脆弱な集団での流行であり、続報での病原体特定・死亡者数の推移の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya di Kalbar: 1.230 Kasus dan Gejala Utama
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya in West Kalimantan: 1,230 cases and main symptoms
article.articleSummary: As of November 17, 2026, West Kalimantan Province reports 1,230 chikungunya cases, with 1,179 suspected/clinical and 51 laboratory-confirmed across multiple districts and cities. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; symptoms include sudden fever above 38.5°C, severe joint pain, skin rash, and fatigue. Officials stress distinguishing it from dengue, which can present with high fever, headache, muscle pain, nausea or vomiting, and possible bleeding. To curb transmission, the 3M vector-control campaign—drain standing water, cover water storage, and dispose of or recycle items that harbor mosquitoes—is urged, especially as the rainy season intensifies. Residents should seek early evaluation at community health centers (puskesmas) or nearest health facilities if fever with severe joint pain occurs. Provincial and district health offices continue monitoring and mapping affected areas and encourage community participation in environmental cleanup.

triage.headline_ja: 西カリマンタン州でチカングニア熱:1,230症例と主な症状
triage.triage_reason: 西カリマンタン州でチクングニア熱1,230例の発生が報告されているが、重症度や異常性の情報が乏しく、地方保健当局による通常の監視・対策の範囲内と見られるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 雨季の進行によりAedes蚊媒介感染症（チクングニア熱・デング熱）の継続的なリスクがあるが、致死率は低く、地方保健当局が通常の監視・3M対策を実施中。重症例や死亡の報告はなく、国際的な拡大や渡航制限の兆候もない。

article.articleHeadline: Londrina registrou sete mortes por tuberculose em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Londrina recorded seven deaths from tuberculosis in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Londrina, Brazil, reported 251 tuberculosis cases and seven deaths in 2026, as the National Tuberculosis Day is observed on November 17. Blacks and mixed-race individuals account for 40% of cases (101 of 251). Partial 2026 data show greater burden among vulnerable groups compared with 2025: people experiencing homelessness (22 vs 14), people deprived of liberty (51 vs 20), and people living with HIV/AIDS (26 vs 20). The BCG vaccination coverage in Londrina reached 99.25% through September. TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis; pulmonary TB remains the main transmissible form via airborne routes, though extrapulmonary TB affects pleura, lymph nodes, and bones. Symptoms include coughing for ≥3 weeks, evening fever, night sweats, and weight loss. The national health system offers free rapid molecular testing for diagnosis and rifampicin resistance, and treatment typically lasts six months if drug-sensitive. Seven deaths highlight a need for improved diagnosis, notification, and contact tracing amid stigma.

triage.headline_ja: ロンドリーナで2026年に結核による死亡が7件報告される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一都市における結核の年間統計報告であり、国際的拡大や異常事態ではなく、通常の公衆衛生モニタリング情報である。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の地方風土病的疾患であり、脆弱層（ホームレス、受刑者、HIV感染者）での増加が見られるが、地域保健当局が通常対応している範囲内の事案。国際的な公衆衛生緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : survivants d'Ebola, ces soignants refusent d'abandonner le combat (REPORTAGE)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola survivors, these healthcare workers refuse to give up the fight (FEATURE)
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reaches six months since the May declaration, with 11,376 confirmed cases and 5,568 deaths reported through November 14, from the Bundibugyo strain, across 68 health zones in eight provinces—the second-largest Ebola epidemic on record. In Beni, Dr. Divin Kinzi, after 24 days in isolation, was declared cured, recounting initial headaches and diarrhoea before seeking treatment; he notes trauma from the loss of colleagues and vows to continue. In Mabalako, nurse Mbafumoja Shukuru Muhindo contracted the virus through direct contact with patients. Across North Kivu, more than 150 frontline health workers have been infected, including nine doctors, four of whom died, PPE shortages hampering response. As of Nov 14, North Kivu logged 2,860 confirmed cases and 1,590 deaths (CFR 55.6%), higher than the national average (48.9%), amid persistent insecurity and ongoing transmissions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ生存者である医療従事者たちが、戦いを諦めることを拒否（ルポルタージュ）
triage.triage_reason: 史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行で、11,376例確認・5,568人死亡、医療従事者の感染拡大とPPE不足が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 発生から6ヶ月経過し、北キブ州を中心に8州68保健地域に拡大。致死率は全国平均48.9%に対し北キブ州は55.6%と高く、治安不安とPPE不足が対応を阻害している。医療従事者150人以上が感染（医師9人中4人死亡）しており、人道・医療支援の国際的関与が強く求められる状況。

article.articleHeadline: Bird Flu Detected in Two Alappuzha Farms; 26,000 Birds to Be Culled
article.articleSummary: Bird flu confirmed at two poultry farms in Alappuzha district, Kerala; about 26,000 domestic birds will be culled within a 1-km radius of affected farms in Ambalappuzha North Ward 11, Ambalappuzha South, and Chennithala panchayat. Positive samples from quails and chickens at Ambalappuzha North Ward 11 and from ducks and chickens at Chennithala Ward 1 were confirmed as avian influenza by NIHSAD, Bhopal. Preliminary estimate: 10,044 birds to be culled in Ambalappuzha North; total culling around 26,000. Six rapid response teams will conduct the culling on Wednesday, November 18, 2026; each team comprises a doctor, two livestock inspectors, two attendants, and four workers, with two additional teams on standby. A 10-km surveillance zone is declared around the affected farms. District Collector Shaji V Nair convened an emergency meeting with Deputy Collector S Biju, Chief Veterinary Officer Dr P Rajeev, and officials from Health, Police, Local Self-Government, Food Safety and Motor Vehicles to coordinate preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザがアラップーザの養鶏場2か所で検出、2万6000羽を殺処分へ
triage.triage_reason: ケーララ州の養鶏場で家禽の鳥インフルエンザ感染が確認され殺処分・監視区域設定が行われているが、ヒトへの感染報告はなく国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限の兆候も現時点でないため、フルRRAには進まず続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽(ウズラ・ニワトリ・アヒル)における鳥インフルエンザであり、ヒト感染症例の報告は記事中にない。地方当局（郡長官主導）による殺処分・10km監視区域設定などの標準的な家禽防疫対応が行われている段階。ヒトへの感染拡大や重症例が確認されればPICKUPに格上げすべき。

article.articleHeadline: ആലപ്പുഴയിൽ രണ്ടിടങ്ങളിൽ പക്ഷിപ്പനി സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു; ഇന്ന് പക്ഷികളെ കൊന്ന് നശിപ്പിക്കും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza confirmed at two sites in Alappuzha; birds to be culled today.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza confirmed at two farms in Alappuzha district, Kerala, located in Ampalapuzha North Ward 11 and Chennithala Grama Panchayat Ward 1. Approximately 26,000 poultry within a 1 km radius of the outbreak centers will be culled to curb transmission, including 10,044 birds in Ampalapuzha North. The infection was confirmed by NIHSAD, Bhopal. Culling is scheduled for November 18 under district veterinary and health authorities, with six rapid-response teams deployed (each: one doctor, two livestock inspectors, two attendants, four workers). Additional support from panchayat members, police, revenue, and related staff; two teams held in reserve. A 10 km surveillance perimeter surrounds the outbreak centers. An emergency meeting chaired by District Collector Shaji V. Nair, with Deputy Collector S. Biju, Chief Veterinary Officer Dr P. Rajiv, and other officials, coordinated the response.

triage.headline_ja: アランプザで2カ所の鳥インフルエンザ確認、本日鳥の殺処分実施
triage.triage_reason: 家禽における鳥インフルエンザ確認で動物衛生対応事案だが、現時点でヒト感染の報告はなく、公衆衛生への直接的影響は限定的。行政対応は迅速かつ組織的であり、今後のヒトへの感染拡大有無を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生事案。ヒト感染例の報告はなく、現地当局（地区行政・獣医当局）により殺処分・監視体制が迅速に組織されている。インドのケララ州における家禽への影響に限定された情報であり、ヒトへの感染拡大の兆候があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果伊波拉疫情失控　華要求入境申報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo out of control; China requires entry declarations.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control six months after declaration; Africa CDC reports 11,254 confirmed cases and 5,505 deaths as of November 12 in the current outbreak. The World Health Organization notes it remains a public health emergency of international concern. China’s General Administration of Customs will require entry declarations from travelers who visited Ebola-affected countries within the past 21 days, had contact with Ebola cases, or show symptoms (fever, fatigue, headache, myalgia, sore throat, nausea/vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, rash, bleeding); measures take effect November 18 and are valid for one year. In addition, sanitation/disinfection is mandated for shipments, containers, goods, luggage, and outer packaging from affected regions. Separately, Kenya reports 9 Ebola cases with 2 deaths (Oct 6–Nov 10) and Nigeria reports 1 imported case (Oct 20).

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ疫病、制御不能　中国が入国申告を義務化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクがWHOによりPHEIC認定され、6ヶ月経過後も制御不能な状態が続き、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大や中国の渡航制限措置も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ケニアでの症例も報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国は入国管理措置を実施しているのみで感染発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。WHOによりPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として宣言されている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: ആലപ്പുഴയിൽ വീണ്ടും പക്ഷിപ്പനി; 26,000 വളർത്തുപക്ഷികളെ കൊന്നൊടുക്കാൻ തീരുമാനം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu again in Alappuzha; decision to cull 26,000 domesticated poultry.
article.articleSummary: Bird flu confirmed in Alappuzha district, Kerala, at Ambalappuzha North and Chennithala panchayats. About 26,000 domesticated poultry to be culled by district authorities to curb spread; culling to begin the next day (18 November 2026). Infections reported at a forest-based farm and at a poultry-raising site; in Chennithala, young chicks (3–4 days old) infected. Authorities note transmission from contact with wild birds, but illness now affects very young birds. The outbreak comes ahead of Christmas, fueling farmer anxiety. Losses have not yet been compensated; compensation announced is reportedly below market price, prompting some farmers to abandon poultry farming or chick-rearing projects.

triage.headline_ja: アラプーザで再び鳥インフルエンザ発生；家禽2万6000羽の殺処分を決定
triage.triage_reason: ケーララ州アラプーザ県で複数地域にまたがる鳥インフルエンザの再発生が確認され、若齢の雛にも感染が広がるなど異常性が見られる。家禽2.6万羽の殺処分という行政対応と農家の社会的関心の高まりがあり、ヒトへの感染リスク評価も含めフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ケーララ州アラプーザ県における家禽の鳥インフルエンザ発生に関するもので、ヒト感染の報告は記事中に明記されていない。疾患名に'Human Infection with Avian Influenza'が含まれるが、サマリー内容は家禽（動物）への影響のみを記述している点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết đe dọa cả người trẻ khỏe mạnh, cần tăng cường phòng bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever threatens even healthy young people; stronger prevention measures are needed.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever remains a major threat in Vietnam, with 170,684 cases and 21 deaths nationwide in the first 10 months, up 26% year over year. A 24-year-old man from Vũng Tàu in Ho Chi Minh City presented with high fever, chest pain, vomiting and diarrhea, reaching shock; laboratory tests confirmed dengue infection and extensive myocardial injury with multi-organ dysfunction. He required VA-ECMO to support circulation while the heart recovered; after a week of intensive care he was able to stop inotropes, wean from ECMO and discharge. This case highlights that dengue can cause fulminant myocarditis and severe organ damage even in previously healthy young adults, with high fatality risk around defervescence (days 3–7). Four dengue serotypes are circulating year-round, and elimination of Aedes breeding sites, early warning, vaccination where appropriate, and personal protection are essential components of prevention.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱、健康な若者にも脅威。予防対策の強化が必要
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで例年発生しているデング熱の流行状況報告であり、症例数・死亡数は増加しているが異常事態とは言えない。重症例（心筋炎）の症例報告は注目に値するが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: ベトナムにおける年間を通じたデング熱流行の定期報告記事。前年比26%増ではあるが、デングはベトナムの風土病であり季節性変動の範囲内と考えられる。重症心筋炎症例が1例報告されているが、個別症例であり全体のアウトブレイクパターンの異常性を示すものではない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: ആലപ്പുഴയിൽ പക്ഷിപ്പനി സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു; 26,000 വളർത്തുപക്ഷികളെ കൊന്നൊടുക്കും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu confirmed in Alappuzha; 26,000 farmed birds to be culled.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (H5N1) confirmed in Alappuzha district, Kerala, India, with 26,000 farmed birds slated for culling in Ambalappuzha North and Chennithala panchayats. Laboratory confirmation from samples indicated the H5N1 strain. An emergency meeting chaired by District Collector Shaji V. Nair at the district collectorate approved swift culling operations led by the rapid response team to contain spread. Authorities report no human infections to date, but they warn of ongoing transmission risk and urge public vigilance. Public health measures to intensify surveillance and containment in affected areas are planned, with immediate steps to sanitize and monitor farms. No information on sources or imported/exported cases is provided.

triage.headline_ja: アラップーザでの鳥インフルエンザ確認；飼育鳥26,000羽を殺処分予定
triage.triage_reason: ケーララ州でH5N1の家禽感染が確認され殺処分が実施されているが、現時点でヒト感染例は報告されておらず、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は未確認のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ヒト感染例は報告されていないが、H5N1家禽感染であり、作業者等への曝露や今後の人への感染拡大の可能性は継続的に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി വ്യാപനം രൂക്ഷം; കേരള സര്‍വകലാശാല കാര്യവട്ടം ക്യാമ്പസും ഹോസ്റ്റലും മൂന്ന് ദിവസത്തേക്ക് അടച്ചു; ക്ലാസുകള്‍ ഓണ്‍ലൈനിലേക്ക്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe dengue fever outbreak; University of Kerala's Kariavattom Campus and hostels closed for three days; classes moved online.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak prompts three-day closure of the University of Kerala’s Kariavattom Campus and hostels, with online classes during the period. As of 17 November 2026, 13 dengue cases have been confirmed within a week, comprising 10 students and 3 staff, with the highest transmission reported from the Ladies Hostel. Numerous individuals exhibit fever, and many awaiting test results. Some students who had been on leave abroad reportedly contracted fever after returning. The action followed discussions at a Syndicate meeting with health department officials. During closure, teaching will be online, and containment measures will include cleaning and fogging in hostels and surrounding areas to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の流行が深刻化；ケララ大学カリアヴァットムキャンパスと寮を3日間閉鎖；授業はオンラインに移行
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州の一大学キャンパス内での局地的なデング熱アウトブレイク（13例）であり、季節性疾患として異常性は低いが、学生寮での感染拡大が続いているため継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はケララ州で季節性に毎年発生する疾患であり、13例という規模は大学キャンパス内の局地的流行に留まる。重症例・死亡の報告はなく、保健当局が既に対応（消毒・燻蒸）を実施している。国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội chia sẻ mô hình chuyển đổi sinh kế phòng bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi shares a livelihood transformation model for rabies prevention
article.articleSummary: Hanoi implements a One Health model to prevent rabies by addressing the source rather than vaccination alone; the approach links human, animal, and environmental health while protecting livelihoods. The project 'Pilot model for rabies prevention, sustainable economic development, and transition of the dog and cat meat trade' was approved July 24, 2025 by Hanoi People's Committee, led by Dept. of Agriculture and Environment and the Livestock, Fisheries and Veterinary Sub-Department, with technical support from Soi Dog Foundation and SBCC Vietnam. After a year across 14 wards, 28 dog and cat meat businesses stopped and 25 households registered to pivot livelihoods; Giang Vo ward became the first to end the trade. The model blends government oversight with community support: voluntary withdrawal, then training, startup assistance, and market linkages. New livelihoods include billiards, beverages, small-scale trading, and online selling. It supports increased vaccination and aims for zero rabies deaths by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ、狂犬病予防のための生計転換モデルを共有
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病予防のための政策・生計転換プログラムの進捗報告であり、新規症例や公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の発生報告ではなく、ハノイ市による犬猫食用取引転換・生計支援を通じた予防プログラムの進捗に関する内容。感染症シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: वायरल फीवर की दवा से नहीं उतर रहा बुखार? हो सकता है स्क्रब टाइफस, जानें इसके शुरुआती संकेत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever not coming down with medicines for viral fever? It could be Scrub Typhus—know its early signs.
article.articleSummary: Scrub Typhus is a bacterial infection transmitted to humans by bites of infected chiggers (larval mites) in tall grass, shrubs, fields, gardens, and forests. Symptoms—fever, headache, chills, and body aches—mimic viral fever, delaying diagnosis; laboratory confirmation aids differentiation. Eschar, a dark crust at the bite site, can appear on hidden areas such as the armpits, groin, waist, breasts, neck, chest, abdomen, back, genitals, or perianal area, but is not present in all patients. Untreated, it can involve lungs, kidneys, liver, and brain. Onset typically 7–10 days after the bite. Risk is higher for people in farming, horticulture, and bush/field areas in Asia-Pacific and India. Antibiotics are effective; early treatment reduces serious complications.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス性熱の薬でも熱が下がらない？それはツツガムシ病かもしれません。初期症状を知っておきましょう
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、ツツガムシ病に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数や地域的な異常発生の報告がないため。
triage.notes: 本記事はツツガムシ病（Scrub Typhus）の症状・診断・治療に関する一般的な医療啓発コンテンツであり、特定の国・地域でのアウトブレイクや症例増加を報告するものではない。発生地域としてIndiaとChinaが付与されているが、記事サマリーには特定の発生事例や地域的流行の記述がなく、一般的なリスク説明（農業従事者等）に留まるため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Podcast JR 15 Min #1552 | Mpox, covid-19 e sarampo: o alerta das doenças infecciosas no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Podcast JR 15 Min #1552 | Mpox, COVID-19 and Measles: The Alert About Infectious Diseases in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Mpox in Brazil has surpassed 1,000 cases in 2026, with at least one mpox-related death reported. COVID-19 hospitalizations are rising in several states, signaling renewed transmission. Measles cases in Brazil increased by 71% compared with 2025. In Podcast JR 15 Min #1552, infectious disease physician Dr. Álvaro Furtado of the University of São Paulo's Hospital das Clínicas discusses what’s driving these trends and how to curb further spread. The discussion covers surveillance, vaccination, and public health measures to reduce transmission. The report emphasizes a growing alert about these infections in Brazil, underscoring the need for vigilance and preventive actions to limit outbreaks and protect vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: ポッドキャスト JR 15分 #1552｜Mpox、COVID-19、麻疹：ブラジルにおける感染症への警鐘
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでMpoxが1,000例超・死亡例報告、麻疹が前年比71%増、COVID-19入院も増加しており、複数感染症の同時拡大という異常な公衆衛生事象としてフルRRAでの精査が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はポッドキャスト形式でMpox・COVID-19・麻疹の3疾患の同時増加傾向を専門医が解説する内容。具体的な地域（サンパウロ州等）の内訳や国際的な拡大の有無については言及がなく不明。複数疾患の同時流行という点でサーベイランス強化の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola à Beni : huit patients guéris après l'introduction de deux nouvelles molécules | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola in Beni: Eight Patients Cured After the Introduction of Two New Molecules | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Eight Ebola patients were cured and discharged from the Ebola Treatment Center in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, on November 16, 2026, after the early November introduction of two therapeutic molecules, MBP134 and Remdesivir, used alongside standard supportive care. Among the recovered are three children, including two infants. Byamungu Nyonyolia left the center with her two children; she had previously lost a two-year-old son who tested positive and died, and days later her five-year-old developed fever before both were admitted. Dr. Jérémie Katsavara, head of patient care at Beni, notes the therapies are adjuncts to existing care, with pediatricians and child-specialized nurses involved. UNICEF reports, as of November 4, 2026, 2,959 Ebola infections in children under five in the DRC and 1,737 deaths, with about 80% of child fatalities outside treatment centers. Authorities urge vigilance and restricting movement of symptomatic children to enable rapid care.

triage.headline_ja: ベニのエボラ：2種の新薬導入後、患者8人が回復
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する続報で、小児の感染・死亡者数が多く、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大・支援の必要性が認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: UNICEF報告によると2026年11月4日時点でDRC国内の5歳未満児のエボラ感染は2,959人、死亡は1,737人に上り、死亡の約80%が治療センター外で発生。新規治療薬（MBP134、レムデシビル）導入による回復例が報告されているが、依然として深刻な流行状況が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Congonhas realiza Dia D de mobilização e enfrentamento à dengue no dia 28 de novembro - Correio de Minas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congonhas Holds D-Day for dengue mobilization and response on November 28.
article.articleSummary: Congonhas, Minas Gerais, will hold a dengue mobilization on November 28, 2026, from 7:00 to 13:00, to intensify control of Aedes aegypti, the vector of dengue, zika and chikungunya. In partnership with the Government of Minas Gerais, activities include education in the central region, commerce and neighborhoods, distribution of materials, home visits, and guidance to identify and eliminate breeding sites. The '10 Minutes Against Dengue' campaign urges a ten-minute weekly inspection of homes, yards and workplaces. Nine Basic Health Units (UBSs) will be open that Saturday as support points. Since 2025, Congonhas has used drone surveillance, school health education, and a Municipal Dengue Combat Committee; the last dengue case occurred in July 2026, with declines in dengue, zika and chikungunya in 2025–2026. Prevention is ongoing, especially during the rainy season. Report irregular dumping to the Urban Cleaning Directorate at (31) 98472-6712 or (31) 3732-0722; EcoPonto, Rua Jair Pereira Toledo, Jardim Profeta, 7:00–17:00. Seek UBS evaluation for fever, headaches, retro-orbital pain, joint pain, nausea or rash.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴーニャス市、11月28日にデング熱対策動員デーを実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジル・コンゴーニャス市における定例のデング熱予防啓発活動の案内であり、最後の症例は2026年7月で2025-2026年にかけて症例数は減少傾向にある。異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地元自治体による予防啓発・蚊対策の定例キャンペーン記事。症例数は減少傾向にあり、感染症危機シグナルとしての該当性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Outbreak: How Fear and Mistrust Drive Community Spread
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with health teams battling the fastest-growing outbreak on record. Community transmission is escalating as families care for sick relatives at home, delaying hospital care and complicating contact tracing. In the village of Nizi 4, residents like Gorette Mbusi resist sending kin to the specialized Ebola facility in nearby Nizi, citing fear and previous losses after hospitalization. Two family members reportedly died after being transported to hospital, reinforcing mistrust and delays in seeking care. Authorities stress that ending community transmission requires faster hospital treatment uptake, thorough contact tracing, and community education about Ebola. Efforts center on overcoming suspicions and isolating contacts in eastern Congo as of 2026-11-17.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・エボラ流行：恐怖と不信がコミュニティ内感染を助長
triage.triage_reason: 過去最速ペースで拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行であり、コミュニティ内感染の制御が困難化している点でIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: NYTが『記録上最速で拡大する流行』と報じており、家庭内看護による受診遅延・接触者追跡の困難さが指摘されている。国際的拡大リスクは明記されていないが、エボラの性質上高いリスクと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : la transmission interrompue dans de nombreux premiers épicentres, Bunia enregistre une baisse de moitié
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: transmission interrupted in many initial epicenters; Bunia records a 50% drop.
article.articleSummary: Six months into an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo caused by Bundibugyo virus, transmission has been interrupted in several initial epicenters, including Mongbwalu, Nyankunde, Nizi, Rwampara, and Butembo, according to WHO on 15 November 2026. In Bunia, new case numbers have halved and treatment centers report low occupancy. Despite these gains, the outbreak remains active nationally with 400–500 new cases weekly across 67 health zones in eight provinces. Laboratory capacity has expanded from 2 to more than two dozen labs, and about 2,000 beds are available across 104 treatment and transit centers. Approximately 3,000 people have survived Ebola. WHO emphasizes consolidating progress, extending gains to other affected and at-risk areas, improving access to hard-to-reach communities, surveillance, and community engagement to interrupt transmission sustainably.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行：多くの初期震源地で感染が途絶、ブニアでは新規症例が半減
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ(Bundibugyoウイルス)流行が6ヶ月継続中で、8州67保健区域にまたがり週400-500例の新規症例が発生している重大かつ進行中の公衆衛生事象であり、フルリスク評価の継続対象となる。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内の流行進捗（改善傾向）を報告する続報。発生地域にRwandaが含まれているが、記事サマリー上ではDRC国内の感染状況のみが主題であり、ルワンダでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。本事案は既存の大規模進行中アウトブレイクであり、継続的なモニタリング・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: केरलम के अलप्पुझा में दो पोल्ट्री फार्म में बर्ड फ्लू की पुष्टि, 26 हजार पक्षियों को मारा जाएगा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu confirmed at two poultry farms in Alappuzha, Kerala; 26,000 birds to be culled.
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (avian influenza) confirmed at two poultry farms in Alappuzha district, Kerala, prompting culling of about 26,000 birds to curb spread. Affected zones include Ambalappa?uzha North, Ambalappuzha South, and Chenithla Panchayats within 1 km of the farms, with a 10 km monitoring zone established. One farm in Ambalappuzha North Ward 11 housed quail and chickens; the other in Chenithla Ward 1 kept ducks and chickens. Lab confirmation was obtained from the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal. Initial culling estimate in Ambalappuzha North is 10,044 birds. Six rapid response teams will operate (each: 1 doctor, 2 veterinary inspectors, 2 assistants, 4 staff), with two additional teams on standby. District Collector Shaji V Nair chaired an emergency meeting with senior officials to coordinate containment and preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州アラプーザのポートリー農場2か所で鳥インフルエンザ確認、2万6千羽を殺処分へ
triage.triage_reason: 家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生で、ヒトへの感染報告はなく、地方当局により通常の防疫対応（殺処分・モニタリングゾーン設定）が実施されている定型的な事例。
triage.notes: 疾患名にHuman Infection with Avian Influenzaとあるが、記事内容は家禽（ウズラ・ニワトリ・アヒル）の感染のみでヒト感染の報告はない。地方自治体（アラプーザ郡）が緊急対応チームを編成し封じ込め中。

article.articleHeadline: ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി ഭീഷണി; കാര്യവട്ടം ക്യാംപസും ഹോസ്റ്റലും മൂന്ന് ദിവസത്തേക്ക് അടച്ചിട്ടു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue threat; Karyavattom campus and hostel closed for three days.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak at the Karyavattom campus of the University of Kerala in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, triggers a three-day closure of the campus and hostel facilities. In the past week, 13 dengue cases have been confirmed (10 students, 3 university staff). Transmission is strongest in student hostels; several residents exhibit symptoms and are awaiting laboratory results. Some students who returned home for breaks have developed fever. In response, the university syndicate and the health department held a joint meeting and ordered three days of closure, with online classes during this period. Vector-control and infection-prevention measures, including fogging around the campus and sanitation drives, will be implemented. Students allege unsanitary conditions contributed to spread; authorities are tracing contacts and monitoring the health status of affected individuals.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の脅威；カリヤヴァットムキャンパスと寮が3日間閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 単一大学キャンパス内での局地的なデング熱アウトブレイク（13例）であり、IHR基準・社会的関心は限定的だが、人-人感染媒介性疾患の流行拡大可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ケララ州トリバンドラムの大学キャンパス内での局地的流行。地元当局（大学・保健当局）が対応中で、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。デング熱はインドで季節性・地域流行性疾患であり、単独のキャンパスでの発生として重症度・異常性は高くない。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Uélé: à Nganya (Durba), la riposte contre Ebola attaquée à coups de pierres et de machettes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Haut-Uélé: at Nganya (Durba), the Ebola response was attacked with stones and machetes.
article.articleSummary: Durba, Haut-Uélé, Democratic Republic of the Congo, sees escalating distrust as an Ebola response team, aided by the Red Cross, attempts to decontaminate a bereaved household in Nganya but is met with violent resistance: over 50 residents hurled stones and machetes, and the response vehicle was sabotaged. No deaths reported yet, but fear and rupture are evident. Residents complain they’re not informed about interventions, what will be placed in homes, where patients will be taken, or when the Ebola Treatment Center (CTE) will be ready. In nearby Bavière, 14 healthcare workers who tested positive are being treated on site in a clinic closed by decree, with no medicines provided and limited medical oversight. At Julien Andavo hospital, patients refuse to leave despite closure, underscoring demands for prior evaluation before reopening. Health workers are caught between angry communities and patients who refuse to depart, revealing deep mistrust and protection gaps in the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: オー・ウエレ州：ンガニャ（ドゥルバ）でエボラ対応チームが石や山刀で襲撃される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ対応チームへの暴力的抵抗、医療従事者14名の陽性確認、コミュニティの深刻な不信感が報告されており、公衆衛生対応の実効性に重大な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域に含まれるBavaria/Germanyは記事内の地名「Bavière」（DRC国内の地区名）がBluedotにより誤って独仏のBavariaと認識されたものと判断し、verified_locationsから除外した。コミュニティの医療対応拒否・暴力行為は感染拡大リスクを高める要因として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Rég voltak ilyen számok, ezek a fertőzések betegítették meg a hajdú-bihariakat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There haven't been numbers like these in a long time; these infections have sickened the people of Hajdú-Bihar.
article.articleSummary: As of the Nov 2–8, 2026 surveillance week, Hajdú-Bihar County reported: Campylobacteriosis 11; Salmonella 7; Rotavirus 4; Viral hepatitis 5; Hepatitis A 5; Scarlet fever 1; Varicella 3. National totals for these diseases were Campylobacteriosis 133; Salmonella 62; Rotavirus 35; Viral hepatitis 40; Hepatitis A 31; Scarlet fever 38; Varicella 82. A mass territorial gastroenteritis outbreak began in Zala County on Nov 4; 1495 exposed, 373 ill with mild diarrhea and vomiting; hospitalizations not required. Four of eight stool samples were positive for Bacillus cereus by the NEBIH laboratory; preliminary assessment points to a multi-food safety issue across several foods and processing steps; investigation ongoing. Three imported dengue fever cases were recorded: two in Győr-Moson-Sopron (a 30-year-old man and a 26-year-old woman) who were in Vietnam during incubation; one in Pest County (a 35-year-old woman) who was in the Maldives during incubation.

triage.headline_ja: 久しぶりの数字、ハイドゥー・ビハール県の住民を病気にした感染症
triage.triage_reason: ハンガリー国内の通常の感染症サーベイランス報告であり、デング熱は渡航者の輸入例に限られ対象国での発生ではない。対象国での公衆衛生上の懸念は確認できない。
triage.notes: デング熱症例はベトナム・モルディブへの渡航歴がある輸入例であり、ベトナム国内での発生ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。主な出来事はハンガリー国内の感染症動向・食中毒アウトブレイクであり対象国外。

article.articleHeadline: Cơ sở bánh mì khiến 155 người ngộ độc ở Quảng Trị bị phạt 90 triệu đồng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The bakery that caused 155 people to suffer food poisoning in Quảng Trị Province was fined 90 million dong
article.articleSummary: Minh Tam Bakery in Cam Lộ, Quảng Trị Province, Vietnam, was fined 90 million dong and ordered to suspend all food processing for four months after a food-poisoning outbreak that affected 155 people. On 14 September, the bakery produced and sold sandwiches and baguettes; 46 people were hospitalized, with the remainder treated at home. Health authorities determined no criminal liability, issuing an administrative penalty and suspension. The business was also required to cover all costs for treatment and investigation, with a 10-day window to implement remedial measures. Laboratory testing by Pasteur Institute Nha Trang showed Salmonella spp in 9 of 11 food samples and 11 of 13 patient samples. All 46 hospitalized patients were discharged by 22 September in stable condition.

triage.headline_ja: クアンチ省でパンを食べた155人が食中毒となったパン屋が9000万ドンの罰金を科された
triage.triage_reason: 単一のパン屋が原因の食中毒事例で、既に行政処分・施設改善が完了し患者全員が回復・退院しており、国際的拡大や継続曝露のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 疾患名にParatyphoid/Typhoidとタグ付けされているが、記事内容はSalmonella spp.による単一施設の食中毒事例であり、既に行政処分と業務停止措置が完了している。パラチフス菌の記載はなく、タグ付けの誤りと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Cơ sở bánh mì bị phạt 90 triệu đồng sau vụ 155 thực khách ngộ độc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bakery fined 90 million dong after 155 customers were poisoned.
article.articleSummary: Quảng Trị Province, Vietnam, fined Minh Tam Bakery in Cam Chính Hamlet, Cam Lộ Commune, 90 million dong and suspended for four months after 155 people were poisoned by sandwiches and other bakery fillings sold there. The penalty, issued by the provincial People’s Committee on 17 November 2026, requires the owner to bear all medical and outbreak-response costs, and to implement corrective measures within 10 days. The outbreak began on 15 September 2026, with more than 40 people developing fever, chills, abdominal cramps, vomiting and diarrhea after consuming bread products. Laboratory tests showed 9 of 11 food samples from the site positive for Salmonella; 11 patient specimens were Salmonella-positive, and one case also involved Staphylococcus aureus toxin causing vomiting; two samples were negative. Authorities ruled the violation not criminally prosecutable.

triage.headline_ja: 155人の食中毒事件を受け、パン店に9000万ドンの罰金
triage.triage_reason: 2026年9月に発生したサルモネラによる食中毒事件（155人罹患）に対する行政処分の事後報告記事であり、既に収束・対応済みで国際的拡大リスクや継続的な公衆衛生上の脅威はない。
triage.notes: Bluedotの疾患名はParatyphoid/Typhoidとなっているが、記事内容はSalmonella（一部Staphylococcus aureus毒素も関与）による食品由来の食中毒事件であり、腸チフス・パラチフスではない。事件は既に発生から2ヶ月以上経過し、行政処分・営業停止・是正措置が完了している事後報告。

article.articleHeadline: 利德曼：控股子公司重组B群脑膜炎球菌疫苗启动Ⅰ期临床试验
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ledman: Its holding subsidiary launches Phase I clinical trial of a recombinant meningococcal group B vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Ledman Biochemical's holding subsidiary Beijing Xiansheng Xiangrui Bioproducts Co., Ltd. has launched a Phase I clinical trial of a recombinant Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B vaccine (expressed in Escherichia coli) to prevent B group meningococcal meningitis. The randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study is conducted at the Hunan Provincial Center for Disease Control and Prevention and includes participants aged 3 months and older. The vaccine received the National Medical Products Administration Drug Clinical Trial Approval Notice on 2026-08-06. Domestic vaccines for serogroup B meningitis have not been approved; overseas vaccines by GSK and Pfizer exist. This trial represents progress in China’s domestic B meningitis vaccine development. R&D is lengthy and high-risk; success and market approval remain uncertain and are unlikely to impact near-term company performance.

triage.headline_ja: 利徳曼：持株子会社が組換えB群髄膜炎菌ワクチンの第I相臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、ワクチン開発（第I相臨床試験開始）に関する企業発表であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、Ledman Biochemicalの子会社によるB群髄膜炎菌ワクチンの臨床試験開始に関する企業・投資家向けニュース。疾患発生の報告ではないため、疫学的シグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Bird Flu outbreak crashes Namakkal egg exports and prices
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, a bird flu outbreak in Cuddalore has crashed Namakkal's egg exports, Tamil Nadu's poultry hub. Overseas buyers in the UAE, Oman, and South Africa have cancelled orders, leaving exports slumped from about 25 crore eggs per month to minimal numbers. The National Egg Coordination Committee has cut procurement prices to six rupees per egg, below the production cost of 6.50. Namakkal remains considered safe; the Cuddalore outbreak affected only broilers, while local farms house egg-layers. Domestic consumption has also fallen due to Sashti fasting and the Sabarimala pilgrimage. Despite the downturn, farms report no massive unsold stock yet. Farmers have intensified biosecurity—disinfecting vehicles, restricting visitors, and spraying feeds—to restore buyer confidence and revive export volumes.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ発生によりナマッカルの卵輸出と価格が暴落
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザ（家禽）の発生による経済的影響（輸出キャンセル・価格下落）が主題で、ヒト感染の報告はなく重症度情報もないが、鳥インフルエンザの潜在的な流行性を踏まえ経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はCuddalore（タミル・ナードゥ州）でのブロイラー向け鳥インフルエンザ発生に伴う、ナマッカルの卵輸出業への経済的影響（UAE・オマーン・南アフリカからの発注キャンセル、価格下落）を報じるもの。ヒト感染例の記載はなく、ナマッカル自体は「安全」とされている。発生地域リストに含まれるOman, South Africa, UAEは輸出先であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue transmission eases in Agusan Sur town
article.articleSummary: Dengue transmission in San Francisco, Agusan del Sur, Philippines, shows signs of easing but remains active across all 27 barangays. As of the Nov. 14 Municipal Health Office surveillance, 21 new dengue cases were recorded in the past week, with no new fatalities, bringing cumulative infections to 488 and the death toll to 2. The outbreak burden now centers on older youth, with 15–19-year-olds accounting for 94 cases (19.3%). Previously, late October saw the 10–14 age group with the highest concentration. All villages have at least one infection, but the five most affected barangays are Lapinigan (60), Pasta (46), Barangay 5 (38), Barangay 1 (33), and Pisa-an (32); Barangay 4 has 31. Authorities reiterated the Department of Health’s 4S strategy—searching and destroying breeding sites, self-protection, early consultation, and fogging support—and the daily 4T habit to drain and cover water containers. Free medical assessments and labs remain at Barangay Health Stations and the MHO facility.

triage.headline_ja: アグサン・デル・スル州の町でデング熱感染が沈静化傾向
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンの一地方都市における季節性デング熱の流行であり、感染は沈静化傾向にあり、地域の保健当局で対応可能な範囲内の事例であるため。
triage.notes: フィリピンではデング熱は毎年流行する風土病であり、本記事は地方自治体レベルのルーティン監視報告で、感染は減少傾向にある。致死率も低く（488症例中2死亡）、地域の保健局（MHO）が4S戦略で対応中であり、外部支援の必要性は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Continued vigilance is essential to protect India's polio-free status
article.articleSummary: Polio-free status in India remains a public-health achievement rooted in vaccination and surveillance, with Pune, Maharashtra highlighting the need to maintain high immunisation coverage and on-schedule doses to sustain protection. Wild poliovirus type 1 continues to circulate in Afghanistan and Pakistan, and India’s proximity and cross-border movement raise the risk of reintroduction, making continued vigilance essential. Dr. Sachin Shah emphasizes that as polio becomes less visible, families must keep up with timely vaccination and maintain records, consulting paediatricians for any missed doses. The Indian Academy of Pediatrics schedule mandates three primary doses at 6, 10, and 14 weeks, followed by boosters at 16–18 months and 4–6 years. Polio is highly infectious, mainly affecting young children; about 1 in 200 infections can cause irreversible paralysis, and 5–10% of those paralysed may die if breathing muscles are affected. There is no cure, making vaccination the most effective prevention.

triage.headline_ja: インドのポリオフリー状態を守るために継続的な警戒が不可欠
triage.triage_reason: インドは現在ポリオフリー状態を維持しており、本記事はワクチン接種継続の重要性を啓発する内容で、実際の症例発生や国内での伝播を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのポリオフリー状態維持のための予防啓発・注意喚起記事であり、アフガニスタン・パキスタンでの野生型ポリオウイルス流行が越境リスクとして言及されているが、インド国内での実際の症例発生は報告されていない。対象国リストのインドも実発生事例ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ക്രിസ്തുമസ് സീസൺ അടുത്തിരിക്കെ ആശങ്ക! ആലപ്പുഴയിൽ വീണ്ടും പക്ഷിപ്പനി; 26,000 വളർത്തുപക്ഷികളെ കൊന്നൊടുക്കാൻ തീരുമാനം; കർഷകർക്ക് കനത്ത തിരിച്ചടി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern as Christmas season approaches! Avian influenza returns to Alappuzha; decision to cull 26,000 poultry; farmers hit hard.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza confirmed in Alappuzha district, Kerala, with infections in Ambalappuzha North and Chennithala panchayats. Authorities plan to cul l about 26,000 poultry to contain the outbreak, with culling to begin the next day. Infections were detected at a forest farm and a poultry rearing center in Ambalappuzha; in Chennithala, chicks have tested positive. Although migratory birds are typically implicated, the outbreak is notable for affecting very young birds—3– to 4-day-old chicks. As Christmas approaches, farmers face heavy losses and ongoing hardship, with compensation reportedly far below market value. Many farmers are reconsidering poultry ventures due to repeated outbreaks and inadequate restitution, underscoring the sector’s vulnerability in the district.

triage.headline_ja: クリスマスシーズンを前に懸念！アラップーザで再び鳥インフルエンザ発生；26,000羽の家禽を殺処分する決定；農家に大きな打撃
triage.triage_reason: 家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生で動物影響のみ報告されており、ヒト感染は確認されていないが、再発・若齢ヒナへの感染拡大という異常性から継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（動物）への影響に限定されており、ヒトへの感染報告は記事中に見られない。疾患タグに'Human Infection with Avian Influenza'があるが、記事内容はpoultry cullingに関するもので、ヒト感染の言及はなし。繰り返し発生していることと若齢ヒナへの感染という点は注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Southern Indian state to cull thousands of birds after Bird flu detected
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (highly pathogenic avian influenza, H5N1) detected in Kerala (Keralam) prompts culling of about 26,000 birds on Wednesday across two poultry farms in Alappuzha district, where quails, chickens and ducks were infected. Lab confirmation came from samples tested at the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal, central India. In neighboring Tamil Nadu, authorities intensified surveillance after H5N1 infection was confirmed in a district poultry farm, with thousands of chickens culled to contain the outbreak. Separately, Japan reported its second highly pathogenic avian influenza outbreak of the season at a Chiba Prefecture farm housing roughly 40,000 chickens. The developments illustrate ongoing regional containment efforts against avian influenza.

triage.headline_ja: インド南部の州、鳥インフルエンザ検出後に数千羽の鳥を殺処分へ
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケララ州およびタミル・ナードゥ州でH5N1鳥インフルエンザが家禽に確認され殺処分が実施されているが、人への感染報告はなく、現時点では動物衛生事象にとどまる。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 日本（千葉県）での家禽H5N1発生も報告されているが、日本は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。人への感染事例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Korea retains WHO measles elimination status for 13th year as import risk rises
article.articleSummary: Korea retains WHO measles elimination status for a 13th straight year after a Jakarta-based regional verification meeting (Sept 7–11) confirmed continued non-endemic transmission in Korea. Measles elimination requires at least 12 months without endemic strain transmission, reliable case surveillance, and supportive genetic analysis. From 2025 through mid-2026, Korea reported 86 measles cases: 61 acquired abroad and 25 linked to imported cases, with no endemic-virus transmissions. High vaccination coverage appears protective: MMR first dose 97.3% (2023), 97.1% (2024), 96.9% (2025); second dose 95.6%, 95.2%, 96.7% respectively; Korea met WHO benchmarks for case response and laboratory surveillance. Global cases rose to 344,136 Jan–Oct this year. Border screening covers 107 countries; travelers with symptoms must report via Q-CODE or health declarations. Infants traveling may receive an early MMR dose (6–11 months) if travel is unavoidable; routine dosing remains two MMR doses at 12–15 months and 4–6 years. KDCA Commissioner Lim Seung-kwan affirmed continued vigilance to maintain elimination status.

triage.headline_ja: 韓国、輸入リスク上昇の中でWHO麻疹排除認定を13年連続で維持
triage.triage_reason: 韓国における麻疹排除状況の維持を報告する内容で、対象国における新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態ではない。ジャカルタは会議開催地として言及されているのみで疾病発生地ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国がWHOの麻疹排除認定を13年連続で維持したという内容。ジャカルタは地域検証会議の開催地として言及されているのみで、インドネシア国内での麻疹発生を報じるものではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: El 'Súper Niño' genera alertas por chikunguña, dengue y golpes de calor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The 'Super Kid' triggers alerts for chikungunya, dengue, and heat stroke.
article.articleSummary: Heat waves and El Niño-driven climate variability threaten vector-borne diseases in Santa Cruz, Bolivia, intensifying dengue and chikungunya outbreaks and stressing health services. The Santa Cruz Departmental Health Service (Sedes) is developing department-wide contingency plans with the National Meteorology and Hydrology Service (Senamhi) and urging municipalities to prepare, aiming to protect children, students, and older adults from heat-related illness and heat stroke. A three-day workshop with delegations from Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Paraguay, and Peru, supported by the Pan American Health Organization and the World Meteorological Organization, sought adaptable tools, regional analysis, harmonized surveillance indicators, and training resources. OPS cautions that extreme heat can affect water- and vector-borne diseases, food security, mental health, and health services; early anticipation and coordination across sectors are essential. Symptoms of heat illness include sweating, cramps, weakness, dizziness, headache; heat stroke requires urgent care, cooling and shade.

triage.headline_ja: 「スーパー・ニーニョ」現象がチクングニア熱・デング熱・熱中症への警戒を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: ボリビア（サンタクルス）における気候変動由来のベクター媒介感染症リスク上昇に関する注意喚起記事であり、具体的な症例数や重症度データが無く、対象国（ブラジル等）での実際の発生は確認できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はボリビア（サンタクルス）が主題で、ブラジル等は地域ワークショップ参加国として言及されているのみであり、対象国での実際の疾病発生を示す記述はないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Wagub ajak masyarakat optimalkan skrining TB lewat website Peduli TB Lampung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Deputy Governor invites the public to optimize TB screening via the Peduli TB Lampung website.
article.articleSummary: Bandarlampung, Lampung – Deputy Governor Jihan Nurlela urged the public to intensify tuberculosis (TB) screening via the Peduli TB Lampung website, integrated with the Free Health Check (CKG) programme, to speed up case finding. She stressed cross‑sector coordination and early detection to prevent progression to TB, with high‑performing facilities mentoring others and addressing barriers in case finding, testing, and reporting. In Lampung Timur, challenges must be tackled collectively; an estimated 3,224 TB cases are expected to be found and treated in 2026. Notified cases in Lampung Timur are at 34%. Expanding TB Preventive Therapy (TPT) for household contacts, now 18% coverage, is essential for protection. Achieving targets requires cooperation among OPD, districts, villages, security forces, cadres, and communities. Urgent actions include rapid Regional TB Action Plan implementation, Desa Siaga TB expansion, stronger SITB reporting, and improved human resources and service quality.

triage.headline_ja: 副知事、ペドゥリTBランプンのウェブサイトを通じたTBスクリーニングの最適化を住民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策・啓発活動に関する行政広報であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の地方性疾患であり、本記事は通常の検診推進・行政プログラムの一環。新規発生や異常増加の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: ഡെ​ങ്കി​പ്പ​നി​ നിസാരമല്ല, സ്വയംചികിത്സ അപകടം... | Deepika | The Largest Read Malayalam Internet Daily | Online News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever is no small matter; self-medication is dangerous...
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever, a virus transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes that breed in clean water, is described with daytime biting and a 3–14 day incubation. The disease presents with sudden high fever, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle and joint pains, chest and facial rashes, and nausea with vomiting. Danger signs include persistent vomiting, abdominal pain, bleeding, black stools, breathlessness, fainting, marked weakness, and low blood pressure, necessitating prompt hospital admission. High-risk groups include older adults, infants under one year, and individuals with diabetes, hypertension, heart disease, cancer, or immunocompromised states. No specific antiviral treatment exists; care is supportive with early diagnosis to prevent progression. Rest and fluids (salted gruel water, coconut water, fruit drinks) are emphasized; avoid aspirin/NSAIDs. Mosquito control priorities include eliminating breeding sites, covering water containers, weekly water drainage, nets and repellents, and introducing larvivorous fish such as guppy and Gambusia. Guidance from Kerala Health Department and National Health Mission is provided.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱は軽視できない、自己治療は危険...
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の一般的な症状説明と予防啓発を目的とした健康教育記事であり、特定の異常な発生やアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はケララ州保健局とNHMによる一般的な啓発情報であり、具体的な症例数や発生状況の報告は含まれていない。デング熱はインドの対象国リストに含まれる疾患だが、本記事は特定のアウトブレイクイベントを報じるものではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情失控創紀錄　半年逾5500死 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo Ebola outbreak spirals out of control, setting a record with more than 5,500 deaths in six months
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo faces a Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak that began May 15; after six months, infections exceed 11,000 and deaths surpass 5,500, ranking as the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record behind 2014–2016 West Africa. The surge and fatalities are occurring at a faster pace than the West African outbreak’s early months, with Ituri Province as the epicenter. Security deterioration and community distrust hinder containment, with healthcare workers, vehicles, and monitoring teams facing attacks. MSF says critical supplies remain unable to reach disaster-affected areas outside the Ituri epicenter. Healthcare workers have gone on strike since August over working conditions and wage arrears, and the government is addressing salaries. Although about $2.9 billion in pledges are pledged for outbreak response, actual disbursements are less than half. The situation heightens global public health concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・エボラ流行が制御不能に、半年で5500人以上死亡し記録更新
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行が発生し、死者5500人超・感染者11000人超と史上2番目の規模。国際的拡大リスク、重症度、治安悪化による対応困難性が高く、国際支援も必要とされておりフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが記事サマリーではコンゴ（イトゥリ州）のみが主題であり、Angolaは対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。資金拠出の遅延や医療従事者のストライキなど対応能力の限界が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak is spreading and killing at a record pace
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-17, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, remains out of control six months after it was declared on May 15. Official counts exceed 11,000 infections and 5,500 deaths, with the epicenter in Ituri province and the disease spreading to hot spots beyond the initial region. The outbreak is the second-largest on record globally and Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak; the 2018–2020 episode in the region had 3,481 cases and 2,299 deaths. Insecurity, attacks on health workers, resource shortages, and poor coordination hamper containment. About $2.9 billion has been pledged, but less than half has been disbursed. Médecins Sans Frontières notes vital resources aren’t reaching hot spots outside the epicenter. The rapid spread alarms public health officials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、記録的なペースで拡大・死者増加
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が史上2番目の規模で拡大中であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威であり、封じ込めが失敗している点でIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 死者5,500人・感染者11,000人超、過去最大級の流行。資金不足と治安悪化により封じ込めが困難な状況が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Seafood virus may be linked to serious human eye disease
article.articleSummary: China-based study links covert mortality nodavirus (CMNV) to a serious human eye disease in 70 patients, with chronic intraocular inflammation and elevated intraocular pressure. CMNV signs detected in eye tissue, and greater aquatic-animal exposure correlated with higher disease risk; many patients handled seafood without protection or ate raw seafood, with cuts during preparation suspected as exposure routes. One patient suffered permanent vision loss; roughly one-third required surgery. Laboratory work in animals and cells suggested possible effects on eye tissue but did not prove human transmission or causation. An editor’s note in July 2026 flagged data reliability concerns; findings are preliminary. The study does not establish cooked seafood as a cause or indicate widespread disease. Basic precautions—protecting cuts and following food-safety guidance—are advised, and anyone with eye pain or vision changes should seek medical assessment.

triage.headline_ja: 海産物由来ウイルスがヒトの重篤な眼疾患に関連している可能性
triage.triage_reason: 中国発の予備的研究でCMNV（隠性大量死ノダウイルス）とヒトの眼疾患の関連が示唆されているが、ヒト-ヒト感染や因果関係は証明されておらず、データ信頼性にも懸念が指摘されているため、現時点ではフルリスク評価には至らず続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本研究は予備的かつデータ信頼性に関する編集部注記（2026年7月）が付されており、ヒト-ヒト感染やウイルスの直接的因果関係は証明されていない。アウトブレイクというより科学研究報告に近く、今後の検証結果の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Xử phạt cơ sở bán bánh mì khiến 155 người ngộ độc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bakery fined after 155 people poisoned.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella enterica outbreak linked to Minh Tâm Bakery in Cam Chính village, Cam Lộ commune, Quảng Trị Province, Vietnam. On Sept 14, the bakery produced and sold sandwiches and banh mi with fillings including beef/pork sausage, fish cake, vegetables, braised meat, sweet-sour pickles, cucumber, and sauce, causing food poisoning in 155 people. By Sept 15, about 42 patients were hospitalized with abdominal pain, high fever, chills, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea; later reports indicate over 60 hospitalizations in Quảng Trị. Pasteur Institute Nha Trang found Salmonella spp in 9 of 11 food samples and 11 of 13 patient samples; Bacillus cereus was also detected in some samples. On 17 Nov 2026, Quảng Trị provincial authorities fined the bakery 90 million VND, suspended all food processing activities for 4 months, and ordered the owner to bear treatment and investigation costs, with a 10-day remediation window. Criminal liability was not pursued by health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 155人が食中毒となったパン屋を処罰
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・クアンチ省の単一のパン屋が原因となったサルモネラ食中毒事例であり、原因が特定・除去され、営業停止と罰金処分で既に収束している。ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクはなく、地域の食品安全当局により適切に管理済みである。
triage.notes: 単一施設（パン屋）が原因の食中毒（サルモネラ・バチルスセレウス）事例で、原因施設は特定され営業停止・罰金処分済み。感染症の国際的拡大やヒト-ヒト感染のリスクはなく、既に地方当局により収束対応が完了しているためDISMISSと判定した。

article.articleHeadline: 美國麻疹病例破5400！疾管署：旅遊警示今升至第二級
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases in the United States exceed 5,400! Taiwan CDC: Travel advisory now raised to Level 2.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in the United States topped 5,400 in 2026, with 5,412 confirmed and 6 deaths across 47 states as of November 12, and about 11% of patients hospitalized. The outbreak has persisted for 14 weeks, with weekly increases around one hundred; PAHO is considering revoking the Americas' measles elimination status. Main clusters are in Pennsylvania, South Carolina, and Utah; 96% of patients are unvaccinated or vaccination status unknown. Taiwan’s CDC raised the travel advisory to Level 2 for the United States, advising vaccination 2-4 weeks before travel; for 6-11 month infants traveling, seek physician guidance and vaccines may be given, offering protection after two weeks. Domestic Taiwan vaccination remains high (MMR around 97% for newborns; healthcare workers 90%+; airline crew 80-90%). Taiwan has 11 measles cases this year, 3 locally acquired and 8 imported from Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, Japan, the United States, India, and Kyrgyzstan.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の麻疹症例が5,400件を突破！台湾疾病管理署：渡航警告を第二級に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は米国における麻疹アウトブレイクと台湾の渡航警告であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）での実際の発生事例は述べられていない。ベトナム・タイ・インドネシア・インド等は台湾への輸入症例の由来国として列挙されているに過ぎず、当該国での流行状況の記述はない。
triage.notes: 米国（対象国リスト外）における麻疹流行が主題。台湾の渡航警告引き上げや各国からの輸入症例に言及があるが、対象国内での発生・流行自体は記載されていないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Período chuvoso aumenta preocupação com a dengue em Rondônia; prevenção deve começar antes do avanço dos casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rainy season increases concern about dengue in Rondônia; prevention must begin before the surge in cases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue concerns rise in Rondônia as the rainy season begins, with November signaling heavier rainfall that boosts Aedes aegypti breeding. Brazil could see about 860,000 dengue cases in 2027, influenced by climate change and El Niño. Dengue is an arboviral disease transmitted mainly by female Aedes aegypti; four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4) exist, with transmission peaking Oct–May. Prevention must start at home: eliminate standing water, clean gutters, keep water tanks covered, check plant pots and other containers, inspect yards, bottles and tires, and repeat weekly after rain. Symptoms include sudden high fever (39–40°C), headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle/joint pain, nausea, weakness, and a red rash; alarm signs around days 3–7 include severe abdominal pain, vomiting, dizziness, breathing difficulty, or bleeding—seek urgent care. Dengue vaccination has been in SUS since Dec 2023/Feb 2024, but vector control remains essential and no specific treatment exists beyond fluids, rest; community action is critical.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季の到来でロンドニア州のデング熱への懸念が高まる、症例増加前に予防対策を
triage.triage_reason: 雨季到来に伴う季節性デング熱予防を呼びかける一般的な啓発記事であり、異常な症例急増や新規事象の報告はなく、社会的・政治的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・ロンドニア州における季節性デング熱予防の啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数増加や異常事態の報告は含まれていない。2027年の予測症例数(約86万件)への言及はあるが、現時点での急増を示すデータではない。

article.articleHeadline: Jacareí realiza ações de combate à dengue; veja cronograma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jacareí carries out actions to combat dengue; see the schedule.
article.articleSummary: Jacareí, Brazil is conducting dengue-control actions through Friday, November 20, including house-to-house visits, fogging (nebulization), and the Cata-Treco cleanup operation to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites that transmit dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. House-to-house visits will cover neighborhoods such as Jardim Nova Esperança, Jardim Didinha, Pagador Andrade, Parque Imperial, Jardim Pedramar, Jardim Paraíba, Jardim São José, and Parque Santo Antônio, with vector-control agents advising residents on removing standing water. The Cata-Treco schedule runs Tuesday the 17th through Friday the 20th across areas like Jardim Primavera, Chácaras Rurais Santa Maria, Jardim Marcondes, Jardim Luiza, Jardim Califórnia, Jardim Vera Lúcia, Jardim Yolanda, Jardim Paraíso, Jardim Novo Amanhecer, Jardim Maria Amélia I‑III, Jardim Olímpia, Jardim Indústrias, Parque Nova América, and the Central Region, collecting unusable materials that can pool water and should be left on the curb before 6:50 am. Nebulization is in Igarapés and Jardim Nova Esperança for confirmed/suspected cases, with insecticide applied per protocol and deemed safe for humans and animals. Dengue vaccination is available for ages 10–14 at 19 health units.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカレイ市、デング熱対策を実施;スケジュールを確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内自治体による定例的なデング熱対策・清掃活動の告知であり、異常な流行拡大や重症化の情報はなく、通常の公衆衛生活動の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 地元自治体による定例的な媒介蚊対策（燻蒸・清掃・ワクチン接種）の案内記事であり、感染拡大の異常性や重症例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Trois centres conjoints Russie-Afrique ont été ouverts pour l'étude de la situation épidémiologique - cheffe de l'agence sanitaire russe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three Russia-Africa Joint Centers Opened to Study the Epidemiological Situation, Says Head of Russia's Health Agency.
article.articleSummary: Three Russia–Africa joint centers were opened to study the epidemiological situation in Guinea, Congo, and Burundi, according to Anna Popova, head of Russia’s health agency, Rospotrebnadzor. The centers embody Moscow’s collaborative surveillance approach with African partners. Popova highlighted Russia’s rapid medical aid in Ebola outbreaks, noting that specialists arrived in Uganda within 48 hours after Ebola spread. The report notes the video excerpt is from social media. No specific case counts, laboratory confirmations, or infection sources are provided. The initiative underscores ongoing Russia–Africa cooperation on public health surveillance and outbreak response, focusing on comparative epidemiological analysis across the listed states rather than detailing a single active outbreak. Information reflects the situation as of 17 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア・アフリカ合同センター3カ所が疫学状況調査のために開設——ロシア保健当局長官
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な症例数や検査確定情報がなく、ギニア・コンゴ・ブルンジでの疫学協力センター開設という行政的な発表であり、現在進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア・アフリカ間の疫学サーベイランス協力体制（センター開設）についての発表であり、現在進行中の具体的なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの詳細（症例数、感染源等）は記載されていない。ウガンダでのエボラ対応は過去の事例として言及されているのみで、対象国リストには含まれない。コンゴについてはDRCか共和国コンゴか明確でないが、対象国リストにあるDRCとして扱った。

article.articleHeadline: Putus Mata Rantai Penularan TBC, Ribuan Narapidana Jalani Pemeriksaan Kesehatan Gratis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking the chain of TB transmission, thousands of inmates undergo free health screenings.
article.articleSummary: Free TB screenings were conducted on 17 November 2026 at Lapas Narkotika Jakarta in Jatinegara, aimed at breaking the chain of tuberculosis transmission among about 2,000 inmates. The program, led by Yudi Suseno, Director of Health Care and Rehabilitation at the Directorate General of Penitentiaries, included comprehensive health checks and TB screening for inmates and their families. Officials say the screenings serve as early detection and will trigger follow-up actions if TB is found. In addition to TB, general health examinations were performed to safeguard overall inmate well‑being. One inmate, Pras (36), who previously tested positive for TB, expressed gratitude for the deeper health assessment that aided his recovery. The initiative reflects a joint effort to reduce TB spread within Jakarta's narcotics penitentiary and protect inmates and their relatives.

triage.headline_ja: 結核感染の連鎖を断つため、数千人の受刑者が無料健康診断を受診
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内での既存の結核対策としてのスクリーニングプログラムであり、新規の異常なアウトブレイクではなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 刑務所内での定例的な結核スクリーニング活動の報道であり、新規アウトブレイクの兆候はない。政府主導の予防的公衆衛生プログラムとして通常運用の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox ultrapassa mil casos no Brasil e acende alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox surpasses 1,000 cases in Brazil and raises alarm.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports mpox surpassed 1,000 confirmed cases in 2026, with 1,055 cases and one death as of 16 November. The fatal case occurred in Rio de Janeiro, in an immunocompromised patient. Mpox transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with infected individuals, especially lesions, blisters, and secretions; contact with contaminated objects; and close, prolonged exposure to respiratory secretions. Symptoms include fever, headache, myalgias, fatigue, chills, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions that can appear on face, hands, feet, mouth, and genital region; incubation is typically 3–21 days. Isolation remains until all lesions heal and a new skin layer forms, usually 2–4 weeks. Prevention emphasizes avoiding contact with suspected/confirmed cases, hygiene, and not sharing personal items. Vaccination is available for priority groups (not mass immunization): HIV-positive individuals, PrEP users, lab workers, and those with medium/high-risk exposure; two-dose schedule, 28 days apart. No routine mpox-specific treatment; most recover in 2–4 weeks; vulnerable groups require care.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでMpoxが1,000例を超え、警戒感が高まる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でMpox症例が1,000例を超え死亡例（免疫不全患者）も発生しており、重症度・流行継続性の観点からスクリーニング基準に複数該当し、社会的関心も高まっていると考えられるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: Mpoxは既存の継続流行であり新規病原体ではないが、症例数の節目（1,000例超）と死亡例発生が報じられ、免疫不全患者のリスクが強調されている。ワクチンは優先群向けに利用可能であり、国内での管理体制は一定程度整っていると見られる。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en el Congo causa más de 5,000 muertes, según datos del gobierno.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Congo has killed more than 5,000 people, according to government data.
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has killed 5,026 people of 10,351 infections as of October 31, according to the Ministry of Health via the Associated Press. The epidemic is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and was declared in mid-May, marking it as the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (≈11,000 deaths). About 2,788 recoveries have occurred; there is no vaccine or approved treatment. Roughly one-third of deaths occurred outside treatment centers before testing, highlighting delays in seeking care. Transmission remains driven by community caregiving at home, complicating detection and isolation. Ongoing barriers include armed conflict and violence hindering response, and health workers’ strikes over delayed or unpaid wages. On Oct 24, a nurse was killed and another worker seriously injured in Bafwasende, Tshopo Province. In Nizi, families such as that of Gorette Mbusi illustrate barriers to timely care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、死者5,000人超える——政府データ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、致死率の高いエボラ大規模流行が継続中で、医療従事者への暴力・ストライキ等管理困難要因もあるため、フルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーはコンゴ東部（Tshopo州Bafwasende、Nizi等）での流行のみを主題としており、Angolaへの言及はないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Tömeges járvány tört ki Magyarországon: 373-an betegedtek meg, súlyos élelmiszerbiztonsági problémára gyanakodnak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A large-scale outbreak has broken out in Hungary: 373 people have fallen ill, and they suspect a serious food safety problem.
article.articleSummary: Zala County, Hungary reported a large foodborne outbreak; 373 of 1,495 exposed people developed vomiting and diarrhea since November 4, with the cluster spanning November 2–8. Four food samples tested positive for Bacillus cereus at the National Food Chain Safety Office (Nébih); authorities warn the issue may involve multiple foods and processing steps; no hospitalizations. Eight diarrheal stool samples collected; laboratory results pending at the time of the ONI report; investigation ongoing. Separately, three imported dengue fever cases were identified: two in Győr-Moson-Sopron County (a 30-year-old man and a 26-year-old woman) who had been in Vietnam; and one in Pest County (a 35-year-old woman) who had a Maldives exposure. In Week 45, Hungary registered 133 campylobacteriosis, 62 salmonellosis, 35 rotavirus gastroenteritis, and 40 hepatitis cases (31 of which were hepatitis A).

triage.headline_ja: ハンガリーで大規模な食中毒が発生：373人が発症、重大な食品安全問題が疑われる
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒事例はハンガリー国内（対象国外）で発生し重症例（入院）もない。ベトナム・モルディブ関連のデング熱は個別の輸入症例であり、当該国内でのアウトブレイクではないため対象国としての該当事象なし。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はハンガリー・ザラ県での食中毒アウトブレイク（Bacillus cereus疑い、入院なし）。ベトナム・モルディブは輸入デング熱症例の曝露地として言及されているのみで、これらの国での流行事象ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ハンガリーは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: मुर्मु ने मलेरिया अनुसंधान संस्थान के स्वर्ण जय... | UNI Varta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Murmu inaugurates the Golden Jubilee of the Malaria Research Institute
article.articleSummary: New Delhi, November 17, 2026 – President Droupadi Murmu inaugurated the Golden Jubilee celebrations of the National Malaria Research Institute, part of the Indian Council of Medical Research, marking a year-long program. She stated that premier institutes like NMRI will play a crucial role in achieving India’s health goals by 2047 through research, collaboration, and innovation. India has made notable progress in malaria control, with 2024 seeing the country move out of the WHO High Burden to High Impact category. The remarks underscore sustained focus on malaria research and public-health partnerships to build on gains in disease control and elimination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ムルム大統領、マラリア研究所の創立50周年記念式典を開会
triage.triage_reason: 式典・記念行事に関する記事であり、新規の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア研究機関の記念式典に関する内容で、マラリアの流行や感染拡大を報じるものではないため、感染症シグナルとしての該当性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Sulteng Catat 6.081 Kasus TBC hingga September 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Sulawesi Health Office records 6,081 TB cases as of September 2026
article.articleSummary: As of September 2026, Central Sulawesi Health Office (Dinkes Sulteng) reported 6,081 tuberculosis (TB) cases, part of an estimated 9,968 TB burden for the province in 2026. Secretary Wayan Apriani disclosed these figures at a Monitoring and Evaluation Meeting for the Public Private Mix (PPM) TB Program in Palu, noting TB remains a leading global cause of death. Nationally, Indonesia’s TB burden was about 1,080,000 cases in 2025. The 6,081 cases found in Sulteng represent roughly 61% of the national discovery target of 90%. Treatment success rate stands at 75% toward a 90% target, while tuberculosis preventive therapy (TPT) coverage is 18% of an 80% national target. Officials identify ongoing program gaps and field constraints at district/city levels, and the meeting aims to lay out strategic steps to strengthen TB control in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 中部スラウェシ県保健局、2026年9月までに結核6,081例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核サーベイランス報告であり、異常な増加や突発的な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す内容ではない。既知の慢性的な疾病負荷に関する定例報告。
triage.notes: 結核は地域で既知の地方病であり、プログラムの進捗報告（発見率・治療成功率・TPTカバー率）が主内容。緊急性のあるシグナルではなく、通常のサーベイランス情報としてWATCH未満のDISMISSと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola à Beni - Le parlement des jeunes appelle la population à consulter dans les structures officielles
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola in Beni - The Youth Parliament calls on the population to seek care at official facilities.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola situation in the Beni region, notably Bunji, is being addressed by the Youth Parliament of Beni through a November 15 outreach urging residents to seek care at officially designated health facilities. The drive follows several community deaths in recent weeks, often linked to delays in seeking care. Parliament leaders warn that Ebola symptoms can resemble other illnesses, requiring evaluation by qualified professionals. Early detection and treatment at sanctioned centers markedly improve survival. The campaign also urges against self-medication and rumors, stressing that adherence to prevention and care measures is essential to controlling the outbreak in Beni. Financial barriers and gaps in infection-control resources are cited as contributing factors.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:ベニでのエボラ出血熱-青年議会が住民に公式医療機関での受診を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCベニ地域でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、受診遅延による死亡例が続発しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ流行拡大のリスクがあるため。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は致死率が高く国際的関心が常に高い疾患であり、受診遅延・医療資源不足が指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Denuncian obstáculos en lucha contra el ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Obstacles in the fight against Ebola in the DRC denounced
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) since May 2026 faces intensified obstacles, according to the Ministry of Health. Unpaid salaries and worker strikes have paralyzed key health facilities and disrupted response activities across multiple regions, forcing suspensions at sanitary checkpoints along transport routes, river ports, municipal borders, and airports. The ministry urges an end to armed clashes in Ituri and North Kivu so medical personnel can reach patients without impediment. It cites harmful rumors, high rejection of screening, resistance to safe burials, and declining patient turnout at health centers as further barriers. Violence against health workers and facilities has been documented. The report underscores how security, pay, and trust challenges jeopardize Ebola control efforts in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ対策における障害が指摘される
triage.triage_reason: 2026年5月から続くDRCのエボラ流行において、ストライキ・武力紛争・検疫拒否などにより対応活動が麻痺しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルリスク評価に進めるべき。
triage.notes: Ituriおよび北キブ州での武力紛争、医療従事者への賃金未払い・ストライキ、安全な埋葬への抵抗、検疫拒否など複合的要因が感染対策を阻害している。国境・空港・河川港での検疫停止は国際的拡大リスクを示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Assessment of Wuchereria bancrofti infection among the migrant populations in South India
article.articleSummary: Assessment of Wuchereria bancrofti infection among migrant populations in South India shows no microfilariae among 52 Tamil Nadu migrants (Thirukovilur block, Kallakurichi district) but 3.1% prevalence among 226 Puducherry migrants from Sedarapet, Thuthipet, Thondamanatham, Koodappakkam (Villianur), and Vadamangalam. Night blood surveys with Giemsa staining detected Mf in Puducherry migrants only. Molecular xenomonitoring of 2047 Culex quinquefasciatus mosquitoes from Puducherry found five pools positive for W. bancrofti DNA, an overall infection rate of 2.50% (95% CI: 0.93–5.51); one pool (11 mosquitoes) yielded larvae in two individuals. Results indicate LF infection risk among migrants and potential local transmission, underscoring the utility of MX for surveillance and the need for focused migrant-area and vector surveillance to sustain elimination amid ongoing MDA programs in India.

triage.headline_ja: 南インドの移民集団におけるバンクロフト糸状虫感染の評価
triage.triage_reason: これはインド・タミルナドゥ州/プドゥチェリーにおけるリンパ系フィラリア症の既存風土病に関する学術研究論文であり、新規アウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生イベントではない。既存のMDA（集団投薬）プログラム下でのサーベイランス研究結果の報告である。
triage.notes: 疾患名フィールドはCoccidioidomycosisとなっているが、記事内容はリンパ系フィラリア症(Wuchereria bancrofti)に関する学術研究であり、Bluedotのメタデータに誤りがある可能性が高い。既存の風土病に対する研究・サーベイランス論文であり、緊急の感染症イベントではない。
