article.articleHeadline: বার্ড ফ্লু শনাক্তের পর ভারতে হাজারো পাখি নিধনের সিদ্ধান্ত
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thousands of Birds to Be Culled in India After Bird Flu Detection.
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (avian influenza) has been detected in Kerala, India, at two poultry farms in Alappuzha district, prompting culling of about 26,000 birds scheduled to begin November 18. The affected stock—quail, chickens, and ducks—was confirmed by laboratory testing at the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal. In neighboring Tamil Nadu, authorities have intensified surveillance after an H5N1 virus was identified at a poultry farm, leading to the culling of thousands of chickens to curb transmission. Separately, Japan’s Chiba region reported a highly pathogenic avian influenza outbreak last week on a farm with around 40,000 chickens. The incidents highlight ongoing avian influenza threats in Asia, with rapid culling and heightened monitoring as key control measures.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ検出後、インドで数千羽の鳥が殺処分へ
triage.triage_reason: インド（ケララ州・タミルナドゥ州）および日本の家禽でH5N1型鳥インフルエンザが確認され、大規模殺処分が実施されているが、人への感染は報告されておらず、現時点では家禽疾患としての管理下にあるため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 人への感染報告はなく、家禽における殺処分対応が中心。日本（千葉）の事例も報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。H5N1のため継続的な動向監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ആലപ്പുഴയിൽ വീണ്ടും പക്ഷിപ്പനി; 26,000-ത്തിലധികം വളർത്തു പക്ഷികളെ ഉൻമൂലനം ചെയ്യാൻ തീരുമാനം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu in Alappuzha again; decision to assess over 26,000 domestic birds.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza confirmed in Alappuzha district, Kerala, with infections in farms at Ampalappuzha North 11th Ward and Chennithala Grama Panchayat. Samples from affected flocks were sent to the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal, where the virus was detected. District Collector Shaji V. Nair chaired a meeting to review containment and ordered the culling of over 26,000 domesticated birds—including ducks, quails, and chickens—to curb further spread. The depopulation targets the two panchayats' farms and aims to prevent transmission to humans or other animals, reflecting a precautionary response following laboratory confirmation of avian influenza.

triage.headline_ja: アラプーザで再び鳥インフルエンザ発生；26,000羽以上の家禽の殺処分を決定
triage.triage_reason: 家禽間での鳥インフルエンザ発生で、ヒトへの感染は報告されておらず、通常の家畜防疫対応（殺処分）が実施されている事例。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はケララ州アラプーザ県における家禽の鳥インフルエンザ発生と殺処分措置に関するもの。ヒト感染の報告はなく、影響カテゴリも動物に限定されている。インドでは鳥インフルエンザの家禽感染は過去にも繰り返し発生しており、特段の異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola à Mandima : 445 décès, la société civile alerte sur les failles de la riposte | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola in Mandima: 445 deaths, civil society warns of the gaps in the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Mandima Health Zone, Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 445 deaths among 627 cumulative cases (case fatality rate 70.9%) as of 15 November 2026. Of 34 suspected living cases identified that day, only eight were transferred to the Biakato Mines Temporary Treatment Center, underscoring logistics and case-management gaps. The Civil Society Forces Vives du territoire de Mambasa warns of shortages in medical supplies, insufficient trained decontamination personnel, and difficulties with dignified, secure burials. Resistance in villages such as Lwemba, Malutu, Alima and Somé impedes the response, while survivors face stigma and some taxi drivers refuse to transport them home. The civil society group urges stronger logistics, intensified community engagement, and dialogue with local leaders to improve the response and facilitate reintegration of recovered individuals.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 マンディマ：死者445人、市民社会が対応の不備を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の致死率約71%の継続的なアウトブレイクが発生し、医療資源不足・コミュニティ抵抗・感染拡大リスクが明確であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率70.9%と非常に高く、医療物資不足・コミュニティの抵抗・埋葬慣行の問題など流行制御の失敗要因が複数報告されている。国際的な支援ニーズが高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: EXPLAINER | Ebola outbreak in DRC spreads, kills at record pace
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo virus remains out of control six months after its May 15 declaration. More than 11,000 infections and over 5,500 deaths have been reported, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record globally. Infections and deaths are rising at twice the rate of West Africa’s 2014-2016 outbreak (over 28,600 infections and more than 11,000 deaths). The epicentre is Ituri province, with hotspots beyond the original area; insecurity, attacks on health workers, and poor coordination hinder response. Health workers face strikes over conditions and unpaid salaries, with some unpaid since August. About $2.9 billion has been pledged, but less than half disbursed. This marks the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak; the 2018-2020 outbreak had 3,481 cases and 2,299 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 解説：DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが拡大、記録的速度で死者が増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが11,000人以上の感染、5,500人以上の死亡という史上2番目の規模に達し、制御不能な状態が続いている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常な拡大速度、国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではAngolaへの言及がないため verified_locations から除外した。本アウトブレイクはDRCの17回目のエボラ流行であり、Bundibugyoウイルスが原因。資金不足・医療従事者のストライキ・治安悪化が対応を阻害している。

article.articleHeadline: Two dengue-related deaths recorded in Mandaue City this November
article.articleSummary: Two dengue-related deaths were recorded in Mandaue City, Cebu, this November, with fatalities in Barangays Umapad and Tabok, as dengue cases rise this year. In 2025, the city reported 520 cases and three deaths. The City Health Office’s surveillance team investigates each case to identify infection sources and mosquito breeding sites and to educate affected families and communities. Every reported case is auto-investigated; health workers visit households to check for breeding sites and encourage early medical consultation. The 4S strategy is being implemented: search and destroy breeding sites, seek early consultation, adopt self-protection measures, and support spraying or fogging in outbreak areas. Eliminating breeding sites remains a preventive measure; residents should remove stagnant water, keep surroundings clean, and dispose of garbage. Dengue fast lanes provide free CBC, platelet counts, NS1 tests, paracetamol, and fluids; fogging is limited to outbreaks. Dengue is a year-round concern; coordination with neighboring cities is urged.

triage.headline_ja: マンダウエ市で11月にデング熱関連の死亡が2件確認
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・セブ島マンダウエ市における季節性のデング熱流行に関する定例報告であり、症例数・死亡数ともに例年の範囲内で、地域保健局が通常の4S戦略で対応している。国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで流行性・季節性があり、本記事は地方自治体レベルの定例サーベイランス報告。外部支援の必要性や社会的関心の高まりを示す記述はなく、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Vespasiano chega a 25 casos de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vespasiano reaches 25 cases of human scabies.
article.articleSummary: Vespasiano in the Belo Horizonte region reports 25 confirmed scabies cases, with municipal schools suspended through Nov 18, 2026. The alert began Nov 9 at the Vovó Mariquita Special Education School after the first case; two days later control expanded to all municipal schools. Ribeirão das Neves records 11 confirmed cases across two schools, prompting two-day suspensions for affected classes. São José da Lapa shut down all municipal schools after four cases. Minas Gerais state health data show 11 scabies outbreaks in 2026 across Campos Gerais, Paraguaçu, São Gonçalo do Pará, Belo Horizonte, Andradas, Lagoa Santa, Itapecerica, Lavras, Joaquim Felício, Coronel Xavier Chaves and Alfenas. Scabies is caused by a mite; transmission mainly through direct skin contact, less commonly via shared clothing or bedding; not airborne and not related to hygiene. Health authorities advise seeking care, treating close contacts as indicated, and following guidance before returning to school.

triage.headline_ja: ヴェスパシアーノ市で疥癬（人型疥癬）の症例が25件に増加
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上重篤な疾患ではないが、複数自治体・学校で集団発生が続いており、地域的な流行拡大の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 疥癬はダニによる接触感染症で致死性・重症度は低いが、ミナスジェライス州内の複数自治体の学校で集団発生が続いており、地域の公衆衛生当局が学校閉鎖などの対応を取っている。国際的拡大や貿易制限のリスクはないと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: إنفلونزا الطيور تضرب جنوب الهند.. إعدام 26 ألف طائر في تحرك عاجل لمنع انتشار الفيروس
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza hits southern India: culling of 26,000 birds in an urgent move to prevent the spread of the virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, avian influenza prompts urgent culling in southern India: Kerala plans to slaughter about 26,000 birds from two farms in Alappuzha district after positive tests for avian influenza, with samples confirmed at the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal. The measure, planned for Wednesday, aims to contain spread within Kerala’s poultry sector. Tamil Nadu intensified monitoring after H5N1 was detected in one district, with authorities culling thousands of chickens to curb transmission. In a separate development, Japan reported a second outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza last week at a poultry farm in Chiba prefecture, involving about 40,000 birds. These actions reflect ongoing regional efforts to control HPAI transmission during the season.

triage.headline_ja: インド南部で鳥インフルエンザ発生：ウイルス拡散防止のため緊急措置として2万6000羽を殺処分
triage.triage_reason: 家禽における季節性HPAI(H5N1)発生であり、ヒトへの感染報告はないが、継続的な曝露リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのケララ州・タミルナドゥ州における家禽のH5N1発生と殺処分を主題としている。日本（千葉県）での別発生も言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ヒトへの感染報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Feature: After surviving Ebola, DR Congo doctors renew vow to fight the disease
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak remains active in North Kivu and eight other provinces, with 11,376 confirmed cases and 5,568 deaths nationwide as of Nov 14, 2026, making it the world’s second-largest Ebola outbreak. A frontline physician, Kinzi Divin, declared Ebola-free after 24 days in isolation at a Beni treatment center; he contracted Ebola while treating patients. The epidemic has spread to 68 health zones across eight provinces. In North Kivu, 2,860 infections and 1,590 deaths (case fatality rate 55.6%) have been reported, higher than the national CFR of 48.9%. More than 150 frontline health workers have contracted Ebola in the province, including nine doctors and four fatalities, with PPE shortages hampering protection. Early symptoms included headaches, fever, chills, and diarrhea, with laboratory confirmation guiding diagnosis. Divin’s recovery underscores both ongoing transmission risks and renewed resolve among health workers to continue fighting the disease.

triage.headline_ja: 特集：エボラから生還したコンゴ民主共和国の医師たち、病との闘いへの誓いを新たに
triage.triage_reason: DRCで世界第2位の規模となるエボラ出血熱流行が継続中であり、8州68保健ゾーンに拡大、死亡率も高く医療従事者への感染も多数発生しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 累計11,376症例、5,568人死亡（致死率48.9%）、北キブ州では致死率55.6%、150人以上の医療従事者感染、PPE不足が報告されており、既知の大規模進行中アウトブレイクとして継続的な監視・支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Second-largest Ebola outbreak in history revives Micah's prophecy of Egypt's plagues
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus drives the Democratic Republic of the Congo's second-largest outbreak to date. As of 2026-11-10, the DRC reports 11,114 confirmed cases and 5,433 deaths, with Ituri province accounting for 7,728 cases and 3,655 deaths across 67 of 178 health zones; North Kivu has 2,761 cases and 1,523 deaths. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri; the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days later, and by July it was the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak. Cross-border transmission includes Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths) and Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths); Nigeria reported an imported case in Abuja Oct 20, with evacuees to Switzerland, and aid workers moved to Germany, France, the Netherlands, and the UK. Ervebo vaccines target a different Ebola species; Bundibugyo vaccines are in early development, with frontline use in August and a Bunia trial starting Oct 23. Violence and strikes have hampered response.

triage.headline_ja: 史上2番目に大きいエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクがミカの預言『エジプトの災い』を想起させる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（1万人超の症例、5千人超の死亡）が発生し、WHOがPHEIC宣言、複数国への越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの越境伝播も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRC（特にIturi州、North Kivu州）が主要な発生地域。WHOによりPHEIC宣言済み、暴力・ストライキが対応を妨げている点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Team Driven Out, Outlet Says
article.articleSummary: Durba, DR Congo (Haut-Uélé): More than 50 people reportedly drove an Ebola response team out of Nganya with stones and machetes on 17 November 2026, sabotaging the vehicle as Red Cross-led disinfection proceeded at a bereaved family’s home. Initial reports say no deaths occurred. Residents say they were never given explanations about the response, where the sick are taken, or when the Ebola treatment centre (CTE) will be ready, fueling anger and distrust. Official closures followed: Bavière polyclinic and Mgr Julien Andavo hospital in Durba were ordered shut; Julien Andavo’s non-Ebola patients reportedly refuse to leave. Reports also indicate 14 Bavière health workers tested positive and are being cared for by colleagues, with medicines reportedly in short supply; the Durba CTE is described as a building site by a local doctor, Dr Patrick. As of 17 November 2026, no comment from provincial or national Ebola authorities has been reported.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ対応チームが追い出される、と報道機関が伝える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ対応において医療従事者14名の陽性確認、地域住民による対応チームへの暴力的妨害、医療施設閉鎖など公衆衛生上深刻かつ管理困難な状況が確認されており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 地域住民の不信感によりエボラ対応が妨害され、医療従事者の感染や医薬品不足も報告されている。州・国レベルのエボラ当局からの公式コメントは未報告であり、当局の対応状況が不明な点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ആലപ്പുഴയില്‍ വീണ്ടും പക്ഷിപ്പനി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza again in Alappuzha
article.articleSummary: On 17 November 2026, avian influenza H5N1 has been confirmed in Ambalapuzha North and Chennithala panchayats of Kerala’s Alappuzha district. The district administration will culled about 26,000 domestic birds beginning 18 November 2026, employing rapid-response teams. Laboratory testing of samples from the affected areas confirmed H5N1. No human infections have been reported to date. Authorities urge strict vigilance and ongoing surveillance among residents and poultry workers. The culling constitutes a containment measure to remove potential infection sources in the two panchayats and prevent zoonotic transmission. This represents an isolated animal outbreak with proactive veterinary action, and officials will continue monitoring as the plan is implemented.

triage.headline_ja: アラップーザで再び鳥インフルエンザ
triage.triage_reason: H5N1が家禽で確認され殺処分が実施されているが、人への感染は報告されておらず、ケララ州では過去にも繰り返し発生している地域的な動物衛生事案であるため、継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 人への感染報告なし。家禽約26,000羽の殺処分による封じ込め対応が実施中。ケララ州では過去にも同様のH5N1発生歴あり、地域的には珍しくない事案。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox chega a 396 casos no estado do Rio, e Secretaria de Saúde passa a atualizar painel diariamente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox reaches 396 cases in the state of Rio, and the Health Department begins updating the dashboard daily.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) outbreak in Rio de Janeiro State, Brazil, with 396 confirmed cases and 1 death as of 17 November 2026. The state health department began daily reporting on Monitora RJ dashboard, tracking cases across 92 municipalities via CIEVS; the capital, Rio de Janeiro, accounts for 71.2% of cases. The Ministry of Health sent 2,000 mpox vaccine doses to Rio, with shipments planned based on evaluation and local needs. The municipal health network is vaccinating adults over 18 living with HIV/AIDS (CD4 <200 cells/mm3) per MS guidance. About 500 health workers trained in mpox care. Transmission is via close contact with lesions or bodily fluids, intimate contact, contaminated objects, and prolonged respiratory exposure. Symptoms include skin lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, muscle aches, chills, and fatigue. Recommendations: avoid direct contact with lesions, suspend intimate contact when suspected, do not share items, seek care for lesions, isolate at home.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州でMpoxが396例に到達、保健局はパネルを毎日更新へ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロ州でMpox症例が396例・死亡1例に達し、HIV陽性者への重点的ワクチン接種や医療従事者研修など行政の積極的対応が報じられており、継続的曝露・流行しやすさ・重症度の観点からWPRO基準を複数満たし社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: Mpoxのクレード（Clade I/II）は記事サマリーからは特定不可。HIV陽性者（CD4<200）への重点的ワクチン接種が実施されており、免疫不全者における重症化リスクに留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : plus de 450 cas de choléra et 82 décès enregistrés à Katoyi en deux mois
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: more than 450 cholera cases and 82 deaths recorded in Katoyi in two months
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak continues in the Katoyi health zone, Masisi territory, North Kivu, with more than 450 cases and 82 deaths since the official declaration on 19 September. Two additional deaths were reported overnight in Bitoyi and Kirambo health centers (Ufamandu II). Cases have also been recorded in Kibua and Itebero in Walikale, and Ziralo in South Kivu. Population displacements due to fighting complicate response; health facilities host displaced people in precarious conditions. In Katoyi, insecurity blocks critical supplies, including 17 cartons of IV fluids for dehydration, stuck about 40 kilometers from affected sites for two weeks, hindering regular delivery and movement of medical teams. Cholera causes acute diarrhea and rapid dehydration and can be fatal without proper treatment; authorities fear worsening if supplies are not promptly provided.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：カトイにおいて2か月間でコレラ感染450例以上、死者82人を記録
triage.triage_reason: コレラ流行による高い致死率（450例中82人死亡、致死率約18%）と、紛争による医療物資輸送の妨害が重なり、対応が困難な状況が続いているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にArmenia（Aragatsotni Marz等）が含まれているが、記事内容はDRC北キブ州・南キブ州に限定されており、Armeniaは地理メタデータの誤りと判断し除外した。致死率が異常に高く、紛争による医療アクセス制限が深刻化要因となっている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Thai authorities clarify details of measles case in transit passenger
article.articleSummary: Measles case involving a transit passenger linked to Australia; Bangladesh origin; transit through Thailand on 7 Nov 2026 via TG340 Dhaka–Suvarnabhumi (seat 46D) and TG475 Bangkok–Sydney (seat 36D). Symptoms began 2 Nov (fever, cough, runny nose, sore throat); rash appeared 8 Nov; lab-confirmed measles. Timeline suggests infection occurred before Thailand stopover; no evidence of infection acquired in Thailand. Bangladesh reports a widespread measles outbreak (>50,000 cases, ≥350 deaths). Thai Department of Disease Control urged passengers and crew on TG340 and TG475 to monitor for 21 days after exposure (through 28 Nov), especially seats 46D and 36D. If fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes or rash develop, avoid close contact, wear a surgical mask, seek medical care, and report travel history. Measles is airborne and can remain infectious for up to two hours; vaccination is the best prevention. Hotline 1422.

triage.headline_ja: タイ当局、乗継客の麻疹症例の詳細を説明
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュ発の麻疹感染者がタイを乗継ぎ、オーストラリア行き便に搭乗したことが確認され、タイ保健当局が接触者調査と21日間の健康監視を実施していることから、国際的拡大リスクと行政機関の高い関心が認められる。
triage.notes: バングラデシュでは50,000例以上・死亡350例以上の大規模な麻疹流行が報告されているが、バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。タイは乗継地点として実際の健康監視対応が行われているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose: conheça os exames que ajudam a diagnosticar a doença - Folha Vitória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis: learn about the tests that help diagnose the disease - Folha Vitória
article.articleSummary: Brazil marks November 17 as the National Day to Combat Tuberculosis, highlighting TB caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis (the Koch bacillus). The disease mainly affects the lungs and spreads via airborne droplets from an infectious person. Brazil is among the 30 high-priority countries with a heavy TB and TB/HIV coinfection burden, together accounting for about 90% of global TB cases. Diagnostic tests discussed include: BAAR smear (acid-fast bacilli staining) on sputum for initial diagnosis and treatment monitoring; TRM-TB, a rapid molecular test detecting M. tuberculosis DNA and rifampicin resistance in under 2 hours (not used to confirm cure); LF-LAM, a urine antigen test especially useful in people living with HIV with low CD4; IGRA for latent TB infection; culture with drug susceptibility as the gold standard, though results can take over a month. TB requires social actions: prevention, contact tracing, surveillance, and public policies addressing social determinants.

triage.headline_ja: 結核：診断に役立つ検査について知る - Folha Vitória
triage.triage_reason: 結核啓発デー（11月17日）に合わせた診断検査に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 結核自体はブラジルで既知の負荷疾患だが、本記事は啓発・教育目的の既存疾患に関する一般情報であり、新規シグナルではない。

diseases.name: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: 美國挪威爆高致病性H5N1　港暫停進口禽類產品
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 detected in the United States and Norway; Hong Kong suspends imports of poultry products.
article.articleSummary: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza A(H5N1) detected in the United States and Norway; Hong Kong suspends imports of poultry products from affected regions. As of 17 November 2026, the World Organisation for Animal Health reported outbreaks in Norway (Akershus County, Agder County including Vennesla Municipality) and in the United States (California’s Stanislaus County; Iowa’s Sac County; Minnesota’s Morrison County). In response, the Hong Kong Centre for Food Safety immediately halted imports of poultry meat, poultry products, and eggs from these areas. Hong Kong currently has an import mechanism only for poultry meat with Norway and no egg import mechanism. Year-to-date imports include about 20 tonnes of chilled poultry meat from Norway; about 33,270 tonnes of frozen/chilled poultry meat from the United States; and about 92.33 million eggs. The Centre is monitoring WOAH updates and will adjust actions as outbreaks evolve.

triage.headline_ja: 米国とノルウェーで高病原性H5N1が発生、香港が家禽製品の輸入を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: 発生地は米国・ノルウェーであり、対象国（香港/中国含む）での感染発生ではなく、香港は輸入規制対応のみ。人への感染報告もなく、対象地域への直接的な公衆衛生リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国（カリフォルニア州、アイオワ州、ミネソタ州）およびノルウェーでの家禽H5N1発生であり、香港は輸入停止措置を講じたのみで発生国ではない。対象国リストに米国・ノルウェーは含まれず、香港（中国）も発生地ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: le corps médical perd un autre médecin emportée par Ebola à Isiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The medical profession loses another doctor to Ebola in Isiro.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with the 17th outbreak tolling on healthcare workers. Dr. Élysée Nako died on 16 November 2026 at the Ebola Treatment Center in Isiro, capital of Haut-Uélé, after contracting Ebola. The loss adds to a recent string of healthcare worker deaths: nurse Justin Kataliko died on 5 November at Les Bernadins Clinic in Beni, Nord-Kivu; Dr. Safari Samuel died 29 October in Lwemba, Ituri; Dr. Marie-France Shogogo died 28 October at the Ebola Treatment Center in Beni, Nord-Kivu; and neurosurgeon Dr. Charles Mbusa Munyumu died 10 August 2026 at the Katwa treatment center, in Butembo. The article notes ongoing challenges in the response, including shortages of equipment and protection for health workers, complicating disease control and patient care across affected areas (Isiro, Beni, Ituri, Nord-Kivu).

triage.headline_ja: DRC：イシロでエボラにより医療従事者がまた一人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中の第17次エボラ流行において医療従事者の死亡が相次いでおり、防護具不足など対応上の課題も報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCの第17次エボラ流行における医療従事者の連続死亡を報告。装備・防護具不足が対応の障害となっている点が明記されており、国際支援の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: alcançar pessoas isoladas é crucial após 6 meses de surto na RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Reaching isolated people is crucial after six months of outbreak in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, figures show over 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths. About 70% of children under five infected die, highlighting extreme vulnerability of this age group. A UN-led, multi-partner response is ongoing, complicated by dozens of attacks on medical teams and impeded access to affected communities. Despite these challenges, up to 3,000 people have recovered and initial transmission foci have been contained, signaling partial control. Reaching isolated populations remains crucial to prevent further spread and complete containment of the Ebola outbreak in the DR Congo. The six-month milestone underscores the urgency of reaching isolated populations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：DRコンゴでの流行発生から6か月、孤立した人々への対応が重要
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行は発生から6か月が経過し、1万1千例以上・5千4百人以上の死者が出ている大規模かつ継続中のアウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 医療チームへの攻撃や孤立地域へのアクセス困難により封じ込めが複雑化している。5歳未満児の致死率が約70%と極めて高く、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Étel is okozhatta a tömeges hányásos, hasmenéses fertőzést Zalában
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Food could also have caused the mass vomiting and diarrheal infection in Zala.
article.articleSummary: Mass gastroenteric outbreak in Zala County, Hungary, affecting 1,495 people with 373 ill. Vomiting and diarrhea were predominant; symptoms were generally mild and no hospitalizations occurred. The ONI reported Nov 2–8 that the outbreak began on Nov 4 and suggested foodborne transmission. Nébih lab found Bacillus cereus in four food samples, indicating contamination; authorities say multiple foods and production processes may be involved. Eight stool samples were collected; laboratory analyses were ongoing and the investigation remained open. Separately, three imported dengue fever cases were reported: two in Győr-Moson-Sopron County (a 30-year-old man and a 26-year-old woman) with Vietnam exposure, and one in Pest County (a 35-year-old woman) who contracted the virus in the Maldives. The week also recorded 133 Campylobacteriosis, 62 Salmonellosis, 35 Rotavirus gastroenteritis, and 40 Hepatitis cases (including 31 Hepatitis A).

triage.headline_ja: ザラ県で集団嘔吐・下痢の感染が食品によって引き起こされた可能性
triage.triage_reason: ハンガリー国内の食中毒（Bacillus cereus等）アウトブレイクで症状は軽度、入院例なし。輸入デング熱症例もベトナム・モルディブでの曝露によるものでハンガリー国内の主題ではなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はハンガリー・ザラ県での集団食中毒事件。デング熱の輸入症例（ベトナム・モルディブでの曝露）は副次的言及であり、対象国リストの主題イベントとは判断されないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Россия создала в Африке три центра для изучения эпидемиологической ситуации
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia has established three centers in Africa to study the epidemiological situation.
article.articleSummary: Russia has established three epidemiological surveillance centers in Africa—Russian-Guinean, Russian-Congolese, and Russian-Burundian centers—to study epidemiological situations in different countries. A center in Venezuela (Russian-Venzuelan) is also part of the network, and the Russian-Vietnamese center has operated for almost ten years. These fixed hubs monitor health developments and illustrate Russia's approach to rapid response. Anna Popova, head of Rospotrebnadzor, cited a recent Ebola incident in Uganda, noting the team arrived within 48 hours. The remarks were made at a meeting with Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアがアフリカに疫学状況調査のための3つのセンターを設立
triage.triage_reason: 記事はロシアのアフリカにおける疫学調査センター設立という外交・協力的取り組みに関する内容であり、具体的な感染症の発生報告ではない。言及されているエボラ事例もウガンダでのものであり対象国リストに該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの国際協力・外交的取り組み（疫学センター設立）を報じるものであり、新規の感染症発生イベントではない。言及されたエボラ事例はウガンダ（対象国リスト外）での過去の事例。DRC、ベトナムは拠点設立国として言及されているのみで、実際の感染症発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: OUCRU và Bệnh viện Bệnh nhiệt đới TP.HCM tự hào về thành tựu thuốc điều trị sốt rét
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: OUCRU and Ho Chi Minh City Tropical Diseases Hospital Proud of Antimalarial Drug Achievements
article.articleSummary: 35-year collaboration between Oxford University Clinical Research Unit (OUCRU) and Ho Chi Minh City Tropical Diseases Hospital (Vietnam) is celebrated on 17 November 2026. A landmark malaria program showed artemisinin-based therapy reduced mortality from about 40% to 10% in severe Plasmodium falciparum infections by 2000, a result adopted globally by the World Health Organization. Over the decades, the research portfolio expanded to tetanus, dengue, tuberculosis, meningitis, HIV, typhoid fever, Streptococcus suis infections, antimicrobial resistance, and emerging infectious diseases, saving millions of lives and publishing thousands of studies. Leaders emphasize continuing to lead in surveillance, outbreak prevention, and precision medicine, training new scientists, and conducting clinically driven research in Vietnam, including responses to COVID-19. Notable honors were awarded to OUCRU and hospital representatives; the hospital will begin COVID-19 testing to ease Pasteur Institute workloads.

triage.headline_ja: OUCRUとホーチミン市熱帯病病院、マラリア治療薬の成果を誇る
triage.triage_reason: 過去35年間の研究協力の成果を祝う記念記事であり、現時点での新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去の研究成果・受賞を祝う内容であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクに関する情報ではない。COVID-19検査体制の言及があるが、新規事例の急増等は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: DH conducts interdepartmental public health exercise codenamed "Quartz" to enhance response capabilities and preparedness for prevention and control of novel infectious diseases (with photos)
article.articleSummary: Public health exercise 'Quartz' by Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection (CHP), Department of Health (DH), on November 17, 2026, aims to bolster response to novel infectious diseases. The two-part event began with a table-top drill on October 28 simulating a Hong Kong cluster, followed by a ground movement exercise at the Police College in Wong Chuk Hang after reports of four cases in a single building. The CHP activated a Multidisciplinary Response Team to investigate environmental factors, conduct risk assessment, and coordinate action, including issuing an isolation order for the building and evacuating residents to quarantine facilities. About 110 DH and other government representatives participated, with 36 observers from Mainland China, Macao, and Singapore. The exercise emphasizes infection surveillance, risk management, and interdepartmental coordination; the DH notes 34 prior exercises have covered diverse outbreak scenarios to strengthen emergency preparedness.

triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、香港衛生署による訓練・演習（シミュレーション）に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の実害は発生していない。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の疾病発生事例ではなく、香港CHP/DHが実施した新興感染症対応訓練（演習名'Quartz'）に関する広報記事。シグナルトリアージ対象の実イベントではないためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: 宁波19岁姑娘得流感，持续一周体温高到39℃至40℃，消炎药、清热解毒中成药都没用，医生提醒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 19-year-old woman in Ningbo contracted influenza; fever persisted for a week, reaching 39–40°C; anti-inflammatory drugs and Chinese patent medicines for clearing heat and detoxifying were of no use, doctors warn.
article.articleSummary: In Ningbo, China, a 19-year-old woman contracted influenza and endured a weeklong fever of 39–40°C despite standard anti-inflammatory drugs and Chinese patent medicines. She sought care at the Xicao Health Service Station of Jiangbei District Ya江 Community Health Service Center, where flying-needle acupuncture combined with oral Chinese herbs rapidly resolved the fever by the next day; five additional herbal doses consolidated recovery, and constipation and cough also disappeared. A physician noted that autumn–winter influenza fever, in traditional Chinese medicine, is a seasonal external wind with internal qi deficiency. Self-medicating with antibiotics or cold-clearing preparations can harm digestion in those with a weak spleen and stomach and may trap disease inside. The guidance is diagnosis-guided treatment rather than self-treatment, with flying-needle therapy providing quick relief followed by constitution-strengthening herbs to maintain remission.

triage.headline_ja: 寧波の19歳女性がインフルエンザに罹患、1週間にわたり39〜40℃の高熱が続く。消炎薬や清熱解毒の中成薬も効果なく、医師が注意喚起

triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザに関する個人の治療体験・中医学的視点を紹介する内容であり、アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Tecpar avança na produção de vacina contra raiva humana para reduzir d
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tecpar advances in the production of a vaccine against human rabies to reduce d.
article.articleSummary: Paraná's Tecpar advances technology transfer to supply the human rabies vaccine to Brazil's SUS through a Sinovac PDP partnership. Selected in 2025 as the sole public laboratory for vaccine provision to the Ministry of Health, Tecpar aims to expand domestic production and reduce Brazil's dependence on imports, since the country currently imports most human rabies vaccines. Rabies remains nearly 100% fatal after symptom onset; Brazil has two historical survivors. Transmission occurs via bites or saliva exposure from infected animals; incubation is about 45 days, with early symptoms such as fever, malaise, and headache, evolving to neuropsychiatric signs. The vaccine is available only in the public network for pre-exposure prophylaxis in high-risk workers or post-exposure management. The transfer is under way; the vaccine has Chinese NMPA approval but awaits Anvisa evaluation, with documentation on quality, safety, efficacy, and manufacturing required. Bats are the main reservoir in Brazil; dogs have not transmitted human rabies for about ten years.

article.articleSummary: Avian influenza H5N1 prompted Indian authorities in Kerala’s Alappuzha district to plan culling about 26,000 birds from two poultry farms after positive tests across multiple species—quail, chickens, and ducks. Samples collected from these farms were confirmed positive for H5N1 by the National Institute of High Security Diseases of Animals (NIHSAD) in Bhopal, leading to a Wednesday culling to contain the outbreak. Separately, Japan reported a second avian influenza outbreak this season at a 40,000-chicken farm in Chiba prefecture, underscoring ongoing challenges to the poultry sector. article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo tötet mehr als 5.000, zeigt Regierungsdaten.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo kills more than 5,000 people, according to government data.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo virus has killed 5,026 people among 10,351 infections as of October 31, with 2,788 recoveries. Declared in mid-May, it ranks as the second deadliest Ebola outbreak after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic and currently lacks a vaccine or proven treatment. In East Congo, health workers aim to reduce delays in seeking care and in-home care of sick relatives. Transmission is predominantly household-based, complicating contact tracing and isolation. Gorette Mbusi is seeking permission to move her sick grandchild to a specialized Ebola facility in Nizi, having already lost two relatives, including a daughter who died after hospital arrival. Ongoing conflict and violence hinder responders; on October 24, a nurse was killed and another health worker seriously injured at an Ebola alert in Bafwasende, Tshopo province.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、政府データによると死者5,000人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）の大規模アウトブレイクで死者5,000人超、ワクチン・治療法未確立かつ紛争地域での対応困難という複合的要因により、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる西アフリカ2014-2016に次ぐ史上2番目に死者数の多いアウトブレイク。ワクチン・確立された治療法がなく、紛争地域での医療従事者への暴力（看護師死亡等）が対応を著しく困難にしている。家庭内感染が主体で接触者追跡・隔離が困難。

article.articleHeadline: Une épidémie d'Ebola au Congo fait plus de 5 000 morts, selon les données du gouvernement.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola outbreak in Congo has killed more than 5,000 people, according to government data.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has killed 5,026 of 10,351 infections as of Oct 31, with 2,788 recoveries. Declared mid-May, it ranks as the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that killed about 11,000. There is no vaccine or proven treatment. Transmission is largely community-based, as families care for sick relatives at home, complicating contact tracing and isolation. Health teams face security and staffing challenges; violence and armed conflict impede response, and health workers have struck over delayed salaries. In Nizi, officials urged moving a sick grandchild to a specialized Ebola treatment facility, illustrating demand for isolation capacity. The reports are from the Associated Press citing the Ministry of Health, with The New York Times also documenting affected households.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行、政府データによると死者5,000人超
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部でのエボラ出血熱流行は感染者10,351人中死者5,026人と致死率約49%に達し、史上2番目に深刻な流行規模。ワクチン・治療法未確立、コミュニティ内感染拡大、治安悪化により対応が困難化しており、国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事本文は空欄だが、サマリーから流行規模・致死率・対応の困難さが明確。Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが記事主題ではないため除外。Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株による流行で、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行に次ぐ規模とされる。

article.articleHeadline: घर-घर पहुंचेगी स्वास्थ्य टीम, 15 दिन चलेगा कुष्ठ रोग खोज अभियान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Door-to-door health teams will reach every home; a 15-day leprosy detection campaign.
article.articleSummary: Jamshedpur district will launch a 15-day door-to-door leprosy detection campaign (Cycle-1) from 9–23 December 2026 to identify suspected cases and initiate timely treatment with MDT. Health teams will visit homes to screen for leprosy and start early care. The district-level plan was approved in a meeting chaired by Deputy Commissioner Rajiv Ranjan, with Additional Deputy Commissioner Nagendra Paswan, Civil Surgeon Dr. Sahir Pal, and District Leprosy Prevention Officer Dr. Mrityunjay Dhavadia among others. Awareness efforts will engage gram sabhas, panchayat representatives, schools, Anganwadi centers, and educational institutions; students will lead quizzes and competitions. Those cured will be honored to boost outreach. District Leprosy Counselor Dr. Rajiv Lochan Mahato provided details on MDT, self-care kits, and the MCR program, and programs at Ayushman Arogya Mandirs to dispel social stigma. Officials urged public cooperation to achieve a leprosy-free district.

triage.headline_ja: 戸別訪問で健康チームが各家庭へ、15日間のハンセン病発見キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常のハンセン病早期発見・啓発キャンペーンに関する行政広報であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: ジャールカンド州ジャムシェドプル地区における定例的なハンセン病スクリーニング・治療キャンペーンの告知であり、新規の疫学的異常は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: കാര്യവട്ടം ക്യാമ്പസിൽ ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി വ്യാപനം; ഒരാഴ്ചയ്ക്കിടെ 13 പേർക്ക് രോഗം , കോളജ്അടച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever spreading on Karyavattom campus; 13 people infected in a week, college closed.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, dengue fever is spreading at the Karyavattom campus of Kerala University in Thiruvananthapuram, prompting temporary shutdown of the campus and student hostels. Thirteen people were confirmed infected in a week, comprising 10 students and 3 university staff. Transmission appears concentrated in student residences, where many show symptoms and several others are awaiting test results. Some students who had returned home for holidays have also developed fever. Health authorities are tracing contacts and monitoring the health status of those on the contact lists. The report does not specify the infection source or laboratory confirmation details, and there is no mention of imported or exported cases. Public health measures include campus closure and ongoing surveillance of infections and contacts.

triage.headline_ja: カリヤヴァットムキャンパスでデング熱が拡大;1週間で13人感染、大学閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 単一キャンパス内の局地的デング熱クラスター（13例）で、デング熱自体は当該地域の既知流行病であり異常性は低いが、拡大状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: キャンパス閉鎖という学校単位の対応が取られており地域報道の関心はあるが、デング熱はケララ州の地域流行病であり国際的な異常性・重大性は認められない。続報で感染拡大や重症度の情報を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Afrique: Pourquoi les avancées scientifiques ne suffisent pas à vaincre le paludisme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: Why scientific advances are not enough to defeat malaria.
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains a major health challenge in Africa, with Sub-Saharan Africa accounting for about 95% of global cases and deaths. Elimination is increasingly realistic for some countries, yet progress is uneven. Three main obstacles hinder turning scientific advances into action: forecasting and preparedness; translating scientific data into policy and operational decisions; and awareness that does not always translate into protective behavior. To convert science to action, programs should link early warnings to concrete plans, ensure prevention and treatment are accessible, and strengthen leadership, resources, and coordination. Since the 1990s, satellite imaging and remote sensing of rainfall, temperature, vegetation, and surface water have helped map transmission risk. Ethiopia’s 2020 Bahir Dar early‑warning system prompted preparation and response. In Southern Africa, the program “Remote Sensing for Malaria Control in Africa” explores improved risk mapping and targeted interventions. A Zambia–Zimbabwe study shows high knowledge of transmission and symptoms, but nets are not always used due to access/cost, with larger households and older children less protected. As of April 2025, WHO reported over 40% of planned insecticide-treated net campaigns for 425 million people were delayed or at risk.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：なぜ科学の進歩だけではマラリアに打ち勝てないのか
triage.triage_reason: 特定の急性アウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、マラリア対策における構造的課題を論じる政策解説記事であり、新規性・異常性のあるシグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア対策の長期的な課題（予測・政策転換・行動変容）を分析する論評記事。ザンビア・ジンバブエの研究事例やエチオピアの早期警戒システムが言及されているが、いずれも既知の継続的取り組みであり、急性の発生イベントではない。ザンビアのみ対象国リストに含まれるため記載。

article.articleHeadline: ಕೇರಳಂನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಕ್ಕಿಜ್ವರ ದೃಢ: 26 ಸಾವಿರ ಪಕ್ಷಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕೊಲ್ಲಲು ನಿರ್ಧಾರ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza confirmed in Kerala: decision to cull 26,000 birds.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza has been confirmed in Kerala's Alappuzha district, with culling planned for about 26,000 poultry within a one-kilometre radius of two farms in Ambalappuzha North and Ambalappuzha South, and a farm in Chennithala panchayat. The infection was detected in chickens and ducks among others, with samples sent to the Central Laboratory in Bhopal where confirmation was received. Six Rapid Response Teams, each comprising one veterinarian, two livestock inspectors, two assistants, and four workers, will carry out the slaughter on Wednesday. A 10-kilometre surveillance zone around the affected farms has been established to monitor for spread. This action underscores ongoing containment of the Kerala outbreak to prevent further transmission from the affected farms and their surroundings.

triage.headline_ja: ケラ州で鳥インフルエンザ確定：2万6千羽の殺処分を決定
triage.triage_reason: 家禽（鶏・アヒル）における鳥インフルエンザの確定事例で、ヒトへの感染報告はなく、インドでは家禽での鳥インフル発生は定期的に起きており異常性は低い。通常の防疫対応（殺処分・監視区域設定）が進行中で管理可能と判断される。
triage.notes: 動物（家禽）における鳥インフルエンザ事例であり、ヒト感染の報告は記事内に見られない。インド当局により標準的な防疫措置（殺処分、サーベイランスゾーン設定）が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija ebole u Kongu van kontrole, broj zaraženih i umrlih raste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in Congo out of control, the number of infected and dead is rising.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, the Ebola epidemic in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo remains out of control, six months after its declaration on 15 May. Government data show more than 11,000 people infected and over 5,500 deaths. The outbreak, caused by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is the second-largest Ebola epidemic on record and is spreading faster than any prior outbreak. By comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak infected over 28,600 people and killed more than 11,000, mainly in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Despite substantial aid inflows, shortages of resources, security instability, and poor coordination hinder containment, and health workers have been targeted in communities with distrust toward outsiders, complicating response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が制御不能、感染者・死者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で宣言から6か月経過したエボラ流行が制御不能な状態にあり、感染者1万1千人超、死者5500人超と史上第2位の規模で急速に拡大しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事中のシエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアは2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。現行の流行は刚刚果民主共和国（DRC）東部に限定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : tragique fin du combat d'un nourrisson contre Ebola au CTE de Kisangani
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Tragic End to an Infant's Fight Against Ebola at the Kisangani Ebola Treatment Center
article.articleSummary: An Ebola update from Kisangani, in Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, reports the death of a 12-day-old infant at the Kisangani Ebola Treatment Center (CTE) on November 17, 2026. The baby arrived eight days after birth and was confirmed positive for Ebola last Thursday; his mother had already died from the disease, and three other family members had perished earlier. Additionally, a schoolteacher died of Ebola at the Kisangani CTE on Monday, two days after the mother’s death, with two other family members previously dying from Ebola. Community resistance hampers the response, with skepticism about Ebola existing or suspicions of misused funds. Since September, the Kisangani CTE has admitted 256 patients, 74 tested positive, and 17 are currently under care, including 11 suspected cases. Authorities note this marked the hundredth Ebola case in Tshopo Province.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:キサンガニのエボラ治療センターで乳児がエボラとの闘いの末に死亡という悲劇的な結末
triage.triage_reason: DRCチョポ州でエボラの死亡例が続発し、州内累計100例に達するなど感染が継続・拡大しており、コミュニティの抵抗も対応を阻害しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: チョポ州での累計100例到達、コミュニティの不信感・資金流用疑惑による対応阻害が指摘されており、継続的な監視と介入支援が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: لجنة الصحة بـ"النواب" تتابع مستجدات انتشار "إيبولا" في دول الجوار
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Committee of the House of Representatives follows up on the latest developments in the spread of Ebola in neighboring countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) is being closely watched in Libya, which reports no confirmed or suspected cases as of last Thursday. In Tripoli, the Health and Environment Committee of the Libyan House of Representatives discussed the situation with the National Center for Communicable Diseases and the National Security Council, focusing on neighboring-country spread and preventive measures. The meeting emphasized ongoing surveillance, cross-agency coordination, and preparedness to detect and respond to any suspected case, with rapid-response teams on alert and strengthened health monitoring. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, which began in May 2026 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and has become the largest Bundibugyo outbreak and the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The report underlines the danger of filoviruses and the need for immediate medical care and isolation to prevent fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: 下院保健委員会、近隣諸国におけるエボラ出血熱の感染拡大の最新状況を追跡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が史上最大規模のブンディブギョ株アウトブレイク、かつ史上2番目に大規模なエボラ流行とされており、近隣国リビアでも警戒レベルが引き上げられ政府レベルで対応が検討されている。
triage.notes: 記事はリビア国会の対応会議を報じているが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRC（2026年5月発生、ブンディブギョ株として史上最大規模、史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行）。リビア自体には確定・疑い症例は報告されていないため、リビアはverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 'Banh mi' shop in central Vietnam fined $3,500 over food poisoning that sickened 155 people
article.articleSummary: On opening day September 14 in Cam Lo Commune, Quang Tri Province, central Vietnam, Minh Tam banh mi shop triggered a food poisoning outbreak affecting 155 people. Patients reported abdominal pain, high fever, vomiting and dehydration; several were hospitalized at Cam Lo Regional General Hospital, including the owner’s mother and wife. Lab testing by the Nha Trang Pasteur Institute found Salmonella spp in 9 of 11 food samples (including banh mi fillings, beef, fish cakes, vegetables, braised meat, pickled vegetables, cucumbers, pork sauce) and Salmonella spp in 11 of 13 patient specimens; one patient sample also tested positive for Staphylococcus aureus. All patients were discharged by September 22. The shop was fined VND 90 million (about $3,500), suspended from food processing for four months, and ordered to cover medical costs for all 155 victims within 10 days; no criminal charges were filed. The incident occurred in central Vietnam’s Quang Tri Province.

triage.headline_ja: 中部ベトナムのバインミー店、食中毒で155人が発症し3,500ドルの罰金
triage.triage_reason: 単一店舗における食中毒（サルモネラ菌）事例で、既に収束・解決済み（全員退院、行政処分完了）であり、国際的拡大や公衆衛生上の継続的リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 食品衛生当局による罰則対応が完了しており、感染症の流行拡大ではなく単発の食中毒事件として扱うべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola au Congo se propage et tue à un rythme record
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Congo is spreading and killing at a record pace.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, persists six months after declaration on May 15, 2026. Since then, more than 11,000 people have been infected and over 5,500 have died, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded and the largest in the DRC. The epicenter is in Ituri province, but transmission is extending to other areas as the outbreak accelerates; the World Health Organization notes the pace is faster than in the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic, which infected more than 28,600 and killed over 11,000. The Congo faces insecurity, with health workers attacked and resources slow to reach outbreak sites outside the epicenter. MSF reports workers striking over unpaid salaries and working conditions. About $2.9 billion has been pledged for the response, but less than half has been disbursed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が拡大し、記録的なペースで死者が増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が11,000人以上感染・5,500人以上死亡と史上2番目の規模に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルRRAへ進むべき重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRC（特にイツリ州）での流行のみを主題としており、Angolaへの拡大や発生の記述はないため除外した。治安悪化と資金不足により対応が遅延しており、国際支援の継続的な必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Climate change, insecticide resistance could threaten malaria eradication: Murmu
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, President Droupadi Murmu warned that climate change, unplanned urbanisation, and rising mosquito resistance to insecticides could hinder India's malaria eradication efforts. Speaking at New Delhi during the year-long Golden Jubilee of the ICMR-National Institute of Malaria Research (ICMR-NIMR), she credited progress to improved healthcare, diagnostics, effective medicines, vector-control campaigns, and community participation, noting India moved out of the WHO 'High Burden to High Impact' category in 2024. She emphasized that malaria elimination requires not only healthcare workers but also prevention of water stagnation and environment management. Dengue has emerged as a major challenge, likely to worsen with global warming and shifting monsoon patterns. ICMR’s broader role in TB, leprosy, kala-azar, and during COVID-19—establishing nationwide testing and contributing to India’s indigenous vaccine—was highlighted as foundational to the fight against infectious diseases.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動と殺虫剤耐性がマラリア撲滅を脅かす可能性:ムルム大統領
triage.triage_reason: 大統領によるマラリア撲滅の課題に関する一般的な演説記事であり、特定の急性アウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではないため、シグナルとしては該当しない。
triage.notes: 政府要人による公衆衛生政策・研究機関の記念演説記事。具体的な感染者数増加や新規アウトブレイクの報告はなく、将来的なリスク要因（気候変動、殺虫剤耐性）への言及にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: Angola: Le pays enregistre 58 735 cas de tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Angola: The country records 58,735 cases of tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Angola reports 58,735 tuberculosis cases from January–September 2026, a 2% decline versus the same period in 2025. In Zaire province’s Mbanza Kongo, 750 positive TB cases were notified, down 112 year-over-year (−1.4%). Tuberculosis remains the third leading cause of death in Angola, after road accidents and malaria. A five-day training for local health technicians covers clinical, laboratory, and radiological diagnosis (including extrapulmonary forms), TB in children, HIV co-infection, TB during pregnancy, treatment and adverse effects, management of adverse events, and the rollout of new therapeutic protocols. The revised treatment protocol for both drug-susceptible and drug-resistant TB aims to shorten therapy from 11 to six months, per WHO guidance in 2024. Pilot provinces Benguela, Bié, and Cuanza-Sul were chosen due to Global Fund partnerships; Zaire, Uíge, Malanje, Moxico, Cabinda, and Cuando complete the training cycle, already delivered in 15 other regions. TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, primarily affecting the lungs.

triage.headline_ja: アンゴラ:同国で結核症例58,735件を記録
triage.triage_reason: 結核の定例統計報告であり、前年同期比で症例数は減少傾向。異常性や国際的拡大リスクはなく、対象国（アンゴラは対象外、DRCは主題ではない）にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はアンゴラ国内の結核統計及び医療従事者向け研修に関する定例報告。地域リストにDRCが含まれるが、記事の主題はアンゴラであり、アンゴラ・DRCともに対象国リストに該当しない（アンゴラは対象外、DRCは主題でないため除外）。

article.articleHeadline: Confins alerta para aumento de casos de Covid-19 no município em novembro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confins warns of an increase in COVID-19 cases in the municipality in November.
article.articleSummary: Confins, a municipality in the Belo Horizonte Metropolitan Region, Brazil, reports a rise in COVID-19 cases in November. As of November 17, 2026, 12 new COVID-19 cases were confirmed this month, bringing the 2026 total to 24 cases (compared with 19 cases in all of 2025). All recent cases have mild symptoms, and patients remain at home under supervision by health teams. The municipal Health Department continues epidemiological monitoring and patient guidance. Preventive measures emphasized to the public include frequent hand hygiene, well-ventilated environments, avoiding close contact with people with flu-like symptoms, seeking healthcare if symptoms arise, and wearing a mask when experiencing respiratory symptoms, especially in health facilities. No details on hospitalizations or fatalities are provided; authorities urge community cooperation to reduce transmission and protect public health.

triage.headline_ja: コンフィンス市、11月のCOVID-19症例増加に警戒
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの一地方自治体における軽症COVID-19症例の季節的増加であり、重症例・入院・死亡の報告もなく、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、本記事は自治体レベルでの軽症例の季節的増加報告に過ぎない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空。

article.articleHeadline: TPHCM: RSV tăng ở trẻ nhỏ, bệnh viện có thời điểm gần kín giường
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City: RSV rising in young children, hospitals at times nearly full.
article.articleSummary: RSV infection is surging among young children in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. At Children’s Hospital 2, two full-term newborns required respiratory support (NCPAP) after RSV infection; one initially presented with gastroenteritis before respiratory symptoms, the other with pneumonia and wheeze. Both tested positive for RSV and are under monitoring; RSV can progress rapidly in infants, sometimes within hours. Admissions have risen since August–October 2026, with daily intake of 10–20 pediatric cases and near-full beds. RSV typically begins with runny nose, congestion, cough, and sometimes fever, progressing to bronchiolitis or pneumonia in the youngest. Prevention emphasizes hand hygiene, avoiding crowds, masking when ill, ventilation, and avoiding smoke. High-risk groups include preterm or with chronic lung disease, congenital heart disease, and immunodeficiency. Prophylaxis includes maternal RSV vaccination during pregnancy and infant monoclonal antibodies.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市：RSVが乳幼児で増加、病院は一時ほぼ満床に
triage.triage_reason: 季節性RSV感染の増加で小児入院が増えているが、既知の病原体で季節的流行の範囲内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: RSVは既知の季節性呼吸器ウイルスで、乳幼児における重症化例（新生児の呼吸窮迫）が報告されているが、国全体規模の公衆衛生危機を示す情報はない。病院の病床逼迫状況の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Six mois après le début de l'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC, "la situation est dramatique et les enfants restent les plus vulnérables", selon l'Unicef
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six months after the start of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC, "the situation is dramatic and children remain the most vulnerable," according to UNICEF.
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, UNICEF reports a dramatic situation, with children bearing the heaviest burden. Authorities tally 11,000 cases and more than 5,500 deaths, about a 50% case fatality rate. Transmission occurs through body fluids; the circulating Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or specific treatment yet. Children under five are disproportionately affected, making up over a quarter of cases and a third of deaths. UNICEF flags the conflict-affected east as the epicenter, where insecurity hampers intervention and health-system capacity. The WHO announced in early November that two vaccine candidates—Moderna and an Oxford University/Serum Institute of India collaboration—will be evaluated in clinical trials in DRC within two to three weeks, with early results expected in 2027. Vaccines could speed containment, though responses have occurred without them in prior West Africa outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行開始から6ヶ月、「状況は悲劇的であり子どもたちが最も脆弱な立場に置かれている」とユニセフが発表
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%、11,000症例・5,500人超の死亡という大規模流行で、ワクチン・治療薬が未確立、紛争地帯での対応困難という複合的な公衆衛生上の重大リスクがありIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域に含まれているが記事サマリーではDRCの流行のみが主題であり、アンゴラでの発生に関する記述はないため除外した。ワクチン候補の臨床試験がDRC国内で予定されており、国際的な支援（WHO、UNICEF、ワクチン開発企業）が既に動員されている状況。

article.articleHeadline: 衞生署「白水晶」演習測試新型傳染病應變能力｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Health 'White Crystal' Exercise Tests Novel Infectious Disease Response Capability
article.articleSummary: On 17 November 2026, Hong Kong's Department of Health staged the 'White Crystal' cross-department public health drill to test the city's ability to respond to a novel infectious disease outbreak. Held at Wong Chuk Hang Police College, the exercise combined a tabletop on 28 October with a live drill on 17 November, simulating a cluster of new-type infectious disease cases. Four patients on three floors of the same building triggered a coordinated response; a cross-department emergency team was activated, environmental investigations and risk assessment were conducted. The Director of Health issued isolation orders for affected residents and arranged orderly evacuation to quarantine facilities. Observers numbered 36 from the National Health Commission, National CDC, Beijing, Shanghai, Guangdong, Shaanxi, nine Bay Area cities, Macao SAR, and Singapore. The drill emphasized environmental transmission, outbreak assessment, infection control, and interdepartmental coordination, aligning with China's 14th Five-Year Plan and Hong Kong's 2026–2030 policy aims.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生署「白水晶」演習、新型感染症対応能力をテスト
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、香港衛生署による訓練（演習）の報道であるため、シグナルとしての実質的な公衆衛生リスクは存在しない。
triage.notes: この記事は実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、香港衛生署が実施した模擬訓練（テーブルトップ演習および実地演習）に関する報道。架空のシナリオであり、実際の患者・疾患は存在しない。

article.articleHeadline: MS confirma 34 mortes por chikungunya - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health confirms 34 deaths from Chikungunya - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Brazil intensifies by November 17, 2026, with Mato Grosso do Sul reporting 34 deaths (53.97% of national total) and about 13,601 probable cases. Dourados leads, recording 19 deaths and 5,351 confirmed infections. Among fatalities, 21 had comorbidities; 127 pregnant women diagnosed. After a decline, notifications rose in November; October tallied 930 probable cases, up 155% from September. In the last week of October, 349 records were reported, versus 27 in the same period in 2025. Aedes mosquitoes drive transmission. Chikungunya causes high fever and severe joint pain that can persist for months or years. Public health authorities expect further increases in 2027 and call for prevention, surveillance, and decisive public actions to curb mortality and transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、チクングニア熱による34人の死亡を確認 - Boca do Povo News
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マトグロッソ・ド・スル州でチクングニア熱による死者34人、推定症例1万3千件超と急増しており、IHR基準2項目・WPRO基準4項目に該当するためフルリスク評価へ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 死亡者の多くが基礎疾患を有し、妊婦127人の診断も報告されている。10月は前月比155%増、2027年にさらなる増加が懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 1 700 enfants décédés parmi près de 3 000 cas recensés, alerte l'UNICEF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: more than 1,700 children have died among nearly 3,000 cases recorded, UNICEF warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues six months after it began on May 15, 2026. UNICEF reports 2,959 children under 18 infected and 1,737 child deaths as of November 4, 2026, from a total death toll exceeding 5,300. More than 1,700 children have died since the start. About 80% of pediatric deaths occur outside Ebola treatment centers, underscoring delays in seeking care and access barriers. The outbreak persists in eastern DRC provinces. UNICEF calls for strengthening pediatric care within treatment centers, psychosocial and protection support for orphans or children separated by the disease, and continued access to safe education. Emphasis on early case detection, rapid care, and protective measures for children in the most affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：約3,000人の感染者のうち1,700人以上の子どもが死亡、ユニセフが警鐘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクが6か月間継続し、死者数5,300人超・子ども死亡1,700人超と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 6か月間継続する大規模エボラアウトブレイクで、死亡者の約80%が治療センター外で発生しており、医療アクセスの課題が深刻。UNICEFが国際支援強化を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: MS confirma 34ª morte por chikungunya e soma mais da metade dos óbitos do Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health confirms 34th chikungunya death and accounts for more than half of Brazil's deaths.
article.articleSummary: By November 17, 2026, Mato Grosso do Sul accounts for 34 of Brazil’s 63 chikungunya deaths in 2026 (53.97%). The MS arboviroses panel records fatalities in 11 cities, led by Dourados with 19 deaths; other towns include Itaporã (3), Bonito (2), Jardim (2), and Ponta Porã (2), with single deaths in Fátima do Sul, Douradina, Guia Lopes da Laguna, Nioaque, Corumbá, and Dois Irmãos do Buriti. Twenty-one victims had comorbidities. There are 127 confirmed chikungunya cases in pregnant women in MS. The state reports 13,601 probable cases, up 290 from the prior update. Dourados accounts for the largest confirmed caseload (5,351); Corumbá (801) and Fátima do Sul (641) follow. Incidence per 100,000 is highest in Douradina (4,535.7), Batayporã (3,790.1), Dois Irmãos do Buriti (3,702.7), Paraíso das Águas (3,647.9) and Fátima do Sul (3,139.4). Women are 56.8% of probable cases; ages 10–29 predominate. In April 2026, MS received 20,000 vaccine doses. CHIKV is transmitted by Aedes aegypti; projections anticipate higher dengue and chikungunya in 2027 due to a Super El Niño.

triage.headline_ja: MS州、チクングニア熱による34人目の死亡を確認、ブラジル全体の死者数の半数以上を占める
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マットグロッソドスル州でチクングニア熱による死者が34人（全国63人の54%）に達し、妊婦127例や基礎疾患保有者の死亡例も多数確認されるなど、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響とIHR基準2項目以上の該当が認められるため。
triage.notes: チクングニア熱としては致死率・死者数が高く、通常の疾病像から逸脱している点が懸念材料。El Niño影響による2027年のデング・チクングニア増加予測も含まれ、今後の拡大動向に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu: durcissement de la grève des prestataires dans trois zones sanitaires - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: escalation of the healthcare providers' strike in three health zones - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola response personnel in North Kivu escalate a dry strike across the health zones of Butembo, Katwa and Musienene in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. They end the minimum service and will not operate in Ebola treatment centers (CTE), transit centers (CT), or WASH/IPC supervision. The move follows two failed attempts to resolve the crisis; organizers blame the absence of the provincial health authority and demand payment of backdated bonuses, improved working conditions, and wage scales. The action disrupts ongoing Ebola response activities in three zones, announced on 17 November 2026, following a service minimum that was due to end at 00:00 on 16 November 2026. The development underscores tensions within frontline responders and risks hindering outbreak control in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州でのエボラ出血熱対応：3つの保健地域で医療従事者のストライキが激化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱対応要員のストライキにより、治療センターや感染制御活動が停止し、アウトブレイク制御に重大な支障が生じるリスクが高いため。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラ新規症例の報告ではなく、既存のエボラ対応体制に関わる医療従事者のストライキが対応能力を脅かしている点が焦点。ストライキによる対応停止はアウトブレイクの再拡大リスクを高めるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Enem: candidatos do Piauí afetados por falta de energia ou doenças infectocontagiosas podem solicitar reaplicação até sexta (20)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ENEM: candidates from Piauí affected by power outages or infectious and contagious diseases may request a retake until Friday the 20th.
article.articleSummary: ENEM 2026 retake window for Piauí candidates: those who could not complete a day due to logistics issues or infectious diseases listed in the edital may request a retake by Friday, November 20. The retake is scheduled for December 15–16; if approved, candidates retake only the missed day. In Piauí, a power outage at a testing site in Regeneração disrupted the exam; Minas Gerais, Bahia, Paraná and Maranhão also reported logistics problems on day two. The option to retake extends beyond logistics: applicants from any Piauí municipality unable to take the exam due to infectious diseases—tuberculosis, pertussis, diphtheria, meningitis, smallpox, Mpox, influenza A/B, polio, measles, rubella, varicella, or Covid-19—may apply with documentation. Those absent for personal reasons, late arrivals, or rule violations are not eligible. Application is via the ENEM Participant Page (enem.inep.gov.br/participante); log in with CPF and Gov.br, select retake, provide reason and documents, and monitor analysis.

article.articleHeadline: Történelmi léptékű járvány tombol: minden eddiginél gyorsabban terjed a halálos kór
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Historic-scale epidemic rages: the deadly disease spreads faster than ever.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled six months after its May 15 declaration. More than 11,000 people have been infected and over 5,500 have died. This outbreak ranks as the world’s second deadliest Ebola epidemic, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, which infected over 28,600 and killed about 11,000 across Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone. The crisis centers in Ituri Province, with severe constraints hindering response, including insecurity, attacks on healthcare workers and vehicles, and distrustful communities. MSF warns essential supplies still fail to reach outlying transmission foci beyond the initial epicenters. Domestic issues—salaries overdue since August and internal disputes—hamper frontline efforts. International donors pledged about $2.9 billion, but Africa CDC says less than half has been disbursed.

triage.headline_ja: 歴史的規模の流行が猛威を振るう：これまでで最も速いペースで致死的な病気が拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行が6か月経っても制御不能で、感染者1万1千人超、死者5,500人超と史上2番目に深刻な流行規模に達しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域に挙げられたギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネ・アンゴラ・ウガンダは2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較や地理的近接性の文脈で言及されたものであり、現流行の発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。現流行の中心はDRCイトゥリ州。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'OMS appelle à atteindre les communautés difficiles d'accès - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: WHO calls for reaching hard-to-reach communities.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, six months into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the WHO urges intensified outreach to hard-to-reach communities. Transmission remains active, with about 400–500 new cases weekly across 67 health zones in eight provinces. Community deaths total about two-thirds of confirmed fatalities, signaling detection delays. Transmission has been interrupted in several foci, including Mongbwalu, Nyankunde, Bunia; Bunia also reports halving new cases. Diagnostics have expanded to more than 24 labs; about 2,000 beds in 104 treatment centers; 3,000 survivors. 17,000 health workers and 46,000 community actors have been trained; 90% of deaths are now in dignified, safe burials. Insecurity disrupts access, with over 80 attacks on health services, including Cantine-Aloya attack that killed 66 civilians (including 3 health workers) and over 1,000 contacts untracked. WHO calls for protected access, flexible funding through 2027, sustained political commitment, and community engagement to end the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：WHOがアクセス困難な地域社会への対応強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで6か月継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで、8州67保健地域にわたり週400〜500件の新規症例が発生し、治安悪化により対応が困難化している重大な公衆衛生イベント。
triage.notes: 武装勢力による攻撃（Cantine-Aloya襲撃で66人死亡）や1,000人超の接触者の追跡不能など、治安悪化が対応を著しく阻害している。WHOは2027年までの柔軟な資金提供と政治的コミットメントの持続を要請。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : les activités perturbées dans une école après décès d'un administratif - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: school activities disrupted after the death of an administrative staff member - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Kisangani, Democratic Republic of Congo, on November 17, 2026, Institut Kalindula in Makiso suspended activities after the death of Nadine, a secretary at the Ebola Treatment Center, from Ebola. She may be the fourth family member to die from Ebola in weeks; the outbreak within the family is linked to a patient from Niania, Ituri province, whose funeral reportedly violated safety measures. An Ebola response team planned to disinfect the school to prevent further transmission, ahead of additional health actions. A prior disinfection occurred at Maleke Primary School near Saint-Paul parish in Kabondo after a teacher’s death attributed to Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニのエボラ出血熱：行政職員の死亡後、学校活動が中断 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCキサンガニでエボラ出血熱による家族内クラスター（4人目の死亡疑い）と学校関係者の感染が報告され、葬儀を通じた感染拡大や学校閉鎖など公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が見られるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはマリ（Koulikoro Region等）が含まれているが、記事本文はDRC・キサンガニ及びイツリ州ニアニアでのエボラ発生について述べており、マリは対象国リストにも含まれないため除外した。葬儀を通じた感染拡大、家族内複数死亡、学校関連の感染可能性など、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクが高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola u Kongu izmiče kontroli: Više od 5.500 mrtvih, broj zaraženih raste rekordnom brzinom
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo spiraling out of control: More than 5,500 dead, the number of infected rising at a record pace.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus is spiraling, with more than 11,000 infections and over 5,500 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC and has become the second-largest Ebola epidemic globally, exceeding the 2018–2020 West Africa outbreak (~28,600 cases, ~11,000 deaths). The epidemic is expanding at a record pace, with infections and fatalities rising faster than during the first six months of 2014–2016. Efforts are hampered by security threats, attacks on health workers, distrust of outsiders, and shortages of medicines and supplies outside the initial epicenter in Ituri province. Some health workers are on strike over unpaid salaries since August. About $2.9 billion in aid was pledged, but Africa CDC notes less than half has been disbursed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、制御不能に拡大：死者5,500人超、感染者数が記録的速度で増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大級（史上2番目の規模）のエボラ流行が進行中で、死者5,500人超・感染者11,000人超と深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、資金・医療支援不足や治安問題で管理が困難なためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC（特にIturi州）のみが流行地として言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限については記事サマリーに明示的言及がなく不明と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de Maceió disponibiliza tratamento gratuito contra a tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maceió Health Department Offers Free Treatment for Tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: TB is the infectious disease caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis that primarily affects the lungs but can involve other organs. In Maceió, Brazil, the Municipal Health Department provides free TB testing and treatment through the Unified Health System (SUS), with evaluation available at any Basic Health Unit (UBS) and sputum testing when indicated. Diagnosis is followed by a six-month, fully funded treatment course under health professionals’ supervision; adherence is essential. Transmission is airborne from individuals with active pulmonary or laryngeal TB. Core symptoms include a cough lasting three weeks or more (with or without sputum), afternoon fever, night sweats, weight loss, chest pain, and fatigue. The National Day for Combating Tuberculosis, observed on Nov 17, seeks to raise awareness and reduce stigma. Prevention emphasizes well-ventilated spaces, cough hygiene, and early vaccination with BCG for newborns.

triage.headline_ja: マセイオ保健局、結核の無料治療を提供
triage.triage_reason: 結核啓発デー関連の通常の公衆衛生広報記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す内容はない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核啓発デーに合わせた既存の無料治療プログラムの案内であり、新規症例増加やアウトブレイクの報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: 衞生防護中心與多部門演習　模擬出現新型傳染病個案群組
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Centre for Health Protection and Multi-Department Drill Simulate Clusters of Novel Infectious Disease Cases
article.articleSummary: Centre for Health Protection (CHP) in Hong Kong, with multiple government departments and auxiliary forces, conducted a public-health drill simulating clusters of novel infectious disease cases. Held at Wong Chuk Hang Police College, the exercise involved about 110 representatives from CHP, Hospital Authority, and bureaus including Lands, Housing, Police, Buildings, EMS, Environment, Civil Aid Service, Fisheries, Auxiliary Medical Service, and Food and Environmental Hygiene Department. Observers included 36 experts from Mainland China’s National Health Commission, National Center for Disease Control and Prevention, Beijing, Shanghai, Guangdong, Shaanxi, nine Bay Area cities, Macao SAR, and Singapore MOH. Scenario: CHP receives notification of four cases of a novel infectious disease, triggering the Cross-Department Emergency Response Team to investigate environmental factors and assess risk, and to coordinate evacuation of residents under quarantine to designated facilities to curb spread. The drill tests interdepartmental response, cross-border collaboration, and overall public-health emergency management.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生防護中心、複数部門と合同演習—新型感染症クラスター発生を想定
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生ではなく、香港衛生防護中心による新型感染症クラスター発生を想定した訓練演習に関する報道であり、トリアージ対象の実イベントに該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、香港における新型感染症対応能力の訓練演習（シミュレーション）を報じたものであり、実疾患の発生地域は存在しない。

article.articleHeadline: Targetkan Daerah Bebas TBC, Puskesmas di Cirebon Diperkuat Alat Deteksi Modern |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Target TB-Free Areas, Public Health Centers in Cirebon Strengthened with Modern Diagnostic Tools
article.articleSummary: TB aims to be eradicated in Cirebon Regency as modern diagnostic tools are deployed at community health centers (puskesmas) to accelerate TB detection and improve care. Central government backing follows visits by the Deputy Minister of Home Affairs and the Deputy Minister of Health. Bupati Imron underscored the TB-free goal and urged health workers and facilities to lead by example in healthy living and service delivery. The central authorities also seek to position Cirebon as a model for health development, with a planned progress review in the coming months. Local budgets should prioritize health and education (APBD), with infrastructure development handled by the Public Works and Spatial Planning Agency (PUTR). The report does not specify TB case counts or outbreaks, focusing on enhanced detection, services, and strategic governance rather than incident response.

triage.headline_ja: 結核のない地域を目指して、チルボンの保健所に最新検出機器を強化
triage.triage_reason: 結核対策の行政・インフラ強化に関する内容で、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの記載はなく、異常性・緊急性も認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の恒常的な公衆衛生対策・行政施策に関する内容であり、アウトブレイクや症例急増の報告はない。対象国リストに含まれるIndonesiaでの発生ではあるが、通常の結核対策強化の報道でありシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Filaria infection declines sharply in UP; 412 b... | UNI India
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, Uttar Pradesh reports a sharp decline in lymphatic filariasis. Once present in 782 blocks across 51 districts, the infection is now confined to fewer areas, with 412 blocks classified as non-endemic. Rampur has been declared filaria-free, while Varanasi, Azamgarh, Mau and Mahoba are also nearing elimination status. The next Mass Drug Administration (MDA) campaign will begin on 19 November to further reduce infection levels by ensuring that more than 90% of the targeted population takes anti-filarial medication.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州でフィラリア感染症が急減、412ブロックが非流行地域に
triage.triage_reason: 記事はリンパ系フィラリア症の改善・減少を報告する内容であり、公衆衛生上の新たな脅威や異常事態ではなく、既存の制圧プログラムの進捗報告である。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症の減少・制圧の成功例を報じるポジティブなニュースであり、MDAキャンペーンによる既存対策の継続を伝える内容。新規脅威ではないためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: Soha nem látott ütemben terjed és szedi áldozatait az ebola, az ötéven aluli gyermekek harmada veszti életét a járványban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads at an unprecedented rate and claims its victims; a third of children under five die in the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Six months after the Ebola outbreak was declared in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the epidemic remains uncontrolled with case and death numbers rising at a record pace. Despite a flood of aid, shortages of resources, uncertainty, and poor coordination continue to hamper containment efforts. Health-care workers are increasingly attacked in communities that distrust outsiders. The outbreak is also taking a toll on health services in severely affected provinces. UNICEF reports that in Tshopo Province about 11% fewer children received the third dose of diphtheria, tetanus, and pertussis vaccine, and the first dose of measles vaccine fell in all three reporting provinces; in South Kivu the decline reaches 7.6%.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが前例のない速さで拡大し犠牲者を出す、流行では5歳未満児の3分の1が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で発生中のエボラ出血熱の流行が6ヶ月経過しても制御できておらず、症例・死亡者数が記録的ペースで増加しており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部（South Kivu, Tshopo州）でのエボラ流行継続と、それに伴うワクチン接種率低下（ジフテリア・破傷風・百日咳・麻疹）を報告。医療従事者への攻撃や援助の調整不足も指摘されており、制御が困難な状況が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: Sarna humana avança e já atinge mais de 100 pessoas em Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human scabies is spreading and already affecting more than 100 people in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei) is spreading in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with Dourados at 74 cases after 28 new records on Monday (16) and Itaporã at 34, totaling 108 across both cities. In Dourados, cases are in three Municipal Early Childhood Education Centers: Recanto Raízes (49), Ceim Beatriz de Barros Bumlai (15), Ceim Professor Bertilo Binsfeld (10); Franklin Luiz Azambuja School has suspected cases awaiting clinical evaluation. In Itaporã, two early childhood units were closed: Milton Milani Center resumed on 16 after cleaning, while Maria Rodrigues Dias (7 cases) remains suspended with return planned for 18, contingent on no new cases and authorities’ assessment. Health teams are monitoring diagnosed individuals; schools are to report suspected cases and support home follow-up. Transmission is linked to close contact in shared spaces, though authorities say transmission did not originate within schools. Symptoms include intense nocturnal itching and skin rashes; treatment is available, and close contacts may require care.

article.articleHeadline: NanoViricides, Inc. Has Filed its Quarterly Report - Broad-Spectrum Antiviral Drug NV-387 Oral Gummies Has Entered Two Separate Phase II Clinical Trials - One to Treat Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease, and Another to Treat Mpox (Monkeypox)
article.articleSummary: NV-387 oral gummies, a broad-spectrum antiviral, has entered two Phase II trials: Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease (BDBV) and Mpox (Monkeypox).
