Enrollment for BDBV began Sept 23, 2026; the Mpox trial opened Sept 23, 2026, with a DR Congo site prepared and on-site q-RT-PCR capacity established. ACOREP approved the Ebola-trial setup in Aug 2026. In the Measles program, NV-387 received FDA Orphan Drug Designation (April 27, 2026) and Rare Pediatric Disease Designation (RPDD) in May 2026, enabling a Priority Review Voucher upon approval. Bangladesh reports a Measles epidemic since March 2026: 249,569 suspected cases and 1,348 deaths; the US has 5,412 confirmed cases in 2026 and at least 6 deaths, with loss of measles elimination status. NV-387 shows pediatric NOAEL of 1,230 mg/kg per dose in 4-day-old mouse pups, suggesting potential pediatric dosing. Financials: cash ~ $2.98M; total assets ~ $9.56M; current liabilities ~ $3.1M; net burn ~ $3.64M in the quarter; funding insufficient to cover through 11/16/2027.

triage.headline_ja: ナノヴィリサイズ社、四半期報告書を提出 - 広域抗ウイルス薬NV-387経口グミが2つの第II相臨床試験を開始 - エボラ・ブンディブギョウイルス病治療とMpox（サル痘）治療
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は製薬企業の四半期財務報告および治験進捗に関する企業ニュースであり、新規の感染症発生事象の報告ではない。バングラデシュの麻疹流行や米国の症例数は背景情報として言及されているに過ぎず、対象国リストにも含まれない。
triage.notes: DRCはMpox治験サイトとして言及されているのみで、DRC国内での新規アウトブレイク発生の記述ではないため除外。バングラデシュ・米国の麻疹流行データは実質的内容を含むが対象国リスト外であり、かつ記事の主題は企業の財務・治験報告である。

article.articleHeadline: NanoViricides, Inc. Has Filed its Quarterly Report - Broad-Spectrum Antiviral Drug NV-387 Oral Gummies Has Entered Two Separate Phase II Clinical Trials - One to Treat Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease, and Another to Treat Mpox
article.articleSummary: NV-387 Oral Gummies has entered two Phase II trials for Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease (BDBV) and Mpox (MPXV). Enrollment for BDBV began September 23, 2026, and the Mpox trial site opened the same date; a DR Congo remote site was prepared for Mpox, with regulatory approval from ACOREP to conduct Ebola BDBV testing granted in early August 2026. On-site Ebola treatment centers and a q-RT-PCR lab support rapid diagnostics. For Measles, NV-387 received FDA Orphan Drug Designation (April 27, 2026) and Rare Pediatric Disease Designation (May 2026), enabling a Priority Review Voucher; a US Phase II trial is planned. Bangladesh has endured a measles epidemic since March 2026 (≈249,569 suspected cases, 1,348 deaths as of Nov 17, 2026); the US reports ≈5,412 confirmed cases in 2026 with at least 6 deaths. Measles has no licensed treatment. Juvenile mouse pups toxicology showed NOAEL 1,230 mg/kg/dose (3x daily) over 12 days, hinting at potential pediatric safety. Financials as of Sept 30, 2026: cash ≈$2.98M; total assets ≈$9.56M; current liabilities ≈$3.1M; net cash used ≈$3.64M in the quarter, with funds insufficient to cover operations through Nov 16, 2027.

triage.headline_ja: ナノビリサイズ社、四半期報告書を提出 ― 広域抗ウイルス薬NV-387経口グミが、エボラ・ブンディブギョウイルス病治療とMpox治療の2つの第II相臨床試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事は製薬企業の治験進捗・財務報告であり、新規の感染症発生報告ではない。DRCへの言及は治験サイト準備の文脈であり、実際のアウトブレイク情報ではないため、シグナルとしての重要性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はNanoViricides社の治験・財務報告が主題。バングラデシュおよび米国の麻疹流行データが記載されているが、両国とも評価対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCへの言及はMpox/Ebola治験サイト準備の文脈であり、実際の疾病発生報告ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC deja más de 11.400 casos y cerca de 5.600 muertos en poco más de seis meses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC has left more than 11,400 cases and about 5,600 deaths in just over six months.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached more than 11,400 cases and about 5,600 deaths after just over six months, with spread to other zones and infections in regional countries. The National Institute of Public Health (INSP) bulletin reports 11,432 cases and 5,593 deaths, including 56 new cases and 25 deaths in the last 24 hours, for an overall case fatality rate of 48.9%. Currently 1,681 people are hospitalized or in isolation, and 3,109 have recovered. Contact tracing is at 85.1%, though the response is hampered by insecurity and resource shortages. The DRC outbreak is the deadliest in the country's history and may surpass the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) which registered 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths, per WHO data.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、6ヶ月あまりで症例数11,400人超、死者約5,600人に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、症例数1万人超という極めて深刻な規模のエボラ出血熱流行であり、国境を越えた拡大も報告されている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）での流行が主題。発生地域リストにあるシエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ギニアは2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行との比較文脈で言及されているのみであり、今回の発生国ではないため除外した。対象国リストにアンゴラは含まれないため、いずれにせよ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Semana de Combate à Dengue mobiliza a Região Leste de Foz do Iguaçu até quinta (19)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fight Week mobilizes the East Region of Foz do Iguaçu through Thursday, the 19th.
article.articleSummary: Dengue Fight Week mobilizes the East Region of Foz do Iguaçu from Monday, 16 November to Thursday, 19 November, 2026, with a cleanup drive running through 27 November. Actions focus on Aedes aegypti prevention: CCZ vector-control visits to homes and businesses, educational activities, inspections of closed or abandoned properties, and a city cleanup led by the Municipal Environment Secretariat—third such initiative this year. The East Region was chosen due to epidemiological indicators; November dengue notifications have risen in the past three years. Transmission appears to slow, with 4,481 notifications and 46 confirmed dengue cases in 2026, and no deaths since 2024. More than 30 dumpsters are available at sites including Morumbi, Morumbi II, Portal da Foz, Niterói, Jardim São Paulo, and Panorama. Report irregular waste via 156 or the e-ouve app. With El Niño bringing heavier rain, residents should eliminate standing water around yards and external areas.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策週間、フォス・ド・イグアス東地域で19日(木)まで実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・フォス・ド・イグアスにおける定例的なデング熱対策活動の報道であり、2026年の確定症例は46件・死亡例は2024年以降なしと規模も縮小傾向。異常性・緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地域の自治体によるベクター対策・啓発活動の日常的な報道。デング熱通知件数は過去と比較して伝達は鈍化傾向にあり、死亡例もない。

article.articleHeadline: Russia establishes three centers in Africa to monitor epidemiological situation
article.articleSummary: Russia has established three epidemiological monitoring centers in Africa—Russian-Guinean, Russian-Congolese, and Russian-Burundian—as part of a network that already includes a Russian-Venezuelan center and a Russian-Vietnamese center, which has been in operation for nearly a decade. These permanent outposts monitor disease activity across countries and exemplify Moscow’s rapid-response approach when outbreaks occur. Anna Popova, head of Rospotrebnadzor, noted Uganda’s Ebola outbreak and said the team reached Uganda within 48 hours. The report does not provide case counts, laboratory confirmation details, or infection-source data. The centers’ purpose is ongoing surveillance of the epidemiological situation in Africa and beyond, including monitoring in Venezuela and Vietnam, with international cooperation as a key feature.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、アフリカに疫学状況監視のための3つのセンターを設立
triage.triage_reason: 記事はロシアによるアフリカでの疫学監視センター設立に関する内容であり、新規の感染症発生や症例報告を伝えるものではない。ウガンダのエボラ流行への言及はあるが既知の過去事例の紹介であり、具体的な新規感染状況のデータはない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアの国際的な疫学監視ネットワーク構築に関するものであり、DRCやベトナムは監視センターの設置国として言及されているに過ぎず、実際のエボラなど感染症の発生国ではない。言及されているエボラ流行はウガンダ（対象国リスト外）に関するもので、具体的な症例数や発生状況のデータも記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Alta da Covid: variante PJ.2.1, que cresce no Brasil, entra no radar da OMS; conheça
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 surge: PJ.2.1 variant, which is growing in Brazil, enters WHO's radar; learn more.
article.articleSummary: SARS-CoV-2 lineage PJ.2.1 is being monitored by the WHO as a variant under monitoring, due to 25 Spike mutations that enhance cell entry but currently do not show major immune escape. In Brazil, PJ.2.1 has been identified with Rio de Janeiro (RJ) as the leading source, now accounting for the majority of sequenced samples (58% of 167 Fiocruz Oswaldo Cruz sequences from Oct 21–Nov 13); the first PJ.2.1 Brazilian sample was collected in RJ in late August and registered in October. Brazilian sequences are mainly from RJ, with additional detections in São Paulo, Brasília, Pelotas (RS), Chapecó, Balneário Camboriú, and Florianópolis (SC); globally first detected in Ontario, Canada, in May. Brazil reports rising COVID-19 activity: 118,920 respiratory-syndrome cases this year as of Nov 4; test positivity rose to 20.45% by Nov 14. Vaccines continue to protect against severe disease; genomic surveillance is essential. Vaccination: 6 months–5 years three doses (2nd after 4 weeks; 3rd after 8 weeks); 5–59 years one dose; boosters for pregnant, elderly, and immunocompromised.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ変異株「PJ.2.1」がブラジルで増加、WHOの監視対象に
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視対象とする新変異株PJ.2.1がブラジルで急速に拡大しており、陽性率上昇や複数州への拡散が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: WHOが監視下に置く新変異株PJ.2.1はリオデジャネイロを起源としブラジル国内で優勢化しつつある。免疫逃避の証拠は現時点でないが、呼吸器症候群の症例数増加と検査陽性率上昇（20.45%）が報告されており、継続的な監視が必要。カナダ（オンタリオ州）が世界初検出地とされるが対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو مستمر رغم تراجع انتقال العدوى في بعض المناطق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo continues despite a decline in transmission in some areas.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains out of control six months after it emerged, despite declines in transmission in some areas. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has spread to 67 health zones across 8 provinces, with 11,197 cumulative cases and about 5,471–5,500 deaths. Africa CDC notes the lack of a licensed vaccine for this outbreak has aided its spread, while the WHO reports roughly 3,000 recoveries. Response efforts face security and health challenges, including an attack on a decontamination team in Ituri, strikes by health workers in Butembo over delayed payments, and treatment centers in Oicha reaching capacity. In Kenya, the health ministry announced the last Ebola patient has left hospital, initiating a 42-day monitoring period to declare the country Ebola-free.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行、一部地域で感染拡大は鈍化も依然収束せず
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が発生6か月を経ても制御できておらず、致死率の高い死亡者数（約5,500人）と8州67保健ゾーンへの拡大、治安・保健体制上の課題（攻撃、ストライキ、病床逼迫）が確認されるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアでの最後の患者退院・42日間の監視期間開始が報じられているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主たる発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州・北キブ州を含む8州。

article.articleHeadline: Radio Ebola: DR Congo children fight myths on the airwaves as outbreak hits 6 months
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Bunia epicenter reaches six months since WHO declaration. It is the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak in history and DR Congo’s deadliest, with at least 5,430 deaths and 11,000 infections, spreading to 67 health zones across eight provinces. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatment or cure. Response efforts are strained by conflict, mass displacement (nearly seven million internally displaced), and funding gaps: US$2.9 billion pledged, less than half disbursed; health workers unpaid since August, strikes over working conditions, and supplies failing to reach hardest-hit areas. A nurse was killed and a community health worker injured by an armed mob over contamination fears. In Bunia, 35 radio children (ages 8–16) broadcast on Radio Mont Bleu and Radio Télé Salama, reaching >800,000 listeners to dispel myths, explain transmission and symptoms, and guide people to care, highlighting community-led prevention amid ongoing challenges.

triage.headline_ja: ラジオ・エボラ：コンゴ民主共和国の子どもたちが流行発生から6か月を迎える中、電波で迷信と闘う
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目に致死的なエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行が継続中で、死者5,430人・感染11,000人、8州67保健地域に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 資金不足(27.5億ドル中半分未満が実際に拠出)、医療従事者の未払い・ストライキ、武装集団による医療従事者襲撃など対応能力に重大な懸念があり、国際支援の継続・強化が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết gia tăng, không chủ quan khi gặp những triệu chứng này
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever on the rise; don't ignore these symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases rise in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi. In week 45 (2–8 Nov), Ho Chi Minh City reported 2,099 dengue infections, up 16.8% from the four week average; 2026 total reaches 46,690. Areas with over 100,000 cases include Con Dao Special Zone, Ngai Giao, and Minh Thanh. Hanoi logged 619 cases in week 6–13 Nov across 101 wards, with a cumulative 7,026 and no deaths. Most infections are mild, but about 5% progress to severe dengue with risks of shock, coagulopathy and organ failure; the critical phase commonly occurs days 3–7 when fever may subside. High risk groups include children under 1 year, pregnant women, people aged 60+, and those with chronic disease or obesity. The Qdenga vaccine, licensed in Vietnam, is a live attenuated vaccine with about 80% efficacy in year one and targets all four dengue serotypes; vaccination should accompany vector control and recognition of warning signs. Mosquito control remains essential year round, as Aedes also transmits Zika and Chikungunya.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が増加、これらの症状を軽視しないよう注意
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市・ハノイでデング熱症例が季節的に増加しているが、死亡報告はなく、重症化率も既知の範囲内であり異常性は低い。蚊媒介感染症としての継続的曝露リスクはあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで毎年季節的に流行する風土病的疾患であり、本記事は公衆衛生啓発・症例報告の定期更新的内容。死亡例なし、重症化率も既知範囲（約5%）であり、特段の異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Variante PJ.2.1 da Covid-19 avança em sete estados e acumula 25 mutações na proteína Spike
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 PJ.2.1 variant spreads across seven states and accumulates 25 mutations in the Spike protein.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 PJ.2.1 variant expanding across seven Brazilian states: Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Distrito Federal, Pelotas (RS), and Chapecó, Balneário Camboriú, Florianópolis (SC). The World Health Organization is evaluating adding PJ.2.1 to watchlist after its spread in Brazil in November 2026. In Rio de Janeiro, Fiocruz sequencing shows PJ.2.1 accounts for 58% of 167 samples collected Oct 21–Nov 13, 2026, ahead of RF.5.3 (22%) and XFG (11%). The first Brazilian PJ.2.1 sample was collected in Rio de Janeiro in late August 2026 and registered in October; initial identification occurred in Ontario, Canada, in May 2026. PJ.2.1 carries 25 Spike mutations; lab studies indicate stronger ACE2 binding, but vaccine-induced antibodies neutralize it. Covid-19 test positivity rose to 20.45% (week ending Nov 14, 2026), highest since Mar 2025; 118,920 SARS cases in 2026 up to Nov 4. SUS vaccination guidance prioritizes children and vulnerable groups with detailed age/risk schedules; vaccination sites: UBS.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19のPJ.2.1変異株が7州で拡大、スパイクタンパク質に25の変異を蓄積
triage.triage_reason: 新規変異株PJ.2.1がブラジル7州で急速に拡大し、WHOが監視対象への追加を検討中であり、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に2つ該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 初出はカナダ・オンタリオ州（2026年5月）とされるが、現在の主要な拡大・報道の焦点はブラジル国内（リオデジャネイロ、サンパウロ、サンタカタリーナ州等）であるため、verified_locationsはBrazilのみとした。陽性率は2026年11月14日時点で20.45%と2025年3月以降最高値を記録しており、今後の重症度・医療負荷の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Se propaga el brote de ébola en el este de la República del Congo - La Banda Diario
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is spreading in the eastern part of the Republic of the Congo - La Banda Diario
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is spreading rapidly six months after its first detection in 2026, with confirmed cases exceeding 11,000 and more than 5,500 deaths since May 15. The epicenter is Ituri Province, and the outbreak is the second-largest worldwide and the seventeenth in the DRC. Containment is hampered by security attacks on health workers, vehicles, and surveillance, with MSF noting vital resources not reaching many contagion hotspots outside the epicenter. By comparison, the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak recorded about 28,600 infections and 11,000 deaths in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Moderna has begun a first-in-human trial of an Ebola Bundibugyo vaccine (mRNA-1469) in Canada, in partnership with Cepi, aiming to enroll ~80 adults to test safety and immunogenicity, funded up to $50 million.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大 - La Banda Diario
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でのエボラ（ブンディブジョ型）流行が11,000人超の感染・5,500人超の死亡に拡大し、医療従事者への攻撃で封じ込めが困難となっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは2014-2016年の過去流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現行イベントの発生国ではないため除外。カナダはModernaのワクチン臨床試験実施国であり、現行アウトブレイク発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: კონგოში ებოლას ეპიდემია რეკორდული ტემპით ვრცელდება - ვირუსს 5 500-ზე მეტი ადამიანი ემსხვერპლა
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo is spreading at a record pace — more than 5,500 people have died from the virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains uncontrolled, spreading at a record pace. By May 15, the outbreak had infected over 11,000 people and claimed more than 5,500 lives, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. Official figures show infection and fatality rates at roughly double those seen in West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak, which killed more than 11,000. Constraining factors include chronic shortages of medical resources, regional instability, and coordination gaps within the health sector. Healthcare workers have been targeted, and some doctors have begun strikes over delayed salaries and harsh working conditions. Donors have pledged about $2.9 billion for the response, but leading African public health authorities say less than half has actually been disbursed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が記録的な速さで拡大 ― ウイルスによる死者5,500人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が記録的規模（感染1万1千人超、死者5,500人超）で拡大中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的関心・支援ニーズも高い。
triage.notes: BluedotはAngolaも発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーではDRCのみが流行地として言及されておりAngolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行であり、医療資源不足・地域不安定・資金拠出の遅れが拡大の要因とされる。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'attaque des ADF à Cantine-Aloya entrave la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The ADF attack on Cantine-Aloya hampers the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: Attack by the Islamic State–linked Allied Democratic Forces on Cantine-Aloya in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on 5 November killed 66 civilians, including three health workers, severely hampering the Ebola response. Security violence restricts access to affected zones, complicating case finding and contact tracing, and jeopardizes distribution of treatments and equipment. Wessam Mankoula of Africa CDC warns that insecurity can let Ebola gain ground and erode response capacity, highlighting barriers to access, community engagement, contact tracing, and logistics. Historically, northeast outbreaks illustrate the potential scale when response is strained: an outbreak declared on August 1 recorded over 700 deaths (including 100 in under three weeks), with 1,117 confirmed or probable cases and 339 recoveries. The current violence underscores how armed conflict directly impedes public health operations and outbreak containment in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ADFによるカンティーヌ・アロヤ攻撃がエボラ対応を妨害
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（死者700人超、症例1,117件）において、武装勢力の攻撃により接触者追跡・治療物資配布などの公衆衛生対応が著しく阻害されており、重大な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 本件は既知の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（2025年8月1日宣言、死者700人超、確定・疑い症例1,117件）の継続であり、治安悪化（ADFによる攻撃）が対応能力を一層損なわせている点が焦点。Africa CDCも懸念を表明しており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: هجمات مسلحة بالكونغو تعطل تتبع 1000 مخالط بـ إيبولا وتهدد جهود احتواء تفشي الفيروس - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Armed attacks in Congo disrupt the tracking of 1,000 Ebola contacts and threaten efforts to contain the Ebola outbreak - Libya News 24
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo worsens as armed attacks disrupt response and contact tracing for more than 1,000 people linked to cases. The World Health Organization warns that insecurity is a major barrier to outbreak control, hindering access, surveillance, testing, and isolation. An attack on Kantin-Aloya in North Kivu killed 66 civilians, including 3 health workers, and three health facilities were looted and burned, crippling local medical services. A separate assault on 11 November signals ongoing risk. As of Sunday data, total Ebola cases since the outbreak began exceed 11,000 with more than 5,400 deaths, and new infections remain at about 400–500 per week. These disruptions raise the risk of undetected transmission and complicate tracing, laboratory confirmation, patient care, and containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの武装攻撃がエボラ接触者1000人の追跡を妨害し、ウイルス流行封じ込めの取り組みを脅かす
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（累計1万人超・死者5400人超）が武装攻撃により接触者追跡や医療対応が妨げられており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: WHOが治安悪化をアウトブレイク制御の主要な障害と警告。新規感染は週400〜500件継続中で、未検出感染拡大のリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Venezuela Declares National Rabies Quarantine After Six Deaths in 2026
article.articleSummary: Venezuela declares a national epidemiological quarantine after six confirmed rabies deaths in 2026: a 14-year-old in Sifontes, Bolívar from bat exposure; five Zulia fatalities from stray dogs (68-year-old woman, 44-year-old man, 20-year-old man, and two children ages 6 and 14). In the 42nd epidemiological week, 154/219 animal-brain samples tested positive (70.32%): 128 from stray dogs, 19 from cats; wild bats carrying the forest strain identified. Nine Zulia municipalities are affected; Caracabo has 77 foci, San Francisco 23, Mara 16, Lagunillas 12. Nationally, suspicious bites total 42,363, up 25.9% from 2025; 967 bite reports in week 42. WHO targets 80% herd immunity via animal vaccination; 2026 domestic-vaccine target is 2.5 million doses (vs 223,000 previously). In Zulia, 154,000 of 400,000 planned doses have been given. Brazil provided 5,000 human vaccines via PAHO. Protocols: wash wounds 15 minutes with soap and water; no alcohol; severe facial/neck bites receive antirabies immunoglobulin and a four-dose vaccine on days 0,3,7,14.

triage.headline_ja: ベネズエラ、2026年の狂犬病による6人の死亡を受けて国家的検疫を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡者6名の発生を受けベネズエラが国家的検疫を宣言し、咬傷件数が前年比25.9%増加するなど深刻かつ異例の公衆衛生事案であり、ブラジルからの緊急ワクチン支援も必要とされている。
triage.notes: 本事案はベネズエラ国内で発生しており、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。ブラジルはPAHO経由で人用ワクチンを提供した支援国として言及されているのみで、ブラジル国内での発生事例ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: பறவைக் காய்ச்சலால் மூடப்பட்ட வண்டலூர் உயிரியல் பூங்கா மீண்டும் நாளை திறப்பு!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vandalur Zoological Park, closed due to avian influenza, will reopen tomorrow.
article.articleSummary: Vandalur Zoological Park (Arignar Anna Zoological Park) near Chennai will reopen to visitors on November 18, 2026, after a temporary closure prompted by avian influenza. Authorities detected H5N1 avian influenza in waterfowl in the park area, leading to precautionary restrictions that confined visitors to non-affected zones. To ensure biosecurity, two rounds of sampling were conducted at 15-day intervals; both sampling events found no infection among tested birds. Based on these results, park management announced the reopening beginning tomorrow, with continued bird population monitoring and surveillance in surrounding zones to prevent recurrence. No related human cases are reported in the article.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザのため閉鎖されていたヴァンダルール動物園、明日再開へ
triage.triage_reason: 動物園でのH5N1検出による一時閉鎖は解除され、再検査でも感染なし。ヒト感染報告もなく、既に収束に向かっている事案であるため見送り。
triage.notes: 動物園内の水鳥でH5N1が検出されたが、人への感染報告はなく、再検査で陰性確認後に再開。鳥類への影響のみで公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Surto se espalha por creches, e cidades vizinhas somam 108 casos de sarna humana em MS - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã/MS e Pedro Juan Caballero/PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak spreads through daycares, and neighboring cities total 108 cases of human scabies in Mato Grosso do Sul - Ponta Porã Informs - News from Ponta Porã/Mato Grosso do Sul and Pedro Juan Caballero/Paraguay
article.articleSummary: As of 16 November 2026, Mato Grosso do Sul reports 108 confirmed human scabies cases across Itaporã and neighboring Dourados, linked to daycares. In Itaporã, 34 cases have been recorded since the outbreak began, with CMEI Milton Menani closed briefly and then reopened; a second unit, CMEI Maria Rodrigues Dias, has seven cases with reopening planned for 18 November. In Dourados, 74 cases are concentrated in multiple municipal early childhood centers: Recanto Raízes (Jardim Água Boa) with 24 children and 16 staff diagnosed; CEIM Professor Bertilo Binsfeld with 10 cases; Recanto Raízes and Beatriz de Barros Bumlai centers with nine cases each. The municipal health and education departments are issuing guidelines on symptom identification, prevention, and enhanced cleaning; some authorities warn of potential escalation if transmission rates rise. Authorities also monitor suspected cases at Escola Municipal Franklin Luiz Azambuja.

triage.headline_ja: 保育施設で集団感染が拡大、ブラジル・マットグロッソ・ド・スル州の近隣都市で疥癬症例が108例に
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度・国際拡散リスクが低い疾患だが、保育施設での集団感染が複数都市に拡大しており、地域内での継続的な曝露・流行可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疥癬はヒトヒゼンダニによる接触感染症で、致死性や重症度は低いが、保育施設等の密集環境で拡大しやすい。地方自治体レベルで対応中であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Dez estados receberão reforço de vacinas contra a Covid-19 após aumento de casos leves - Brazil Urgente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ten states will receive booster doses of the COVID-19 vaccines after an increase in mild cases - Brazil Urgente
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s Health Ministry will distribute more than 1.4 million additional COVID-19 vaccine doses to ten states after a rise in mild infections across 18 federative units. Doses target São Paulo (largest share, >500,000), Rio de Janeiro (≈350,000, with 150,000 for the capital), Minas Gerais (≈290,000), Rio Grande do Sul (≈140,000), and smaller allocations to Paraná, Piauí, Mato Grosso do Sul, Espírito Santo, Alagoas, and Tocantins (5,000–50,000 each). Despite higher case counts, severe COVID-19 hospitalizations remain below 2025 levels. Delivery will occur gradually, aligned with each state’s capacity; some units have not confirmed requests due to distribution logistics. The SUS vaccination calendar prioritizes children 6 months–<5 years, pregnant women, and those 60+, plus adults with chronic diseases, healthcare workers, indigenous and quilombo communities, and riverine populations, with varying booster intervals (every six months for older/immunocompromised; annually for others). The program excludes routine vaccination in private clinics; emphasis remains on high-risk groups. Three-dose infant schedule: 6, 7, and 9 months.

triage.headline_ja: 軽症例の増加を受け、10州にCOVID-19ワクチンの追加供給 - Brazil Urgente
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19軽症例の季節的増加に対する通常のワクチン接種体制強化であり、重症入院は前年水準を下回っている。異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められず、既存の管理された公衆衛生対応の範囲内。
triage.notes: 既知の病原体（COVID-19）による軽症例の季節的増加であり、保健省が通常のワクチン接種計画に沿って対応している。重症化率は低下傾向で、パンデミック上の新規シグナルとは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Gilead Partners With Generic Manufacturers to Boost Future Access to Experimental Ebola Prevention Drug -
article.articleSummary: Gilead's investigational antiviral obeldesivir is being pursued as post-exposure prophylaxis for Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD). The company signed royalty-free voluntary licenses with Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, Eva Pharma, and Ferozsons Laboratories to cover 127 mostly low- and lower-middle-income nations, aligning with remdesivir's COVID-19 license footprint and including every African country reporting current Ebola BVD cases. Technology transfer and manufacturing readiness are underway; additional manufacturers may be added. Regulators have not approved obeldesivir for filovirus disease or any other indication. ALIMA and partners are coordinating the Phase 3 EBO-PEP randomized, placebo-controlled trial in high-exposure individuals. Earlier work showed activity in COVID-19/RSV and preclinical efficacy across filoviruses. Gilead also expanded remdesivir licenses to cover filovirus disease and donated more than 2,000 vials to Kenya; across DRC, Uganda and Kenya compassionate-use donations exceed 38,000 vials.

triage.headline_ja: ギリアド、実験的エボラ予防薬への将来的アクセス拡大に向けジェネリックメーカーと提携
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は既知の進行中エボラ（ブンディブギョ型）流行に対する医薬品アクセス・供給体制強化のビジネスニュースであり、新規アウトブレイクの探知情報ではないが、現在進行中の流行継続を示唆するため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ウガンダ・ケニアにおける現在進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）流行への対応薬剤開発・供給契約に関する内容。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ（ウガンダ・ケニアはリスト外のため除外）。新規発生イベントの一次情報ではなく、既存流行への製薬企業の対応ニュースである点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Avian flu confirmed in Alappuzha, 26,000 birds to be culled
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza confirmed in Alappuzha district, Kerala, at two farms. Quails and chickens were infected at Ward 11, Ambalapuzha North grama panchayat, and ducks and chickens at Ward 1, Chennithala grama panchayat. Samples tested positive at the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD), Bhopal. About 26,000 domesticated birds across Ambalapuzha North, Ambalapuzha South and Chennithala are slated for culling on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, including 10,044 birds in Ambalapuzha North. A 1-km radius around the affected farms is designated for culling and disposal in bulk. Six rapid response teams (each with one doctor, two livestock inspectors, two attendants, four workers) will carry out the operation, with a grama panchayat member and police, revenue, and panchayat office staff present; two more teams on standby. A 10-km surveillance zone surrounds the outbreak. District collector Shaji V Nair chaired an emergency meeting with disaster management deputy collector S Biju, chief veterinary officer Dr P Rajeev, and other officials.

triage.headline_ja: アラプーザで鳥インフルエンザ確認、2万6000羽の鳥を殺処分へ
triage.triage_reason: 家禽での鳥インフルエンザ発生で殺処分・監視区域設定の対応が取られているが、人への感染は報告されておらず、現時点では公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されていない。人獣共通感染症としての潜在リスクから継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（ウズラ・ニワトリ・アヒル）における動物の鳥インフルエンザ発生であり、人への感染報告はない。ケララ州アラプーザ県の2農場で陽性確認、26,000羽を殺処分、半径1kmを処分区域、10km圏を監視区域に設定。地方当局による緊急対応（迅速対応チーム6班編成）が実施されている。疾患タグに『Human Infection with Avian Influenza』が含まれるが、記事内容は動物感染に限定されており、人への感染拡大がないか今後の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Duale orders 21-Day quarantine for Kenyans returning from DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola: Ongoing outbreak in DR Congo drives Kenya to impose a mandatory 21-day quarantine on Kenyans returning from DR Congo. Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale announced that all Kenyans arriving from the eastern African country will be subjected to a 21-day monitoring period. Travellers from DR Congo will also undergo enhanced screening and health assessments at designated entry points, with Gate 16 specifically cited for thorough screening. Duale said the outbreak continues in DR Congo, so the risk of importation remains real, especially as Kenyans prepare to return home for the festive season. The new protocol aims to prevent importation of Ebola cases into Kenya and applies to those traveling from DR Congo; it emphasizes quarantine compliance and entry-point health checks during the 21-day monitoring window.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：デュアレ氏、DRCから帰国するケニア人に21日間の隔離を命令
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを受け、ケニアが入国者に21日間の強制隔離・検疫措置を導入しており、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限の両方に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで継続中のエボラアウトブレイクであり、ケニアは越境輸入予防のための隔離措置を講じている側。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria cases, deaths have dipped by 80% between 2015 and 2025: President Murmu
article.articleSummary: Malaria in India declined about 80% in cases and deaths from 2015 to 2025, President Droupadi Murmu said while inaugurating the ICMR-NIMR golden jubilee. High-burden districts fell from 155 to 33, and roughly 160 districts reported zero indigenous malaria during 2022–2025. India exited the WHO High Burden to High Impact (HBHI) group in 2024, reflecting substantial progress. Ongoing challenges include climate change, unplanned urbanization, and rising insecticide resistance, underscoring the need for water management and vector-control measures alongside new medicines and vaccines. The government emphasizes strengthened diagnosis, treatment, surveillance, and community participation to sustain gains. India, home to about 16% of the global population, contributed roughly 0.7% of global malaria cases and 0.6% of malaria deaths, and targets zero indigenous malaria by 2027 and elimination by 2030, with ICMR-NIMR leading research efforts.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア症例・死亡数、2015年から2025年の間に80%減少：ムルム大統領
triage.triage_reason: インドにおけるマラリア対策の進捗を称える内容であり、新たな公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 政府高官による成果報告の記事であり、感染症の急増や新規アウトブレイクを示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Distrito Federal registra 44 casos confirmados de mpox em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Federal District records 44 confirmed monkeypox cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in the Federal District of Brazil reached 44 confirmed cases in 2026, up from a previous tally of 23. The Secretaria de Saúde also received 100 vaccine doses for high-risk groups, including people with severe immunosuppression and laboratory professionals who handle the virus. The illness can present as mild to moderate, with full recovery typically within a few weeks. Suspected or confirmed mpox cases should avoid contact with others and follow health professionals' guidance. The report highlights ongoing outbreak management in the Federal District and targeted vaccination to protect vulnerable groups and curb transmission through standard public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦直轄区、2026年のMpox確診症例44件を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル連邦直轄区でMpox症例が23件から44件に倍増しているが、重症度は軽度～中等度で、ワクチン接種など管理対応が進行中であり、IHR基準には該当しない。継続的な症例増加を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。症例数が倍増している点は継続監視すべきだが、現時点で管理体制は機能している模様。

article.articleHeadline: Covid, gripe ou resfriado? Saiba diferenciar os sintomas em meio à alta de casos em SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19, flu, or cold? Learn how to tell the symptoms apart amid the rise in cases in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state reports rising COVID-19 activity with 1,405 confirmed cases and 196 deaths as of November 12, per the state Health Secretariat. Authorities warn symptoms overlap with influenza and the common cold, recommending rapid tests or RT-PCR for accurate differentiation. Influenza (Orthomyxoviridae) types A and B drive seasonal epidemics; incubation about 2 days (1–4); abrupt onset with high fever, cough, nasal congestion, and body aches, lasting 1–2 weeks. Children may have vomiting or diarrhea; the elderly may present confusion without fever. COVID-19 (family Coronaviridae) has no fixed seasonality; incubation varies, with Omicron-era cases often 2–3 days. Symptoms can evolve for about three weeks, with loss of smell/taste. Children are often asymptomatic or mild; MIS-C is rare; older adults with chronic disease face higher risk of severe disease. The common cold, caused by rhinoviruses, parainfluenza, or RSV, is typically milder and up to four days.

triage.headline_ja: コロナ、インフルエンザ、それとも風邪？サンパウロでの症例増加の中、症状の見分け方
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器感染症（COVID-19、インフルエンザ、風邪）の症状比較に関する一般的な健康情報記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性の呼吸器感染症に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、既知の病原体による通常の季節変動の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Serious Events Linked to GLP-1s; Implicit Bias Training in Medicine; Ebola in Kids
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-17, Ebola rages in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with UNICEF reporting that children account for about 28% of cases but 35% of deaths, underscoring greater pediatric mortality in the outbreak. In the United States, 334 measles cases were reported in the past week, per Yale School of Public Health data, with experts urging a sustained, intensified vaccination push to restore measles elimination status and curb transmission. The briefing also notes broader health-news items, including policy updates and public health discussions in other sectors, but the infectious-disease focus remains on Ebola in DRC and measles activity in the U.S. These figures reflect ongoing transmission dynamics and the need for targeted vaccination and outbreak response to reduce morbidity and mortality.

triage.headline_ja: GLP-1関連の重大事象、医療における暗黙のバイアス研修、小児のエボラ出血熱
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が継続拡大しており、小児の死亡率が特に高い（症例の28%・死亡の35%）ことから重症度・異常性ともに高く、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 米国の麻疹に関する記述は対象国リストに含まれないため評価対象外とした。エボラはDRCでの継続的流行であり、特に小児の死亡率の高さが懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 中國疫情上升快速 中小學增聘「健康副校長」 | 新冠病毒 | 中共海關總署 | 停班停課
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's COVID-19 outbreak is rising rapidly; primary and secondary schools hire more "Health Vice Principals" | COVID-19 | General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China | Class suspensions
article.articleSummary: China reports a rapidly rising COVID-19 outbreak with increasing deaths amid alleged government concealment. Campus clusters drive ongoing transmission; many primary/secondary schools and kindergartens have suspended classes. On November 16, the National Health Commission ordered schools to appoint Health Vice Principals, professionals from medical institutions tasked with infectious-disease management. Reporting requirements mandate that students with fever, rash, diarrhea, or vomiting be reported to local disease-control and education authorities; thresholds include more than five sick students in a class within three days, and hand-foot-mouth disease also triggers reporting. Separately, the General Administration of Customs issued a notice to prevent Ebola virus importation. Since May, Ebola outbreaks began in Congo (DRC) and have spread to multiple countries, with tens of thousands of cases and case fatality up to 50%. Returning workers and travelers from Ebola-affected areas must declare exposure or symptoms on entry.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の感染状況が急速に悪化、小中学校で「健康副校長」を増員 | 新型コロナウイルス | 中国税関総署 | 休校・授業停止
triage.triage_reason: 中国でのCOVID-19急増・隠蔽疑惑による学校閉鎖の拡大に加え、DRC発のエボラ出血熱が複数国に拡大し致死率最大50%とされる重大な記述があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 情報源はNTDTV（新唐人電視台）であり、中国政府批判的な論調が強い媒体のため、死者数増加や『隠蔽』『致死率50%』『数万人規模』などの数値・主張の信頼性は要検証。特にDRCのエボラ『数万人規模』は過去の実例と比べ過大な可能性があり、フルRRAでの一次情報（WHO等）照合が必要。COVID-19（中国）とエボラ（DRC）という異なる2つの感染症イベントが同一記事に混在している点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Após cinco focos de doença de Newcastle em granjas, SC libera trânsito de aves e retomada de alojamentos em todo o estado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After five Newcastle disease outbreaks on farms, Santa Catarina lifts bird movement and resumes poultry housing across the state.
article.articleSummary: On 17 November 2026, Santa Catarina lifts bird movement and poultry housing restrictions statewide after five Newcastle disease foci in the western Santa Catarina region were closed. The outbreaks occurred in Nova Itaberaba (two foci), Nova Erechim (two foci) and Coronel Freitas. Cidasc, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture (Mapa), updated surveillance strategies following epidemiological investigations. No birds showed symptoms. First confirmation occurred October 18. A total of 251 commercial poultry establishments within 10 km of the foci, and more than 3,600 properties, were inspected; some properties visited more than once. Movement of birds and on-farm housing resume, with empty period and ongoing commercial requirements; export restrictions may remain per importing country. Surveillance continues; education and biosafety measures persist. Newcastle disease is a viral avian disease and poses no human health risk from properly inspected meat and eggs.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病の5つの発生拠点の後、サンタカタリーナ州が家禽移動と鶏舎再開を州全体で解除
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（ニューカッスル病）であり、発生は既に終息・制限解除済み。人への健康リスクはなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念も低い。
triage.notes: 動物衛生当局（Cidasc、Mapa）による対応は既に完了し、制限解除段階にある。人への感染リスクはないと明記されている。家禽貿易への影響（輸出制限の可能性）はあるが、公衆衛生上のシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемията от ебола в Конго е извън контрол, жертвите надхвърлят 5500
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo is out of control; casualties exceed 5,500.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo remains out of control six months after its declaration on 15 May. It is caused by a rare Bundibugyo strain and has infected more than 11,000 people with over 5,500 deaths. The outbreak is the second-largest in history and spreading faster than the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic; it exceeds the 2018–2020 DRC outbreak (3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths). The Ituri province is the epicenter, with transmission spreading to other areas. Contributing factors include insecurity, resource shortages, and poor coordination; medical staff have faced attacks, and MSF notes vital supplies are not reaching districts outside the initial epicenter. Unpaid salaries have prompted strikes by healthcare workers, while about $2.9 billion was pledged for the response, with less than half disbursed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行は制御不能、死者数5,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで制御不能な規模(感染者11,000人超、死者5,500人超)で拡大しており、史上2番目の規模の流行で国際的拡大・支援の必要性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが記事サマリーではDRC国内（特にIturi州）の流行拡大のみが主題であり、Angolaでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak is spreading and killing at a record pace
article.articleSummary: Congolese authorities report the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, now the second-largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded globally. More than 11,000 people have been infected and over 5,500 have died since the outbreak was declared on May 15, with the epicenter in Ituri province. Insecurity, resource shortages, poor coordination and distrust of outsiders have hampered containment, with health workers attacked in communities. MSF warns essential supplies remain unavailable in hot spots outside Ituri’s epicenter. This outbreak is Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, surpassing the 2018-2020 event that had 3,481 cases and 2,299 deaths. Official comparisons show infections and deaths rising at double the rate of the early stage of West Africa’s 2014-16 outbreak. About $2.9 billion has been pledged, but less than half has been disbursed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが拡大し、過去最速のペースで死者が増加
triage.triage_reason: 史上2番目の規模（感染者11,000人超、死者5,500人超）のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、封じ込めが困難化し拡大が続いているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC（特にIturi州）のみが発生地として言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。資金拠出の遅延（約29億ドルの誓約のうち半分未満しか拠出されていない）や治安悪化による対応の遅れも懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta Unicef sobre retraso en atención a niños con ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF alert on delays in care for children with Ebola in the DRC
article.articleSummary: UNICEF warns of delays in care for Ebola-infected children in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In the current outbreak, more than 1,700 children have died, with 2,959 confirmed pediatric cases from May 15 to November 4. About 80% of child deaths occur outside Ebola treatment centers, highlighting delays in seeking care. UNICEF urges the government, humanitarian partners, and donors to reinforce pediatric capacity inside treatment facilities and to provide psychosocial support and protection for orphans or children separated from their families. The agency also stresses preserving education access through safe learning spaces. Report from Kinshasa on 17 November 2026; ongoing Ebola transmission necessitates rapid, child-focused health services and timely access to treatment.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEF、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染児童への対応遅延を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の進行中アウトブレイクで小児死亡者1,700人超・確定症例2,959人という重大な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: エボラは既知の病原体だが、小児死亡者数が非常に多く(1,700人超)、治療アクセスの遅延が深刻。継続中のアウトブレイクであり既にWHO等で注視されている可能性が高いため、フルRRAでの最新状況確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: El comité de emergencia de la OMS se reúne mientras el brote de ébola sigue en expansión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO Emergency Committee meets as the Ebola outbreak continues to expand.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to expand as the WHO Emergency Committee meets quarterly, six months after declaration. The epidemic has logged 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths, with about 500 new cases. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that cases are rising in several areas and that two-thirds of deaths occur outside treatment centers, signaling late detection and weak contact tracing. Insecurity remains a major obstacle, including an attack in Cantine-Aloya earlier this month that killed 66 civilians, including three health workers. Health facilities have been looted and burned; two weeks ago a nurse died and another health worker was seriously injured near an Ebola alert in Tshopo Province. Children account for a quarter of confirmed cases and a third of deaths. Travel restrictions to affected regions hinder response and disincentivize notification. The committee will issue recommendations and decide if this remains an international emergency.

triage.headline_ja: WHO緊急委員会が開催、エボラ出血熱の流行は拡大継続中
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が11,000症例・5,400人死亡に拡大し、WHOがPHEIC継続を検討する緊急委員会を開催するなど、国際的関心・公衆衛生影響が極めて深刻であるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: WHOはすでに本流行をPHEIC相当として扱っており、既存の継続的国際緊急事態として扱われている可能性が高い。治安悪化・医療従事者への攻撃・渡航制限など複合的リスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola Outbreak Is Spreading Faster Than Ever -- and Killing at Record Pace
article.articleSummary: Outbreak in eastern DR Congo (Bundibugyo Ebola strain) remains uncontrolled six months after declaration, with over 11,000 infections and more than 5,500 deaths since May 15. The outbreak is accelerating at roughly twice the rate of the West Africa 2014-16 outbreak, and is Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak, surpassing the 2018-2020 event. Security issues and poor coordination hamper response; health workers face attacks and protests, including strikes over unpaid salaries, slowing efforts. Although $2.9 billion has been pledged, less than half has been released. The World Health Organization urges donors to work with the Congolese government to ensure resources are used effectively.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクがこれまでで最速の拡大、過去最多ペースの死者数を記録
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が6ヶ月以上制御不能で11,000人超の感染、5,500人超の死亡と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的拡大・対応リスクが極めて高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが対象国リストに該当せず、またサマリー上でもAngolaへの拡大は言及されていないため除外。アンゴラへの越境拡大の有無は続報で要確認。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: الأطفال يمثلون أكثر من ربع حالات الإصابة بـ إيبولا وثلث الوفيات فى الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Children account for more than a quarter of Ebola cases and a third of deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Six months since declaration, with 11,000+ cases and 5,400+ deaths across 67 health zones in eight provinces. Children account for more than a quarter of confirmed cases and about one third of deaths; seven in ten deaths are in children under five. Outside DRC, Kenya has nine imported cases (including two deaths) and a 42-day countdown; Nigeria reports one imported case. Diagnostic capacity now exceeds 20 laboratories; about 2,000 treatment beds and roughly 3,000 recoveries. Clinical trials enroll over 900 participants; an Ervebo vaccine is being trialed but is not approved for Bundibugyo; two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines will join trials soon. Emphasis remains on early care, contact tracing, isolation, safe burials, and community engagement. However 400–500 new weekly cases persist, and some areas continue to spread. Insecurity, including the Kantin-Alwa attack killing 66 civilians (3 health workers), looting, and displacement, hampers response and delays frontline pay.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、感染者の4分の1以上、死者の3分の1を子どもが占める
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱流行は11,000例超・死者5,400例超に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境輸入例も発生。治安悪化による対応阻害や週400-500例の新規発生継続など、IHR基準・WPRO基準の多数に該当する重大な公衆衛生危機であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア（9例・うち死亡2例）、ナイジェリア（1例）への越境輸入例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。主たる発生地であるDRCのみを記載。治安悪化（Kantin-Alwa攻撃で民間人66名死亡）が対応を妨げている点にも留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Em meio à alta de Covid-19, SES lança painel interativo sobre doenças respiratórias em MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid the COVID-19 surge, the State Health Secretariat launches an interactive dashboard on respiratory diseases in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-17, Mato Grosso do Sul's State Health Secretariat launched an interactive dashboard tracking Severe Acute Respiratory Syndromes (SRAG) to monitor circulating respiratory viruses in the state. The tool filters by municipality, epidemiological week, and age group, with weekly updates to improve access for the public and health professionals. Integrated with MS’s Contingency Plan for Respiratory Viruses, it helps identify each municipality’s scenario and required response levels, aiding timely decision-making. The move comes amid a national COVID-19 surge linked to the XFG variant, though the state is reportedly trending downward according to the Ministry of Health. About 18,000 additional COVID-19 vaccine doses will be delivered to reinforce stocks and sustain immunization. The dashboard is freely accessible at https://painelsrag.saude.ms.gov.br/. Lívia Mello, SES technical manager for Influenza and Respiratory Diseases, highlighted its value for scenario visualization and timely response planning.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19の増加を受け、マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州保健局が呼吸器疾患に関するインタラクティブダッシュボードを公開
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19のXFG変異株による全国的な増加が背景にあるが、当該州では減少傾向にあり、内容は監視体制強化のための行政施策（ダッシュボード公開）に留まるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は新規の監視ツール導入という行政的対応に関する内容であり、感染症の異常な拡大や重症化を示す情報はない。州レベルではCOVID-19は減少傾向との記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Health: Nearly 3,000 Ebola recoveries recorded in six months
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo virus marks six months since its start, with the World Health Organization reporting slowing transmission in some affected areas and nearly 3,000 recoveries. Ongoing challenges include insecurity, population displacement, and limited access to communities, which complicate response efforts. UN agencies note progress but stress fragility across several zones. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, in a message posted on X on November 15, praised health teams and the ground interventions, reiterating commitment to support Congolese authorities until new cases are completely eliminated. The article does not specify laboratory confirmations, exact case totals, or the infection source beyond the Bundibugyo virus designation. The situation remains dynamic, requiring continued containment and response amid security and access constraints.

triage.headline_ja: 健康:過去6ヶ月間でエボラ出血熱の回復者が約3,000人に達する
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）のアウトブレイクが6ヶ月継続中であり、治安悪化・住民避難・アクセス制限により対応が複雑化しているため、WHOおよび国際的な注目度が高く、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（発生から6ヶ月）の経過報告であり、新規症例数・検査室確認状況・正確な感染源の詳細は記載されていない。治安状況・アクセス制限が継続的な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 美國爆發嚴重麻疹疫情！疾管署宣布升級「旅遊建議等級」　這3州是重災區
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Severe Measles Outbreak in the United States! Taiwan CDC Announces Upgraded Travel Advisory Level; These Three States Are the Hardest-Hit.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in the United States intensifies: as of November 12, 2026, 5,412 confirmed cases and 6 deaths across 47 of 51 jurisdictions, up 2.4-fold from 2025’s 2,289. From August 16 to November 8, 2026, 2,622 cases were confirmed, with 14 consecutive weeks above 100 cases, the most severe outbreak in 35 years. About 11% of patients are hospitalized; 96% of cases are unvaccinated or vaccination status unknown. The outbreak centers on Pennsylvania, South Carolina, and Utah. PAHO will meet to evaluate removing the U.S. measles elimination certification. Taiwan’s CDC upgrades its travel advisory for the United States to Alert Level 2, while domestic risk remains low due to high MMR vaccination (97%) and healthcare worker immunity (>90% in emergency, pediatrics, obstetrics/gynecology, and infectious diseases; airline crew >80%). In Taiwan this year, 11 measles cases (3 locally acquired, 8 imported from Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, Japan, the United States, India, and Kyrgyzstan).

triage.headline_ja: 米国で深刻な麻疹アウトブレイク発生！台湾疾病管制署が旅行勧告レベルを引き上げ　最も被害が深刻なのはこの3州
triage.triage_reason: 米国で35年ぶりの大規模麻疹アウトブレイク（5,412例、死亡6例）が発生し、IHR基準の重大性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限のすべてに該当。台湾CDCが渡航勧告を引き上げるなど国際的関心も高く、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本イベントの主発生国は米国であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。記事中で言及されるタイ・インドネシア・ベトナム・インドは台湾への輸入症例の出身国として挙げられているのみで、各国内でのアウトブレイクの主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento de casos do mpox no DF reforça atenção a sintomas como febre, dores no corpo e erupções na pele
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in mpox cases in the Federal District underscores attention to symptoms such as fever, body aches, and skin rashes.
article.articleSummary: Mpox cases are rising in the Federal District, Brazil, with 51 confirmed infections as of 16 November 2026; 45 are residents. All cases are male, predominantly aged 30–39. Key symptoms include skin eruptions/lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, body aches, chills, and fatigue. Public health guidance emphasizes early medical evaluation, isolation, and avoiding close contact and sharing personal items; reinforce hand hygiene and surface cleaning. Transmission is via direct contact with lesions and bodily secretions (pus, blood, saliva). Vaccination is prioritized for people living with HIV/AIDS aged 18+ with CD4 counts under 100 cells/mm3 in the last six months; doses arrive from the Ministry of Health, with other groups added as supplies permit. SES-DF notes ongoing surveillance and that the health network is prepared to diagnose and monitor cases; suspected cases should seek care and report exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦直轄区（ブラジリア）でのエムポックス感染拡大、発熱・体の痛み・皮膚発疹などの症状への注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: WPRO基準で複数該当（持続的曝露・流行しやすさ）があり、保健省によるワクチン優先接種など行政的関心も確認されるため、フルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: 51例中45例が居住者、全例男性・30〜39歳中心。HIV陽性者（CD4<100）への優先ワクチン接種が実施されており、特定集団での持続的な感染拡大が懸念される。死亡例の報告はなく、重症度は現時点で高くないと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Estado de SP supera meta de vacinação com BCG e reforça alertas no Dia Nacional de Combate à Tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State of São Paulo surpasses vaccination target with BCG and reinforces alerts on the National Day for Combating Tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: On National Day for Combating Tuberculosis, November 17, 2026, São Paulo State Health Secretariat reports vaccination progress and TB surveillance. BCG vaccination coverage reached 92.11% in 2025, exceeding the 90% target; by November 16, 2026, 355,058 public-health doses were administered. In 2026, 16,970 TB cases were confirmed through November 16, down from 20,760 in 2025 and 20,605 in 2024. Tuberculosis is an airborne infectious disease primarily affecting the lungs but can involve other organs. Transmission occurs via droplets from active pulmonary or laryngeal cases; prevention emphasizes well-ventilated spaces and sunlight, plus contact screening. Symptoms include a persistent cough for three weeks or more, with or without sputum, alongside low late-day fever, night sweats, weight loss, and fatigue. Treatment via SUS lasts about six months and must not be interrupted; poor adherence risks relapse and drug resistance. BCG vaccines remain freely available at UBS clinics, with dashboards for monitoring by NIES.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、BCGワクチン接種目標を達成し結核対策全国デーでの啓発を強化
triage.triage_reason: 結核症例数は前年より減少傾向にあり、ワクチン接種目標も達成している定例の啓発報道であり、異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核対策の年次啓発・統計報告であり、症例数は減少傾向。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではないため対象国リストへの該当国はあるがイベントとしての重大性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола у Конгу однела више од 5.500 живота, заражено преко 11.000 људи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo has claimed more than 5,500 lives and infected more than 11,000 people.
article.articleSummary: More than 11,000 people infected and over 5,500 killed by Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, six months after declaration on May 15, 2026, with the outbreak expanding at a record pace. The 17th Ebola outbreak in Congo is centered in Ituri province and has surpassed the 2018-2020 crisis (3,481 infections, 2,299 deaths). Despite international aid, resources and medical supplies have not reached flare-ups beyond the initial epicenter. The Bundibugyo strain is driving faster transmission than any previous outbreak. Health workers face insecurity, including attacks and strikes over poor conditions and unpaid salaries (some since August). About $2.9 billion has been pledged, but less than half disbursed. WHO cites uncertainty as a major hurdle; MSF warns of resource gaps, security issues, and coordination problems hindering containment. Official data show cases and deaths rising at twice the rate of the West Africa 2014-2016 outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、死者5,500人超・感染者11,000人超に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で過去最大規模のエボラ流行が進行中であり、国際的拡大リスク・重症度・管理困難性が極めて高いためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが記事本文での言及はなく、流行の主題はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州）であるため除外した。史上最速の拡大速度、資金・医療資源不足、治安悪化など複数の深刻な懸念が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемијата на ебола во Конго е надвор од контрола, се зголемува бројот на заразени и починати
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo is out of control; the number of infected and dead is increasing.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo remains out of control six months after being declared on May 15. The outbreak, caused by a rare Bundibugyo strain, has infected more than 11,000 and killed over 5,500, with case numbers rising at a pace faster than any previous Ebola outbreak. Comparisons to West Africa's 2014-2016 epidemic note that that outbreak infected more than 28,600 and killed over 11,000, primarily in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Despite large aid inflows, resource shortages, security instability, and poor coordination hinder containment. Health workers face attacks in communities that distrust outsiders. The situation underscores ongoing challenges in outbreak response in the DRC, including protecting frontline workers and engaging local communities to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が制御不能に、感染者・死者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）が11,000人以上感染、5,500人以上死亡と報告され、制御不能・拡大中であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: US officially loses measles-free status after 26 years amid outbreak
article.articleSummary: Measles endemic status declared in the United States by PAHO after confirming that the same virus strain circulated continuously for at least 12 months, ending the country’s 26-year elimination (achieved in 2000). Since the start of 2025, about 7,700 US measles infections have been recorded, the highest in more than three decades. The CDC-confirmed measles deaths this year total six, while state officials in Pennsylvania, Wisconsin and New York report 10 deaths combined, a discrepancy in fatality counts. Preschool vaccination coverage is about 92%, below the level experts say is needed to prevent major outbreaks, amid vaccine hesitancy associated with remarks by Health Secretary RFK Jr. Measles is highly infectious, with roughly 95,000 global deaths in 2024. Public health experts urge a broader vaccination response across workplaces and communities and note lessons from India; travel and migration heighten international risk.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、アウトブレイクの最中に26年ぶりに麻疹排除状態を喪失
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの3つが該当し、WPRO基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ等複数該当。社会的関心も高く、フルリスク評価に進むべき国際的に注目度の高い事案。
triage.notes: 主たる発生国は米国（対象国リスト外）。インドは『インドからの教訓』として言及されているのみで、インド国内で現在アウトブレイクが発生しているわけではないため verified_locations には含めない。国際的な渡航・移民によるリスク波及の観点から、対象国への波及可能性を注視する価値はある。

article.articleHeadline: Над 11.000 заразени и 5.500 починати во епидемијата на ебола во ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 11,000 infected and 5,500 dead in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo remains out of control six months after its May 15 declaration. According to the DRC government, more than 11,000 people have been infected and over 5,500 have died. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and is the second-largest on record, spreading faster than any previous outbreak. The World Health Organization notes the current toll outpaces the first six months of West Africa's 2014–2016 epidemic, which infected over 28,600 and killed more than 11,000, mainly in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Despite substantial international aid, resource shortages, security instability, and weak coordination hamper response. Attacks on health workers in local communities, where distrust of outsiders compounds challenges.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行で1万1千人以上感染、5千500人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱の大規模流行で死者5,500人超、国際的拡大や対応困難が明確であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にシエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ギニアが含まれるが、これらは2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現行アウトブレイクの発生地ではないため除外。現行流行はDRC東部に限定。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija ebole van kontrole: Više od 5.500 preminulih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic out of control: More than 5,500 have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo remains out of control six months after the May declaration. Since then, over 11,000 people have been infected and over 5,500 died, making it the 17th Congo Ebola outbreak and far exceeding the 2018–2020 wave (3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths). The Bundibugyo strain is driving rapid transmission. Attacks on health workers and distrust of outsiders have hampered containment; insecurity is cited by WHO as a major obstacle. MSF says essential supplies are not reaching outbreak zones beyond the Ituri epicenter. Health workers have gone on strike over poor conditions and unpaid salaries since August, with the government saying payments are being addressed. About $2.9 billion was pledged, but less than half disbursed. Despite aid, resource gaps, security and coordination challenges persist; the West Africa 2014–2016 outbreak recorded over 28,600 cases and more than 11,000 deaths, mainly in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が制御不能:死者5,500人超
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部で11,000人超感染・5,500人超死亡という大規模流行が6ヶ月以上制御不能であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する深刻な公衆衛生事態である。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ東部（イトゥリ州中心）の現行エボラ流行に関するもの。シエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ギニアは過去の流行（2014-2016年西アフリカ流行）への言及であり、現行イベントの発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: राष्ट्रपति ने आईसीएमआर-एनआईएमआर के स्वर्ण जयंती समारोह का किया उद्घाटन, मलेरिया के मामलों में 80 प्रतिशत कमी पर जताई खुशी - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The President inaugurated ICMR-NIMR's Golden Jubilee Celebration, expressing happiness over an 80 percent reduction in malaria cases - Punjab Kesari.
article.articleSummary: Malaria in India shows substantial progress as President Murmu opened ICMR-NIMR's Golden Jubilee, reporting an ~80% reduction in cases and deaths from 2015–2025. The high-burden districts fell from 155 to 33; 2022–2025 saw no locally transmitted cases in 160 districts. India, home to ~16% of the world’s population, accounts for ~0.7% of global malaria cases and ~0.6% of deaths. The event highlighted ongoing challenges, including climate change, unplanned urbanization, and rising insecticide resistance; emphasis on vector control, environmental management, surveillance, and community participation. Bhubaneswar hosts development of an indigenous malaria vaccine acknowledged at the ceremony. Health leadership reiterated a 2030 elimination target; funding shifts were noted: household out-of-pocket share fell from 63% to 42%, while government health spending rose from 6% to 23%.

triage.headline_ja: 大統領がICMR-NIMR創立50周年記念式典を開会、マラリア症例の80%減少を喜ぶ
triage.triage_reason: マラリア症例の大幅な減少（80%削減）という肯定的な進捗報告であり、公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事態ではない。記念式典・政策達成に関する内容でシグナルとしての該当性はない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア対策の成功事例・式典報告であり、気候変動や殺虫剤抵抗性などの将来的課題は言及されているが、現時点での緊急シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. officially loses measles elimination status in a body blow to public health
article.articleSummary: Measles elimination status for the United States was formally revoked by PAHO on 2026-11-17 amid a nationwide outbreak. In 2026, the U.S. has recorded more than 5,400 measles cases and 8 deaths, far exceeding 2025’s 2,289, with cases driven by vaccine skepticism and declining childhood immunization. U.S. kindergarteners’ MMR vaccination reached 92.4% in 2026, below the 95% herd-immunity target; some states report vaccination as low as 75%. PAHO Director Jarbas Barbosa warned that loss of elimination status implies prolonged transmission and higher risk of preventable illness. Critics fault HHS Secretary RFK Jr. while the department notes $100 million in funding to combat outbreaks. The move follows Canada’s loss last year; this year’s affected countries include the United Kingdom, Spain, Austria, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Uzbekistan, with Mexico and Bolivia added. Venezuela and Brazil had earlier revocations (2018, 2019) that were later restored.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、公衆衛生に深刻な打撃となる麻疹排除status（認定）を正式に喪失
triage.triage_reason: PAHOが米国の麻疹排除認定を正式に撤回し、2026年に5,400例超・死亡8例を記録するなど深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、ワクチン忌避による長期的な感染拡大リスクも高いためIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 本イベントは主に米国・欧州・中南米（ベネズエラ、ボリビア、メキシコ等）における麻疹排除status喪失を扱っており、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当する国は主題として含まれていない。ブラジルは2018-2019年の過去の撤回事例として言及されているのみで、今回の主要イベントの発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: РЕКОРДЕН БРАН НА ЕБОЛА ВО КОНГО: Бројот на починати надмина 5.500 лица во шестмесечната епидемија
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Record number of Ebola cases in Congo: The death toll surpassed 5,500 people in the six-month outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues to grapple with a record Ebola outbreak six months after its May 15, 2026 declaration. Government figures show more than 11,000 people infected and over 5,500 killed since the outbreak began. The crisis is driven by a rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain and is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, spreading faster than the West Africa epidemic of 2014–2016. That earlier outbreak infected over 28,600 people and killed more than 11,000, predominantly in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Despite large international aid inflows, resource shortages, insecurity, and poor coordination hamper control efforts. Frontline health workers in affected communities are frequently targeted, as distrust of outside teams remains high. The situation underscores the ongoing severity of Ebola in the region and the need for strengthened public health response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで記録的なエボラの急増：6か月間の流行で死者数が5,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で史上2番目の規模となるエボラ流行が進行中で、感染者1.1万人超・死者5,500人超と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、国際的拡大・管理困難性も認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部（コンゴ民主共和国）での進行中のエボラ流行に焦点を当てている。シエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアは過去の2014-2016年西アフリカ流行の比較対象として言及されているのみで、現在のイベント発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：刚果（金）埃博拉疫情已致逾5400人死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed over 5,400 people.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, the World Health Organization reports the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has killed over 5,400 people. The virus has crossed borders, with Kenya reporting 9 imported-related cases (2 deaths) and Nigeria 1 imported case; Kenya has discharged its last patient and begun a 42‑day observation. Authorities caution against blanket travel bans; targeted, evidence‑based measures are preferred. In-country response shows progress: testing capacity has risen from 2 to more than 20 laboratories; nearly 2,000 treatment beds are available and about 3,000 patients have recovered. Therapeutic trials exceed 900 participants; Ervebo is being trialed for this strain but not yet approved, with two additional vaccine candidates due to join trials soon. Vaccines supplement but do not replace life‑saving actions like early treatment, contact tracing, safe and dignified burials, and community engagement. Security challenges hinder relief, including the Cantine-Aloya town attack (66 civilians killed, 3 healthcare workers) and many contacts lost to follow-up; a nurse was killed in Teisho Po Province responding to an alert.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行で死者5400人超
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5400人超の死者を出す大規模エボラ流行が継続し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境例も報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大、渡航制限議論）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア・ナイジェリアへの輸入症例にも言及しているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。治安悪化（医療従事者殺害等）により対応が困難な状況が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: Nova variante da Covid-19 circula em Alagoas; veja sintomas e quem deve reforçar a vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new COVID-19 variant is circulating in Alagoas; see symptoms and who should get a booster shot.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, a new COVID-19 variant, XFG (Stratus), circulating in Brazil with Alagoas highlighted; 18 states show a six-week rise in mild cases. XFG is a descendant of Omicron; about 90% of sequenced samples nationwide identify this lineage, though that does not mean 90% of infections are caused by it. Symptoms resemble other viral infections: fever, headache, runny nose, cough, and sometimes hoarseness; some cases may include diarrhea or vomiting. Most infections are mild, but elderly individuals, those with chronic diseases, and immunocompromised patients face higher risk of progression to severe disease. Vaccination continues to protect against severe outcomes; booster doses are being distributed, with Alagoas emphasizing checks of vaccination cards. Adults 65+ may receive semiannual boosters; others follow risk-based guidelines. Early testing and treatment within five days can reduce viral replication and illness duration.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株がアラゴアス州で流行中；症状とワクチン追加接種が必要な対象者について
triage.triage_reason: 既知のオミクロン系統（XFG/Stratus）による軽症例の増加であり、重症度や異常性、国際的拡大リスクなど懸念される基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: XFGはオミクロンの子孫系統であり、既存のワクチン・対応体制で管理可能とされる通常の季節的変動とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Bolívia e México também perdem status de livre do sarampo, diz Opas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bolivia and Mexico also lose measles-free status, says PAHO.
article.articleSummary: Bolivia and Mexico, like the United States, have lost measles-free status in the Americas, PAHO Director Jarbas Barbosa announced. The update follows an endemic wave of measles transmission across the region, presented after PAHO meetings in Washington. To keep the elimination certificate, a country must not experience more than 12 months with active outbreaks. Brazil is cited as lacking sustained transmission chains despite imported cases; it had achieved measles-free status in 2016, lost it in 2019 due to sharp declines in vaccination and multiple outbreaks (over 20,000 cases in 2019), and recovered elimination in 2024 after two years without local transmission. The development underscores that measles elimination remains fragile and relies on continued high vaccination coverage to prevent reestablishment of endemic transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ボリビアとメキシコも麻疹排除認定を失った、とPAHO(汎米保健機構)が発表
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはボリビア・メキシコ・米国における麻疹排除ステータス喪失に関するもので、監視対象国（ブラジルを含む）はいずれも主題として関与していないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: ブラジルは記事中で言及されているが、持続的な伝播がなく2024年に排除ステータスを回復した事例として比較対象として挙げられているのみで、本イベント（排除ステータス喪失）の主題国はボリビア・メキシコ・米国である。これらは監視対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Temperature shifts could raise disease risks: CDC
article.articleSummary: By 18 November 2026, monsoon shifts may raise respiratory infections, while influenza remains the dominant virus. Influenza A(H1N1) accounted for 94.7% of detections. Last week there were 89,487 medical visits for flu-like illness, down 4.3% from the prior week and 9.3% of emergency visits. Seventy-one severe flu cases and 37 deaths were reported, with over 90% unvaccinated this season. Flu activity is rising in South Korea, Japan, US, Canada and parts of China. COVID-19 visits fell to 1,432 last week, with three severe cases and two deaths. The CDC will monitor the trend for two weeks to decide whether the epidemic period has ended, potentially by month end if declines hold. During World AMR Awareness Week, the CDC urged not to misuse antibiotics: do not ask for them, do not purchase without prescription, do not take others’ antibiotics, and complete prescribed courses, while informing providers about supplements or traditional medicines.

triage.headline_ja: 気温変化が疾病リスクを高める可能性：疾病管理センター（台湾CDC）
triage.triage_reason: 台湾CDCによる季節性インフルエンザの定例サーベイランス報告であり、H1N1優勢という通常の季節性パターンを示すのみで、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾における季節性インフルエンザの定例サーベイランス報告。中国本土（一部地域）でもインフルエンザ活動の上昇が言及されているため対象国として記載したが、台湾自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。重症例・死亡例の報告はあるが、季節性インフルエンザとして想定内の範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: പക്ഷിപ്പനി; മുന്നറിയിപ്പുമായി ആരോഗ്യ വകുപ്പ്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza; Health Department issues warning.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) warning issued for Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India. Health Department states transmission from infected birds to humans is relatively low but possible; human infections can cause severe illness and death. Those in contact with affected or dead birds should exercise strict precautions and seek medical care if symptoms appear. Symptoms in humans include fever, diarrhea, sore throat, severe body aches, shortness of breath, coughing up blood, and severe pneumonia. Do not self-medicate; report to nearest health facility. Hospitals and the public should wear masks and follow respiratory infection precautions. Prevention includes avoiding direct contact with birds, protecting hands after contact with secretions, avoiding raw poultry products from affected areas, and ensuring meat and eggs are fully cooked. Officials handling culling must use PPE (N-95 masks, gloves, face shields, boots) and dispose safely. Exposed individuals may receive seven days of oseltamivir; exposure details should be recorded and monitored.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ；保健局が警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケララ州で鳥インフルエンザに関する予防的警告が発令されているが、実際のヒト感染確定例や死亡例の報告は記事内に明記されておらず、情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は保健当局による予防啓発・注意喚起であり、具体的な人感染症例数や死亡者数の報告は含まれていない。続報で実際の感染確定例が報告されるか注視が必要。
