article.articleHeadline: keralam | ಆಲಪ್ಪುಝದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಕ್ಕಿಜ್ವರ ದೃಢ: ಕೋಳಿಗಳ ಸಾಮೂಹಿಕ ಹತ್ಯೆಗೆ ಆದೇಶ‌ | Bird flu confirmed in Alappuzha, Kerala; mass culling of chickens ordered.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu confirmed in Alappuzha, Kerala; an order for the mass culling of chickens.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, bird flu (avian influenza) confirmed in two poultry farms in Alappuzha district, Kerala, prompting authorities to cull about 26,000 chickens to curb spread. Samples from the infected farms were sent to the National Veterinary Diagnostic Laboratory in Bhopal for confirmation, with avian influenza testing returning positive. Concurrently, a poultry farm in a neighboring district of Tamil Nadu reported H5N1 infection, triggering enhanced surveillance and stricter controls, with several thousand chickens already culled. Earlier reports indicate Japan’s Chiba region also confirmed highly pathogenic avian influenza in a farm with around 40,000 chickens. The developments underline ongoing regional outbreaks and rapid response measures, including planned culling in Kerala starting Wednesday.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州アラプーザで鳥インフルエンザ確定、鶏の大量殺処分命令
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザ(H5N1)がインド複数州(ケララ、タミル・ナードゥ)の養鶏場で確認され拡大傾向にあるが、現時点で人への感染報告はなく、公衆衛生への直接的影響は確認されていないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽でのH5N1感染に関するもので、ヒトへの感染報告はない。インド複数州（ケララ、タミル・ナードゥ、マディヤ・プラデーシュ）で発生しており、地域的拡大の可能性があるため経過観察が必要。日本（千葉県）での発生も言及されているが対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ആലപ്പുഴയില്‍ പക്ഷിപ്പനി; കോഴി, താറാവ്, മുട്ട, ഇറച്ചി വില്‍പ്പനയ്ക്ക് ഒരാഴ്ച നിരോധനം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu in Alappuzha; one-week ban on the sale of chicken, duck, eggs, and meat.
article.articleSummary: As of November 17, 2026, avian influenza (bird flu) has been confirmed in Alappuzha district, Kerala. In response, the district administration imposed a one-week ban on selling and transporting live poultry (chickens, ducks), eggs, meat, and related products within a 10-km radius of outbreak centers. Restrictions cover Alappuzha urban local bodies and numerous panchayats in Alappuzha and Pathanamthitta districts, with Haripad and Mavelikkara municipalities excluded; the last four panchayats are in Pathanamthitta. Culling of affected poultry is ongoing, particularly within 1 km of outbreak centers, and after culling is completed, poultry farming will be banned for three months in those zones. Public vigilance is urged due to the risk of zoonotic transmission from avian influenza.

triage.headline_ja: アラプーザで鳥インフルエンザ確認；鶏肉・アヒル肉・卵・食肉の販売を1週間禁止
triage.triage_reason: 家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生で行政が防疫措置を実施しているが、ヒトへの感染は確認されておらず、人獣共通感染リスクへの注意喚起にとどまるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生と行政の防疫対応（移動・販売制限、殺処分、3ヶ月間の養鶏禁止）について述べており、ヒト感染例の報告はない。人獣共通感染症としてのリスクに対する注意喚起が記載されているのみで、現時点ではヒトへの感染拡大の証拠はない。

article.articleHeadline: Com alta de casos no Brasil, Sesau de Campo Grande alerta: 'Covid-19 nunca deixou de circular'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As Brazil sees a surge in cases, Campo Grande's Sesau warns: 'COVID-19 has never stopped circulating'.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 continues circulating in Brazil, with Mato Grosso do Sul reporting 63 severe cases and 12 deaths this year, and Campo Grande recording 22 cases and five deaths. The surge is linked to the SARS-CoV-2 variant XFG. Despite this, Mato Grosso do Sul is the only Center-South state with a projected case decline per the Ministry of Health, though upticks can occur. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, fatigue, body aches, and headaches; XFG may cause hoarseness and has fewer reports of loss of smell or taste. Seek a Family Health Unit for mild symptoms, or an Emergency Care Unit if shortness of breath or condition worsens. Prevention: hand hygiene, ventilated spaces, and masking in health settings. MS will receive 18,000 extra vaccine doses; monovalent: two doses 84.75%, three 51.12%, four 17.41%; bivalent: one dose 15.84%. MS has 241,411 doses in 2026, below national average.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでの感染拡大を受け、カンポグランデ保健局が警告：『COVID-19は流行を止めていない』
triage.triage_reason: 既知のCOVID-19変異株（XFG）による季節的な感染増加であり、ブラジル国内の一地域に限定された通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内で、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、XFG変異株による季節的な感染増加が報告されているが、ワクチン供給など通常の保健行政対応で管理されている。新規性や異常性は認められず、国際的な懸念事項には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Rekordno širenje ebole: Ovo su ključni uzroci
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unprecedented spread of Ebola: These are the key causes.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has spiraled beyond control six months after declaration, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. Despite aid inflows, resource shortages, insecurity, and poor coordination hinder containment, making this the second-largest Ebola epidemic on record. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, more than 11,000 people have been infected and over 5,500 have died. The WHO notes case and death counts rising faster than during West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak, which infected more than 28,600 and killed over 11,000 across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. This is DR Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, far exceeding the 2018–2020 peak (3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths). Attacks on health workers and distrust hinder response; MSF warns critical supplies have not reached outbreaks beyond Ituri. Kinshasa acknowledges issues; about $2.9 billion pledged, but less than half disbursed, with calls for donor coordination.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の記録的拡大：その主要な原因とは
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で発生中のエボラ出血熱が史上2番目の規模（感染者11,000人超、死者5,500人超）に達し、封じ込めが失敗している深刻な公衆衛生危機であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事中のギニア、リベリア、シエラレオネ、アンゴラへの言及は2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較のための過去事例であり、現在の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。現在の流行は主にイトゥリ州を含むコンゴ民主共和国東部で進行中。

article.articleHeadline: الإيبولا يحصد 5500 وفاة في الكونجو ويصيب 11 ألف شخص
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola claims 5,500 lives in the Congo and infects 11,000 people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues six months after its May declaration, with 11,376 confirmed infections and 5,568 deaths, and about 3,083 recoveries as of 14 November. The second-largest Ebola outbreak globally, this episode has spread to 67 health zones across eight provinces, generating 400–500 new infections weekly. Children comprise over a quarter of cases and about one-third of fatalities, with seven of ten deaths among children under five infected. Despite progress, including expanding laboratories from 2 to 24 and roughly 3,000 recoveries, security challenges and community distrust hinder response; armed attacks last week in Kantine Alouya region killed 66 civilians, including three health workers, and damaged three medical facilities, disrupting contact tracing. About $2.9 billion has been pledged for the response, but less than half has reached implementers. This is the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in DRC and exceeds 2018–2020 outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴで死者5500人・感染者11000人に達する
triage.triage_reason: DRCで6ヶ月以上続く大規模エボラ流行（感染11,376人、死亡5,568人）で、史上2番目の規模に達し、武装勢力の攻撃により対応が妨げられるなど深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本流行はDRCで17回目のエボラ流行であり、2018-2020年の流行を上回る規模。武装勢力による攻撃で接触者追跡が妨げられ、約29億ドルの支援表明のうち半分未満しか実施機関に届いていない点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Maior parte do estado tem risco moderado ou está em alerta para transmissão de arboviroses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Most of the state is at moderate risk or is on alert for arboviral transmission.
article.articleSummary: Pernambuco, Brazil, reports 102 of 184 municipalities in alert for arboviral transmission, with 57% at alert or moderate risk per the 5th Rapid Indices for Aedes aegypti (LIRAa) covering Jan 1–Nov 7, 2026, including Fernando de Noronha. Sixty-two municipalities are satisfactory/low risk; 16 are high risk or outbreak potential (8.7%), with data missing for two. Dengue accounts for 54,363 suspected cases; 13,480 confirmed; 741 severe; 16 deaths under investigation and 7 confirmed, a 29.6% rise vs last year. Chikungunya shows 7,816 notified cases with 447 confirmed; 72% of cases among racial 'pardo' individuals, 12.6% among whites, predominantly affecting ages 0–4. Zika records 1,432 notified cases; none confirmed, a 12.9% decrease from last year; 68.2% pardo and 20.9% white, mostly 0–4 years. Precautions focus on eliminating Aedes breeding sites and masking symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 州の大部分が中等度リスクまたはアルボウイルス感染警戒レベルにある
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ペルナンブコ州における例年のデング熱・チクングニア・ジカ熱サーベイランス報告であり、季節的な増加傾向は見られるが国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、地方紙報道にとどまるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱の症例・死亡数は前年比増加しているが、ブラジルでは毎年繰り返される風土病的な季節性流行であり、異常性は低いと判断。州保健当局による定例のLIRAa(迅速指標)サーベイランスに基づく報告。

article.articleHeadline: مخاوف إيبولا تدفع "باريك" الكندية لإبعاد بعض العاملين عن منجمها للذهب في الكونغو الديمقراطية - بوابة الأهرام
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fears push Canadian Barrick to keep some workers away from its gold mine in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Al-Ahram Portal
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola cases confirmed near Kibali gold mine in Haut-Uele, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo prompted Barrick Gold to temporarily pull nonessential workers and tighten health screenings; both patients died. Contact tracing with health authorities and WHO found no exposure among Barrick staff or contractors; mine operations continue normally. Kibali, one of Africa’s largest gold mines, is 45% owned by Barrick and 45% by AngloGold Ashanti, with 10% held by the state miner Sokimo. The current outbreak in eastern DRC, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has surpassed 11,000 infections and 5,500 deaths since May, marking the seventh major outbreak in the country and among the largest globally, outpacing the 2018–2020 West Africa outbreak. Containment faces security deterioration, resource shortages, and mistrust; MSF notes insufficient supplies outside Ituri; health-worker strikes over pay are reported. No cases yet in industrial mines; artisanal mining activities are affected.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ懸念でカナダのバリック社がコンゴ民主共和国の金鉱山から一部作業員を退避
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは感染11,000人超、死亡5,500人超に達する過去最大級の流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際企業の操業対応など社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部（Haut-Uele州Kibali金鉱山周辺）でのエボラ症例に関するもの。発生地域リストにAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文で言及されていないため除外した。既存の大規模アウトブレイク（Bundibugyo ebolavirus、5月以降7回目の主要流行）の継続報道であり、既に危機的状況にあるため継続的な監視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: After surviving Ebola, DR Congo doctors renew vow to fight the disease
article.articleSummary: DR Congo faces a Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak spanning eight provinces six months after the May 15 declaration. As of Nov 14, 11,376 confirmed cases and 5,568 deaths nationwide, with 68 health zones affected. North Kivu reports 2,860 infections and 1,590 deaths (CFR 55.6%). Frontline health workers have suffered heavily—over 150 infected in North Kivu, including nine doctors (four deaths)—amid PPE shortages. In Beni, doctor Kinzi Divin was Ebola-free after 24 days in isolation, having contracted the disease at work and vowing to continue fighting. In Mabalako, nurse Muhindo Mbafumoja Shukuru was infected through direct patient contact; symptoms began with headaches, chills, fever and were laboratory-confirmed. The outbreak continues to strain the health system and keep PPE and frontline protection as critical needs.

triage.headline_ja: エボラを生き延びたコンゴ民主共和国の医師たちが病気との闘いを再び誓う
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyo型エボラが8州に拡大し、11,376症例・5,568死亡（致死率高）、医療従事者にも多数感染が発生しておりIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内（特に北キブ州・マバラコ）での大規模エボラ流行と医療従事者の感染・PPE不足に焦点を当てている。国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する直接的記載はないが、致死率55.6%、8州にわたる拡大から既にWHO通知相当の深刻な公衆衛生事象と判断。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Η ιλαρά επιστρέφει δυναμικά στις ΗΠΑ - Ρεκόρ κρουσμάτων και θανάτων
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles are making a strong comeback in the United States — record numbers of cases and deaths.
article.articleSummary: Measles resurgence in the United States with PAHO reporting uninterrupted transmission of the same measles lineage for more than 12 months. In 2026, U.S. measles cases total 5,400 with 10 deaths—the highest annual tally since 1991. A Pennsylvania outbreak accounts for over 1,400 cases and seven deaths. Nationwide MMR vaccination coverage is 92.4%, below the 95% herd-immunity threshold. The two-dose MMR schedule (ages 1–6) is about 97% effective. Mexico and Bolivia have also lost measles elimination status; Canada has reduced transmission this year. Europe and Eurasia saw elimination status lost earlier in 2026 in the United Kingdom, Spain, Austria, Russia, Azerbaijan, and Uzbekistan. Public health authorities call for corrective actions to raise vaccination uptake amid persistent vaccine misinformation and political controversies surrounding immunization policies.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹が米国で勢いを増して再流行 - 症例数・死亡数が記録的水準に
triage.triage_reason: 米国・メキシコ・ボリビア・欧州/ユーラシア地域での麻疹再流行に関する記事であり、監視対象国（タイ等）は発生地域リストに含まれるものの記事本文・サマリーでは言及されておらず、対象国における実際の発生は確認できないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にタイ（バンコク含む）が含まれているが、記事サマリー・見出しには米国・メキシコ・ボリビア・英国・スペイン・オーストリア・ロシア・アゼルバイジャン・ウズベキスタン・カナダのみが言及されており、タイを含む監視対象国での発生は確認されない。これはBluedotのタグ付け誤りの可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: AI, rapid diagnostic devices speed up TB detection
article.articleSummary: TB detection in Chitradurga district, India, is accelerated by AI and chip-based diagnostics and mobile X-ray units, cutting test turnaround from at least two days to about an hour in some cases. AI-enabled tech and portable imaging enable early identification of suspected TB in remote villages, slums, mining zones, stone quarries, industrial sites, and migrant worker settlements; ASHA workers and healthcare staff now have expanded access to modern diagnostics. The district currently treats 1,085 TB patients, with case distribution: Chitradurga taluk 347, Challakere 213, Hiriyur 147, Holalkere 133, Hosadurga 130, Molakalmuru 115. In 2025, 1,900 TB cases were recorded in the district. Officials note that faster diagnosis supports earlier treatment, reduces delays, helps contain transmission, and may lower TB-related deaths; emphasis on regular monitoring and completing therapy to prevent drug resistance. District TB Control Officer Dr Tulasi Ranganath highlighted the impact of technology.

triage.headline_ja: AI・迅速診断機器がTB検出を加速
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策における診断技術改善に関する記事であり、異常事態や新規アウトブレイクではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の診断技術向上（AI・迅速診断・モバイルX線）に関する地域保健当局の取り組みを報じたもので、新規の感染拡大やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。既知の疾患（結核）の日常的な対策報道のため対象国リストへの計上は行わない。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: Secretaria de Saúde confirma 51 casos da doença no Distrito Federal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: Health Department confirms 51 cases of the disease in the Federal District.
article.articleSummary: Mpox outbreak in Brazil’s Federal District (DF) rises to 51 cases, with 45 among DF capital residents; a 15.9% increase from 44 cases reported in the 12 November bulletin. All DF residents affected are men, primarily aged 30–39. On 6 November, the Ministry of Health sent 100 mpox vaccine doses to the DF after SES-DF requested replenishment, the stock having been exhausted. Vaccination is currently prioritized for people living with HIV/AIDS aged 18+ with CD4 counts below 100 cells/mm³ in the last six months; other groups will be added as more doses arrive. Authorities urge vigilance for mpox symptoms, prompt medical evaluation, and isolation to prevent spread. While most recover in a few weeks, mpox can lead to serious complications. Transmission is mainly through direct contact with skin lesions and secretions; suspected cases should seek care and report close contacts with others with suspected or confirmed mpox.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox：保健局がフェデラル・ディストリクトで51例の感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル連邦直轄区における既知のMpox流行の継続的増加（44→51例）であり、新規性・深刻性は限定的だが、HIV陽性者など脆弱層への曝露継続とワクチン供給状況について経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: HIV陽性者（CD4低値）を優先したワクチン接種戦略が取られており、脆弱層への感染拡大リスクが懸念される。ワクチン在庫枯渇後の補充要請があり、供給体制の持続性に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde amplia monitoramento de casos de mpox no RJ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro State Health Department expands monitoring of mpox cases.
article.articleSummary: Mpox in Rio de Janeiro state remains higher than projections, concentrated in the capital. The state has 396 confirmed mpox cases in 2026, second in Brazil, with the year’s first mpox death confirmed in the second half of October. The deceased was 40–49 years old, immunosuppressed, and died at Fiocruz Evandro Chagas National Institute of Infectology. Daily case updates started November 16 by SES-RJ, accessible via Monitora RJ. About 14% of diagnosed patients required hospitalization this year. Transmission occurs through direct contact with skin lesions, body fluids, respiratory secretions, intimate or sexual contact, contaminated objects, and animal exposure. Prevention focuses on avoiding contact with suspected/confirmed cases, hand hygiene, and isolation until lesions heal; vaccination targets priority/risk groups; treatment is mainly supportive, with antivirals for severe cases. Mpox is caused by MPXV, an orthopoxvirus.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州保健局、mpox症例の監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロ州でmpox症例が予測を上回り、死亡例・入院例（14%）が発生し州保健局が日次モニタリングを開始するなど社会的・行政的関心が高まっているため。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため採用。Mpoxは既存のエンデミック傾向のある疾患だが、死亡例・入院率の高さ、州当局による日次モニタリング開始など継続監視すべき状況。国際的拡大やIHR通報相当の情報は記事からは確認できず。

article.articleHeadline: В Кении ввели 21-дневный карантин для прибывающих из ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya imposes a 21-day quarantine on travelers arriving from DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Kenya imposes a 21-day mandatory quarantine for all travelers arriving from the Democratic Republic of Congo amid an ongoing Ebola outbreak that began May 15 in DRC and Uganda. As of 17 November 2026, Kenya has nine laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases with two fatalities; the first importation into Kenya was detected 6 October in a Kenyan national living in DRC. Entry points, including airports, have zones with medical screening; symptomatic individuals or those with known contact are moved to medical isolation, while arrivals with no symptoms or contacts are quarantined at home under medical supervision. Ebola incubation ranges 2–21 days. Since 12 November, Kenya is under a 42-day surveillance period; if no new cases emerge, the country could be officially declared Ebola-free on 23 December 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、コンゴ民主共和国からの入国者に21日間の検疫を導入
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダで発生したエボラ出血熱がケニアに越境伝播し、死亡例を伴う確定症例が複数報告され、ケニアが渡航制限的措置（21日間検疫）を導入している。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアの検疫措置だが、感染源はDRC（およびウガンダ）であり、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・ケニアはリスト対象外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: México, Bolivia y EE.UU. dejan de ser países libres de sarampión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico, Bolivia and the United States cease to be measles-free countries.
article.articleSummary: On November 17, 2026, the Pan American Health Organization withdrew measles-free status from Mexico, Bolivia, and the United States due to sustained transmission in under-vaccinated communities. The Regional Commission on measles, rubella, and congenital rubella syndrome met November 10–13 to assess progress. In Mexico, cases persist despite a downward trend since February, with over 20,000 confirmed infections and about 50 deaths in 2025–2026. Bolivia cut cases by 83% this year (from 444 to 76) but transmission continues. The United States tallied 5,412 measles cases across 47 jurisdictions year-to-date, more than double 2025’s 2,289 and above long-term norms. Canada had lost measles-free status in 2025 with around 5,100 cases in 12 months. OPS urges vaccination drives in Brazil, Colombia, Guatemala, Honduras, and Peru to reach the 95% two-dose coverage and prevent outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ボリビア、米国が麻疹排除国の地位を失う
triage.triage_reason: PAHOがメキシコ・ボリビア・米国の麻疹排除国認定を取り消すという異例の公衆衛生上の事態であり、死亡例や数千件規模の感染拡大、地域全体でのワクチン接種率低下という複数国にまたがる重大な公衆衛生イベントであるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はメキシコ・ボリビア・米国（およびカナダ）の麻疹排除国地位喪失であり、ブラジル・コロンビア・グアテマラ・ホンジュラス・ペルーはワクチン接種キャンペーン推奨対象として言及されているのみで、発生の主題国ではないため対象国リストに該当する国は検証対象から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Rio Grande do Sul registra queda nos casos de mpox, mas mantém alerta diante do avanço da doença no país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Grande do Sul reports a decline in mpox cases, but remains vigilant amid the disease's spread across the country.
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Sul reports 15 mpox cases from Jan 1 to Nov 16, 2026, a 25% drop from 20 in the same period in 2025. Two recent cases have no travel history and no confirmed contact with individuals from another state, raising the possibility of local transmission within RS. Most 2026 infections were acquired outside RS. Nationally, São Paulo has 409 cases and Rio de Janeiro 395 by Nov 16, 2026, with Brazil totaling 1,099. RS has identified only clade IIb (2022 outbreak) in sequenced samples; results for recent samples are pending. In Rio de Janeiro, a possible new clade Ib variant may contribute to rising cases. Diagnosis and isolation remain crucial; most patients do not require hospitalization and may isolate at home with follow-up, with vigilance ahead of summer and Carnival.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデドスルで新型痘（mpox）症例が減少するも、国内での感染拡大を受けて警戒を継続
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロで新たなclade Ib variantの可能性が示唆され、州内での渡航歴のない局地感染も報告されており、WPRO基準（異常性・持続曝露・流行性）を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: リオデジャネイロでのclade Ib variant疑いは国際的に懸念される株（アフリカ由来のより重症型）であり、確定結果待ちのため続報確認が必要。州内渡航歴なしの局地感染例も注視対象。

article.articleHeadline: ആലപ്പുഴയിൽ പക്ഷിപ്പനി സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു. നിരീക്ഷണ മേഖലയിൽ ഒരാഴ്ചത്തേക്ക് കോഴി, താറാവ്, മുട്ട, ഇറച്ചി വിൽപ്പനയ്ക്ക് നിരോധനം. രോഗപ്രഭവ കേന്ദ്രങ്ങളുടെ ഒരു കിലോമീറ്റർ ചുറ്റളവിൽ മൂന്ന് മാസത്തേക്ക് പക്ഷിവളർത്തലിനും വിലക്ക്. മനുഷ്യരിലേക്കും പകരാൻ സാധ്യതയുള്ളതിനാൽ കനത്ത ജാഗ്രത പാലിക്കണമെന്ന് ആരോഗ്യവകുപ്പ്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza confirmed in Alappuzha. In the surveillance zone, sale of chicken, turkey, eggs and meat prohibited for one week. Poultry farming banned within a one-kilometer radius of outbreak centers for three months. The Health Department urged strict vigilance due to the potential for transmission to humans.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza confirmed in Alappuzha district, Kerala. A 10-km surveillance zone around outbreak centers bans the sale and movement of poultry (including chicken and turkey), eggs, and meat for one week. Within a 1-km radius, culling of birds will be completed before imposing a three-month ban on poultry farming. Restrictions cover Alappuzha municipality wards (13 wards) and the Harippad and Mavelikkara municipalities, with additional coverage across numerous panchayats in Alappuzha and Pathanamthitta districts. Health authorities urge public and trader cooperation and strict vigilance. Officials engaged in culling will use PPE (N-95 masks, gloves, face shields, boots) with safe disposal of carcasses. People exposed to infected or dead birds should seek prompt medical care if symptoms develop. Symptoms include fever, body pains, cough, diarrhea, sore throat, shortness of breath, and blood-tinged sputum. Oseltamivir prophylaxis for seven days is advised under medical supervision.

triage.headline_ja: アラプーザで鳥インフルエンザ確認。監視区域内で1週間、鶏・アヒル・卵・肉の販売を禁止。発生地点から半径1kmでは3か月間の養鶏禁止。ヒトへの感染可能性もあることから衛生当局が厳重警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生が確認され当局が防疫措置を実施しているが、現時点でヒト感染例の報告はなく、情報は家禽対策が中心であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ヒト感染例の報告はなく家禽における発生と防疫措置が中心。衛生当局はヒトへの感染可能性に言及し、曝露者へのオセルタミビル予防投与を推奨している。ヒト症例発生の続報に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Afrique: Unitaid - 25 millions $ pour renforcer la prise en charge de la tuberculose et de l'hépatite C
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: Unitaid – $25 million to strengthen tuberculosis and hepatitis C care.
article.articleSummary: Unitaid launches a $25 million funding call to expand integrated, person-centered tuberculosis and hepatitis C care in high-transmission and vulnerable settings across Africa, with emphasis on prisons and other detention sites, overcrowded communities, migrants, refugees or displaced persons, people who inject drugs, minors, and mining communities. Proposals should demonstrate integrated services that cover screening, diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up within existing health platforms, aiming to reduce service fragmentation and stigma while enabling scalable, affordable models. Projects must produce evidence on implementation, cost-effectiveness, and budget impact, and provide governments with a clear roadmap for adoption and sustainability amid global health funding constraints. Eligible applicants are organizations based in low- or middle-income countries, preferably in countries where projects will be implemented (e.g., Nigeria, South Africa, Kenya, Ethiopia, Bangladesh, Pakistan, India, Brazil), though others or regional approaches are welcome. Deadline for full proposals: March 1, 2027, 12:00 CET.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：Unitaid – 結核とC型肝炎のケア強化のために2,500万ドル
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はUnitaidによる結核・C型肝炎対策の資金提供公募に関する発表であり、具体的な感染症の発生・流行イベントではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は資金提供公募の案内であり、特定の国での結核・C型肝炎の発生状況やアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。インド・ブラジル等は対象国リストの例示として挙げられているに過ぎず、実際の発生報告ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: En RDC, les femmes sont "en première ligne" face à Ebola, alerte l'Onu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, women are "on the front line" against Ebola, UN warns.
article.articleSummary: UN Women warns that Ebola is feminizing the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Six months after the May 15 declaration of the 17th Ebola outbreak, women accounted for 54% of cases in September, reflecting greater exposure through caregiving and frontline health work. Crises also disrupt maternal health services and raise gender-based violence risks. On November 17, UN Women and the Ministry of Health, with partners in Kinshasa, organized a meeting with the private sector to strengthen partnerships and mobilize concrete support for affected communities. Catherine Obimba, UN Women Deputy Representative in the DRC, stresses accountability: all actors must ensure women's protection, participation, and leadership in the response. The strategy aims to reverse feminization and interrupt transmission by broadening engagement with media, women's groups, ministries, youth, and other sectors.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で、女性がエボラ対応の「最前線」に立っていると国連が警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行（5月15日宣言）に関する継続的な公衆衛生上の懸念であり、重症度・国際的な支援必要性・社会的関心が高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存の第17次エボラ流行（DRC、5月15日宣言）における女性への影響拡大を報じるもの。流行自体は既知だが、ジェンダー視点での悪化・対応強化の必要性が強調されており、継続的な注視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: SC altera restrições após focos de doença de Newcastle - 17/11/2026 - Agro - C-Level
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Catarina changes restrictions after Newcastle disease outbreaks - Nov 17, 2026 - Agriculture - C-Level.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreaks in Santa Catarina, Brazil led to a 60-day zoosanitary emergency after five foci were detected in Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim. The first focus on Oct 18 at a turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba prompted culling of about 6,000 birds. Additional foci followed Oct 24 (Coronel Freitas), Oct 27 and Nov 3 (Nova Erechim), and Nov 7 (Nova Itaberaba). Sanitary barriers were removed on Nov 11 after cleaning at the Nova Itaberaba site; 251 farms within 10 km and roughly 3,600 nearby properties were inspected. In total, more than 47,000 birds were sacrificed. The disease is a viral avian infection with respiratory, digestive, and nervous signs. Human infection is rare and requires exposure; properly cooked chicken and eggs are safe. Export restrictions on Brazilian poultry were lifted on Nov 7 and then narrowed to Santa Catarina farms.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州、ニューカッスル病発生後に規制緩和 - 2026年11月17日 - 農業 - C-Level
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州での家禽ニューカッスル病の発生であり、既に防疫措置が完了し規制が緩和されている段階。ヒトへの感染リスクは稀であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は見られない。
triage.notes: 家禽の動物疾患であり、ヒトへの感染は稀とされている。既に防疫対応（殺処分・消毒・検査）が完了し、輸出制限も緩和・縮小されている段階であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 男子为滋补，生吞新鲜蛇胆，大约花生米大小！3个月后抽搐倒地，检查结果让人吓一跳：脑子里长满寄生虫；医生：生蛇胆不是补品
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man swallows fresh raw snake gallbladder for nourishment, about peanut-sized; three months later he convulsed and collapsed; tests revealed his brain was full of parasites; doctor: raw snake gallbladder is not a supplement.
article.articleSummary: A 50-year-old man from Taizhou, Zhejiang, China developed seizures and left-sided weakness after swallowing fresh snake gallbladder as a folk remedy. Three months later he collapsed; brain imaging showed numerous bilateral cerebral lesions and a 1.6 x 1.1 cm cyst in the right temporal lobe with ring-like enhancement, consistent with neurocysticercosis. At Zhejiang University First Affiliated Hospital, clinicians diagnosed brain cysticercosis caused by Taenia spp. eggs acquired from ingesting raw snake gallbladder; snakes can harbor parasites, and consuming their gallbladders can introduce eggs that hatch and migrate to the brain, forming cysts and triggering seizures, hemiparesis, and other deficits. The patient’s seizures were controlled with antiparasitic therapy, he regained limb function, and was discharged, but will require ongoing medication and regular follow-up. Doctors warn that raw snake gallbladder is not a supplement and advise against wildlife-based folk remedies to prevent serious outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 男性が滋養のため新鮮な蛇の胆のうを生で飲み込む、落花生大、3か月後にけいれんし倒れる：検査結果は脳内に寄生虫が充満していたことが判明；医師：生の蛇胆は滋養強壮剤ではない
triage.triage_reason: 個人の民間療法（生の蛇胆摂取）による単発の嚢虫症（脳嚢虫症）症例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や公衆衛生上の拡大リスクはなく、公衆衛生危機とは言えない。
triage.notes: 個人の食習慣（生の蛇の胆のう摂取）による単発の寄生虫症例であり、人から人への感染経路はなく、感染症アウトブレイクには該当しない。民間療法に関する健康啓発的な内容。

article.articleHeadline: Covid: variante PJ.2.1 aumenta no Brasil e entra no radar de vacinas da OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: PJ.2.1 variant on the rise in Brazil and enters the WHO's vaccine radar.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1, a SARS-CoV-2 lineage, is rising in Brazil and has been added by the WHO to data requests for evaluating vaccine composition ahead of a December vaccine guidance meeting. In Brazil, the Ministry of Health reports a six-week upward trend in COVID-19 notifications. As of the week ending 7 November 2026, 118,920 COVID-19–related influenza-like illness (ILI) notifications were recorded for 2026, with growth across 17 states and the Federal District; hospitalizations remain low, though increases are seen for severe acute respiratory syndrome due to COVID-19 in parts of the Center-South and Bahia. PJ.2.1 was first identified in Canada in May 2026, later detected in the United States and elsewhere. A Journal of Infection study (Oct 24) found higher ACE2 binding; the variant was neutralized by antibodies from an LP.8.1-adapted mRNA vaccine, with no strong immune escape in lab tests. The WHO seeks data on neutralization, durability, and protection against infection, symptoms, and severe disease.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19:PJ.2.1変異株がブラジルで増加、WHOのワクチン検討対象に
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1がブラジルで増加傾向にあり、WHOがワクチン組成評価のためデータ収集を行っているが、重症度や免疫逃避は現時点で顕著でなく、入院数も低水準のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 米国・カナダは変異株の初期検出地として記載されているが、記事の主題はブラジルでの増加。対象国リストに米国・カナダは含まれないため除外。実験室レベルでは強い免疫逃避は確認されておらず、重症度上昇の明確なエビデンスはない。

article.articleHeadline: भोपाल में तैयार हुई देश की पहली स्वदेशी बर्ड फ्लू वैक्सीन, 20 नवंबर को शिवराज सिंह चौहान करेंगे लॉन्च
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India's first domestically produced avian influenza vaccine developed in Bhopal, to be launched by Shivraj Singh Chouhan on November 20.
article.articleSummary: India’s first domestically produced highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) vaccine has been developed at the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal to combat H5N1, clade 2.3.2.1a. It will be launched on 20 November by Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan. The vaccine aims to protect chickens from HPAI and is expected to bolster human health safety by preventing zoonotic transmission, given that avian influenza can reach humans. It will help control outbreaks and reduce economic losses in the poultry industry by limiting culling. The institute had previously developed a low-pathogenic vaccine; the new vaccine broadens protection and may reduce reliance on imported vaccines. This domestic capability strengthens national biosecurity and supports export-ready poultry supply chains.

triage.headline_ja: ボパールでインド初の国産鳥インフルエンザワクチンが開発、11月20日にシブラージ・シン・チョウハン氏がローンチ
triage.triage_reason: 記事は鳥インフルエンザワクチンの開発・発表に関するもので、実際の感染拡大や新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は家禽向けHPAIワクチンの開発・ローンチに関する科学・産業ニュースであり、実際のヒトまたは動物における新規感染拡大事例を報告するものではない。政府関係者（連邦大臣）のローンチイベントのため行政的関心はあるが、公衆衛生上の緊急シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ouro Preto determina suspensão de aulas por sete dias em turmas com casos confirmados de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ouro Preto orders seven-day suspension of classes in classes with confirmed cases of human scabies.
article.articleSummary: Ouro Preto's Municipal Education Department ordered seven-day suspensions for classrooms with confirmed human scabies, following notices to municipal schools. The measure, prepared with the Health Department, Vigilance in Health, Occupational Health, and HR, applies only to affected rooms; other classes may continue in-person activities for students and staff without symptoms. If new cases arise, the principal must notify Education and Health Surveillance to reassess suspensions. For staff, asymptomatic workers may stay at work; those with intense itching or skin lesions should seek medical evaluation. Confirmed cases require 24 hours of leave after starting treatment. Suspected or confirmed cases must be reported to Vigilance in Health. Hygiene measures include cleaning, sealing linens in plastic bags, washing fabrics in hot water and ironing, and three-to-seven day containment for non-washable toys. A seven-day action plan deadline is required.

triage.headline_ja: オウロ・プレト市、人疥癬症の確定例が出たクラスで7日間の休校を決定
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上重篤性が低く、局所的な学校対応にとどまり、国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限のリスクは認められないため見送り。
triage.notes: 疥癬は軽症で局所管理可能な皮膚疾患であり、学校単位での対応にとどまっている。地域の衛生当局が主体的に対応しており外部支援の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Кения ввела карантин для прибывающих из ДРК из-за вспышки Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya has imposed a quarantine on arrivals from DR Congo due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Kenya has imposed a 21-day mandatory quarantine for all individuals entering from the Democratic Republic of Congo amid an ongoing Ebola outbreak there. Health Minister Aiden Duale said the measure aims to protect Kenya and applies to both Kenyan citizens and foreigners. At entry points, including airports, Kenya has established dedicated zones for arrivals from the DRC, with passport control and medical screening. Symptomatic travelers or those who have had contact with Ebola cases are directed to isolation facilities; asymptomatic arrivals are quarantined at home under medical supervision. Reports cited a regional outbreak: in DR Congo, Ebola fatalities surpassed 5,500 since May, with confirmed cases around 10,990 as of the prior week; authorities in DR Congo reportedly discharged the last recovered patient from hospital on a recent Thursday, as of 2026-11-17.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアがエボラ出血熱の流行によりコンゴ民主共和国からの入国者に検疫を導入
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱流行は死者5,500人超、感染者約11,000人という大規模な公衆衛生危機であり、ケニアが越境検疫措置を導入するなど国際的拡大・渡航制限の懸念が明確であるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ケニアは検疫措置を導入した対応国であり、感染発生国ではないため対象国リストに含まれる地域としてはDRCのみを記載。ケニアはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue aumentam 162% no Maranhão
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases rise 162% in Maranhão
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Maranhão rise 162.5% in 2026. Up to Epidemiological Week 43, the state recorded 9,159 confirmed dengue cases, versus 3,489 in the same period in 2025 (approx. 162.5% increase). Ten dengue deaths have been confirmed across Benedito Leite, Chapadinha, Loreto, Pindaré-Mirim, São Bento, São Luís and Grajaú, with six more deaths under investigation. In 2025, three dengue deaths were confirmed, all in the capital São Luís. The surge underscores transmission across urban centers and municipalities with high incidence. High-incidence locations include Benedito Leite, Riachão, Lago Verde, Pedreiras, Pindaré-Mirim, Loreto, São Bento, Chapadinha, Grajaú, Balsas and Pinheiro, among others. SES-MA urges heightened surveillance and targeted public health responses in areas with the highest burden and in densely populated cities.

triage.headline_ja: マラニョン州でデング熱症例が162%増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マラニョン州でデング熱症例が前年比162%増と大幅増加し、死者も発生しているが、デング熱は同地域で流行性が既知の疾患であり国際的拡大リスクは限定的。対象国リストに含まれないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・マラニョン州のデング熱症例急増を扱っており、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）のうちBrazilが地理情報に含まれるが、Brazilは対象国リストに含まれているため確認：Brazilは対象国リストにID 3469034として含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Guaíba é obrigada a garantir tratamento para esporotricose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guaíba City Hall must ensure treatment for sporotrichosis.
article.articleSummary: Sporotrichosis outbreak in Guaíba prompts medical-legal response. The fungus is transmitted from cats to humans; more than 300 cats diagnosed and 25 human cases reported this year. Following the 2024 floods that left many animals abandoned, authorities conducted 530 tests in felines, with 319 positives. A judicial order requires the City Hall to provide free medications and to present an emergency plan within 30 days to curb the outbreak, including expanding the veterinary team, securing medicines and equipment, and creating new spaces at the municipal kennel. The SOS Gatos da Colônia institute reports ongoing rescue difficulties due to infrastructure gaps but continues treating critically ill cats. The court demands permanent public health policies and deployment of endemic disease control agents. Residents are urged to seek prompt treatment if symptoms appear, as sporotrichosis is treatable and curable.

triage.headline_ja: グアイーバ市役所、スポロトリコーシスの治療保証を義務付けられる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部の一地域（Guaíba市）における猫由来真菌症（スポロトリコーシス）のアウトブレイクで、治療可能・治癒可能な疾患であり国際的拡大リスクは低いが、2024年洪水後の動物放置を背景に継続的な曝露リスクがあり地域の公衆衛生対応が注視される。
triage.notes: 人獣共通感染症（猫→ヒト）で、ヒト-ヒト感染はない。地域自治体レベルの司法命令による対応強化が主眼であり、国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態には該当しない。地域内の動物由来感染対策の進捗を継続観察する価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. loses measles elimination status year after deadly Texas outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-17, the Pan American Health Organization announces the United States no longer meets measles elimination status, with endemic transmission reestablished in the U.S., Mexico and Bolivia after a year of continuous measles spread. The U.S. first achieved elimination in 2000; ongoing vulnerability stems from falling vaccination rates since the COVID-19 pandemic. A severe Texas outbreak in 2025 saw over 750 measles cases and two deaths in young girls. In 2024-2025, more than half of Texas school districts reported MMR coverage below the 95% threshold for herd immunity. Measles is extremely contagious; one case can infect up to 18 others and can cause pneumonia, blindness, death, immune suppression, and rare neurological diseases. PAHO urges urgent action to close immunity gaps, sustain at least 95% two-dose vaccination, and improve outbreak response; Venezuela and Brazil previously lost elimination status but regained it by 2024.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、テキサス州での致死的はしか流行から1年後にはしか排除状態を喪失
triage.triage_reason: IHR/WPRO基準は複数該当するが、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン等）に該当する国が記事主題に含まれておらず、米国・メキシコ・ボリビアのみが対象であるため本モニタリング範囲外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はPAHOによる米国・メキシコ・ボリビアでのはしか排除状態喪失に関する内容。ブラジルは過去に排除状態を喪失したが2024年に回復したと言及されているのみで、現在の主題ではないため除外。対象国リストに該当する国が存在しないため、グローバルな公衆衛生上の重要性にもかかわらずDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Six mois après l'apparition d'Ebola en RDC, l'accès aux populations isolées reste un défi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six months after the appearance of Ebola in the DRC, access to isolated populations remains a challenge.
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC, the situation remains precarious despite progress. The epidemic spans 67 health zones across eight provinces, with 400–500 new weekly cases. Since onset, more than 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths have been reported. Children account for over a quarter of confirmed cases and about a third of deaths; among under‑fives, seven in ten die. Diagnostics have expanded from two to over twenty laboratories; about 2,000 beds are available in 104 treatment/transit centers. Nearly 2,000 survivors have been identified, with a quarter in survivor programs. Over 17,000 community health workers and 46,000 community actors have been trained. Insecurity drives over 80 attacks on health services, including Cantine-Aloya (66 civilian deaths; three health workers). About 1,000 contacts are untraceable; three cases missing. UN agencies and Africa CDC call for ceasefires and funding through 2027 to reach isolated communities and end the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱発生から6か月、孤立した住民へのアクセスは依然として課題
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は8州67保健地区に拡大し、1万1千件超の症例・5400人超の死亡を記録。治安悪化によるアクセス制限と国際支援の必要性が明確であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中アウトブレイクの6か月時点の進捗報告。新規症例は週400-500件と依然として高水準であり、治安問題（医療施設への80件超の攻撃）がアクセスと対応を阻害している。UN機関・Africa CDCが2027年までの資金拠出と停戦を要請しており、国際的な関与が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: ആലപ്പുഴയില്‍ പക്ഷിപ്പനി സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു; നിരീക്ഷണ മേഖലകളില്‍ കോഴി, താറാവ് വില്‍പ്പനയ്ക്കും കടത്തലിനും ഒരാഴ്ചത്തേക്ക് നിരോധനം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza confirmed in Alappuzha; sale and transport of chicken and turkey banned for one week in surveillance zones.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza has been confirmed in Alappuzha district, Kerala, as of 17 November 2026. In response, the district administration imposed a one-week ban on sale and transport of poultry—including chickens, turkeys, and game birds—and their eggs, meat, viscera, and other products within a 10-kilometer surveillance zone around outbreak centers. The decision was made at an emergency meeting chaired by the District Collector. Culling and sanitation operations in the affected areas will continue during this period. Additionally, within a 1-kilometer radius of outbreak centers, bird culling will proceed, and once completed, poultry farming will be prohibited in the affected zone for the next three months. Primary areas under restrictions: Haripad and Mavelikkara municipalities, and 13 wards of Alappuzha Municipality (Beach, Kuthirappandi, Mullathuvallappu, Thiruvambady, Pazhavil, Pallathuruthy, Vadakkal, Gurumandir, Iravukad, Housing Colony, Kaittavan, Sanathanapuram, Kalarkode).

triage.headline_ja: アラップーザで鳥インフルエンザ確認；監視区域内で鶏・七面鳥の販売・輸送を1週間禁止
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生が確認され行政措置が取られているが、ヒトへの感染報告はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は現時点で不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽(動物)における鳥インフルエンザ発生であり、ヒト感染の報告は記事中に見られない。影響カテゴリも'animals'のみ。地域当局により殺処分・監視区域設定・販売輸送禁止等の対応が進行中。ヒト感染事例が確認された場合は速やかにPICKUPへ格上げすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Rio amplia vacinação contra mpox em meio ao avanço de casos | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio expands mpox vaccination amid rise in cases | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro expands mpox vaccination to include people using pre-exposure HIV prophylaxis (PrEP) who have not yet been vaccinated, requiring a prescription or medical report valid up to six months. Vaccination remains available for people living with HIV (age 18+, CD4 count <200 cells/mm³). Five thousand doses are available while stocks last, administered at five centers: Botafogo Super Center, Shopping Nova América (Del Castilho), ParkShopping Campo Grande, the Dr. Álvaro Aguiar Immunization Center (CEVAA), and Fiocruz Institute’s CRIE/INI center, with hours aligning to site operation. Rio has recorded 297 mpox cases in 2026 and one death in an immunosuppressed patient. State data up to Nov 16 show 396 confirmed cases in Rio de Janeiro, with the city accounting for 71.2% of occurrences. Mpox transmission is mainly via direct contact with lesions and contaminated objects; symptoms include lesions, fever, headache, muscle pain, chills, and enlarged lymph nodes. Vaccination follows two-dose, 28-day interval guidance, not part of routine PNI.

triage.headline_ja: リオ、症例増加の中でmpoxワクチン接種を拡大
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロでmpox症例が継続的に増加し死亡例も報告されており、州・市当局がワクチン接種対象を拡大するなど公的対応が強化されているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はリオデジャネイロ州・市における既知のmpox流行の継続的な公衆衛生対応（ワクチン接種拡大）を報じたもので、新規性よりも既存アウトブレイクの進展に関する情報。死亡例（免疫不全患者）が報告されている点は重症度の指標として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Avanço da chikungunya coloca Cobija em alerta vermelho na fronteira com o Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of chikungunya puts Cobija on red alert at the border with Acre.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, the Bolivian department of Pando, bordering Acre, Brazil, reports a chikungunya surge led by Cobija. A total of 830 confirmed cases, with 813 in Cobija, underscore an outbreak in the border region near Brasiléia and Epitaciolândia. The health system has declared a red alert, urging immediate execution of an emergency plan to curb Aedes aegypti, including insecticide spraying in high-incidence bairros. Dr. Francisco Vasquez, coordinator of the dengue, Zika and chikungunya program at Sedes, notes ongoing strategy meetings while awaiting the municipality’s contingency plan promised since last Friday. Epidemiology shows the majority of cases are women aged 15–34, suggesting domestic transmission within homes and yards. Authorities urge residents to ventilate interiors and eliminate standing water in containers. Pando now leads Bolivia in chikungunya cases, outperforming Santa Cruz.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱の拡大によりコビハがアクレ州との国境で赤色警報
triage.triage_reason: ボリビア・パンド県（コビハ）でチクングニア熱が急増し830例確認、赤色警報が発令され緊急対応が進行中。ブラジル国境に近接し越境拡大のリスクがあるためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 実際の症例報告はボリビア・パンド県コビハ（813/830例）で発生しており、対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジル・アクレ州は国境近接地域として言及されているのみで、ブラジル国内での症例確認は記載されていないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: México, Bolivia y Estados Unidos pierden certificación libre de sarampión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico, Bolivia and the United States lose measles-free certification.
article.articleSummary: Measles-free certification for Mexico, Bolivia, and the United States was revoked by the Pan American Health Organization (OPS) due to declining vaccination rates and ongoing transmission. The decision followed the Regional Commission for Monitoring and Verification of the Elimination of Measles, Rubella and Congenital Rubella Syndrome (RVC) meeting November 10–13. In Mexico, measles cases trended down since February but remained persistent, with over 20,000 confirmed cases and 50 deaths from 2025–2026. Bolivia reduced cases by 83% this year (444 to 76) yet continues to report transmission. In the United States, CDC data show 5,412 measles cases across 47 jurisdictions this year, more than double 2025’s 2,289 and above the long-term average of about 180 annually (2000–2024). OPS urges maintaining 95% two-dose vaccination coverage and is coordinating campaigns in Brazil, Colombia, Guatemala, Honduras, and Peru to prevent outbreaks, noting measles’ high contagion (about eight infections per case).

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ボリビア、米国が麻疹排除認証を失う
triage.triage_reason: 汎米保健機構（PAHO/OPS）によるメキシコ・ボリビア・米国の麻疹排除認証取消という公衆衛生上重要な事案だが、対象国リストに該当する国での実際の発生は確認できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は中南米・米国での麻疹流行とPAHOによる排除認証取消を報じているが、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当する発生国はない。ブラジルは言及されているが、実際の発生国としてではなく予防キャンペーンの対象として記載されているため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 volta a preocupar em SP; veja quem deve tomar a vacina - Hora de S. Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 is a concern again in São Paulo; see who should get the vaccine - Hora de S. Paulo
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 concerns resurfaced in São Paulo state, where the Health Secretariat reports more than 1,400 cases and 196 deaths since January, with ICU admissions rising. Vaccination remains free via the Unified Health System (SUS) and is part of the National Immunization Program (PNI). Guidance varies by age and health status. Vaccination is recommended for: children 6 months to under 5 years (three-dose primary series); adults 60+ (two doses per year, six-month interval); immunocompromised individuals (semiannual); pregnant and postpartum women (one dose per pregnancy); and other priority groups (comorbidities, disabilities, healthcare workers, Indigenous, riverine communities, quilombolas, incarcerated, and homeless; one dose annually). People previously infected should still vaccinate. Check the vaccination card and visit a UBS for doses. Common symptoms include sore throat, runny nose, fever, cough, fatigue, and headache; seek care for shortness of breath, chest pain, confusion, or marked deterioration.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州でCOVID-19が再び懸念材料に；ワクチン接種対象者を確認
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、本記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州における通常のワクチン接種案内と季節的な症例増加に関する情報提供記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は既存の国家予防接種プログラム（PNI）に基づくCOVID-19ワクチン接種対象者の案内記事であり、新規または異常な感染症イベントではない。症例数・死亡者数の増加は季節的変動の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says 2 Ebola vaccine candidates to enter phase 2 trials next week in DRC
article.articleSummary: Two experimental vaccines developed specifically for Bundibugyo Ebola virus are set to enter phase 2 trials in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with testing in Bunia to begin November 26–27. The candidates are ChAdOx1, from Oxford University and the Serum Institute of India, and a Moderna-developed vaccine. Both have been approved to move from phase 1 to phase 2 of the Tumani randomized controlled trial, which launched October 23 and aims to test safety and immunogenicity before potential phase 3 assessment against a comparator. More than 140 participants have enrolled, with thousands expected as sites expand and mobile teams operate. The DRC Ebola outbreak has surpassed 11,300 cases and 5,500 deaths, with 400–500 new infections weekly, a situation worsened by insecurity, attacks on health workers, and delays in identifying infections that hamper containment.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCで来週からエボラワクチン候補2種が第2相試験に入ると発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行はすでに11,300症例・5,500人死亡に達し、週400-500例の新規感染が続く深刻な公衆衛生事態であり、治安悪化により封じ込めが困難な状況が続いている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで進行中のエボラ流行（Bundibugyo型）に対するワクチン第2相試験の開始を報じたもの。インドは血清研究所がワクチン開発に関与しているため発生地域に含まれているが、実際の流行発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: ആലപ്പുഴയില്‍ രണ്ടിടങ്ങളില്‍ പക്ഷിപ്പനി സ്‌ഥിരീകരിച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu confirmed at two locations in Alappuzha.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, avian influenza (bird flu) has been confirmed in two poultry farms in Alappuzha district, Kerala—Ambalapuzha North ward 11 and Chennithala Grama Panchayat's 1st ward—affecting turkeys and chickens. Samples tested at the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal confirmed infection. About 26,000 poultry in Ambalapuzha North, Ambalapuzha South, and Chennithala GP within a 1 km radius are slated for culling, including 10,044 birds in Ambalapuzha North. The district Animal Husbandry Department leads the response, supported by six rapid-response teams (each with a doctor, two livestock inspectors, two attendants, and four workers) plus Panchayat members, police, revenue, and other staff; two teams are kept in reserve. A 10-km containment zone around the outbreak centers covers 36 GPs. An emergency meeting chaired by District Collector Shaji V. Nair assessed the situation with health, police, disaster management, and other departmental officials.

triage.headline_ja: アラプーザで2か所において鳥インフルエンザが確認される
triage.triage_reason: 家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生で防疫対応（殺処分・封じ込め）が実施されているが、ヒト感染の報告はなく、現時点では動物衛生事象として管理されている。
triage.notes: ヒトへの感染は報告されておらず、家禽（七面鳥・鶏）での発生。地元行政による迅速な対応（殺処分・10km封じ込め区域設定）が実施されている。続報でヒト感染や拡大の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Vacinas-candidatas a estirpe de Ébola entram em teste na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Candidate Ebola-strain vaccines enter testing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Two candidate Ebola vaccines enter early-stage testing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as the 17th Ebola outbreak there—caused by the Bundibugyo strain—becomes the deadliest in the country’s history. Next week, the vaccines will begin clinical trials under the WHO-led Tumaini study: ChAdOx1, an adenoviral-vector vaccine developed by Oxford University with Serum Institute of India, and mRNA-1469 from Moderna. These are the first vaccines included in Tumaini, which is enrolling more than 140 patients with laboratory-confirmed Ebola infection. The Bundibugyo strain carries a case-fatality rate near 50%, with about 11,400 cases and 5,600 deaths reported in this outbreak. Ebola is highly contagious through direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated surfaces. Across Africa in the last 50 years, Ebola has caused more than 15,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の候補ワクチンの試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪のエボラ流行（致死率約50%、死者5,600人超）が継続中であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン臨床試験開始のニュースだが、背景として国内史上最悪規模（11,400症例、5,600死亡）のエボラ流行が継続中であることが明記されており、既存の深刻な公衆衛生危機として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: Na današnji dan prije 7 godina počeo je haos koji je zaustavio svijet: Ovako je zabilježen nulti pacijent korone
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: On this day seven years ago, chaos began that brought the world to a halt: This is how the coronavirus patient zero was recorded.
article.articleSummary: Seven years after the earliest known SARS-CoV-2 infection on 17 November 2019 in a 55-year-old man from Hubei province, Wuhan, COVID-19 emerged from a local outbreak into a global crisis. Initial reports described atypical pneumonia; by mid-December 2019 cases exceeded 100, and by year’s end 266 patients were recorded. China notified WHO on 31 December 2019 about a cluster of pneumonia of unknown cause. In January 2020 the virus spread beyond China, and Wuhan entered one of the first large-scale lockdowns. On 11 March 2020 WHO declared a global pandemic. Vaccines and natural immunity, plus variants such as Omicron, shifted dynamics; by May 2023 WHO announced the end of the global PHEIC, signaling the transition to routine life. Seven years on, the date remains tied to the start of the pandemic and its profound societal changes.

triage.headline_ja: 7年前の今日、世界を止めた混乱が始まった：コロナウイルス『ゼロ号患者』はこう記録された
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はCOVID-19パンデミック開始から7年を振り返る回顧記事であり、現在進行中の新規感染イベントではないため、シグナルトリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 2019年末の武漢での初期症例に関する歴史的回顧記事。現在の公衆衛生上の新規事象は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Governo do Tocantins orienta produtores sobre novo acesso ao sistema de notificação de doenças em animais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tocantins State Government guides producers on new access to the animal disease notification system
article.articleSummary: In Tocantins, Brazil, the State Agency for Agricultural Defense (Adapec) informs producers and residents about the new URL of the Brazilian Veterinary Surveillance and Emergency System (e-Sisbravet), a MAPA platform updated to speed notification registration and tracking. The enhanced system integrates with historical occurrence data and supports field teams, including in areas with limited internet. As of August 2026, Tocantins recorded 121 notifications through the system. Adapec stresses rapid notification for suspected diseases of immediate notification and high sanitary risk; response to the property is targeted within 12 hours of receipt, potentially up to 24 hours depending on the illness and access. Diseases of concern include foot-and-mouth disease, avian influenza, and classical swine fever. Sérgio Leocádio, Adapec’s Animal Health Manager, notes that early notification enables timely measures to prevent spread and protect herds. Reports can be made by any citizen, rural producer, or veterinarian at no cost via e-Sisbravet.

triage.headline_ja: トカンチンス州政府、動物疾病通知システムへの新たなアクセス方法について生産者に案内
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な疾病発生事例の報告ではなく、通知システムの行政的な案内に関する記事であり、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・トカンチンス州の動物疾病通知システム（e-Sisbravet）の更新案内であり、口蹄疫・鳥インフルエンザ・豚コレラなどの具体的な発生事例を報告するものではない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、実際の疾病発生事例がないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Telangana sounds flu alert as mercury dips
article.articleSummary: Telangana (Hyderabad) issues a flu advisory as temperatures are expected to fall 2–3°C below normal over the next two days. Health officials warn that dry weather and cooling can raise transmission of seasonal influenza and other respiratory infections. Seasonal flu spreads via droplets; common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, body aches and fatigue, with most people recovering within about a week with rest and fluids. At-risk groups—pregnant women, children under five, seniors over 65, and people with chronic illnesses—should consult a doctor if symptoms develop. Those with high fever, breathing difficulty, bluish skin or lips, blood in sputum, or altered behavior should seek urgent care at a government facility. Public facilities have special beds and medicines; call 108 for ambulance services. As of 17 November 2026, authorities urge precautions in Telangana.

triage.headline_ja: テランガナ州、気温低下に伴いインフルエンザ警報を発令
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する通常の注意喚起であり、異常性・重症性・国際的拡大リスクはいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 季節的な気温低下に伴う一般的な季節性インフルエンザへの行政注意喚起であり、公衆衛生上の重大なリスクや異常事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Nova variante da Covid-19 avança no Brasil e preocupa OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID-19 variant advances in Brazil and concerns the WHO.
article.articleSummary: New SARS-CoV-2 variant PJ.2.1 has drawn WHO attention amid rising COVID-19 cases. It was placed on the WHO monitoring list to inform potential vaccine updates. Data requests were issued Oct 27 ahead of a December meeting to assess updates, including antibody neutralization, durability of vaccine-induced immunity, and protection against infection, symptoms and severe disease. A Journal of Infection study (Oct 24) reported higher ACE2 binding by PJ.2.1, potentially enhancing infection and spread. First identified in Canada in May 2026, PJ.2.1 has since been detected in the United States and elsewhere. Lab data show the LP.8.1-adapted mRNA vaccine neutralizes PJ.2.1 with no strong immune escape observed, though the WHO continues evaluation. In Brazil, 118,920 COVID-19–related influenza-like illness notifications were recorded for the week ending Nov 7, 2026, with increases in several states; SARS-CoV-2–related severe respiratory cases rose, but hospitalizations remain low. Health Ministry urges vaccination to reduce complications and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで新型コロナウイルスの新変異株が拡大、WHOが懸念
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視中の新変異株PJ.2.1がブラジルで検出数増加、ACE2結合性増強の報告もあり、IHR基準の異常性・国際拡大の2項目に該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: カナダ・米国は変異株の初期検出国として言及されているが、記事の主題はブラジルでの症例増加とWHO監視であるため、対象国リストに含まれる国としてはブラジルのみを抽出した。入院率は低いままとされており、重症度は現時点で高くない。

article.articleHeadline: OMS monitora nova variante da Covid-19 e Brasil registra alta de casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO monitors new variant of COVID-19, and Brazil records a rise in cases.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 variant PJ.2.1, first identified in Canada in May and later detected in the United States, shows enhanced binding to the human ACE2 receptor, potentially increasing infectivity. The World Health Organization has added PJ.2.1 to its monitored lineages to assess vaccines’ effectiveness, with data requests issued on Oct 27 ahead of a December decision on immunization recommendations. In Brazil, the Health Ministry reports rising COVID-19 notifications across 17 states and the Federal District through the week ending Nov 7, totaling 118,920 reports of COVID-19–related influenza-like illness in 2026. Hospitalizations for severe acute respiratory syndrome associated with coronavirus have increased in parts of the Central-South and Bahia, though overall levels remain low. Lab data show PJ.2.1 is neutralized by antibodies from people vaccinated with mRNA vaccines adapted to LP.8.1, with no strong immune escape observed. The analysis will examine neutralization, durability, and protection against symptomatic and severe disease.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、COVID-19新変異株を監視下に置く。ブラジルでは症例数が増加
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1はACE2結合能向上が示唆されWHOが監視対象としているが、免疫逃避は強くなく、ブラジルでの重症化・入院は低水準にとどまるため、現時点ではフルリスク評価より継続観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 米国・カナダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルは症例増加の主題地域として含めた。重症度・入院は全体として低水準であり、ワクチンの有効性も保たれている点から深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Segunda infecção por dengue pode ser mais grave - Deu Click
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second dengue infection may be more severe - Deu Click
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces dengue risk as summer arrives and November 21’s National Dengue Combat Day highlights Aedes aegypti. From January–October 2026, Brazil reported over 374,000 dengue cases and 371 deaths; 2025 saw 1,841 dengue deaths, down 70.6% from 2024’s 6,270. Antibody-Dependent Enhancement (ADE) means a prior dengue infection can raise severity when infected with a different serotype. DENV-3 is rising in Brazil, accounting for about 30% of serotyped cases in 2026, up from 14% in 2025, increasing risk for those previously exposed to DENV-1 or DENV-2. Qdenga vaccination is approved for ages 4–60, two doses three months apart, available in private networks and SUS, prioritizing 10–14-year-olds; contraindicated in pregnant, lactating, and immunocompromised individuals. Severe dengue signs include persistent abdominal pain, bleeding, low blood pressure, vomiting, reduced urine, or altered consciousness; 2025 recorded 35,749 severe or alarm cases.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の二次感染はより重症化する可能性がある - Deu Click
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2026年にDENV-3血清型の増加とADE(抗体依存性感染増強)による重症化リスクが指摘されており、死亡・重症例数も多く、公衆衛生上の注意喚起キャンペーン（国家デング対策デー）とワクチン接種施策により社会的・行政的関心が高いため、フルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: 本記事は国家デング対策デー(11月21日)に合わせた啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイクの速報ではないが、DENV-3血清型の増加によるADEリスク上昇という疫学的に注目すべき情報を含むため、継続的なモニタリングが推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: 17 ноември 2019 година - регистриран првиот пациент со COVID-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: November 17, 2019 - the first patient with COVID-19 registered.
article.articleSummary: First registered infection with SARS-CoV-2: November 17, 2019, a 55-year-old man from Hubei Province, Wuhan, China. Early cases were not recognized as a new virus; by December 2019 Chinese experts identified a novel coronavirus. On December 31, China notified the WHO of a cluster of pneumonia of unknown origin in Wuhan; in January 2020 the virus spread beyond China and Wuhan was locked down. On March 11, 2020, the WHO declared a global COVID-19 pandemic. In Macedonia, the pandemic began in late February 2020; the first diagnosed case was a woman who had contracted the virus in Italy, with cases rising from early March; by the end of July total cases reached 10,000. Measures: March 10 closed all schools and banned public events; March 13 crisis declared in Debar and Centar Župa; March 18 a nationwide state of emergency granted the executive branch legislative power; Parliament dissolved for the July 15 elections, and a technocratic government led by Oliver Spasovski managed the response under emergency.

triage.headline_ja: 2019年11月17日 - COVID-19の最初の患者が登録された
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2019年11月のCOVID-19最初の症例および北マケドニアでの流行開始に関する歴史的回顧記事であり、新規の感染症イベントや進行中の公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はCOVID-19パンデミックの起源（2019年11月、武漢）と北マケドニアでの流行史を振り返る回顧記事であり、配信日（2026年）時点での新規イベントではない。トリアージ対象としての新規性・緊急性はないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox avança no Rio com novo clado viral
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox advances in Rio de Janeiro with a new viral clade.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (mpox) cases surge in Rio de Janeiro in 2026, with 297 confirmed in the city and 404 in the state as of Nov 17, 2026, and 341 under investigation. The Zona Sul and Centro districts account for 37% of Rio’s cases (73 and 37 respectively), with Penha, Ramos and Ilha do Governador also reporting 37, and Barra/Jacarepaguá 32. One death confirmed in the municipality; about 55.6% of Rio cases have resolved. A new clade 1B is circulating in the state, with recent samples predominating in the last two months at INI/Fiocruz. At INI, 144 confirmed and 40 suspected cases were notified by Nov 10; roughly 70 tests pending. On Nov 9, Dédalos Rio nightclub in Centro temporarily suspended operations. Vaccination expanded for PrEP users and HIV patients with CD4 <200; by Nov 16, 916 people vaccinated. Brazil-wide 2026 cases 665; growth attributed to surveillance and new lineage entry.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなウイルス系統（クレード）の流入により、リオデジャネイロでMpoxが拡大
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロ州でMpox症例が急増（州404例、市297例、死亡1例）し、新たにクレード1Bの国内流入が確認された。国際的に懸念されているクレードの新規検出であり、性感染拡大の可能性やナイトクラブでのクラスター等、公衆衛生上重大な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 本事例はブラジル（対象国）での発生であり、他の対象国（例:タイ等）での関連事例は言及されていない。クレード1BはWHOが過去にPHEIC宣言の根拠としたクレードであり、南米での新規検出は国際的監視上重要な意味を持つ可能性がある。渡航制限や国際支援要請の有無は記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: "Curitiba sem Mosquito" mobiliza moradores contra a dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: “Mosquito-Free Curitiba” Mobilizes Residents Against Dengue.
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention drive Mutirão Curitiba Sem Mosquito expands to Boqueirão and Boa Vista in Curitiba, with health agents guiding residents on dengue prevention and proper entulho (waste) disposal. From 16–19 November 2026, 15 blocks in the Eucaliptos Health Unit catchment (Alto Boqueirão) and 20 blocks in the Vila Esperança Health Unit catchment (Atuba) will receive orientation. Waste collection is scheduled for 24 November 2026 (Boqueirão) and 26 November 2026 (Boa Vista). What is collected: tires (up to two per residence), organic/plant waste (up to 1 m3 per residence), and recyclable materials (bottles, plastics, ferrous/metal containers). Not collected: large-volume construction debris, unbagged organics/vegetation, toxic/hazardous waste (lamps, medicines, batteries, paints), vehicles, and furniture/electrical appliances. Residents should place waste outside on pickup days, with smaller items bagged. Goal: reduce mosquito breeding and dengue transmission through community cleanup and education.

article.articleHeadline: Alta de casos de mpox no Distrito Federal reforça alerta para sintomas e prevenção -- Política Distrital agora é PDNews, notícias sobre Política e Saúde do DF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in mpox cases in the Federal District reinforces warning about symptoms and prevention — District Politics is now PDNews, news about Politics and Health of the DF.
article.articleSummary: Mpox outbreak in Brazil's Federal District has reached 51 confirmed cases, with 45 residents; overwhelmingly male and aged 30–39, per epidemiological bulletin updated through Monday, November 16. SES-DF reports sustained surveillance and readiness to diagnose and monitor infections; most patients recover in weeks, though severe disease can occur. Core symptoms include skin eruptions/lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headaches, myalgias, chills, and weakness. Transmission is via direct contact with lesions and bodily fluids (pus, blood, saliva). Prevention emphasizes avoiding close contact with symptomatic individuals, not sharing clothing or personal items, frequent hand hygiene, and surface disinfection. Vaccination in the Federal District targets people living with HIV/AIDS (18+) with CD4 counts below 100 cells/mm3 in the last six months; expansion depends on new vaccine doses from the federal government, with other groups to be added gradually as supplies arrive.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦区でのMpox症例増加、症状と予防への警戒強化 — ディストリクト・ポリティカは現在PDNewsとしてDFの政治・健康ニュースを配信
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル連邦区でMpox確定51例と既知疾患の局地的増加が報告されているが、重症度は限定的で国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、情報も断片的なため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: HIV陽性者（CD4低値）向けワクチン接種を進めている点から脆弱層への感染拡大リスクに留意。地域保健当局（SES-DF）は自力で監視・対応を継続しており、外部支援要請の記載はない。続報でケース数の推移や重症例の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose preocupa especialistas após sete mortes em Londrina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis concerns specialists after seven deaths in Londrina.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis in Londrina: As of November 12, 2026, the city reported 251 tuberculosis cases and seven deaths, with overall notifications still below 2025's annual total. Yet three highly vulnerable groups—homeless people, those deprived of liberty, and individuals living with HIV/AIDS—have already surpassed 2025 case counts. Specialists warn of diagnostic and control challenges, describing a 'chaos' worsened by stigma and difficulties in patient follow-up. TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Koch’s bacillus); the pulmonary form is most common and drives transmission via airborne spread. Predominant symptoms include a cough lasting three weeks or more, afternoon fever, night sweats, and weight loss. While TB can affect all ages, risk is higher for the immunocompromised and for children under five. The report underscores ongoing concerns about outbreak containment and continuity of care.

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Covid-19 em Mariana chegam a 102 em novembro; Prefeitura recebe 6 mil doses de vacina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases in Mariana reach 102 in November; City Hall receives 6,000 vaccine doses.
article.articleSummary: Mariana reported 102 COVID-19 cases in November as of 13 November 2026; Mayor Juliano Duarte announced the figures in a 17 November 2026 video with the Health Secretariat. Earlier in the month the city had 35 cases; the year’s peak was 22 in May, with June–August of zero and September–October of 1–2. Three patients were hospitalized, non-severe, and discharged. To bolster vaccination, the city obtained 6,000 doses from Belo Horizonte for adults; vaccination sites include Central Immunization, health units in Cabanas and Santo Antônio (Prainha), and Passagem de Mariana; from 19 November the Vacimóvel will serve at Terminal Turístico. Vaccination schedules: 6 months–4 years: three doses; 5–59 years: one dose; 60+ and immunosuppressed: every six months; pregnant: one dose during pregnancy. All UBS offer rapid COVID-19 testing. Those with respiratory symptoms should avoid crowds, seek care at their health unit, wear a mask when needed, and practice hand hygiene; seek urgent care for severe symptoms.

article.articleHeadline: Northern Thailand Emerges as Primary Dengue High-Risk Area Over Twenty
article.articleSummary: Dengue remains a public health concern in Thailand, with Northern Thailand emerging as the primary high-risk area over a 20-year period (2005–2024). Analysis of 1,640,368 reported dengue cases across five four-year intervals showed significant global Moran's I spatial autocorrelation in four periods (0.211–0.473; p<0.01), but a fragmentation period in 2017–2020 (0.065; p=0.190). Local indicators (LISA) tracked a decline in High-High provinces from 11 to 2, with clusters shifting from Central-Eastern to northern Thailand. SaTScan Poisson analyses identified 13 significant space-time clusters; the most likely Northern Thailand cluster occurred 2013–2016 with relative risk 2.33 (p<0.001). The maximum cumulative burden cluster spanned Central-Western 2009–2016 with 149,010 cases. Findings advocate geographically stratified dengue control in Thailand.

triage.headline_ja: 北部タイが20年間で主要なデング熱高リスク地域として浮上
triage.triage_reason: 過去20年間（2005-2024）の疫学的・空間統計分析に関する学術研究報告であり、新規の異常事態や緊急対応を要するシグナルではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去20年間の統計・空間分析に基づく学術研究の報告であり、デング熱の地理的に層別化された対策を提言するもの。新規発生や急増を示す速報ではないため、トリアージ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Após 26 anos, Estados Unidos perdem status de país que eliminou o sarampo - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After 26 years, the United States lose status as a country that eliminated measles - Jornal O Sul
article.articleSummary:
Measles elimination status for the United States was officially lost, as announced by PAHO/OPAS on 2026-11-17, after continuous measles virus transmission for more than 12 months. CDC figures show 5,412 laboratory-confirmed cases in 2026 through 12 November, with deaths, amid outbreaks since 2025 in Texas, Utah, South Carolina, Pennsylvania, and New York. Elimination, achieved in 2000, signified no sustained endemic transmission rather than eradication; imported cases had occurred previously. To regain elimination, the same viral lineage must stop circulating for at least 12 months and surveillance must be maintained. The MMR vaccine (two doses) is about 97% protective. Coverage among children entering early education declined from ~95% (2019-2020) to 92% (2025-2026). Measles spreads rapidly, with airborne transmission and the potential to infect 12–18 people; it can linger up to two hours in enclosed spaces. Canada lost elimination in 2025; Bolivia and Mexico in 2026; Brazil regained in 2024.
Type: string

article.articleHeadline: Santa Catarina flexibiliza medidas contra a Doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Catarina Relaxes Measures Against Newcastle Disease
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreaks in western Santa Catarina, Brazil, have been resolved with five foci closed across three municipalities: Nova Itaberaba (two), Nova Erechim (two), and Coronel Freitas (one). The first focus was confirmed on October 18. No birds exhibited symptoms; emergency-area restrictions are lifted, and the housing of new poultry flocks and movements return to normal, including in areas previously under intervention, though export restrictions to certain countries remain per market rules. During the emergency, 251 commercial poultry establishments within a 10-km radius of the foci were inspected, along with over 3,600 properties including subsistence poultry operations. Regular surveillance will continue; Newcastle disease poses no human health risk from consuming meat or eggs from inspected, officially controlled establishments.

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde confirma 51 casos de mpox no Distrito Federal -- Política Distrital agora é PDNews, notícias sobre Política e Saúde do DF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department confirms 51 mpox cases in the Federal District -- District Politics is now PDNews, news about Politics and Health in the DF.
article.articleSummary: Mpox cases reach 51 in the Federal District of Brazil, with 45 among residents, up 15.9% from 44 on 12 November; update as of 16 November. All locally infected patients are male, predominantly aged 30–39. Immunization expansion hinges on federal vaccine supplies; on 6 November, the Ministry of Health dispatched 100 doses to the Federal District after district request to replenish stock. Vaccination prioritizes People Living with HIV/AIDS aged 18+ with CD4 counts below 100 cells/mm³ in the last six months. Most mpox infections recover within weeks, but severe complications can occur. Transmission mainly via direct contact with skin lesions and secretions (pus, wound blood, saliva). Public health guidance emphasizes avoiding physical contact with suspected cases, frequent hand hygiene, cleaning and disinfecting surfaces, and not sharing personal items. Suspected cases should seek care at a basic health unit or hospital and report close contacts during triage.

article.articleHeadline: Por qué Estados Unidos, México y Bolivia perdieron la condición de países libres de sarampión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why the United States, Mexico, and Bolivia lost their measles-free status.
article.articleSummary: Bolivia, Mexico, and the United States have lost their measles elimination status after sustained endemic transmission for at least 12 months. PAHO/OPS notes a single genotype and lineage circulated uninterrupted in each country, with regional outbreaks totaling more than 58,000 infections and 82 deaths. The decision followed the Regional Commission on Monitoring and Verification of Measles, Rubella, and Congenital Rubella Syndrome (RVC) meeting November 10–13, 2026. The 12-month periods ended on Jan 20, 2026 (U.S.), Feb 1, 2026 (Mexico), and Apr 16, 2026 (Bolivia). Loss of elimination reflects sustained local transmission, not uniform outbreaks nationwide; countries are strengthening immunization, surveillance, and rapid response. The Americas first eliminated measles and regained regional status in 2024 (Venezuela, Brazil) but Canada lost national status in 2025. Symptoms include high fever, runny nose, conjunctival injection, Koplik spots, and a face-to-body rash; vaccination prevents infection. An imported case or isolated outbreak is not enough to lose elimination status.

triage.headline_ja: なぜ米国、メキシコ、ボリビアは麻疹排除国の地位を失ったのか
triage.triage_reason: PAHO/OPSにより米国・メキシコ・ボリビアで12ヶ月以上の持続的な地域内麻疹伝播が確認され、麻疹排除国の地位喪失という異常事態であり、地域全体で58,000人超の感染と82人の死亡を伴う国際的拡大が認められるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国・メキシコ・ボリビアにおける麻疹排除状態の喪失であり、対象国リストに含まれる国（ブラジル等）は過去に排除状態を回復した例として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。モニタリング対象国に直接該当する発生事例ではないが、地域的な麻疹流行の拡大傾向は公衆衛生上の重要なシグナルとして記録する。

article.articleHeadline: Strain-specific Ebola jab trials to start in DR Congo next week: WHO
article.articleSummary: Two candidate vaccines developed for Bundibugyo Ebola are set to enter trials in the outbreak’s epicentre, Bunia, Ituri province, DRC, as part of the Tumaini study. The Bundibugyo strain, behind the current outbreak declared a public health emergency in May, has no approved vaccines or treatments. In DRC, 11,376 cases and 5,568 deaths have been confirmed, with 400–500 new cases reported weekly. The Tumaini trial, which uses ring vaccination, initially began with Ervebo (Zaire strain) on Oct 23; two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines—ChAdOx1 vector (Oxford) and mRNA-1469 (Moderna)—will join Phase 2 testing, with safety and immune response assessed. Phase 2 is slated for November 26–27 in Bunia; successful results would move to Phase 3. Enrolment has exceeded 140 participants with thousands of contacts expected; expansion may occur beyond Bunia. Children account for over a quarter of cases and about a third of deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 系統特異的エボラワクチンの治験が来週DRCで開始：WHO
triage.triage_reason: DRCで公衆衛生緊急事態宣言済みのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行が継続しており、死者数・症例数が多く、ワクチン未承認という異常事態かつ国際的な支援（WHO・Oxford・Moderna）が必要なためフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pediatra mówi, co teraz krąży wśród pacjentów. "Mieliśmy nawet dengę" - Super Nowości - wiadomości z Rzeszowa i Podkarpacia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A pediatrician says what's currently circulating among patients. "We even had dengue."
article.articleSummary: Autumn in Poland, as of 17 November 2026, shows a broad mix of infections among pediatric patients. Besides RSV, COVID-19, influenza, scarlet fever and croup, clinicians are noting travel-associated diseases such as dengue and chikungunya. A child returning from Thailand developed high fever, rash and abdominal pain; tests confirmed dengue, but the course was not severe. Another patient from Egypt presented with high fever and gastrointestinal symptoms, prompting consideration of tropical pathogens. The pediatrician warns dengue requires vigilance, especially with infection by a different serotype, which raises the risk of severe dengue including hemorrhagic forms. In Poland, RSV remains a major signal: 76,067 RSV infections confirmed Jan 1–Oct 31, 2026; the usual winter peak has not yet arrived. RSV can cause bronchiolitis in infants and serious disease in the elderly and those with chronic conditions. Travel history and daycare exposure shape diagnosis and management.
