article.articleHeadline: Cruzeiro do Sul registra dois surtos de catapora em escolas e 13 casos da doença em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cruzeiro do Sul records two chickenpox outbreaks in schools and 13 chickenpox cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Cruzeiro do Sul reports two chickenpox outbreaks in 2026 in schools, with 13 cases to date. The illness is caused by the varicella-zoster virus and is highly contagious, presenting with skin rashes, fever, malaise, and intense itching. Transmission occurs via airborne particles or direct contact with lesion fluid; an infected person is contagious from two days before rash onset until all lesions crust over. Incubation is 10–21 days. Vaccination is available in all Primary Health Units: first dose at 15 months via the tetraviral vaccine (measles, mumps, rubella, varicella) and a second dose at 4 years. Authorities urge temporary exclusion of symptomatic children and staff from schools until lesions crust over, and schools must notify Epidemiological Surveillance of suspected cases, especially when multiple cases arise. Preventive measures include ventilation, hand hygiene, avoiding contact with lesions, and monitoring contacts for symptoms. Outbreaks recur annually in Cruzeiro do Sul, underscoring ongoing surveillance.

article.articleHeadline: Man Dies After Allegedly Eating Sweet Near Mumbai, Food Poisoning Suspected
article.articleSummary: 35-year-old Zubair Ansari died in Mumbra, Thane, Maharashtra, from suspected food poisoning after consuming 'aflatoon' sweets from Sagar Sweets and Bakery; five others who ate from the same batch suffered severe vomiting and diarrhoea, with one diagnosed as typhoid. Four have recovered; autopsy findings and laboratory reports are awaited to confirm the cause. The shop has been sealed and sweet samples collected for testing. In a state-wide crackdown, the Maharashtra FDA seized adulterated stock worth Rs 1.97 crore and shut five vendors, suspended licences of four businesses in Mumbai and Nagpur, and served stop-work notices to five Pune Camp area establishments. A Navi Mumbai godown was found with about 97,000 kg of wet dates and cassia/cinnamon, seized for incorrect labelling, substandard quality and unhygienic storage. At Mumbra, Sagar Sweets stocks worth over Rs 4.58 lakh, including aflatoon, loose mawa, pure ghee and maida, were seized.

article.articleHeadline: ВООЗ: у ДР Конго можуть почати другу фазу випробувань вакцин проти Еболи -- Anadolu Agency
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: the second phase of Ebola vaccine trials may begin in the DR Congo — Anadolu Agency
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the second phase of randomized, controlled Ebola vaccine trials may begin next week in Bunia, evaluating two candidates against the Bundibugyo strain: ChAdOx1 (Oxford University and Serum Institute of India) and a Moderna vaccine. Phase 2 will assess safety and immunogenicity; those meeting criteria advance to Phase 3 to gauge efficacy versus a comparator. The Tumani trial, launched on October 23, has enrolled over 140 participants and may add new candidates as they become available, with thousands potentially participating as more sites and mobile teams come online. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reports the outbreak has surpassed 11,300 cases and 5,500 deaths, with 400–500 new infections weekly. Ongoing challenges include unstable security, attacks on health workers, and delays in detecting infections.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラワクチンの第2段階試験が開始される可能性 — アナドル通信
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラアウトブレイクが11,300症例・5,500人の死亡に達し、週400-500人の新規感染が継続しており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン臨床試験（第2相）の開始に関する報道だが、背景として既存の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（11,300症例、5,500死亡、治安不安定、医療従事者への攻撃）の深刻な状況が述べられている。インドはSerum Institute of Indiaのワクチン製造拠点としての言及であり、発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Tres países, incluida Bolivia, pierden estatus libre de sarampión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three countries, including Bolivia, lose measles-free status.
article.articleSummary: Bolivia, the United States, and Mexico have lost their measles-free status per PAHO/WHO, after sustained transmission of the measles virus for 12 months or more. The regional setback undermines the Americas’ progress toward elimination, achieved in 2024 after interrupting endemic transmission in Venezuela and Brazil. The November 2025 reversal, following transmission in Canada, marks a renewed circulation of the same virus lineage and complicates regional elimination efforts. As of 13 November 2026, the region reported 58,213 confirmed measles cases and 82 deaths, versus 12,806 cases in the same period last year. Countries are intensifying vaccination, surveillance, and outbreak response. Canada has interrupted transmission linked to its outbreak and seeks to regain elimination status. The Regional Monitoring and Verification Commission met November 10–13 to review the epidemiology and regional status.

triage.headline_ja: ボリビアを含む3カ国が麻疹排除国認定を喪失
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の排除国認定喪失という公衆衛生上重要な出来事だが、発生国（ボリビア・米国・メキシコ・カナダ）はいずれも監視対象国リストに含まれず、ブラジルも過去の達成実績として言及されているのみで現事象の主題ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事はPAHO/WHOによる米州地域の麻疹排除状況に関する報告。対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）はいずれも現事象の発生国として主題化されていない（ブラジルは過去の排除達成国としての言及のみ）。

article.articleHeadline: Especialistas discutem estratégias para evitar nova epidemia de dengue em Rio Preto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts discuss strategies to prevent a new dengue epidemic in Rio Preto.
article.articleSummary: {"description":"Dengue prevention strategies were discussed by health professionals from across the region at a meeting in Rio Preto, aimed at preparing the healthcare network for a possible new epidemic in 2027. The discussions address the circulation of different dengue virus serotypes and the effects of climate change on transmission. Rio Preto registered 5,648 dengue cases in 2026. In 2025, during the last outbreak, there were 53,076 cases and 41 deaths. The gathering underscores a proactive regional effort to confront dengue as the epidemiology evolves, with emphasis on readiness to respond to a future resurgence consistent with ongoing climatic shifts and serotype diversity."}

triage.headline_ja: 専門家らがリオ・プレトでデング熱の新たな流行を防ぐための戦略を議論
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の将来的な再流行に備えた予防策の会議に関する記事であり、現時点で新たな異常な流行やアウトブレイクの発生を示す情報ではないが、過去の大規模流行歴があり継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2027年に向けた予防戦略会議についてのもので、現在進行中の新規アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。2025年には53,076例・41人死亡の大規模流行歴があり、気候変動やセロタイプ多様化による将来的な再流行リスクが懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: Alertan masiva presencia de tortugas invasoras: se multiplican y pueden transmitir graves infecciones
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning of a massive presence of invasive turtles: they multiply and can transmit serious infections.
article.articleSummary: Red-eared slider turtles, native to North America, are proliferating in canals at Brisas del Sol, Talcahuano, Biobío, Chile. Residents warn the invasive population is growing, threatening fauna and Salmonella risk. A 2018 SAG estimate of 60–100 individuals seems outdated, as adult females have been observed laying eggs in the sand. With few natural predators, the population is expanding; in captivity they live about 20 years, and in the wild can reach 30 cm and 40 years. A Universidad de Concepción project (Cooperativa Ciencia) monitoring 17 wetlands in Concepción, San Pedro, Talcahuano and Hualpén reports eggs and hatchlings, indicating reproduction. Salmonella transmission through feces can cause diarrhea, fever, abdominal cramps and nausea. Neighbors have asked for a SAG-led technical working group to remove turtles; mayor Eduardo Saavedra has not yet responded. People are urged not to release exotic pets; if seen out of water, wear gloves and bag the animal.

triage.headline_ja: 外来種カメの大量発生に警報：繁殖が進み、重篤な感染症を媒介する恐れ

triage.notes: 疾患名にParatyphoid/Typhoidとあるが、記事内容はチリにおける外来種カメ（ミシシッピアカミミガメ）の繁殖とサルモネラ感染リスクに関するもので、腸チフス・パラチフスとは無関係。発生地域にフィリピンが含まれているが、記事サマリーはチリのTalcahuano地域のみを主題としており、フィリピンでの発生は確認できない。対象国リストにチリは含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: L'ebola, fora de control a la República Democràtica del Congo: més de 5.500 morts mig any després - 3CatInfo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, out of control in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: more than 5,500 deaths six months later.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control six months after detection, driven by the Bundibugyo variant for which there are no vaccines or approved treatments. More than 11,300 cases and over 5,500 deaths have been reported by November. Transmission extends beyond known contact circles, with hospital outbreaks and unsafe burial practices fueling spread; conflict, displacement, and limited health-system capacity hinder the response. Despite about $2.9 billion in international commitments, funds have not fully reached transmission foci. The outbreak is active in eight provinces, with Uganda reporting cross-border cases and isolated infections in France, Kenya, and Nigeria. Most cases involve adults aged 20–39, with women accounting for over 60% of infections. Incubation 2–21 days; early symptoms are nonspecific, complicating diagnosis and enabling progression to intestinal dysfunction, organ failure, and hemorrhagic manifestations. The first case occurred April 24 near Mongbwalu, Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で制御不能に：発生半年で死者5,500人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）が制御不能で、11,300例超・死者5,500人超、ウガンダへの越境例や複数国での散発例もあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境例、フランス・ケニア・ナイジェリアでの散発例が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リスト外または主要発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。ワクチン・承認治療薬が存在しないブンディブジョ株であることも懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: World News in Brief: Ebola cases double in DR Congo, chemical exposure starts before birth, Türk concern over EU-Rwanda transfer plan
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths across 67 health zones in eight provinces, WHO says. In Bundibugyo virus disease, children account for more than a quarter of cases and a third of deaths; seven in ten under-five deaths occur among confirmed Ebola cases. Transmission slowed in epicentres, but 400–500 new weekly cases persist; two-thirds of deaths occur outside Ebola treatment centres. Kenya reports nine imported cases and two deaths; Nigeria reports one imported case. Laboratories testing the virus have risen to more than 24; two Bundibugyo vaccines will join a vaccine trial soon. Separately, UNEP/WHO report links prenatal exposure to endocrine-disrupting chemicals with fertility, brain, thyroid, metabolism, and cardiovascular effects; costs may exceed 1% of GDP. Geneva conference runs through Nov 20. UN rights chief Volker Türk warns against migration transfers to Rwanda, urging drivers to be addressed and expanded pathways.

triage.headline_ja: 世界ニュース概要：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ症例が倍増、出生前化学物質曝露、EU・ルワンダ移送計画へのテュルク氏の懸念
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョウウイルス病）の大規模流行が継続し、11,000症例・5,400死亡に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境輸出例も確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア（9例・2死亡）、ナイジェリア（1例）への越境輸出例が報告されているが、両国とも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。スイス（ジュネーブ）は会議開催地であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Itapema realiza mobilização contra a dengue na orla da Meia Praia nesta quinta-feira
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Itapema holds anti-dengue mobilization on the Meia Praia waterfront this Thursday.
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention mobilization in Itapema, Brazil, on the Meia Praia waterfront near Rua 237 starting at 9:00 on Thursday, November 19, as part of National Dengue Control Day activities ahead of November 28. The event, led by the Municipal Health Department, aims to educate the public about dengue control and the Aedes aegypti mosquito that transmits dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. It involves multiple city sectors—Health, Public Works, Civil Defense, environmental agencies, and FAACI—and features information materials, on-site guidance, and a Dengue Ombudsman desk for inquiries and reporting potential mosquito breeding sites; mascots will engage attendees. Health units statewide will also carry out educational actions. Emphasizes home prevention: eliminate containers that collect water, keep water tanks closed, clean gutters, and regularly inspect yards and outdoor spaces. Community participation is essential to reduce mosquito breeding and disease risk.

triage.headline_ja: イタペマ市、木曜日にメイア・プライア海岸でデング熱対策啓発活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防啓発イベントであり、新規感染拡大や異常事態の報告ではないため、IHR・WPRO基準いずれにも該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Mariana registra 102 casos de Covid-19 em novembro, de acordo com balanço recente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mariana records 102 COVID-19 cases in November, according to a recent report.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Mariana, Brazil: 102 confirmed cases in November 2026, bringing the year’s total to 173. Monthly totals: Jan 8, Feb 7, Mar 20, Apr 1, May 22, Jun–Aug 0, Sep 1, Oct 2. The municipal health department reports rising numbers and confirms six thousand adult vaccine doses arriving from Belo Horizonte; vaccines for children are also available. Immunizations will be offered at health units in Cabanas and Passagem de Mariana and at the Central Immunization Hub. Dosing schedules: ages 6 months–4 years receive three doses; 5–59 years one dose; 60+ and immunocompromised every six months; pregnant individuals one dose during pregnancy. Vacimóvel will operate from Nov 19 at the Tourist Terminal for priority groups. Authorities advise avoiding crowds when symptomatic, maintaining hand hygiene, and using masks as needed; seek care for severe symptoms.

triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の疾患で、ブラジル地方都市における通常の症例増加とワクチン接種案内に関する内容であり、異常性・緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジルのミナスジェライス州マリアナ市での通常のCOVID-19症例報告とワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する地方ニュース。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、本記事は定例の公衆衛生報告であり、シグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Londrina testa nova técnica de aplicação de fumacê para combater a dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Londrina tests a new fogging technique to combat dengue.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-17, Londrina is among five Brazilian cities testing a new Ultra-Low Volume (UBV) fumigation technique to combat Aedes aegypti, the mosquito that transmits dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The initiative, a partnership of the Ministry of Health, Fiocruz, Paraná’s Secretaria de Saúde (Sesa), and an insecticide company, runs in Jardim Messianico in the Oeste district. The objective is to assess the efficacy of a redesigned fumigation method, adjusting the spray cannon position and vehicle route. The test covers nine blocks, with four houses directly participating; each selected home will receive three cages containing live mosquitoes placed in strategic yard locations. After spraying, cages are collected to measure the impact on the mosquitoes and inform methodology. Officials emphasize dengue control also depends on community actions—keeping yards clean, removing standing water, checking gutters and drains, and allowing vector-control agents to operate.

triage.notes: 記事はデング熱媒介蚊対策の新技術試験に関する内容であり、症例数や流行状況についての具体的情報はない。保健当局による予防的対策の一環。

article.articleHeadline: Cabo Frio confirma caso de Mpox em paciente atendido na rede municipal de Saúde -- RC24H
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cabo Frio confirms Mpox case in patient treated at the municipal health network -- RC24H.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) case confirmed in Cabo Frio, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil—an imported case treated in the municipal health network, as the patient does not reside there; origin city has been notified for surveillance. Laboratory confirmation was provided by Lacen-RJ after sample testing, with protocols from SES-RJ and the Ministry of Health guiding response. In the Região dos Lagos, Arraial do Cabo, Búzios, São Pedro da Aldeia, Iguaba Grande and Araruama have no confirmed mpox cases. No suspected or confirmed cases were recorded in Arraial do Cabo, Búzios or São Pedro da Aldeia; Iguaba Grande’s October suspicion was discarded; Araruama reported nine suspected cases in 2026, all ruled out, with none under investigation. Mpox is an Orthopoxvirus transmitted via close contact with lesions, bodily fluids, or contaminated objects; symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pains, lymph node enlargement, and skin lesions. Diagnosis is clinical plus lab testing; contact tracing is crucial.

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: Alto Tietê registra casos e mortes em 2026; veja quem pode se vacinar | Hoje Diário
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: Alto Tietê records cases and deaths in 2026; see who can get vaccinated | Hoje Diário
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 remains circulating in the Alto Tietê region of São Paulo, Brazil in 2026, with reported cases, hospitalizations, and deaths. Vaccination is recommended for children 6 months to under 5 years, pregnant individuals, seniors 60+, and health-risk groups defined by the Ministry of Health (comorbidities, immunocompromised, permanent disability, healthcare workers, Indigenous, quilombolas, riverine communities, homeless, and other vulnerable populations). Fiocruz InfoGripe signals rising severe COVID-19 in several regions, underscoring the need to keep vaccines up to date and seek care for respiratory symptoms among high-risk groups. The Health Ministry sent more than 1.4 million additional vaccine doses to 10 states, with São Paulo receiving the largest share (>500,000). Regional tallies through mid-November: Santa Isabel 69 cases, 0 deaths; Suzano 38 cases, 13 hospitalizations (5 ICU), 1 death; Mogi das Cruzes 12 cases, 3 deaths; Arujá 29 cases, 0 deaths; Guarulhos 330 flu-like Covid-19 cases, 6 deaths; Itaquaquecetuba 51; Poá 19; Ferraz de Vasconcelos 1 case, no deaths yet (data pending).

article.articleHeadline: Panvel Residents Troubled By Mosquito Menace; Citizens Demand Action To Eliminate Breeding Sites
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-18, Panvel residents report a rising mosquito menace despite PMC’s ongoing fogging and spraying. Creek-side housing societies, notably Sector 36 in Kamothe and Ravi Heights, report higher infestation and urge identification and elimination of breeding sites beyond routine measures. PMC has deployed about 100 personnel for citywide fogging and insecticide spraying, with health officials sharing disease-surveillance data to enable targeted interventions. Blood tests are being conducted for suspected cases, with prompt treatment provided. Malaria and dengue figures for August–November show 615 malaria cases from 52,223 tests (Aug 197, Sep 238, Oct 152, Nov 28) and around 700 dengue cases from 3,254 tests (Aug 173, Sep 386, Oct 183, Nov 38). Residents call for sustained surveillance and preventive measures, especially in creek-adjacent settlements, to curb breeding and transmission.

triage.headline_ja: パンヴェル住民、蚊の脅威に苦慮。市民は発生源除去への対策を要求
triage.triage_reason: マハラシュトラ州パンヴェルでマラリア・デング熱の症例が継続的に発生しているが、既存の対策（燻蒸・殺虫剤散布・サーベイランス）が実施されており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。地域的な蚊媒介性疾患の管理課題であり、フルRRAへの移行は現時点で不要だが、症例数の推移は注視を要する。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・マハラシュトラ州パンヴェル市（PMC管轄）における季節性のマラリア・デング熱流行と地域住民の蚊対策要求に関するもの。ミャンマー（Kayin State）は発生地域に含まれているが、記事本文では言及されておらず、Bluedotの誤タグと判断し除外。地方自治体レベルでの対応が継続中であり、現時点では国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: SC retoma alojamento de aves após controle da Doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Catarina Resumes Poultry Housing After Newcastle Disease Control.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease (avian paramyxovirus type 1) outbreak in western Santa Catarina, Brazil, with first focus identified Oct 18 at a commercial turkey slaughter facility in Nova Itaberaba. Movement and housing restrictions in the area have ended, but export bans and sanitary fallow periods remain. Five properties (2 in Nova Itaberaba, 2 in Nova Erechim, 1 in Coronel Freitas) were investigated; none showed disease symptoms after cleaning and disinfection. Since Oct 18, 251 commercial poultry establishments within a 10 km radius were inspected, and over 3,600 properties (including subsistence flocks) were surveyed in under a month. A 60-day zoosanitary emergency is in place for Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim. Surveillance continues and education efforts are ongoing. Laboratory confirmation was by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense of São Paulo; no human health risk from consuming products from inspected facilities.

triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（家禽のニューカッスル病）であり人の健康リスクは明記されていないが、輸出禁止等の貿易制限が継続しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 動物（家禽）のニューカッスル病で、記事は人の健康リスクがないことを明記。既に封じ込め・衛生対策が進み、地域制限は解除済み。輸出禁止と衛生休止期間のみ継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox passa de mil casos no Brasil em 2026, mais da metade confirmada em outubro e novembro, e Rio e São Paulo concentram três de cada quatro registros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox surpasses 1,000 cases in Brazil in 2026, with more than half confirmed in October and November, and Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo account for three-quarters of the records.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (MPXV) has reached 1,023 confirmed cases in Brazil in 2026, plus 46 probable and 581 suspected cases, with one death, according to the Ministry of Health as of November 12. More than half of the year’s confirmations occurred in October and November (October 293; November 227). Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo together account for 778 cases, about 76% of national tallies, while Ceará, Minas Gerais, the Federal District, and Santa Catarina round out the top six states, contributing roughly 93% of annual confirmations. Symptoms center on a skin eruption with vesicles or ulcers, fever, headache, muscle pains, and lymphadenopathy, with transmission mainly through direct contact with lesions and contaminated items, including sexual contact. Vaccination via the SUS targets high-risk groups with two doses (28 days apart) at Immunobiological Reference Centers; 25,000 doses are secured through PAHO, though global shortages limit access. Suspected cases should isolate and seek care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで2026年のエムポックス感染者数が1,000人を超え、その半数以上が10月と11月に確認。リオデジャネイロとサンパウロで全体の4分の3を占める
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのMpox症例数が年間を通じて急増し、直近2か月で半数以上が確認されるなど増加傾向が顕著であり、WHO/PAHOの支援（ワクチン供給）も必要とされているためフルリスク評価が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 死亡例は1件のみで重症度自体は低いが、症例数の急増とワクチン供給不足（PAHO支援）が継続的な監視を要する要因。

article.articleHeadline: Infectologista explica avanço da covid e orienta sobre prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infectious disease specialist explains the progression of COVID-19 and provides guidance on prevention.
article.articleSummary: Booster vaccination is being deployed to curb rising mild COVID-19 cases across 17 states and the Federal District in Brazil. The surge is linked to the XFG variant, accounting for about 88% of samples this year. A flu-like COVID-19 syndrome has risen in 18 states; 285 cases were recorded in the week of 1–7 November. Year to date, 118,920 infections have been reported, up 1,481 in two weeks, with a ten-week upward trend but still considered low risk due to mostly mild illness. Symptoms include sore throat, cough, nasal congestion, fatigue, and headache; fever is milder and loss of taste/smell is less common. Lab data suggest XFG does not increase hospitalizations or deaths versus other variants. In Brazil, SARS-CoV-2 cases this year total 3,641 (down 62% YoY) and 445 deaths (down 70% from 1,481). Dr. Edmilson Migowski (UFRJ) says diagnosis is clinical; treatment is largely symptomatic, and testing is not mandatory. Preventive measures include masks and avoiding crowds.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症専門医、新型コロナの流行状況を解説し予防法を助言
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでCOVID-19（XFG株）の軽症例が増加しているが、入院・死亡は前年比で減少しており重症化リスクは低い。季節性変動の範囲内で、専門家による一般的な予防啓発記事であり緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はXFG変異株による軽症COVID-19流行の医学的解説記事。重症化・死亡は前年より減少しており、ワクチンブースター接種と一般的な予防策の呼びかけが中心。新規脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Seasonal infection surge strains Pune's critical care capacity; experts flag staff crunch
article.articleSummary: Seasonal dengue and influenza surges strain Pune's critical-care capacity. ICU beds total 2,453 of 27,235 beds across private, PMC-run, and government facilities; Pimpri Chinchwad has 8,800 hospital beds (1,800 in PCMC-run facilities, 175 ICU). Despite 893 private hospitals and a Covid-era live bed dashboard, demand in a city of more than 10 million outpaces supply, with Sassoon General Hospital and the Aundh District Hospital experiencing constant ICU pressure and two-to-three day waitlists. Some Kamala Nehru and Naidu PMC hospitals report bed availability, but private hospitals remain highly sought-after. Experts call for a city-wide real-time bed-availability system, better inter-hospital coordination, and strengthened staffing. They stress leveraging regional hospitals and incentivizing training in DNB, DrNB, IDCCM, and critical-care nursing, alongside planned infrastructure expansion.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性感染症の急増がプネーの救急医療体制を圧迫、専門家は人員不足を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・インフルエンザによる既知の医療キャパシティ逼迫の報道であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、新興感染症シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性のデング熱・インフルエンザによるプネー市内の医療資源（ICU病床・人員）逼迫に関する専門家の指摘であり、新興感染症の発生報告ではない。COVID-19は記事本文中で直接言及されていない（ダッシュボードのCOVID時代の仕組みへの言及のみ）。

article.articleHeadline: México pierde el estatus de país libre de sarampión: qué implica la decisión de la OPS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico loses its measles-free status: what the PAHO decision implies.
article.articleSummary: Mexico has lost its measles-free status after the Pan American Health Organization confirmed continuous measles transmission in the country for at least 12 months, starting Feb 1, 2025; the decision was announced in Nov 2026. United States and Bolivia also lost elimination status in the same review. Loss of status does not imply nationwide outbreaks; transmission can be localized and still meet criteria if interrupted for 12 months. To recover, Mexico must demonstrate 12 consecutive months without endemic transmission and show strengthened prevention and surveillance. Current figures: 20,701 measles cases in 2025–2026, with 14 active (12 in Chiapas, 2 in Quintana Roo). Measures include sustained vaccination, rapid case detection/investigation, improved laboratories, active case finding, and emergency support. Vaccination: MMR at 12 and 18 months, a dose at 6–11 months, catch-up 2–9 years, and a two-dose schedule for 10–49 depending on history. Vaccines are free; details at dondemevacuno.salud.gob.mx. Brazil regained measles-free status in 2024 after similar improvements.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコが麻疹排除国の地位を喪失：PAHOの決定が意味すること
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはメキシコ・米国・ボリビアでの麻疹排除国資格喪失に関するものであり、ブラジルは排除国資格を「再取得」した肯定的事例として言及されているのみで、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）における実際の発生事案ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はメキシコ・米国・ボリビアの麻疹排除国資格喪失であり、ブラジルは2024年に排除国資格を再取得した好事例として比較言及されているのみ。対象国でのアウトブレイク発生ではないため対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Três Rios realiza levantamento para identificar focos do mosquito da dengue | Petrópolis | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Três Rios Conducts a Survey to Identify Dengue-Carrying Mosquito Breeding Sites | Petrópolis | O Dia.
article.articleSummary: Três Rios launches the 2026 Rapid Indices Survey for Aedes aegypti (LIRAa) to identify larval habitats of the dengue-, Zika-, and chikungunya-transmitting mosquito. Conducted by the Municipal Health Secretariat's Environmental Health Surveillance teams, the survey visits selected properties to inspect containers and other water-collection sites and to collect samples as needed. Collected data enable measurement of infestation indices across city regions, guiding targeted vector-control actions. Community cooperation is essential; residents must allow entry for inspections and participate in source reduction—eliminating water-holding containers, and regularly checking yards, gutters, drains, and water tanks. LIRAa serves as a monitoring tool to map risk areas and allocate resources for dengue and other Aedes aegypti–transmitted diseases.

triage.headline_ja: トレス・リオス市、デング熱媒介蚊の発生源を特定するための調査を実施

triage.notes: 記事は定例の蚊幼虫調査（LIRAa）活動の告知であり、具体的な感染者数や流行拡大の記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Maternal Treatment Defers Caesarean Delivery in Late-Pregnancy Malaria
article.articleSummary: Late-pregnancy Plasmodium falciparum malaria in a 31-year-old Ghanaian woman at 37+2 weeks presented with persistent fetal tachycardia (179–186 bpm), severe thrombocytopenia (37×10^9/L), and anemia (Hb 8.9 g/dL). Initial referral suggested preeclampsia, but subsequent findings showed negative proteinuria and stabilized blood pressure. Peripheral smear confirmed falciparum parasitemia at 22,268/µL, two weeks after completing artemether-lumefantrine. A conservative, time-limited strategy emphasized intrauterine resuscitation (IV fluids, left lateral decubitus, oxygen) and intravenous artesunate (2.4 mg/kg; 204 mg at 0, 12, 24 h). Fetal tachycardia resolved within 24 hours; maternal condition improved, allowing continuation of pregnancy. At 39 weeks, labor was induced and a vaginal delivery occurred for a healthy 3.6 kg infant with Apgar scores 8 and 9. Six weeks postpartum showed both mother and neonate well. The authors note thrombocytopenia is common in malaria during pregnancy and typically improves after parasitemia clearance; this single Ghana case underscores cautious management in resource-limited settings.

triage.headline_ja: 妊娠後期マラリアにおける母体治療が帝王切開を回避
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。臨床管理に関する学術的報告に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 単一症例の臨床報告であり、マラリアはガーナにおいて既知の流行性疾患であるため新規性や異常性はない。SFTSウイルスは疾患名リストに含まれるが記事内容とは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: Early Data: Amazonas Malaria Hits Jan-Oct Low Since 2016
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Amazonas, Brazil, shows an early-2026 decline. From January through October 2026, Amazonas reported 38,149 malaria cases, a 29% drop compared with the same period in 2025. Preliminary data from the FVS-RCP indicate this is the lowest malaria caseload for January–October in Amazonas since 2016, underscoring a significant year-over-year improvement in this high-burden state. The data provide an initial signal of reduced transmission or effective control measures during the period, though they remain provisional. The report highlights the need for continued surveillance to confirm whether the trend persists across the remainder of 2026 and to guide ongoing vector-control and public health responses in Amazonas.

triage.headline_ja: 早期データ：アマゾナス州のマラリア症例、1月～10月期として2016年以来の低水準に
triage.triage_reason: マラリア症例数は前年比29%減少し、2016年以来の低水準という改善傾向を示す内容であり、公衆衛生上の脅威の増大や異常事態ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア症例の減少傾向を報告する内容であり、警戒を要する増加や異常事態ではないため見送り判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: casos aumentam no ES e Marataízes reage
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: cases rise in Espírito Santo and Marataízes reacts.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising in Espírito Santo state, Brazil, with positivity increasing from 9% to 24% in weeks. Marataízes municipality intensified prevention messages and vaccination efforts. By October 31, Espírito Santo recorded 2,073 new COVID-19–related influenza-like illness cases, of which 51 progressed to severe disease; 17 deaths were confirmed by mid-November. Most cases occur in adults 18–59, followed by those 60+, with cases also in children. Preventive measures include hand hygiene, covering coughs, avoiding close contact during respiratory symptoms, mask use when symptomatic, and protecting vulnerable individuals. Espírito Santo is among ten states to receive booster doses. Target groups: adults 60+, one dose every six months; children 6 months to under five years, three-dose schedule; pregnant women, one dose per pregnancy; special/immunocompromised groups per the National Immunization Program. Vaccination reduces complication risk; individuals should verify vaccination status and seek guidance.

triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の季節性COVID-19増加であり対象国リストに含まれないが、重症化・死亡事例もあるため経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: Contagem determina uso de máscaras em UPAs e hospital por causa da Covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Contagem mandates mask use in UPAs and hospitals due to COVID-19.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 prompted Contagem, part of the Belo Horizonte metro area, to require masks inside UPAs, the Maternity, and the Municipal Hospital, as of 17 November 2026. The city cited a rising caseload and advised people with flu-like symptoms not to visit patients to curb transmission. Contagem has 2,264 COVID-19 deaths and 84,027 infections through 4 September 2025, per the Ministry of Health. In Greater Belo Horizonte, Confins reported 12 cases recently, with 24 in the year to date, higher than all of 2025 (19). SARS-CoV-2 causes COVID-19 and spreads mainly via respiratory droplets, aerosols in poorly ventilated indoor spaces, and contaminated surfaces. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, fatigue, headache, body aches, shortness of breath, and loss of taste/smell. High-risk groups: older adults, pregnant/postpartum, immunocompromised, chronic diseases, and unvaccinated. Long-term management includes periodic vaccination for priority groups.

triage.notes: 既知の病原体（SARS-CoV-2）による季節的増加で、地方自治体レベルの予防措置（マスク着用義務化）に留まる。死亡者数・感染者数の報告はあるが過去データであり、急激な異常増加や国際的拡大のリスクを示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: நாமக்கல்லில் டெங்கு காய்ச்சல் தடுப்பு நடவடிக்கை தீவிரம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Namakkal: Dengue fever prevention measures intensified.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever prevention measures intensified in Namakkal. As of 17 November 2026, the Namakkal Municipal Corporation has mobilized 150 mosquito-breeding control workers across 39 wards and 12 adjoining panchayats to curb dengue during ongoing northeast monsoon rains. Weekly door-to-door inspections identify and destroy larval habitats and educate residents on steps to prevent breeding. Vehicle- and hand-sprayed fogging with insecticides targets adult mosquitoes, with operations along Namakkal–Salem Road, Mohanur Road, and Kadappalli, especially in waterlogged areas where transmission risk is higher. The intensified campaign accompanies rising moisture conditions and aims to reduce vector density and dengue transmission in the municipal area.

triage.headline_ja: ナマッカルでデング熱予防対策が強化
triage.triage_reason: インドのナマッカル市でデング熱の季節的な予防対策強化が報じられているが、具体的な症例数・重症度等の情報はなく、通常の季節的対応の範囲内と見られる。
triage.notes: モンスーン期における季節性のベクター対策強化を伝える行政報道であり、感染者数・死亡者数などの疫学データは記事に含まれていない。継続的な流行状況の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Tosse por duas semanas pode ser sinal de tuberculose, alerta Saúde do DF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A cough lasting two weeks may be a sign of tuberculosis, warns the Health Department of the Federal District.
article.articleSummary: Persistent cough for two weeks or more is the main warning sign of tuberculosis (TB) caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis in the Federal District, Brazil. TB is infectious and transmissible; treatment is provided free through the public health network for at least six months. Delays arise from lack of knowledge and stigma, as symptoms can resemble other illnesses. Suspected cases should seek care at a nearby Basic Health Unit (UBS); diagnosis may involve rapid molecular testing for TB, clinical evaluation, and imaging as needed. If confirmed, completing the prescribed regimen is essential to prevent relapse and the development of drug resistance, even if symptoms improve early. Prevention includes BCG vaccination for children up to 4 years, 11 months and 29 days, contact tracing with possible preventive therapy for latent infection, and maintaining ventilated, well-lit environments with good coughing hygiene. National TB Control Day is observed on 17 November.

triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核啓発・注意喚起記事であり、異常な流行や急増を示す情報はなく、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限等の懸念も確認されない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核啓発の一般的な公衆衛生情報であり、国家結核対策デー（11月17日）に合わせた広報記事。アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Novo mapa digital mostra onde a dengue avança no ES e vai ajudar a conter surtos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New digital map shows where dengue is advancing in Espírito Santo and will help contain outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Espírito Santo integrated Brazil’s GeoConass Arboviroses digital platform, enabling near-real-time geospatial tracking of dengue, chikungunya, zika and related Aedes aegypti–transmitted diseases. The state joined 19 states on Oct 23 to create daily-updated risk maps that drill down to region, municipality, and census sector, allowing health officials to target vector-control blockades, field teams, and home visits before outbreaks scale. The system uses Espírito Santo’s e-SUS Vigilância em Saúde instead of Sinan, preserving privacy by showing case counts by area rather than names or exact addresses per LGPD. Although currently stable with low transmission and no red-flag areas, the tool monitors the Minas Gerais border ahead of summer and rainy season, enabling proactive containment. Future steps include integrating neighboring-state records and climate data to forecast spread.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいデジタルマップがエスピリトサント州でのデング熱拡大状況を可視化し、アウトブレイク抑制を支援
triage.triage_reason: 記事はデング・チクングニア・ジカのサーベイランス用デジタルマップ導入に関する内容であり、現時点で感染拡大や異常事態の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性も認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・エスピリトサント州における蚊媒介感染症監視システム（GeoConass Arboviroses）の導入に関する行政・技術的な内容であり、現状は『安定・低伝播・赤旗エリアなし』と明記されている。アウトブレイクの発生報告ではないためDISMISS相当。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة: بدء تجارب لقاح ضد سلالة من إيبولا في الكونغو الديموقراطية الأسبوع المقبل - كويت نيوز
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Vaccine trials against a strain of Ebola to begin in the Democratic Republic of the Congo next week - Kuwait News
article.articleSummary: Two candidate vaccines, developed specifically to combat the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, are set to enter human trials next week in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, WHO said. The outbreak has reached 11,376 reported cases and 5,568 deaths in the DRC, which declared the outbreak on May 15. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noted that 400–500 new infections are detected each week, and about two-thirds of confirmed deaths continue to occur outside treatment centers. The trials aim to evaluate safety and immunogenicity of the two vaccine candidates, underscoring ongoing global efforts to address this Ebola outbreak in Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:来週、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の一系統に対するワクチン治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（Bundibugyo株）アウトブレイクは1万1千例超・死者5千5百人超と深刻で、ワクチン未承認・治療法未確立のまま週400〜500例の新規感染が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラのアウトブレイクは2026年5月15日に宣言され、現在までに1万1千例超・死者5千5百人超。ワクチン・治療法未承認で、WHOが治験開始を発表。死亡例の約3分の2が治療施設外で発生しており、感染制御の課題が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: أمل يطرق أبواب الكونغو الديمقراطية.. بدء تجارب لقاحين ضد "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hope knocks on the doors of the Democratic Republic of the Congo as two Ebola vaccines enter trials.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is amid a Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak totaling 11,376 cases and 5,568 deaths. Weekly new cases remain about 400–500, with roughly two-thirds of confirmed deaths occurring outside treatment centers. The World Health Organization announced that two candidate vaccines developed against the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain will enter clinical trials in the outbreak's epicenter next week, marking the first time for this strain. There is no licensed vaccine or approved therapy for Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease. The outbreak was officially declared on 15 May. The advancement of vaccines aims to curb transmission and mortality amid ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 希望がコンゴ民主共和国の扉を叩く――エボラに対する2種類のワクチン治験開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのBundibugyoエボラウイルス大規模流行(感染者11,376人、死者5,568人)が継続中で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響・国際的拡大リスクが認められ、ワクチン未承認という管理可能性の問題もあるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約49%と高く、治療施設外での死亡が約2/3を占めることから、サーベイランス・医療アクセスの課題が示唆される。Bundibugyo株に対する初のワクチン治験開始は重要な進展。

article.articleHeadline: La OPS pide reforzar la vacunación para frenar los brotes de sarampión en las Américas | HSB Noticias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PAHO calls for bolstering immunization to curb measles outbreaks in the Americas | HSB Noticias
article.articleSummary: PAHO calls for intensified measles vaccination, surveillance, and outbreak control across the Americas after Bolivia, Mexico, and the United States lost measles elimination status due to sustained transmission. The Regional Commission for Monitoring and Verification of Measles, Rubella, and Congenital Rubella Syndrome found the same virus genotype/lineage circulating endemically for 12+ months in those countries. Elimination was re-attained in 2024 after Venezuela and Brazil interrupted transmission, but by November 2025 Canada experienced transmission and is working to recover status. As of November 13, 2026, the Americas reported 58,213 confirmed measles cases and 82 deaths, up from 12,806 cases the prior year. Measles is highly contagious (up to 18 secondary infections); complications include pneumonia, encephalitis, blindness, and death, with temporary immune suppression. PAHO urges at least 95% two-dose coverage, targeted outreach, strengthened surveillance and labs, rapid response teams, healthcare worker vaccination, and airborne isolation protocols.

triage.headline_ja: PAHO、米州における麻疹アウトブレイクを抑えるためワクチン接種強化を呼びかけ | HSBノティシアス
triage.triage_reason: ボリビア・メキシコ・米国で麻疹排除status喪失、症例数が前年の約4.5倍（58,213例・82人死亡）に急増しており、IHR基準の複数該当とPAHOによる地域的な警告・対策要請が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 本イベントの主要発生国はボリビア・メキシコ・米国・カナダであり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジル・ベネズエラは2024年に麻疹の排除を達成した国として言及されており、現在の流行の主体ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: SES descarta possível caso de mpox em criança vinda do Haiti no MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SES rules out a possible mpox case in a child arriving from Haiti in Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleSummary: An 8-year-old child arriving from Haiti to São Gabriel do Oeste, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, presented with skin lesions for over 20 days. He was evaluated by SES/MS and local health authorities; mpox testing was negative and the case was discarded under Ministry of Health protocols. Samples for mpox and arboviruses were collected and sent to LACEN/MS for analysis. As of 2026-11-17, Mato Grosso do Sul has 31 mpox notifications: 2 confirmed (first in September; second confirmed on 2026-11-17), 27 discarded, and 2 under investigation. The child was released with guidance, while samples were to be sent to Fiocruz for genotyping if positive. The second confirmed mpox case remains clinically stable and in isolation. The report emphasizes cautious interpretation of rising notifications, noting that increased surveillance sensitivity may raise case counts without indicating greater virus circulation. Laboratory testing occurs at LACEN/MS, with positive samples sent to Fiocruz in Rio de Janeiro for genotyping.

triage.headline_ja: SESがハイチから来た子供のmpox疑い例を否定（マトグロッソ・ド・スル州）
triage.triage_reason: 疑い例は検査により否定され、州内の確定例も安定・隔離管理下にある。新規性・異常性に乏しく、ルーティンの監視報告の域を出ない。
triage.notes: 疑い例（ハイチ由来の渡航児童）は検査で否定。州内では2件の確定例（うち1件は直近確定、安定・隔離中）と27件の否定例、2件調査中という状況で、既存のmpox監視体制下でのルーティン報告。ハイチは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Queda na vacinação favorece retorno do sarampo, afirma especialista
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Decline in vaccination favors the return of measles, says specialist.
article.articleSummary: Measles returns to the United States after PAHO declared loss of measles-free status following 26 years, during the highest outbreak in over three decades. Since 2025, about 7,700 people have been infected and 13 have died. The resurgence aligns with falling vaccination coverage and vaccine hesitancy under Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Dr. Edmilson Migowski notes measles is the most contagious human disease, far exceeding COVID-19, influenza, or varicella, and remains eradicable if immunization stays high. He warns that an imported case could spark local transmission in Latin America, potentially affecting Brazil, which regained measles-free status in 2024 after losing it in 2019. Preventing reemergence requires sustained high coverage of the MMR and MMRV vaccines, and vigilance for rubella in pregnancy.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン接種率の低下がはしか再流行を助長していると専門家が指摘
triage.triage_reason: 米国で麻疹排除状態が26年ぶりに喪失し、感染者7,700人・死者13人を記録する過去30年で最大規模の流行となっており、ワクチン接種率低下によりラテンアメリカ（ブラジル含む）への波及リスクが専門家により指摘されているため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国における麻疹再流行であり、米国は対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジルについては『輸入症例が現地伝播を引き起こす可能性がある』という専門家の警告にとどまり、実際の症例発生は確認されていないため verified_locations には含めなかった。今後ブラジルやPAHO地域での実際の症例報告があれば速報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Еболата во ДР Конго се шири со рекордна брзина
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo spreads at record speed.
article.articleSummary: Since its declaration on May 15, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province, is expanding at a record pace. Official counts exceed 11,000 infections and 5,500 deaths, caused by a rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, making it the second-largest outbreak globally and far surpassing West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (28,600 cases, 11,000 deaths). Transmission remains uncontrolled despite substantial aid, with health workers targeted in communities, resource shortages, and mistrust hindering containment. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that uncertainty is a major barrier. MSF notes essential supplies have not reached areas outside the initial epicenter in Ituri. Worker strikes over pay persist; about $2.9 billion was pledged, but less than half disbursed. Donors are urged to coordinate with Kinshasa to avoid duplicative spending and improve the outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでエボラが記録的な速さで拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴ東部で発生中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が1万1千人以上の感染、5500人以上の死亡という記録的規模に達し、制御不能な状態が続いているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し緊急のフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事本文ではDRコンゴ(特にイトゥリ州)での流行のみが主題であり、アンゴラでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。既に5月15日の宣言から半年以上経過しており、西アフリカ2014-2016流行に次ぐ史上2番目の規模とされる極めて深刻な事例。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Catarina volta a alojar aves depois de conter surto da Doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Catarina returns to hosting poultry after containing an outbreak of Newcastle disease.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in western Santa Catarina, Brazil, prompted a 60-day zoosanitary emergency and temporary farm interdictions. Restrictions on bird housing and movement were lifted after veterinary investigations found no birds with compatible symptoms following thorough cleaning and disinfection. The first outbreak originated in a commercial turkey operation; authorities initially activated the emergency in affected municipalities, restricting farms in the area. Surveillance extended to thousands of poultry operations within the safety radius, covering both commercial flocks and subsistence holdings, with ongoing education and inspections to detect any abnormality quickly and prevent recurrences. The outbreak was reported to the World Organisation for Animal Health and international partners. Although production flow was disrupted, authorities stated that chicken meat and eggs remain safe for consumption when sourced from officially inspected establishments. Protocols remain active.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州、ニューカッスル病の流行を封じ込め後、家禽の飼育を再開
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（家禽のニューカッスル病）であり、既に封じ込めが完了し規制解除された事案。ヒトへの健康影響は報告されておらず、IHR・WPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 家禽の動物衛生事案。OIE（WOAH）に報告済みで、既に封じ込め・規制解除済み。ヒト感染例の報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: Santa Catarina libera trânsito de aves e alojamentos nas granjas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease: Santa Catarina allows movement of birds and farm housing.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, Newcastle disease measures in Santa Catarina, Brazil, have been relaxed after the five outbreak foci detected in the Oeste Catarinense (western Santa Catarina) were closed. The Ministry of Agriculture and the Santa Catarina Integrated Agricultural Development Company (Cidasc) announced that restrictions tied to the sanitary emergency area no longer apply, enabling the resumption of movement of birds and poultry housing within the state, including in areas previously delineated for intervention. The policy shift follows the end of the five foci and allows greater operational flexibility for poultry producers in affected zones. The announcement was released by the Ministry of Agriculture and Cidasc.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病：サンタカタリーナ州、家禽の移動と農場施設の制限を解除
triage.triage_reason: 既に終息した家禽のニューカッスル病流行に関する規制緩和の報道であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクは低く、新規性・緊急性も認められない。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾患であり、ヒトへの感染は稀（結膜炎程度）。本記事は5つの発生地が終息し、規制が緩和されたことを報じる内容であり、新たな公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Se registraron 58.213 casos de sarampión en América, un 355% más que en 2025: estos países lideran las estadísticas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 58,213 measles cases were recorded in the Americas, up 355% from 2025: these countries top the statistics.
article.articleSummary: Measles in the Americas surged to 58,213 cases by 13 November 2026, with 82 deaths; by 16 November the tally reached 58,795 cases and 84 deaths, a 354.5% rise from 12,806 cases in 2025. Guatemala accounts for 34,860 cases, followed by Mexico (14,087) and the United States (5,412), together about 94.4% of infections and 97.6% of deaths. Bolivia, Mexico, and the United States lost measles-free status due to endemic transmission of the same genotype for more than 12 months. Other affected countries include Peru (2,985), Canada (1,128), Bolivia (127), Brazil (67), and El Salvador (58). The Pan American Health Organization urges accelerated vaccination, surveillance, and outbreak response, stressing that at least 95% two-dose measles vaccination coverage is essential to close immunity gaps and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 米州で麻疹58,213例を記録、2025年比355%増：上位国は？
triage.triage_reason: 米州全体で麻疹症例が前年比355%増加し、複数国で麻疹排除状態が喪失するなど、国際的拡大と異常性が明確であり、IHR基準を2つ以上満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は米州全体（グアテマラ、メキシコ、米国、ペルー、ボリビア、カナダ、ブラジル、エルサルバドル、スペイン領カナリア諸島）の麻疹流行を報告。対象国リストに含まれるのはブラジルのみ（67例）であり、他国は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ആലപ്പുഴയെ വിറപ്പിച്ച് വീണ്ടും പക്ഷിപ്പനി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu terrifies Alappuzha again
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, avian influenza outbreak in Alappuzha district, Kerala, confirmed in Ambalappuzha North and Chennithala Grama Panchayats, with infections across 20 panchayats. About 26,000 poultry will be culled within a one-kilometer radius; a ten-kilometer surveillance zone enforced. Confirmation by NIHSAD (Bhopal). Six rapid-response teams from the district Animal Husbandry and Health Departments deployed for culling; emergency meeting chaired by District Collector Shaji V. Nair. Migratory birds from the US and other countries implicated as carriers; virus spreads via shed material during landing after long flights. Findings indicate the virus could affect up to a million birds per gram of shed material.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザが再びアラプーザを震撼させる
triage.triage_reason: ケーララ州アラプーザ県で家禽の高病原性鳥インフルエンザ（H5N1系統と推定）が再発しているが、ヒト感染例の報告はなく、地域の家禽業で繰り返し発生している事象である。渡り鳥による継続的な曝露リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はヒトへの感染を報告しておらず、家禽(鳥類)における鳥インフルエンザのアウトブレイクであり、地元自治体が主体的に対応（約26,000羽の処分、10km監視区域設定）している。渡り鳥による持続的な曝露の可能性があるため、今後ヒトへの波及がないか継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: México, Estados Unidos y Bolivia pierden su estatus de países libres de sarampión: alerta de la OPS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico, the United States, and Bolivia lose their measles-free status: PAHO alert.
article.articleSummary: PAHO confirms loss of measles elimination status in Mexico, the United States, and Bolivia after sustained endemic transmission. A Regional Commission found the same measles virus genotype circulated locally for 12 months or longer in each country, with US transmission starting Jan 20, 2025 (12 months by Jan 20, 2026); Mexico from Feb 1, 2025 (Feb 1, 2026); Bolivia from Apr 16, 2025 (Apr 16, 2026). As of Nov 13, 2026, the Americas recorded 58,213 measles cases and 82 deaths, a sharp rise from 12,806 cases at the same point last year. Drivers include immunity gaps, uneven vaccination coverage, limited health access, and misinformation. PAHO urges boosting vaccination to at least 95% two-dose coverage, strengthening surveillance and lab capacity, active case finding, and closing immunization gaps. Restoring elimination is possible, as Venezuela and Brazil did in 2024.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、米国、ボリビアが麻疹排除国としての地位を喪失：PAHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: 米州で麻疹の地域内伝播が12ヶ月以上継続し、複数国が排除状態を喪失。症例数・死亡数が前年比で急増しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 本イベントは米国・メキシコ・ボリビアでの麻疹排除状態喪失に関するもので、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。Brazilは2024年に排除状態を回復した成功例として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Dvije eksperimentalne vakcine protiv ebole ulaze u novu fazu testiranja uslijed epidemije u Kongu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two experimental Ebola vaccines enter a new phase of testing amid an Ebola epidemic in Congo
article.articleSummary: Two experimental Ebola vaccines targeting the Bundibugyo strain move to Phase 2 trials in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The vaccines—ChAdOx1 from the University of Oxford and Serum Institute of India, and a Moderna-developed candidate—were cleared to advance to Phase 2 in a randomized controlled study named Tumani. Testing is slated to begin November 26–27 in Bunia and will assess safety and immunogenicity, with Phase 3 planned to evaluate efficacy against a comparator. The Tumani trial, launched October 23, already includes more than 140 participants, with thousands expected as sites expand and mobile teams are deployed. WHO Director Meg Doherty noted progress amid an Ebola epidemic that has surpassed 11,300 cases and 5,500 deaths, with 400–500 new infections weekly. Ongoing challenges include insecurity, attacks on health workers, and delays in detecting infections that hinder response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行を受け、2種類の実験的エボラワクチンが新たな試験段階に入る
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,300例超・死亡5,500人超、週400〜500例の新規感染が続く大規模エボラ流行であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的対応（ワクチン治験・WHO関与）が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン治験の進展に関する内容だが、背景として既存の大規模エボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）の深刻さを報告しており、継続的なモニタリングが必要。発生地（Bunia）はDRC国内のため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Lutte contre Ebola: reprise de la grève sèche des prestataires des CTE et services PCI à Butembo, Katwa et Musienene | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Fight against Ebola: resumption of the dry strike by providers of ETCs and PCI services in Butembo, Katwa and Musienene | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Ebola treatment centers (CTEs), transit centers (CTs) and infection prevention and control (IPC) supervision services in North Kivu’s health zones of Butembo, Katwa and Musienene resumed a dry strike on 16 November 2026 after four days of partial suspension, with no accord reached with provincial authorities. A meeting at the governorate liaison office, chaired by Abbé Patrick Kasolene, saw Promesse Lumire say the temporary pause hinged on the arrival of Prisca Luanda Kamala, the provincial health coordinator, who did not attend. The providers announced the immediate end of the minimum service they had maintained since Friday and warned that no staff would be present in the targeted facilities. They demand backdated premium payments and better working conditions and salary scales. The strike raises concerns about surveillance, prevention and infection-control activities amid ongoing Ebola preparedness and response in Nord-Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策闘争：ブテンボ、カトワ、ムシエネネでCTE・PCIサービス提供者による無期限ストライキ再開
triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州のエボラ対応拠点（治療・移送センター及び感染制御部門）で医療従事者がストライキを再開し、サーベイランス・感染予防制御活動が停止する恐れがあり、既存のエボラ流行対応能力低下による拡大リスクが懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ対応従事者の労働争議に関するもので、現時点での新規感染者数・死亡者数等の疫学情報は記載されていない。対応体制の崩壊がエボラ流行の制御に及ぼす影響について続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de Maceió disponibiliza tratamento gratuito contra a tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maceió's Health Department offers free treatment for tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: In Maceió, Brazil, on November 17, 2026—National Tuberculosis Control Day—the Municipal Health Department offers free TB diagnosis and six-month treatment through the SUS. Residents may attend any Basic Health Unit for evaluation and, if indicated, sputum testing. TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis and is airborne, mainly affecting the lungs but can involve other organs. Key symptoms include a persistent cough for three weeks or more, fever (especially afternoon), night sweats, weight loss, chest pain, and fatigue. After confirmation, treatment is provided at no cost with physician supervision throughout the six months; adherence is essential. Preventive measures include well-ventilated spaces, covering the mouth when coughing or sneezing, and the BCG vaccine given at birth to protect children from severe forms. The day emphasizes awareness, early diagnosis, and combating stigma.

triage.headline_ja: マセイオ市保健局、結核の無料治療を提供
triage.triage_reason: 結核啓発デーに関する通常の公衆衛生広報記事であり、異常な発生や流行を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・マセイオ市における結核啓発キャンペーンと既存の無料治療プログラムの案内であり、新規の感染拡大や異常事態を報じるものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura do Rio amplia público de vacinação contra Mpox
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro City Hall Expands Mpox Vaccination to a Broader Population
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro city authorities expand mpox vaccination starting 17 November 2026 to include people using HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) and HIV-positive individuals with CD4 counts below 200 cells/mm³ aged 18+, who have never been vaccinated or have a medical prescription valid for six months. The vaccination schedule remains two doses 28 days apart and mpox vaccination is not part of the routine National Immunization Program; doses and guidance are set by the Ministry of Health. Rio has 5,000 doses available while stocks last. In 2026, the city reported 297 mpox cases and one death (immunosuppressed). State totals: 411 confirmed, 5 probable, 309 suspected cases. Vaccines are offered at five hubs, including Botafogo, Zona Norte (Nova América), Zona Oeste (ParkShopping Campo Grande), Centro Especial de Vacinação Dr. Álvaro Aguiar (CEVAA), and CRIE/INI Fiocruz. Public health guidance emphasizes hand hygiene, surface cleaning, symptom monitoring, isolation if symptomatic, avoiding sharing personal items, and appropriate PPE for healthcare workers and caregivers.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ市、Mpoxワクチン接種対象を拡大
triage.triage_reason: 既存のMpox流行への対応としてワクチン接種対象を拡大するニュースであり、新規性・異常性は低いが、継続的な感染拡大や免疫不全者への影響があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: リオデジャネイロ州で既に411例確認、5例疑い、309例疑いが報告されている既存流行への対応。HIV陽性者やPrEP利用者への接種対象拡大が主題で、新規シグナルというより継続中アウトブレイクの管理情報。

article.articleHeadline: Contagem determina uso de máscaras em hospitais e UPAs após aumento de casos de Covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Contagem mandates mask use in hospitals and urgent care centers after an increase in COVID-19 cases.
article.articleSummary: Contagem, in the Greater Belo Horizonte region, mandates mask use in the Municipal Hospital, Maternity, and Emergency Care Units after a rise in COVID-19 cases across Grande BH. The municipality also advises that people with flu-like symptoms refrain from visiting patients to reduce transmission to patients and healthcare staff. Itatiaia requested local case data and vaccination coverage. Fiocruz Info Gripe bulletin signals growing SRAG cases attributed to SARS-CoV-2, with increases observed in Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Bahia, and the Federal District, though hospitalizations remain low. Expert Tatiana Portella urged checking vaccination status, noting that booster doses are needed annually for priority groups. COVID-19 is an acute respiratory infection caused by SARS-CoV-2; common symptoms include fever/chills, cough, fatigue, dyspnea, myalgia, and headache, plus sore throat and congestion; transmission is widespread.

triage.headline_ja: コンタジェム市、COVID-19症例増加を受け病院・救急医療施設でのマスク着用を義務化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でCOVID-19症例増加が報告されているが、入院は低水準であり重篤度は限定的。季節性の流行拡大として続報の注視が妥当。
triage.notes: 複数州（ミナスジェライス、サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ、バイーア、連邦直轄区）でCOVID-19によるSRAG症例増加が報告されているが、入院率は低水準であり季節的な流行拡大とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Megállíthatatlanul terjed az ebola, több nehézség hátráltatja a védekezést
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading uncontrollably; several difficulties hinder the response.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-17, Ebola virus disease in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spread uncontrollably. Official counts exceed 11,000 infections and 5,500 deaths, with the outbreak ongoing for about six months. Response efforts are hampered by severe resource shortages, security concerns, and coordination difficulties. Health workers are facing attacks and intimidation in some communities, driven by distrust of foreigners, complicating containment and patient care. The outbreak's pace exceeds that of the West Africa Ebola epidemic of 2014–2016, signaling a rapidly accelerating crisis. Critical needs include safer access for responders, protection of healthcare staff, robust surveillance, and strengthened health systems to curb transmission and mortality amid challenging local conditions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが制御不能な勢いで拡大、対応を複数の困難が妨げる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ流行がIHR基準を2つ以上満たし（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大速度）、WPRO基準も複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき案件。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC東部での流行のみが言及されており、Angolaへの言及がないため除外。11,000人超の感染、5,500人超の死亡、6ヶ月継続という規模は2014-2016年西アフリカエボラ流行を上回るペースとされ、極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Msf: Ogni tre minuti un bambino muore di tubercolosi, serve implementare le linee guida
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF: Every three minutes a child dies of tuberculosis; guidelines need to be implemented.
article.articleSummary: Four-month treatment for non-severe pediatric tuberculosis (TB) can be implemented within routine primary health care, according to an MSF study in Uganda and the Philippines, presented at the Union World Conference on Lung Health in Rio de Janeiro (Nov 17–20). Of 214 children under treatment, 74% were eligible for the shortened regimen upfront, and 95% completed therapy. The regimen uses the same drugs and pediatric formulations but reduces treatment burden, fewer clinic visits, lower costs, and less exposure to side effects. Challenges include limited access to chest radiographs, gaps in health-worker training, and high staff turnover. WHO has recommended the four-month course since 2022, but uptake remains slow in many countries. MSF urges governments to invest in diagnostics, pediatric drug access, and family support. TB remains the deadliest infectious disease; in 2025, half of under-five TB cases were undiagnosed or untreated per Global TB Report 2026.

triage.headline_ja: MSF: 3分に1人の子供が結核で死亡、ガイドラインの実施が必要
triage.triage_reason: MSFによる小児結核治療の研究発表・提言記事であり、新規の異常発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は学会発表（Union World Conference on Lung Health, リオデジャネイロ）での研究結果報告であり、ウガンダとフィリピンでの臨床研究データに基づく。特定の地域での感染拡大や異常事態を報じるものではなく、対象国リストの国々（フィリピン含む）での新規発生イベントではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: quais os sintomas e quem pode ser vacinado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: what are the symptoms and who can be vaccinated
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) in Brazil: 665 confirmed cases in 2026 as of November, a 94% drop from 2022's >10,000. Symptoms include skin eruptions, fever, headache, myalgias, chills, fatigue, and lymphadenopathy; lesions can appear on the face, hands, mouth, genitals, and anal region, evolving from macules to vesicles to crusts and often painful or itchy during healing. Incubation is typically 3–16 days (up to 21). Most cases are mild to moderate with recovery in 2–4 weeks, but risk is higher for immunocompromised individuals, pregnant people, and young children. Transmission occurs via direct contact with lesions, bodily fluids, contaminated objects, and, in some cases, animal reservoirs; sexual contact with an infected person is notable. Brazil does not practice mass vaccination; SUS targets adults 18+, prioritizing people living with HIV/AIDS with CD4 <100 cells/mm³ (and some with CD4 <200), PrEP users, and certain lab workers. Post-exposure vaccination is recommended within four days (up to 14 days). Two-dose regimen, 28 days apart.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox：症状とワクチン接種対象者は誰か
triage.triage_reason: 2026年のブラジルにおけるMpox症例は2022年比94%減少しており、一般向けの症状・ワクチン接種対象者に関する啓発記事であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な拡大を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発・教育目的の一般情報記事であり、症例数は大幅減少傾向にある。ブラジル国内の既存ワクチン接種制度（HIV陽性者等のハイリスク層対象）について説明しているのみで、新規の警戒を要する内容はない。

article.articleHeadline: Cabo Frio confirma caso de Mpox em paciente da rede municipal | Cabo Frio | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cabo Frio confirms Mpox case in patient from the municipal health network | Cabo Frio | O Dia.
article.articleSummary: Cabo Frio, in Rio de Janeiro’s Região dos Lagos, reports a laboratory‑confirmed Mpox case treated in the municipal health network; the patient does not reside in the city, and their home municipality was notified for surveillance. As of November 17, 2026, Cabo Frio is the only among six regional municipalities with a confirmed case; Arraial do Cabo, Búzios, and São Pedro da Aldeia have no suspected or confirmed cases, Iguaba Grande’s October suspected case was ruled out, and Araruama had nine suspected cases in 2026, all discarded. Diagnosis was confirmed by Lacen-RJ, with SES-RJ and Ministério da Saúde protocols in place. Mpox spreads via direct contact with skin lesions, secretions, bodily fluids, contaminated objects, or close prolonged respiratory contact. Symptoms include fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, myalgia, fatigue, and skin lesions; incubation is 3–16 days (up to 21). Treatment is supportive; most recover in 2–4 weeks; close-contact surveillance is ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: カボ・フリオ市、公立医療機関の患者でMpox症例を確認 | Cabo Frio | O Dia
triage.triage_reason: 単一の確定症例であり、他の近隣自治体では疑い例が否定されるなど感染拡大の兆候はなく、支持療法で経過観察中のため重大な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は単発の確定Mpox症例報告であり、地域の他自治体では疑い例がすべて否定されている。州・国レベルのプロトコルに基づくルーチンのサーベイランス対応として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: Radio Ebola: DR Congo children fight myths over the airwaves as outbreak hits six months | Western Morning News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Bunia, reaches six months since the WHO declaration. The Bundibugyo strain has no treatment or cure; it is the second deadliest outbreak in history and the deadliest in DR Congo, with at least 5,430 deaths and 11,000 infections. Declared May 15, the outbreak has spread to 67 health zones across eight provinces. Nearly seven million people are internally displaced; about a quarter of deaths are children, and around 2,000 thousand more have been orphaned or separated from their families. Response funding stands at US$2.9 billion pledged, with less than half disbursed; some health workers have been unpaid since August; a nurse was killed and a community health worker injured by an armed mob. Thirty-five children aged 8–16 broadcast on local radio, reaching over 800,000 listeners to dispel myths and guide care, highlighting the need for sustained funding and stronger primary healthcare.

triage.headline_ja: ラジオ・エボラ：DRコンゴで発生6か月を迎えた中、子どもたちが電波を通じて誤情報と闘う
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクがDRコンゴで8州67保健ゾーンに拡大し、死者5,430人・感染11,000人に達する深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中アウトブレイクであり、既にWHOが宣言済み（2026年5月15日）。資金不足や医療従事者への攻撃など、対応の持続可能性に懸念があるため、フルリスク評価で最新状況を精査すべき。

article.articleHeadline: تليفزيون اليوم السابع يرصد تحذيرات الصحة العالمية من انتشار إيبولا وتأثر الأطفال
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Youm7 TV monitors WHO warnings about the spread of Ebola and its impact on children.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) persists, per WHO warnings cited by Youm7 TV. The coverage cites more than 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths across 67 health zones in eight provinces, with cases more than doubling over the past six months. Children are disproportionately affected: over a quarter of confirmed cases are among children, and about one third of deaths occur in this group; seven in ten children under five who are infected die. The outbreak’s reach extends beyond DRC, with Kenya reporting 9 cases linked to an imported case (including 2 deaths) and Nigeria reporting 1 imported case.

triage.headline_ja: Youm7テレビ、エボラ出血熱の拡大と子どもへの影響に関するWHOの警告を報道
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で11,000例超・5,400人超の死亡を伴うエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が継続し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの輸入症例拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCの感染規模・致死率（特に5歳未満児で7割死亡）は極めて深刻であり、速やかなフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Centros infantis suspendem atividades após casos de mão-pé-boca e sarna causarem preocupação em cidade de SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Childcare centers suspend activities after cases of hand-foot-and-mouth disease and scabies raise concern in a city in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Two municipal early childhood centers in São Francisco do Sul, on Santa Catarina’s northern coast, suspend activities to permit cleaning after an outbreak of hand-foot-and-mouth disease and scabies. Pequeno Príncipe and Peter Pan halt operations from Wednesday, November 18, with an additional closure day due to strong cleaning product odor; classes resume Monday, November 23. The preventive measure aims to ensure a safe return for students, staff, and families. Symptoms: hand-foot-and-mouth disease—fever, sore throat, reduced appetite, malaise, painful oral ulcers, and red spots with small blisters on hands and feet; scabies—intense itching and small skin lesions, often on hands, fingers, wrists, armpits, waist, abdomen, and skin folds. Families are advised to monitor for symptoms and not send symptomatic children to school, seeking healthcare if signs appear.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病と疥癬の発生で懸念、サンタカタリーナ州の都市で児童施設が活動を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の保育施設2か所における手足口病と疥癬の局所的な発生で、いずれも軽症かつ一般的な小児感染症であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクはなく、社会的・政治的関心も限定的なローカルニュースにとどまる。
triage.notes: 手足口病と疥癬はいずれも小児に多い一般的な感染症で、保育施設の一時休業は清掃目的の予防的措置。重症例や死亡の報告はなく、地域内で管理可能と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Short-Course Steroids Linked to Improved Early Hepatitis B Liver Failure
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis B virus–related pre-stage/early-stage liver failure in China showed improved short-term recovery with short-course glucocorticoids. A 10-year retrospective cohort (2015–2025) at the Affiliated Hospital of North Sichuan Medical College in Nanchong included 143 patients; 43 received adjunctive intravenous methylprednisolone (40–80 mg/day for 3–7 days, taper) plus standard antiviral/hepatoprotective care, versus 100 with standard therapy alone. All patients received nucleos(t)ide analogue antivirals (entecavir 0.5 mg, tenofovir disoproxil fumarate 300 mg, or tenofovir alafenamide 25 mg) with hepatoprotectants. The four-week composite endpoint required resolution of hepatic encephalopathy, ascites, and jaundice, plus laboratory improvement (bilirubin and prothrombin time). Four weeks: 81.4% in the steroids group achieved the endpoint vs 54.0% in controls (p<0.05). The study supports short-course steroids in HBV-related liver failure, addressing immunopathogenesis concerns in China, where HBV-related liver failure remains a leading cause of acute hepatic collapse.

triage.headline_ja: 短期ステロイド投与、早期B型肝炎関連肝不全の転帰改善と関連
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は単一病院での後ろ向きコホート研究による治療法の臨床効果報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な感染症発生を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は疫学的なアウトブレイク情報ではなく、B型肝炎関連肝不全に対する短期ステロイド療法の臨床研究結果を報告するものであり、シグナルトリアージの対象外（治療研究）と判断。

article.articleHeadline: இடுக்கியில் டெங்கு பாதிப்பு: தமிழக எல்லையில் மருத்துவ முகாம்கள் அமைக்கக் கோரிக்கை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue infection in Idukki: Call to establish medical camps on the Tamil Nadu border.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, dengue fever is rising in Kerala's Idukki district, with cases concentrated in Shanthanparai (Devikulam area) and also in Karunapuram and Nedungkandam. Public health authorities urge actions to curb transmission: eliminate standing water around homes and environs; designate Fridays for schools, Saturdays for offices, and Sundays for homes as movement-restriction days to reduce mosquito breeding. Residents should allocate 10 minutes weekly to clean surrounding areas. Thousands of workers from Theni district travel daily to Idukki's areca-nut plantations, and people from across Kerala travel into Tamil Nadu, highlighting cross-border risk. Consequently, the Theni district health department proposes 24/7 special medical camps at the Kumily, Kambammettu, and Bodimettu border areas to screen fever cases, provide treatment, and arrange follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: イドゥッキでデング熱感染拡大：タミル・ナードゥ州境に医療キャンプ設置を要請
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州イドゥッキ県でデング熱が増加し、国内他州（タミル・ナードゥ州）への越境リスクが指摘されているが、地方レベルの季節性流行の範囲であり国際的拡大の兆候はないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はインド・ケララ州で季節性に発生する既知の媒介蚊感染症。越境リスクは国内（州間）の話であり、国際的な拡大ではない。重症度や死亡者数の情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: بدء تجارب لقاحين ضد سلالة من إيبولا في الكونغو الديموقراطية الأسبوع...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Start of trials of two Ebola vaccines against a strain of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo this week.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization announced clinical trials of two experimental vaccines targeting the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola will begin next week in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The candidates are ChAdOx1 and mRNA-1469, developed specifically against Bundibugyo, to be evaluated under the Tomaini clinical platform for safety and immunogenicity, with potential move to phase III if criteria are met. Phase II is planned to start on 26 or 27 November in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province in northeast DRC, a center of the outbreak; more than 140 volunteers have enrolled, with thousands more expected and sites to be expanded beyond Bunia. The trials use ring vaccination targeting contacts and high-risk groups. Earlier, on Oct 23, Ervebo began to assess cross-protection against Bundibugyo. WHO reports 11,376 infections and 5,568 deaths; 400–500 new cases weekly; no vaccine or treatment is licensed specifically for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で来週からエボラ・ブンディブギョ株に対する2種類のワクチン臨床試験開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ株の大規模アウトブレイク（感染11,376例、死亡5,568例、週400-500例の新規発生）が継続しており、WHO主導でワクチン臨床試験が開始されるなど国際的な関与・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン臨床試験の開始に焦点を当てているが、背景にある大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクの深刻さ（致死率約49%、継続的な新規感染）を踏まえPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Aparecida Debate discute os desafios no combate à dengue no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aparecida Debate discusses the challenges in the fight against dengue in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Brazil: The Aparecida Debate on 17 November 2026 discusses transmission, symptoms, treatment, vaccination, and prevention amid concerns of new surges with summer. Brazil's 2024 dengue season was the worst on record with 6.6 million cases; this year, cases have fallen by about 70%. The discussion highlights Aedes aegypti control and the influence of climate factors, including El Niño. Participants include José Eduardo Marques Júnior, veterinarian and vector-control specialist from Guaratinguetá, SP; Sérgio Zanetta, sanitary physician; and Nathalia Franceschi, technical advisor to the São Paulo State Health Secretariat. They cover transmission dynamics, warning signs requiring medical care, risks of self-medication, treatment approaches, and vaccination via the SUS, plus home prevention practices, repellents’ effectiveness, and common errors that promote indoor mosquito breeding. The program airs Tuesdays at 22:00.

triage.headline_ja: アパレシーダ・デバーチがブラジルにおけるデング熱対策の課題を議論
triage.triage_reason: 新規の異常事態ではなく、季節性デング熱に関する教育討論番組の告知記事であり、むしろ症例数は前年比70%減少している。
triage.notes: 本記事はテレビ討論番組の告知であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。ブラジルの2024年デング熱シーズンは過去最悪（660万症例）だったが、今年は約70%減少しており、夏季の再燃懸念について専門家が議論する内容。季節性疾患の恒常的な公衆衛生教育活動として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: 麻疹疫情飆升 赴美旅遊列警示
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles outbreak surges; warnings issued for travel to the United States.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in the United States reaches 5,412 confirmed cases with 6 deaths as of November 12, the largest in 35 years, with about 11% hospitalized and 96% of cases in unvaccinated or vaccination-status-unknown individuals. The surge centers on Pennsylvania, South Carolina, and Utah. Taiwan’s CDC reports 11 measles infections (3 domestic, 8 imported) from Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, and the United States. Taiwan maintains high MMR coverage (97% in infants) and frontline vaccination above 90%; pregnant women and children under 1 are advised to avoid high-risk areas, and travelers are urged to obtain self-paid MMR vaccination 2–4 weeks before travel. Domestic influenza activity: 89,487 fever/flu visits last week, down 4.3% from the prior week, with 71 severe cases and 37 deaths; eight consecutive weekly declines, with end-of-season expected by late November. Taiwan has administered over 5.94 million flu vaccines and 1.76 million COVID vaccines; 169,000 Novavax doses have been purchased for distribution to counties.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹疫情急増、米国への渡航に警告
triage.triage_reason: 米国で過去35年最大規模の麻疹流行が発生し、ベトナム・タイ・インドネシアからの輸入症例が台湾で報告されるなど国際的拡大が確認されており、渡航警告も出されているためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 主要な流行は米国（対象国外）で発生しているが、台湾CDCがベトナム・タイ・インドネシアからの輸入麻疹症例を報告しており、これら対象国での麻疹感染リスク・活動を示唆する。米国・台湾・マレーシアは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。具体的な重症度や管理体制の詳細は記事に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: بدء تجارب لقاحين محتملين ضد سلالة من إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية الأسبوع المقبل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Starting trials of two potential vaccines against an Ebola strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo next week.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of 17 November 2026, the outbreak has recorded 11,376 cases and 5,568 deaths since it was officially declared on 15 May; weekly new infections remain around 400–500. Two vaccines specifically developed to counter the Bundibugyo strain are set to enter trials next week in the affected region, marking a step toward available countermeasures where no licensed vaccine or therapy currently exists. Notably, about two-thirds of confirmed deaths have occurred outside treatment centers, underscoring gaps in access to care. WHO data underpin these figures, while surveillance and supportive management continue in facilities and communities facing this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の2種類の候補ワクチンの試験が来週開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のブンディブギョ株エボラ流行は11,376症例・5,568死亡（致死率約49%）に達し、週400〜500件の新規感染が続く重大な公衆衛生事案であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべきである。
triage.notes: 致死率が極めて高く（約49%）、死亡の約3分の2が治療施設外で発生している点は医療アクセスの重大な課題を示唆する。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない中での臨床試験開始は国際的関心が高いと推測される。

article.articleHeadline: Shanghai Adult Respiratory Pathogen Detection Rebounded to Twenty Percent
article.articleSummary: Shanghai, a five-year multi-center study across seven sentinel hospitals, tracked respiratory pathogens in 4,738 adults (≥15) with severe acute respiratory infection (SARI). Real-time PCR screened 12 pathogens across 22 subtypes. Overall detection rose to 20.07% in 2023 after 16.50% (2020–2022) and 30.26% (2019). The period covers pre-pandemic 2019, active-pandemic 2020–2022, and post-pandemic 2023.
