Four temporal patterns emerged: a decline-resurgence for influenza, Mycoplasma pneumoniae, Bordetella pertussis, and human bocavirus; sustained decline for human parainfluenza virus, human coronavirus, adenovirus, human rhinovirus/enterovirus, and Legionella pneumophila; a transient peak for human metapneumovirus; and a continuous rise for respiratory syncytial virus. Influenza, HRV/EV, and HCoV remained among top five pathogens throughout. Mycoplasma pneumoniae was the main driver among 15–44-year-olds (33.65%). Co-infections occurred in 54 patients (1.14%), most often influenza plus Mycoplasma pneumoniae (20.37%). Ongoing multi-pathogen surveillance is essential to guard against single- and multi-pathogen epidemics.

triage.headline_ja: 上海の成人における呼吸器病原体検出率、2023年に20%へ回復
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は過去5年間の呼吸器病原体サーベイランスに関する学術研究報告であり、新規の異常事態や急性のアウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2019〜2023年の多施設共同研究の結果報告であり、サーベイランスデータの傾向分析が主題。現在進行中の異常なアウトブレイクを示唆する内容ではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Surveillance in North Sulawesi Finds Endemic Viruses Rather Than Novel
article.articleSummary: North Sulawesi, Indonesia's Minahasa District, surveillance from Nov 2017 to Dec 2018 enrolled 217 syndromic patients presenting with acute respiratory illness or fever of unknown origin at Noongan Hospital and Puskesmas Kawangkoan. Of these, 63 (29.0%) yielded viral nucleic acids by RT-PCR across nine viral families/genera (coronaviruses, influenza, enteroviruses, etc.). All sequenced amplicons showed 97–100% identity to globally circulating reference strains, confirming infections with known endemic viruses rather than novel zoonoses. No high-consequence agents—filoviruses, hantaviruses, or henipaviruses—were detected in any specimen. The study, conducted under USAID's Emerging Pandemic Threats PREDICT project, targeted a wildlife-rich, market-linked landscape with heavy wildlife contact; estimated regional wildlife trade included dozens of tonnes of bats, wild pigs, and snakes. Although daily animal contact occurred in all participants, only 6% reported high-risk wildlife exposure. The findings emphasize existing endemic viral circulation rather than emergent pathogens in this setting.

triage.headline_ja: 北スラウェシのサーベイランスで新規動物病原体ではなく既存の流行ウイルスを検出
triage.triage_reason: 2017-2018年の過去の調査研究報告であり、既知の流行ウイルスのみが検出され新規病原体や高リスク病原体は検出されなかったため、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2017-2018年に実施された過去の研究成果の学術報告であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではない。検出されたのはすべて既知の流行ウイルスで、フィロウイルス・ハンタウイルス・ヘニパウイルスなどの高リスク病原体は検出されなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Minas Gerais recebe reforço de 290 mil doses de vacina contra a covid-19; BH tem aumento de casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais receives a 290,000-dose booster of the COVID-19 vaccine; Belo Horizonte reports an increase in cases.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais will receive a supplementary batch of 290,000 COVID-19 vaccine doses to reinforce state stocks, with gradual delivery and distribution overseen by SES-MG based on local demand. The vaccine mentioned is Comirnaty (Pfizer) via SUS. In Belo Horizonte, test positivity rose to 7% in epidemiological week 43 (Oct 25–31), the highest in 2026; October began with 1%. For 2026 to date, BH reports 27,885 suspected COVID-19 cases, 449 confirmed infections, and 9 deaths, eight of whom were aged 60+. Vaccine eligibility includes children 6 months to under 5 years, pregnant women, and people aged 60+. For elderly and immunocompromised, a dose every six months; other special groups, annually. For unvaccinated children 6 months to under 5: three-dose scheme; second dose after four weeks; third after eight weeks.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州、新型コロナウイルスワクチン29万回分の追加供給を受領；ベロオリゾンテで感染増加
triage.triage_reason: 通常のワクチン接種・流行状況に関する定例報告であり、季節的な感染者増加の範囲内で、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも該当性が低い。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州における季節的なCOVID-19陽性率上昇とワクチン供給に関する行政・医療情報。死亡例は高齢者中心で、既存の対策（ワクチン接種体制）で対応可能な事象と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ouro Preto identifica casos de sarna humana em cinco escolas e creches municipais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ouro Preto identifies human scabies cases in five municipal schools and day-care centers.
article.articleSummary: Five Ouro Preto schools and day-care centers have confirmed human scabies cases: Zezinho Pedrosa Daycare, Alfredo Baeta School, Cantinho da Criança Daycare, Arnaldo Bastos Daycare, and Haydee Antunes School. Classes are temporarily suspended in affected groups, and facilities are cleaned under surveillance guidance to curb transmission; total infected is consolidated. In Belo Horizonte area, Vespasiano suspended classes after scabies was identified in five municipal and one state school, with 25 confirmed cases. Ribeirão das Neves reported at least 11 cases in two schools; São José da Lapa closed all schools and daycares for cleaning. In southern Minas, outbreaks span at least 17 municipalities, including Ingaí (22 cases, three schools closed for two days) and São Thomé das Letras (16 infections). SES-MG lists 11 municipalities with outbreaks in 2026; scabies is caused by Sarcoptes scabiei, transmitted by prolonged skin contact; treatment and hygiene measures render patients non-contagious within 24 hours.

triage.headline_ja: オウロプレット市、5つの公立学校・保育施設で人疥癬の集団発生を確認
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は軽症で治療可能な皮膚感染症であり、複数自治体で発生しているものの重症度・国際的拡大リスクは低く、EBSとしてのフルリスク評価は不要と判断。
triage.notes: 疥癬（Sarcoptes scabiei）は皮膚接触による感染症で、致死性は低く、衛生管理・治療により24時間以内に非感染性となる。学校・保育施設での集団発生はブラジル国内の公衆衛生対応事案であり、国際的な健康危機としての重大性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Morcego encontrado em Ouro Preto testa positivo para raiva
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bat found in Ouro Preto tests positive for rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in a bat found in Ouro Preto's São Cristóvão neighborhood. The mammal was collected November 13 after behavioral changes and sent to a reference laboratory in Belo Horizonte for testing; it tested positive for rabies. No human contact with the bat has been reported. Municipal Health Secretary Leandro Moreira said authorities are following Ministry of Health and state health protocols and have implemented preventive measures. Starting Wednesday, endemic control agents will conduct door-to-door visits within a 500-meter radius of the discovery site to verify pet vaccination certificates. Animals without a 2026 anti-rabies vaccine will be vaccinated. In the 2026 campaign, 150 dogs/cats were vaccinated in the area, compared with 173 in 2025. Residents are advised to keep dogs and cats indoors, especially at night, and to report any contact with bats to the Zoonoses Surveillance, and seek care if bitten or scratched.

triage.headline_ja: オウロ・プレトで発見されたコウモリが狂犬病陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: 単一のコウモリでの狂犬病陽性事例であり、人への感染報告はなく、自治体が通常の予防対策（ワクチン接種確認・巡回）を実施済みで、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州オウロ・プレトでの動物（コウモリ）における狂犬病陽性事例。人への感染は報告されておらず、地域保健当局が通常の予防措置（ワクチン接種確認、戸別訪問）を実施中。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、本事例は局所的な動物衛生事案であり、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念やシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz aponta aumento de casos graves de Covid-19; veja quem deve se vacinar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz points to a rise in severe COVID-19 cases; see who should be vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Severe COVID-19 cases are rising in Brazil, with a Fiocruz bulletin cited by Band showing increases in six states: Paraná, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Bahia, and the Federal District. In response, the Health Ministry dispatched booster doses to ten states to bolster protection for priority groups and curb complications. The guidance emphasizes boosters every six months for adults aged 60+, with immunocompromised individuals, pregnant women, health professionals, and children also prioritized. The circulating lineage is Omicron, and vaccination remains effective in preventing severe disease. Two recently treated severe cases involved unvaccinated elderly women—one with encephalitis and the other with pulmonary thrombosis—underscoring the vaccine’s protective value. Vaccination reduces risk of complications, hospitalizations, and deaths. Individuals should verify vaccination status with local health units. Examples include 69-year-old Rosivaldo da Costa and retiree Ana Denczuk, who stress keeping the vaccination card current.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルスが新型コロナウイルスの重症例増加を指摘；接種対象者を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内での季節的なCOVID-19重症例増加とワクチン接種呼びかけに関する国内保健広報であり、新規性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 既知のOmicron株による季節的な重症化例増加であり、ブラジル保健省がブースター接種を展開する通常の公衆衛生対応。国際的な脅威やIHR通報相当の事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo no Brasil entra em alerta após EUA perderem certificado da Opas com 5,7 mil casos em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles in Brazil enters alert after the U.S. lost PAHO certification with 5,700 cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak intensifies in the Americas as US loses PAHO elimination status. United States records 5,700 confirmed measles cases in 2026 through November 13, with at least eight deaths—the highest since 1991—and 97% of cases not vaccinated. In Brazil, the Health Ministry reports 65 confirmed cases by November 2026 across São Paulo, Amazonas, Rio de Janeiro and Acre, all linked to international travel or importation, with no sustained transmission. Across the Americas, outbreaks extend from Canada, the US and Mexico to Guatemala, and Peru reports 2,700 infections in 2026. Brazil has vaccination progress but gaps remain: first-dose coverage rose to 95.3% in 2026; second-dose to 80.7% (goal 95%). Measles transmission is highly contagious, capable of 18 secondary infections, with aerosol persistence. Brazil’s vaccination plan includes a dose-zero for 6–11 months in priority areas, a 12‑month first dose, and a 15‑month second dose, plus catch-up for 12–59 year olds without proof.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでの麻疹、米国がPAHO排除認証を失い2026年に5,700例を記録したことを受け警戒態勢に入る
triage.triage_reason: 米国でのPAHO麻疹排除認証喪失という異常事態に加え、ブラジルを含む米州全域で輸入例による麻疹発生が拡大しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の該当により社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は米州全体の麻疹状況（米国のPAHO認証喪失、ブラジル・ペルー・カナダ・メキシコ・グアテマラでの発生）を扱っているが、対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ。ブラジル国内は輸入例中心で持続的human-to-human伝播は確認されていない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox pode evoluir para casos graves em pessoas imunodeprimidas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox Can Progress to Severe Cases in Immunocompromised People.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November 2026, mpox in Brazil totals 1,005 cases this year, including one confirmed death in Rio de Janeiro, where vaccination will be expanded to PrEP users who have never been vaccinated. Since the start of the year, cases surged in October–November, with over half occurring in these months; infections concentrate in Southeast Brazil and major urban centers, led by São Paulo with 409 cases and Rio de Janeiro with 382, followed by Ceará, Minas Gerais, the Federal District, and Santa Catarina. About 80% of cases are men aged 18–39; transmission occurs via close personal contact, including sexual contact. Despite rising numbers, totals are about 90% below 2022. SUS maintains a vaccine stock. Experts emphasize vaccinating high-risk groups, especially immunocompromised individuals, since mpox can progress to severe disease; common symptoms include fever, malaise, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions.

triage.headline_ja: Mpoxは免疫不全者において重症化する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで継続中のMpox流行（2026年累計1,005例、死亡1例）に関する経過報告であり、新規性・異常性は低いが、免疫不全者の重症化リスクとワクチン接種拡大の動きから継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 2022年のピーク時と比較して約90%減少しており、既存の国内公衆衛生対応（SUSによるワクチン備蓄、PrEP利用者への接種拡大）の範囲内で管理されている。性的接触を介したヒト-ヒト感染が主な感染経路で、18-39歳男性が約80%を占める。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de mão-pé-boca e sarna provocam suspensão das aulas em duas creches em cidade de praia em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of hand-foot-and-mouth disease and scabies lead to the suspension of classes in two daycares in a beach city in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Two daycares in São Francisco do Sul, a beach city on Santa Catarina’s northern coast, suspended classes on Wednesday, November 18, after new cases of hand-foot-and-mouth disease and scabies were reported. Pequeno Príncipe and Peter Pan will undergo thorough cleaning and sanitization, with activities set to resume on Monday, November 23, due to the strong odor of cleaning products. The suspension is a preventive measure by the municipal Health Secretariat to maintain a safe environment and ensure transparent communication with families. Hand-foot-and-mouth disease is a contagious illness caused by an enterovirus, most common in children under five, producing lesions on hands, feet, and in the mouth. Scabies is caused by the Sarcoptes scabiei mite, causing intense itching as it burrows into the skin. Families are advised to monitor children at home and seek health guidance if symptoms appear; do not send symptomatic children to school.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病と疥癬の発生によりサンタカタリーナ州のビーチ都市で2つの保育園が休園
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの一地域の保育園における手足口病・疥癬の局地的発生であり、重症度・国際的拡大リスクともに低く、通常の予防的措置にとどまる。
triage.notes: 手足口病・疥癬ともに小児に多い一般的な感染症で、地域の保育園2施設での予防的休園措置に過ぎず、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威や社会的関心の高まりは見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde intensifica monitoramento com foco na prevenção de casos de Mpox
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department steps up monitoring with a focus on preventing Mpox cases.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) in Minas Gerais, Brazil, is under intensified surveillance by the State Health Secretariat (SES-MG). No severe cases or hospitalizations are currently reported. From January through November 2026, Minas recorded 41 laboratory-confirmed Mpox cases, predominantly among males aged 15–34; 2025 saw 136 cases, and 2024 had 68. SES-MG conducts daily epidemiological and laboratory monitoring, updates a weekly epidemiological panel, and trains 28 regional health units. Case reporting to Sinan occurs within 24 hours. Mpox is transmitted via skin lesions, sexual contact, bodily fluids, or contaminated objects. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle or back pain, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions anywhere on the body, persisting up to four weeks. Diagnosis uses lesion material tested at Lacen-MG/Funed and decentralized labs in Juiz de Fora and Diamantina. Vaccination prioritizes people with HIV/AIDS with immunosuppression, laboratory workers at Biosafety Level 2, and direct contacts, preferably within four days of exposure (up to 14 days if asymptomatic).

triage.headline_ja: 保健局、Mpox症例の予防に焦点を当てた監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州における既知のMpox流行の継続的サーベイランス報告であり、重症例・入院例は報告されていないが、性的接触等による感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 2024年68例、2025年136例、2026年(1-11月)41例と報告されており、既存の流行に対する定期的な行政モニタリング強化の内容。重症化や死亡例の報告はなく、州内での管理下にあると考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Contagem exige máscaras em unidades de saúde após aumento de casos de Covid-19 - BH 24 Horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Contagem requires masks in healthcare facilities after an increase in COVID-19 cases - BH 24 Horas
article.articleSummary: Contagem, part of the Belo Horizonte metropolitan area in Brazil, has mandated indoor mask use in health facilities—the Urgent Care Units, the Maternity Ward, and the Municipal Hospital—effective 17 November 2026, due to rising COVID-19 cases. The measure aims to curb SARS-CoV-2 and other respiratory viruses among patients, companions, and healthcare workers. The rule applies to individuals inside these facilities; residents with flu-like symptoms are advised not to visit inpatients or those under care. Common respiratory symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, fatigue, headache, body aches, shortness of breath, and loss of taste or smell. Contagem’s public health data show 84,027 COVID-19 infections and 2,264 deaths as of 4 September 2025; an April 2026 emergency declaration for respiratory diseases was noted. In Confins, 24 COVID-19 cases were recorded in 2026 (12 so far), exceeding the 2025 total of 19.

triage.headline_ja: コンタージェン市、COVID-19症例増加を受け医療施設でマスク着用を義務化 - BH 24 Horas
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地方都市における季節性COVID-19増加に対する通常の予防対策であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれにも該当せず、社会的関心も限定的で国際的な懸念材料ではない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。地方都市の季節的なCOVID-19増加に対するルーチンの公衆衛生対応であり、特段異常な事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Vacina BCG continua sendo a principal forma de prevenir a tuberculose, alerta Sesau
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BCG vaccine remains the main way to prevent tuberculosis, warns Sesau.
article.articleSummary: TB remains the leading infectious disease in Alagoas, Brazil, with BCG vaccination as the main preventive measure. The SUS-recommended vaccine is given to children at birth or up to age five, available in UBS vaccination rooms across 102 municipalities and in some maternity wards; if not administered at birth, it can be given up to 4 years 11 months. Additional prevention includes well-ventilated spaces, avoiding crowds, and covering coughs or sneezes. TB most commonly affects the lungs, though extrapulmonary disease occurs, especially in people with HIV. Early warning signs include a persistent cough for three weeks or more, fever, night sweats, weight loss, and fatigue. In Alagoas, 2025 saw 1,136 new cases and 106 deaths (36.3/100k and 3.4/100k); 2026 has 904 new cases and 59 deaths (28.9/100k and 1.9/100k) as of 2026-11-17.

triage.headline_ja: BCGワクチンは依然として結核予防の主な手段、Sesau(アラゴアス州保健局)が警告
triage.triage_reason: 結核に関する通常の公衆衛生啓発・予防接種推奨記事であり、異常な増加や新規脅威はなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列。記事は地方保健当局による定例的な結核予防啓発情報であり、2026年のデータはむしろ前年より減少傾向を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Así enfrenta el Congo la expansión de uno de los brotes de ebola más preocupantes de la historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This is how Congo is facing the spread of one of the most concerning Ebola outbreaks in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo variant, has surpassed 10,000 cases with 5,302 deaths across 67 health zones as of November 6. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for this variant; response focuses on rapid case finding, preventing new infections, and engaging communities to halt transmission. Experts describe it as the largest and most concerning Ebola outbreak in history, with about 80% of cases of unknown origin and 30–40 new infections daily. Some infected individuals are asymptomatic or mildly ill for two to four weeks, hindering detection and allowing ongoing spread. Corus International partners with the DRC, South Sudan, and Burundi under a US State Department program worth $27 million, training over 3,200 frontline workers, evaluating more than 400 health facilities, and supporting 49 health zones in the DRC for surveillance, prevention, and risk communication.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがいかにして史上最も懸念されるエボラ出血熱の流行拡大に対処しているか
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1万人超の感染者・5,302人の死者を出す史上最大規模とされるエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株、ワクチン・治療薬未承認）が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事ではブルンジ・南スーダン・米国も言及されているが、これらは対象国支援プログラムの文脈であり、エボラ流行の主体はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。ブルンジ・南スーダン・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。致死率約53%、1日あたり30-40件の新規感染、約80%が感染経路不明という点から拡大継続・管理困難な状況が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемијата на ебола во Конго бега од контрола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo is out of control.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is described as out of control. Declared May 15, 2026, the epidemic is spreading faster than the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, raising public‑health concerns as resources run short, insecurity increases, and coordination falters. Government figures report more than 11,000 infections and over 5,500 deaths since the declaration. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, far exceeding the 2018–2020 central African outbreak (3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths). Health workers face attacks, strikes over working conditions and unpaid salaries, delaying response, while supplies fail to reach flare areas beyond the initial Ituri epicenter. WHO Chief Tedros emphasizes uncertainty as a major obstacle. About $2.9 billion has been pledged, with less than half disbursed; donors are urged to coordinate with Kinshasa authorities to avoid duplicative efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）が制御不能とされ、11,000人以上の感染、5,500人以上の死亡が報告されており、過去最大規模かつ国際支援が必要な重大事案であるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: Bluedot発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC（特にイトゥリ州・キンシャサ）での流行が主題でありAngolaへの言及はないため除外。WHOのテドロス事務局長も不確実性を強調しており、国際的な資金拠出（29億ドル規模）が行われているが調整不足が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Число заразившихся лихорадкой Эбола в ДР Конго достигло 11,5 тысяч человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 11,500.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has grown to 11,500 confirmed cases and 5,630 deaths, according to the National Institute of Public Health. The daily bulletin confirms the outbreak is ongoing, first detected in April 2026, with no licensed vaccines or treatments available for the emergent Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. The report provides no laboratory confirmation details beyond the stated case counts. These figures underscore a persistent epidemic requiring continued surveillance and public health response. The article also cites international remarks: Russia expressed willingness to continue medical assistance to African countries, while a Ugandan health official highlighted cooperation with Moscow to bolster medical capacity. Key context remains the need to curb transmission and manage the outbreak amid the absence of approved, strain-specific therapies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス病感染者数が11,500人に達した
triage.triage_reason: DRCで新興のブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行が11,500例・死亡5,630例に拡大しており、承認されたワクチン・治療薬が存在しない重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ロシア・ウガンダの言及は国際協力に関する文脈であり、発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ロシアはBluedotが付与した発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストにも該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Seis mulheres denunciam dentista por suspeita de transmissão intencional de HIV em Rondônia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six women accuse a dentist of intentionally transmitting HIV in Rondônia.
article.articleSummary: Six women in Rondônia, Brazil, accuse dentist Jean José Dunga, 41, of intentionally transmitting HIV through intimate relationships. New complaints to the State Public Prosecutor's Office (MP-RO) broaden investigations; one conviction already given in August: five years in a semi-open regime and R$50,000 in damages in a related case, with another action involving three women. MP-RO seeks Dunga’s arrest again due to risk of additional victims. A victim described persistent symptoms—body pain, redness, itching, headache, fatigue—leading to an HIV diagnosis after a medical consult revealed the partner was under investigation. Investigations suggest Dunga knew of his HIV diagnosis about ten years ago and allegedly did not adhere to treatment. Public health guidance stresses prevention, early diagnosis, and antiretroviral therapy, achieving undetectable viral load and eliminating sexual transmission; those exposed should seek testing and medical guidance.

triage.headline_ja: ロンドニア州で6人の女性が歯科医をHIV故意感染疑いで告発
triage.triage_reason: 個人による意図的なHIV感染疑いに関する刑事事件であり、公衆衛生上の集団感染リスクや国際的拡大の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 刑事事件・個人間感染の事例であり、公衆衛生上の集団的感染症アウトブレイクには該当しない。対象国リストの疾病監視対象ではなく、感染症危機管理の観点からは見送り判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: OPS busca proteger a Honduras ante nuevos brotes de sarampión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PAHO seeks to protect Honduras from new measles outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: PAHO/OPS reports Mexico, Bolivia, and the United States have lost measles-free status due to sustained transmission linked to insufficient vaccination, prompting regional vigilance. Honduras remains under preventive surveillance as PAHO intensifies efforts to avert new outbreaks. The Commission’s November assessment (Nov 10–13) led to the decision; PAHO also collaborates with Brazil, Colombia, Guatemala, and Peru to strengthen vaccination campaigns. In 2026, the United States recorded 5,412 measles cases across 47 jurisdictions; Mexico exceeded 20,000 confirmed cases with 50 deaths (2025–2026); Bolivia reduced cases by 83% to 76 this year but transmission persists. Canada lost measles-free status in 2025 after 5,100 cases in 12 months. Honduras reports 13 measles cases in 2026, including a confirmed infection in a baby and an outbreak in San Pedro Sula. The main preventive measure is achieving at least 95% two-dose measles vaccination coverage nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: PAHO、ホンジュラスを新たな麻疹の流行から守るべく対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: メキシコ・ボリビア・米国・カナダで麻疹排除状態喪失という国際的に重大な事象だが、対象国リストに含まれる国（ブラジル）は協力パートナーとして言及されるのみで、実際の流行国ではないため直接的な対象国シグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はホンジュラス・メキシコ・ボリビア・米国・カナダの麻疹流行状況であり、ブラジルは予防接種キャンペーン強化のための協力国として言及されているのみで、同国自体での流行発生は記述されていないため verified_locations には含めない。対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に直接関連する流行情報は確認できず。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : appel aux leaders communautaires à intensifier la sensibilisation sur Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Call to Community Leaders to Intensify Ebola Awareness - ACP
article.articleSummary: Training workshop in Beni, North Kivu, DRC, on Ebola risk awareness and prevention for community leaders in Mabakanga and Kanzuli-Nzuli health zones, held November 17–18, 2026 at La Référence de Beni hotel. Aims to have trained community leaders own and drive Ebola risk communication across all areas. Participants include community relays, religious leaders, market women, motorcycle taxi drivers, and health-zone officials. The curriculum covered general Ebola information, pre- and post-training assessments, school-based transmission and prevention, and infection prevention and control in schools and homes, with emphasis on suspected cases. Part of broader community mobilization to strengthen public engagement in the 17th Ebola outbreak in Nord-Kivu province, eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：コミュニティリーダーへのエボラ啓発強化の呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州で進行中の第17次エボラ流行に関するコミュニティ啓発トレーニングの報告であり、新規症例急増や状況悪化を示す情報はないが、既知のアウトブレイクが継続中であるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRC北キブ州ベニで進行中の第17次エボラ流行における地域住民向け啓発活動（トレーニングワークショップ）に関する報道であり、新規の症例情報や感染拡大の具体的データは含まれていない。既存のアウトブレイク対応の一環として継続監視が適当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mambasa : l'arrivée tardive des malades au CTE accentue le taux de létalité (société civile) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mambasa: The Late Arrival of Patients at the Ebola Treatment Center Increases the Case-Fatality Rate (Civil Society) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On November 17, 2026, in Mambasa territory, Ituri province, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, delays in patients arriving at the Ebola Treatment Center are cited as a key driver of a high Ebola case-fatality rate in the Mambasa health zone. Local civil-society coordinator Abedi Yunga told health officials, response teams and government partners that late presentations, coupled with ongoing care challenges, worsen outcomes. He highlighted persistent rumors in the community, blaming ignorance and information gaps for delays, and urged residents not to hide sick relatives and to seek care at the first symptoms. He also pressed the government to clear four months of salary arrears for physicians and community relays (RECO) involved in the response. Early treatment is emphasized as increasing survival chances.

triage.headline_ja: マンバサのエボラ出血熱：治療センターへの患者到着の遅れが致死率を押し上げる（市民社会）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州マンバサで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて致死率上昇が報告されており、エボラは常に重大な公衆衛生事象としてIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は進行中のエボラアウトブレイクに関する続報であり、新規発生ではなく既存の公衆衛生危機対応の課題（患者受診遅延、医療従事者給与未払い）に焦点を当てている。フルRRAにて既存アウトブレイクの進捗状況との整合性を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Kinshasa : ONU-Femmes place la gent féminine au cœur de la riposte contre l'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinshasa: UN Women places women at the heart of the Ebola response - ACP
article.articleSummary: UN Women places protection of women and girls at the center of the Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) response in the Democratic Republic of Congo, during a Kinshasa workshop with private-sector partners organized with the Ministry of Health. Deputy representative Catherine Odimba said protecting women and girls, harnessing their expertise and decision-making power, is essential to an effective, rights-based response. She outlined six strategic axes to intensify the response: gender-responsive accountability across clusters; leadership and participation of women in humanitarian teams and community consultation mechanisms; localization and funding to improve access to resources and flexible financing for women’s organizations; data and knowledge, strengthening gender data coordination, rapid analyses, and indicators; and the prevention of gender-based violence alongside expanded access to essential health and livelihoods services to support early recovery for the most exposed women and girls. The aim is to accelerate the end of the Ebola outbreak. She urged gender-sensitive funding and ensuring resources reach local women’s organizations, with intersectional data integration (sex, age, disability) to guide programming and resource allocation.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサ：国連女性機関、エボラ対応の中心に女性を据える - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCで既知のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対する対応strategy（ジェンダー配慮）に関する記事であり、新規症例数や重症度等の疫学的更新情報は含まれていないため、フルRRAには至らないが継続監視対象とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存のDRCエボラ出血熱流行への対応（ジェンダー配慮の戦略）に関するもので、新規の疫学データ（症例数・死亡者数・地理的拡大等）は含まれていない。既知のアウトブレイクに対する人道支援・保健省連携の文脈であり、新規シグナルというよりは既存事案の継続的モニタリング対象。

article.articleHeadline: Strain-specific Ebola jab trials to start in DR Congo next week: WHO
article.articleSummary: Two Bundibugyo-specific Ebola vaccine candidates will enter testing in the Democratic Republic of Congo next week within the Tumaini trial, WHO announced, targeting the outbreak’s epicentre. The Bundibugyo strain is less common and, unlike other Ebola variants, currently has no vaccines or treatments. DR Congo's outbreak, declared in May as an international public health emergency, has produced 11,376 confirmed cases and 5,568 deaths, the worst on record for the country. The Tumaini framework will assess multiple vaccines’ safety, efficacy, and immunogenicity using ring vaccination of contacts at high risk. The Bundibugyo-specific candidates have completed earlier-phase (Phase 1) trials and will now be evaluated in combination with existing protocols to gauge immune response and protection in the ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で来週、株特異的エボラワクチンの治験開始：WHO
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で国際的に公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)に指定された過去最悪規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 本記事はコンゴ民主共和国で続く過去最悪規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（11,376例確診、5,568人死亡、5月にPHEIC宣言）に対するBundibugyo株特異的ワクチンの治験開始に関する続報。既にフルRRA対象の重大イベントと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans le Haut-Uélé : la deuxième vague de l'épidémie commence dans la province(un médecin) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uélé: The second wave of the outbreak begins in the province (a doctor) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 17 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in Haut-Uélé Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, is characterized as a second wave in the Isiro health zone. Ebola Treatment Center at Isiro General Reference Hospital reports continued patient admissions after a roughly three-week lull, with the director Dr. David Kamalu noting that Isiro alone cannot end the outbreak; cross-border health zones still face transmission. The Isiro center is somewhat standardized compared with others, yet remains susceptible to inflows from surrounding zones. Current census: 13 patients in the treatment center, of whom 7 are confirmed positive and 6 are suspected awaiting results. New cases arrive daily, including patients presenting at advanced, critical stages, complicating the decline in cases. Health authorities urge the population to adhere to control measures to eradicate Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: オート・ウエレ州でのエボラ出血熱：州内で流行の第2波が始まる（医師談）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCオート・ウエレ州でエボラ出血熱の第2波が発生し、確認症例・重症患者が継続的に発生、越境伝播リスクも指摘されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Isiro保健地域での第2波流行。治療センターには13名入院中（確定7名、疑い6名）。医師は単一地域での終息は困難と指摘し、周辺地域からの流入リスクと外部支援の必要性を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Guaíba registra aumento de casos de esporotricose em animais e anuncia plano emergencial
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guaíba records an increase in sporotrichosis cases in animals and announces an emergency plan.
article.articleSummary: Sporotrichosis outbreak in Guaíba, in the Porto Alegre Metropolitan Region, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, with 302 cats testing positive and 25 human infections (no hospitalizations). Animal positives rose from 293 to 302 (+9). Among humans, 42 notifications: 25 confirmed, 9 discarded, 8 under investigation. In response to a court decision, the municipality launched an emergency plan for surveillance, prevention, and control. Key measures include a triage protocol at the Zoonoses Control Unit due to limited municipal cat housing, free treatment, and home monitoring of about 300 cats at 30-day intervals. All human cases are in care within the public health system; no hospital admissions so far. Public guidance: avoid contact with injured animals and seek care at Hospital Nelson Cornett if symptoms appear. Transmission occurs via scratches, bites, or contact with contaminated materials (soil, plants).

triage.headline_ja: グアイーバ市、動物でのスポロトリコーシス症例増加を記録し緊急対応計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオグランデ・ド・スル州グアイーバで猫由来のスポロトリコーシスが継続的に発生し人へも感染（25例確認、入院なし）。裁判所命令により自治体が緊急サーベイランス計画を発表するなど行政の関心が高く、人獣共通感染症として継続的曝露・流行性のリスクがある。
triage.notes: 人への感染は軽症で入院例なし。動物（猫）での持続的な感染拡大が主な懸念点。地方自治体レベルでの緊急対応が報道されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola Death Toll Tops 5,500 as Cases Pass 11,000 | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has killed more than 5,500 and infected over 11,000 since authorities declared it May 15, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak sees infections and deaths rising at about twice the pace of the opening six months of West Africa's 2014-16 epidemic. The latest figure covers Congo alone; a prior regional toll of 5,376 spanned Congo, Uganda and Kenya. Response efforts face security, supply, and staffing barriers: insecurity and attacks affect health workers and field surveillance; MSF reports essential supplies are missing from hotspots away from the outbreak's original epicenter in Ituri province. Health workers have stopped work over pay and working conditions, with some unpaid since August. About $2.9 billion has been pledged for the response, but less than half has been released.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の死者数が5,500人を突破、感染者数は11,000人超に
triage.triage_reason: 史上2番目の規模となるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで死者5,500人超、感染者11,000人超。国際的拡大（ウガンダ・ケニアにも波及）、治安・資金不足による対応困難があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ・ケニア・アンゴラも含まれるが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。地域合計5,376人という過去の数値はコンゴ・ウガンダ・ケニアにまたがるが、最新の5,500人超はコンゴ単独の数値である点に留意。資金拠出（29億ドルの約束のうち半分未満が実際に拠出）の遅れや、医療従事者の未払いによるストライキなど対応能力の深刻な課題が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Doença transmitida por gatos já infectou 1.465 pessoas no RS em 2026; veja cidades com mais casos e como é o tratamento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cat-transmitted disease has already infected 1,465 people in Rio Grande do Sul in 2026; see cities with the most cases and how it's treated.
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, reports 1,465 human sporotrichosis cases in 2026 as of 17 November, surpassing last year’s total of 1,960. The Metropolitan Region accounts for most cases, led by Canoas (156), Porto Alegre (142), and Alvorada (119), with Viamão and Gravataí also high. Total notifications are 2,752—about 7% above 2025 (2,574); 1,051 cases remain under investigation (15–30 days for results). Diagnosis can use biopsy or fungal culture; direct microscopy is often negative due to low fungal load. Animal notifications total 2,510, 99% cats and 1% dogs. Guaíba faces a feline outbreak and is implementing an emergency plan after a court order for free medications within 10 days. Sporotrichosis is a fungal zoonosis transmitted mainly from cats via bites or scratches; soil exposure is a known risk. Treatment is free via SUS for 3 months to a year; seek care for skin lesions on hands/arms that spread.

triage.headline_ja: 猫から感染する病気、2026年にリオグランデ・ド・スル州で1,465人感染；症例が多い都市と治療法
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部における毎年発生している人獣共通真菌症(スポロトリコーシス)の症例報告で、前年比微増にとどまり、重症度・国際的拡大リスクは低く、地域保健当局により既に対応・管理されている。
triage.notes: スポロトリコーシスは猫由来の真菌性人獣共通感染症で、主に皮膚病変を呈し、ブラジル南部（リオグランデ・ド・スル州）では毎年一定数の報告がある風土病的事象。前年比7%増だが、地域保健当局(SUS)が無料治療・緊急対応計画を実施しており、管理可能な範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: No Thai link to Australian measles case
article.articleSummary: Measles case in Australia shows no evidence of Thai acquisition, according to Thailand's Department of Disease Control (DDC). Preliminary findings point to Bangladesh or an earlier stop on the traveler's journey. The investigation focuses on travel history and exposure, with no confirmed link to Thailand at this stage. Australian health authorities are coordinating with Thai officials and subjecting samples to laboratory confirmation to determine the infection source. The report underscores cross-border transmission potential and ongoing surveillance of travelers presenting with measles symptoms. As of 17 November 2026, authorities have not established a Thai source and are pursuing Bangladesh or earlier travel segments as possible origins.

triage.headline_ja: オーストラリアの麻疹症例、タイとの関連なし
triage.triage_reason: オーストラリアでの単発の麻疹輸入症例に関する調査報道であり、タイとの関連は否定されている。アウトブレイクの兆候はなく、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: タイは感染源である可能性が公式に否定されており、バングラデシュが推定起源として調査中だが未確定。オーストラリアおよびバングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Rio tem mais de 400 casos de mpox e primeira morte no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro has more than 400 mpox cases and the first mpox death in Brazil
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Rio de Janeiro state reaches 404 confirmed cases as of 17 November 2026, with 288 in the capital and the first mpox death in Brazil this year. Over two-thirds of cases are in Rio de Janeiro city, incidence about 4 per 100,000 population; other confirmed cases are distributed across municipalities such as Nova Iguaçu, São Gonçalo and Niterói. Symptoms are dominated by skin lesions resembling blisters or rashes, including in the genital area, with fever, headache and fatigue also reported. There are 341 suspected cases under investigation, with 48% of analyzed suspicions confirmed. The municipal health network is vaccinating adults over 18 living with HIV/AIDS (CD4 < 200 cells/mm³) per Ministry guidance, and 2,000 vaccine doses have been dispatched to the state. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids; prevention emphasizes avoiding contact, hand hygiene, cleaning surfaces, laundering contaminated items, and completing isolation as advised.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州でmpox症例400件超、ブラジル初の死亡例
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロ州でmpox症例が404件に達し、同国初の死亡例が報告された。HIV/AIDS患者など免疫不全者への感染拡大リスクがあり、複数自治体への拡散も確認されているためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 死亡例が報告されており、HIV/AIDS患者（CD4<200）への重点的なワクチン接種が実施されている。感染経路は密接接触・体液を介するもので、現時点で国際的拡大の明確な兆候は記事内に記載なし。続報でブラジル国内の対応能力や感染動向を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Sai lầm cần tránh khi mắc bệnh giun rồng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mistakes to avoid when infected with Guinea worm disease
article.articleSummary: Guinea worm disease (dracunculiasis) newly recorded in several northern provinces of Vietnam. As of 18 November 2026, transmission occurs via water or food contaminated with Dracunculus larvae. Common clinical features include skin nodules with itching and swelling, discharge, and the worm emerging from the skin; some patients report self-extraction of a 15–20 cm white filament, while others have worms that die beneath the skin. Wound infection can lead to septicemia, tetanus, or joint infections. There is currently no pre-symptom diagnostic test and most cases are diagnosed when the worm protrudes; no specific drug treatment exists. Patients should not self-medicate or attempt removal themselves, especially by injection, as breaking the worm can disseminate larvae and toxins. Removal should be performed in a healthcare facility with proper hygiene to minimize complications.

triage.headline_ja: 竜巻症（ギニア虫症）感染時に避けるべき誤り
triage.triage_reason: 世界的に根絶間近とされるギニア虫症（dracunculiasis）がベトナム北部の複数省で新たに確認されたとの記述があり、非流行国での発生は極めて異常であり、合併症（敗血症・破傷風）のリスクも示唆されるためフルRRAでの確認が必要。
triage.notes: ギニア虫症は世界保健機関の根絶プログラム対象疾患であり、近年の確認例は南スーダン・チャド・エチオピア・マリなど限られた国に集中している。ベトナムでの発生報告は非常に異例であり、診断・感染経路・患者数等の続報確認が必要。記事は患者向け注意喚起（誤った自己治療の回避）が主眼であり、公的な疫学調査報告ではない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Boletim de Arboviroses: Prefeitura reforça prevenção e monitora casos em Vitória da Conquista
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arboviral Disease Bulletin: City Hall reinforces prevention and monitors cases in Vitória da Conquista.
article.articleSummary: Arboviral disease bulletin for Vitória da Conquista reports Week 45 (8–14 November 2026). Dengue has 15 notified cases (14 probable, 1 discarded) and 14 under investigation. Dengue probable cases are spread across multiple neighborhoods. Compared with Week 45 of 2025 (29 probable), dengue shows a downward trend. Cumulative dengue in 2026: 1,205 notifications, 929 probable, 37 confirmed, with no deaths to date. Chikungunya records: 3 cases notified, probable or under investigation, similar to 2025 Week 45 (4). Year-to-date chikungunya: 110 notifications, 103 probable, 3 confirmed. Zika: no new cases this week; year total 6 notifications and 1 confirmed. Data from Sinan Online remain dynamic as labs progress. Prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water, covering tanks, cleaning gutters, and proper waste disposal to curb Aedes aegypti. Seek care for fever, body pains, rash, or nausea; contact Centro de Endemias at (77) 3229-3151.

triage.headline_ja: アルボウイルス感染症速報:ヴィトーリア・ダ・コンキスタ市、予防を強化し症例を監視
triage.triage_reason: 通常の自治体による定期的な感染症サーベイランス報告であり、デング熱は前年同期比で減少傾向。死亡例もなく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 定例の週次アルボウイルス感染症モニタリング報告。デング熱・チクングニア熱ともに前年同週比で横ばいまたは減少傾向。ジカ熱は新規症例なし。死亡例報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: US, Mexico, Bolivia lose measles elimination status
article.articleSummary: United States, Mexico and Bolivia have lost measles elimination status after sustained transmission of the virus was re-established in the three countries, PAHO announced following the Nov. 10–13 regional review. The Measles, Rubella and Congenital Rubella Syndrome Elimination Regional Monitoring and Re-Verification Commission concluded that the same measles virus genotype and lineage circulated uninterrupted for 12 months or more, meeting criteria for endemic transmission. PAHO accepted the recommendation to withdraw elimination status. The Americas had achieved measles elimination in 2016, regained it in 2024 after interruption in Venezuela and Brazil, but lost verification in November 2025 due to Canada's sustained transmission. PAHO cautioned that this deterioration complicates efforts to restore regional elimination and urged strengthened vaccination, surveillance and outbreak response. Achieving and sustaining at least 95% coverage with both measles vaccine doses in every community remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: 米国・メキシコ・ボリビアが麻疹排除認証を喪失
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は米国・メキシコ・ボリビアにおける麻疹排除状態の喪失であり、対象国リストに該当する発生国が主題として含まれていないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事はPAHO（米州保健機構）地域における麻疹排除状態の喪失を報じており、主題国は米国・メキシコ・ボリビア（いずれも対象国リスト外）。ブラジル・ベネズエラは2016年達成・2024年再達成という過去の文脈で言及されているのみで、現在の主題発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: "Известия": первая российская поливакцина защитит от новых штаммов коронавируса
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Izvestia: Russia's first multivalent vaccine will protect against new coronavirus strains.
article.articleSummary: Russia's Gamaleya Center announced registration of a polyvalent SARS-CoV-2 vaccine containing antigens from the Wuhan strain, Delta, and Omicron, designed to protect against all known variants including PJ.2.1. The developers say two multivalent vaccines for intranasal and parenteral use target multiple genotypes, incorporating both spike and capsid proteins, to maintain efficacy as the virus evolves. The shot is ready for deployment, with partners sought to scale production. PJ.2.1 emerged in May 2026 and has been detected in Canada, the United States, and Spain; as of end-October, Russia had not reported PJ.2.1 cases. Experts cited in the article note extensive cross-immunity among coronavirus lineages, suggesting that existing vaccines or prior infection may still confer protection against new variants.

triage.headline_ja: イズベスチヤ：ロシア初の多価ワクチン、新型コロナウイルスの新変異株を防ぐ
triage.triage_reason: 記事はロシアの新規多価ワクチン開発・承認に関する報道であり、対象国（中国等）における新規感染拡大等の公衆衛生イベントではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発の技術的発表であり、中国（武漢株由来の歴史的言及のみ）やカナダ・米国・スペインでのPJ.2.1変異株検出に言及しているが、これらはいずれも対象国リストに含まれない、または主題ではないため verified_locations は空。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde alerta para reforço da vacinação contra o sarampo no Ceará
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health urges strengthening of measles vaccination in Ceará.
article.articleSummary: Ceará reinforces measles vaccination amid regional outbreaks. No confirmed measles cases have been reported in Ceará since 2022, and there are no active suspected cases. Gov.br alerts are encouraging residents to check vaccination status as cases rise in other South American countries, highlighting the risk of reintroduction via imported infections. In 2026, Ceará reports 96% first-dose and 85% second-dose coverage for the measles-containing vaccine (the triple viral vaccine protecting measles, mumps, rubella). Health officials emphasize completing the schedule, especially for children, due to the disease’s potential serious complications including pneumonia, as well as cardiac and neurological sequelae. Vanessa Soldatelli and Ana Karine Borges warn that insufficient coverage could allow measles to return to the state, given active outbreaks across the Americas and neighboring Peru.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、セアラ州で麻疹ワクチン接種強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: セアラ州（ブラジル）では2022年以降麻疹の確定症例・疑い症例はなく、現時点では予防的なワクチン接種強化の呼びかけに過ぎないが、南米他国での麻疹流行と接種率の伸び悩みから再流入リスクがあり、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・セアラ州における麻疹ワクチン接種率向上キャンペーンに関するもので、同州での実際の症例報告はない。ペルーなど周辺国での流行が言及されているが、ペルーは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Minas Gerais reforça vigilância e monitoramento contra a Mpox
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais strengthens surveillance and monitoring against Mpox.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports 41 confirmed Mpox cases from January through November, predominantly men aged 15–34. The state logged 136 notifications in 2025 and 68 in 2024. SES-MG coordinates 28 units, provides training, and requires municipalities to enter case data into Sinan within 24 hours; daily epidemiological and laboratory monitoring and weekly panels guide actions. Laboratory confirmation uses samples sent to Lacen-MG/Funed and laboratories in Juiz de Fora and Diamantina; there is no specific treatment, only supportive care. Mpox spreads via skin lesions, sexual contact, bodily fluids, respiratory routes, or objects; incubation is 6–21 days, and lesions may appear on the face, hands, or genitals and persist up to four weeks. Vaccination targets people living with HIV/AIDS and immunosuppressed (CD4 <200 in six months), biosafety Level 2 lab workers, and close contacts, within four days of exposure and up to 14 days if asymptomatic. No severe cases or hospitalizations reported.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州、Mpox（エムポックス）対策の監視体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州での既知のMpox流行に関する定例的な監視報告であり、重症例・入院なしと明記されているが、性感染・ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性がある疾患のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ミナスジェライス州の既存Mpox監視体制の強化に関する定例報告。2024年68件、2025年136件、2026年41件（1-11月）と推移しており新規異常事態ではない。重症化・入院例なしと明記。州独自の体制で対応できており外部支援の必要性は低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm A có thể khiến người khỏe mạnh nguy kịch, bác sĩ khuyến cáo đừng chủ quan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A can cause healthy people to become critically ill; doctors warn not to take it lightly.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A can cause severe illness even in healthy adults, with rising cases across northern Vietnam, transmitted by droplets. In Phu Tho Province General Hospital, a 55-year-old previously healthy man developed influenza A–associated pneumonia with acute respiratory failure unresponsive to mechanical ventilation, requiring 7 days of VV-ECMO to survive. In Hanoi’s Thanh Nhan Hospital, about 50 influenza A cases are being treated, expanding beyond high-risk groups to younger adults. A 26-year-old woman from Bat Trang experienced 40°C fever for three days before seeking care, followed by nearly a week of treatment to recover. Experts warn that influenza A can deeply injure alveoli, cause pneumonia, progression to ARDS, and possible bacterial co-infection, underscoring not to delay care. Urge vaccination for under-5s, seniors, pregnant women, and those with chronic or immunocompromising conditions; reinforce hand hygiene, masks, cough etiquette; seek emergency care if shortness of breath, chest pain, altered consciousness. Do not self-medicate.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAは健康な人でも重篤化する可能性あり、医師は油断しないよう警告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの重症化例（ECMO使用例含む）が北部ベトナムで増加しているが、新型・異常病原体ではなく通常の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの重症化事例に関する医療啓発記事であり、ハノイ・フート省で症例が増加している。ワクチン接種や受診遅延への注意喚起が主眼で、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示唆する内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 降幅6～10℃！湖南断崖式降温来袭，省疾控发布防病提醒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 6–10°C drop! A precipitous temperature plunge hits Hunan as the Hunan Provincial CDC issues disease-prevention reminders.
article.articleSummary: From 16 to 18 November 2026, Hunan Province, China, faces a rapid cold front with a 6–10°C temperature drop and strong winds. Xiangxi and Xiangbei see daytime highs of 15–19°C (later 13–18°C) and nighttime lows of 9–13°C (down to 6–8°C by the 18th); overall, highs fall to 12–15°C at the bottom. Health authorities warn abrupt cooling increases risks of cardiovascular and cerebrovascular events (hypertension, heart attack, stroke) via vasoconstriction and blood pressure fluctuations, and worsens respiratory diseases as dry air irritates airways, provoking cough, wheeze, and COPD exacerbations. Immunity may dip, raising influenza, respiratory syncytial virus, and Mycoplasma transmission and cross-infection risk. High-risk groups include the elderly, cardiovascular patients, asthma/COPD sufferers, infants/children, and outdoor workers. Preventive guidance covers layered clothing, masks in closed spaces, ventilation, influenza vaccination for vulnerable groups, moderate outdoor activity, warm meals, and seeking medical care for persistent chest pain, dyspnea, fainting, or neurological signs (slurred speech, facial asymmetry).

triage.headline_ja: 6〜10℃の急落！湖南省に大寒波到来、省疾病予防管理センターが疾病予防を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 寒波に伴う一般的な健康注意喚起の記事であり、特定の異常な感染症発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性の気温低下に伴うインフルエンザ・RSV等への一般的注意喚起であり、特定の発生・アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dấu hiệu nhận biết 4 bệnh lây truyền qua đường tình dục phổ biến
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Signs to recognize the four most common sexually transmitted diseases.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam highlights four common sexually transmitted infections: Chlamydia, Gonorrhea, Trichomoniasis, and Genital Herpes. Many STIs are asymptomatic yet transmissible, making safe sex and routine screening essential to prevent infertility and pregnancy complications. Chlamydia often has no early signs; when present, symptoms may appear 1–3 weeks after exposure and include painful urination, abdominal discomfort, discharge, and pain during sex. Gonorrhea signs typically emerge about 10 days after exposure and can include thick discharge and dysuria, with possible pelvic or rectal symptoms. Trichomoniasis, caused by Trichomonas vaginalis, may appear 5–28 days after contact; women commonly have vaginal discharge with odor, itching, and painful urination or sex. Genital herpes presents with red bumps, blisters, or ulcers and itching; the first outbreak is most severe, and transmission can occur without visible sores. Emphasizes prevention and treatment adherence.

triage.headline_ja: 一般的な性感染症4種を見分ける兆候
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な性感染症に関する健康啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は性感染症の症状啓発を目的とした一般的な健康情報記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや症例報告を伴わない。ベトナム国内の特定事案ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Perubahan Iklim Perluas Habitat Nyamuk Penyebab DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate change expands the habitat of dengue-carrying mosquitoes
article.articleSummary: Climate change and extreme El Niño are expanding the habitat of Aedes aegypti, raising dengue fever risk in Indonesia. By October 2026, Indonesia logged 98,946 dengue cases and 265 deaths across 467 districts/cities in 33 provinces, with 488 of 514 districts still experiencing annual increases. UGM epidemiologist Riris Andono Ahmad notes regional variation due to ecology and seasons. Beyond climate, household water management shapes mosquito populations; during dry seasons, water storage can create breeding sites. The Pontang coastal region illustrates how limited clean-water access drives rainwater storage that sustains mosquitoes even in dry periods. Warmer temperatures may let Aedes aegypti survive in subtropical and highland areas, broadening endemic zones. Recommended actions include multi-source surveillance (weather, mobility, etc.), cross-sector coordination, persistent larval source management, and strong community engagement. Early warning relies on case numbers exceeding five-year averages; prevention starts at home.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動がDBD（デング熱）媒介蚊の生息域を拡大
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでデング熱の症例数・死亡者数は多いが、気候変動による生息域拡大という季節性・構造的な解説記事であり、突発的な異常事態としての新規シグナルではないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は気候変動とデング媒介蚊の生息域拡大に関する分析・啓発記事であり、2026年10月までの累計症例数（98,946例、死亡265例）は既存の年次傾向の報告。突発的アウトブレイクの通知ではなく、長期的傾向把握のための継続監視対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Paraná registra 14 casos de mpox em 2026; veja cidades com confirmações
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraná records 14 mpox cases in 2026; see cities with confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Paraná, Brazil: As of November 2026, Paraná has 14 confirmed mpox cases this year, far fewer than the 44 registered across all of 2025. Londrina leads with 5 cases, followed by Marialva (3) and Curitiba (2); Foz do Iguaçu, Maringá, Araucária and Ivaiporã each recorded one case. The 2026 cases are predominantly male (13 men, 1 woman); age 20–39 accounts for 12 cases (11 men, 1 woman), with two additional men aged 40–59. Common symptoms include skin lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy, weakness; headaches, myalgias, chills, sweating, and rashes may accompany. Transmission occurs mainly through close contact with an infected person or contaminated objects, with potential respiratory-droplet spread; infection persists from symptom onset until lesion healing. Suspected cases should seek care and observe isolation; hygiene and protective measures advised for contacts. Brazil recently purchased 25,000 mpox vaccine doses; vaccination uses two doses 28 days apart. Data for 2026 remains provisional.

triage.headline_ja: パラナ州、2026年にmpox14例を記録；確定症例のある都市一覧
triage.triage_reason: Mpox症例は2025年の44例から14例へ減少しており異常な増加は見られないが、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が継続するため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 症例数は前年比で減少しており、ブラジル国内でワクチン25,000回分を確保するなど対応は進んでいる。既知の疾患で特段の異常性は見られないため、現時点ではフルRRAの必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: DKI kemarin, warga lapas diperiksa TBC hingga Sekolah Luar Biasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yesterday in DKI Jakarta, inmates were screened for TB, including at Special Schools.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) screening for inmates and their families was conducted at Jakarta Narcotics Prison (Lapas Narkotika Jakarta) in Jakarta, Indonesia, to prevent TB transmission and enable early detection. The free health checks will trigger immediate action if TB is found, per Yudi Suseno, Director of Health Care and Rehabilitation at the Directorate General of Prisons. This initiative highlights TB as the infectious-disease focus within the Jakarta news roundup dated November 17, 2026. The article also covers non-disease topics in DKI Jakarta, including education funding discussions for Special Schools and urban development plans, but TB surveillance at the prison stands as the primary public-health item described.

triage.headline_ja: 昨日のDKIジャカルタ:刑務所収容者への結核検診、特別支援学校の話題まで
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内での通常の結核スクリーニング活動を報じるもので、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はなく、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の流行病であり、本記事は通常の予防的検診活動を報じるのみで、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: الأسبوع المقبل.. الكونغو تختبر لقاحين جديدين لمواجهة سلالة إيبولا الأخطر | القاهرة الاخبارية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Next week, the Congo tests two new vaccines to confront the deadliest Ebola strain | Cairo News
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo will start clinical trials next week on two candidate Ebola vaccines targeting the Bundibugyo strain: ChAdOx1 (Oxford University/Serum Institute of India) using a chimpanzee adenovirus vector, and mRNA-1469 (Moderna) using mRNA technology. Trials, conducted under the Tumaini framework in Bunia, Ituri province, northeastern DRC, are scheduled to begin Phase II on November 26–27 to assess safety and immunogenicity, with results guiding progression to Phase III. Both vaccines have completed early Phase I testing, and WHO expert groups endorsed their inclusion. The ring-vaccination approach will immunize contacts of cases and high-risk individuals to curb transmission, with expansion to additional sites beyond Bunia anticipated. Separately, since October 23, Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) is being evaluated for cross-protection against Bundibugyo. Over 140 people have enrolled; thousands expected, with initial Phase II findings anticipated in early 2027.

triage.headline_ja: 来週、コンゴは最も危険なエボラ株に対抗する2種類の新ワクチンの治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）に対する接触者へのリング・ワクチン接種が実施されており、現在進行中の感染拡大が示唆される。国際的な関心・支援（WHO、英国・インドの研究機関が関与）も高く、WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア）で実施中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）ワクチン治験に関する内容。接触者へのリング・ワクチン接種が行われている点から、現地で症例が発生していることが示唆される。インド・英国は製薬・研究機関の所在地であり、発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Oficina da Sespa destaca estratégias de enfrentamento às arboviroses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sespa Workshop Highlights Strategies to Combat Arboviral Diseases
article.articleSummary: Arboviruses dengue, chikungunya, and Zika are the focus of the Sespa Integrated Arboviroses Workshop at the 1st Regional Health Center in Belém, Brazil. Held 16–18 November 2026, the event prepares the 2026/2027 season amid Amazonian winter conditions that favor Aedes aegypti transmission in Belém, Ananindeua, Marituba, Santa Bárbara, and Benevides. Participants include Sespa, municipal health secretaries, the Ministry of Health, and the Evandro Chagas Institute. The program covers climate influences, epidemiology, prevention, surveillance, vector control, and patient care, with emphasis on dengue management in urgent care, pediatric considerations, and the role of primary health care in early identification and follow-up. The workshop aims to strengthen inter-municipal coordination, CIEVS alerting, and contingency planning for outbreaks. Community prevention emphasizes eliminating water containers, sealing water tanks, cleaning gutters, and discarding tires and bottles to reduce Aedes breeding.

triage.headline_ja: SespaのワークショップがArbovirus（節足動物媒介性ウイルス感染症）対策戦略を強調
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジル・ベレンで開催された季節前対策ワークショップに関する行政的な内容であり、実際の異常な感染拡大や症例急増を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節前のデング・チクングニア・ジカ対策ワークショップに関する内容であり、具体的な症例数や流行状況の報告はない。例年実施される予防活動の一環と考えられ、通常のarbovirus流行シーズン対応の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: GC녹십자엠에스, 한타바이러스 진단 키트 2종 수출허가 획득
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: GC Green Cross MS has obtained export approval for two hantavirus diagnostic kits.
article.articleSummary: GC Green Cross MS (GCMS) has secured export approvals from South Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety for two hantavirus diagnostics: a rapid immunodiagnostic kit and a PCR-based molecular kit. The rapid kit was approved on Oct 30, followed by Nov 12 for the PCR kit, expanding GCMS’s hantavirus line beyond ELISA-based research-use reagents. Hantavirus, mainly rodent-borne, can cause severe diseases such as hantavirus hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) and hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS). The company aims to leverage accumulated diagnostic tech to broaden global markets, using its overseas sales network to increase countries and product offerings. Future targets include mpox and Ebola. Separately, GCMS announced a strategic cooperation with China’s Yuwell to expand home healthcare, including CGM, strengthening domestic and regional competitiveness.

triage.headline_ja: GC녹십자엠에스、ハンタウイルス診断キット2種の輸出許可取得
triage.triage_reason: 記事は企業の診断キット輸出許可取得に関するビジネスニュースであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の懸念を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国企業の診断キット輸出承認および中国企業との提携に関するビジネス/産業ニュースであり、実際の感染症発生事例は報告されていない。発生地域（韓国・中国）も疾患発生国ではなく企業所在地である。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus silencioso: Caav intensifica testagem de HTLV nesta quarta-feira, 18
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Silent virus: Caav intensifies HTLV testing this Wednesday, the 18th.
article.articleSummary: On Wednesday, November 18, the Center for Care and Life Support (Caav) will host a public HTLV testing and awareness event in two shifts, 8:00–11:00 and 13:30–16:00, offering free serology tests, guidance in the waiting room, and early diagnosis. HTLV (human T-lymphotropic virus) is a retrovirus that targets the immune system and can be transmitted via unprotected sex, sharing sharp instruments, or mother-to-child transmission (including breastfeeding). Caav’s technical lead nurse Saadi Oliveira Ribeiro notes most carriers are asymptomatic (about 93–94%), while roughly 7% may develop serious conditions such as HTLV-associated myelopathy/tropical spastic paraparesis. The virus was identified in the 1980s, two years before HIV. The event aims to increase testing and awareness among the population.

triage.headline_ja: 静かなるウイルス：Caavが11月18日水曜日にHTLV検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の啓発・検査イベントに関する地域保健活動の告知であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や急性のアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内の地域医療機関によるHTLV検査啓発イベントの告知であり、アウトブレイクや新規感染拡大の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnam Morning Monitor: Students win int'l award for eco-friendly bricks, dengue cases rise in major cities
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases rise in Vietnam’s major cities: Ho Chi Minh City logged 2,099 cases in the week of November 2–8 (up 16.8% from the four-week average), while Hanoi recorded 619 cases in November 6–13. Health experts warn patients to seek immediate care for warning signs such as severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, lethargy, unusual bleeding, and cold extremities, and underscore vaccination plus mosquito control to reduce transmission. Separately, a very strong El Niño endangers the Mekong Delta with saltwater intrusion and potential water shortages; six localities—Tay Ninh, Dong Thap, Vinh Long, Can Tho, An Giang, and Ca Mau—are urged to prepare water-use plans and proactively store freshwater. Dak Lak Province also forecasts heavy rain (Nov 19–21) with risks of flash floods and inundation, prompting evacuation and safety measures. The round-up also highlights ECOVAL eco-friendly bricks by Ho Chi Minh City students and other items.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム朝のモニター：学生がエコブリックで国際賞を受賞、主要都市でデング熱症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム主要都市でデング熱症例が季節的に増加しているが、重症度や死亡者数などの詳細情報が不足しており、記事全体も総合ニュースの一部としての言及に留まるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで季節性の流行が通常みられる疾患であり、本記事も総合ニュースの一部としての報道。重症度や入院率、死亡者数などの詳細データがなく、突出した異常事態とは断定できない。

article.articleHeadline: Nhiều bệnh truyền nhiễm gia tăng tại Vĩnh Long
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many infectious diseases on the rise in Vĩnh Long.
article.articleSummary: Vĩnh Long Province, Vietnam, reports rising infectious diseases: dengue fever, hand-foot-and-mouth disease, rabies, and meningococcal meningitis. Dengue cases total nearly 7,300 this year, up over 12% versus the same period last year, with about 50 severe cases and 2 deaths. Hand-foot-and-mouth disease numbers exceed 7,200, up 70% year-on-year. A rabies exposure incident occurred Oct 30–Nov 2 in Phú Thành hamlet, Giao Long commune: nine residents bitten by a stray dog; the dog died and tested positive for rabies. Public health actions include intensified surveillance, early outbreak detection, and containment of new foci; the provincial CDC will closely monitor transmission and aim to fully contain outbreaks. Coordination with the Department of Livestock and Veterinary Medicine is being used to manage dogs/cats and the rabies outbreak. Hospitals will ensure triage, screening for dengue and hand-foot-mouth, and maintain isolated treatment areas; localities supervise households and nurseries.

triage.headline_ja: ヴィンロン省で複数の感染症が増加
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の死亡例・重症例、手足口病の大幅増加（前年比70%増）、狂犬病曝露事例が同時に報告されており、地方当局が監視強化と対応を行っている。WPRO基準（重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、行政機関の関心も高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 発生地域データにはQuảng Ngãi省の座標情報が含まれているが、記事本文はVĩnh Long省（メコンデルタ地域）について述べており、Bluedotの地域付与に誤りがある可能性が高い。国レベルではVietnamのみ確認。複数疾患（デング熱・手足口病・狂犬病・髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎）が同時増加している点に注意が必要。
